tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/mesbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
'bring rimaslobama'iklogadebanorabu'ibangamadzod/
'bringarimaslobara'iXsangebajorabu'ibangamadzong

dkar chagaskya rengs ma shar gong la/ (1)zla bcu ba'i dmar 'dzing / (13)khi long si ji yi 6 phyir rgol rdul du brlags pa/ (25)ma ya khi hpho si ji/ (37)hang gha ri su'u we ed spyi mthun rgyal khab/ (45)gsar brje'i dpa' mo ra'o sa lag dzem lhag (53)pho brang wer se le'i nang gi kha rtsod/ (63)ke mal gyi gsar brje/ (72)lnga the khrin rgyal phran/ (80)she thi ler la ji ltar dbang thang rgyas pa/ (87)le phu zeg zhal lce'i rgyal kha thob mkhan/ (101)bcom brlag tu btang ba'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gsar ba/ (112)'tshe med zhi bas rgol cing mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul/ (122)'jar pan gyi 662 26 don rkyen/ (131)war so shor ba/ (140)/ tun khir khe'i byas rjes ngo mtshar can/’ (146)te ku li'i 6 pho ran si'i rang dbang gi las 'gul (154)hpha ran si'i 6 nya yi 'char gzhi/ (162)nor we'i rgyal tshong mkhan khe'u si len/ (178)

rdung rdeg drag po'i mdun du mgo ma sgur cig (178)dka' nyen che ba'i byang 'khyag rom rgya mtsho'i mtsho lam (188)war so yi ye'u the ba/ (198)'jar pan dmag gis mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byas pa/ (205)bar lam gling phran gyi mtsho kha'i dmag 'khrug (218)yen si then dang rdul phran mtshon cha/ (228)ljid chu'i dmag 'khrug (234)si ta lin ku rid kyi srung skyob dmag 'khrug (241)sbrag rtags kyi 'thab 'dzing / (254)mu so li nyi yi phugs 'bras/ (261)ya ma mo to sgo rju ro khub tsher phung sdug por dur 'jug byas pa/ (272)nor man dhe skam sar bskyod pa/ (277)the o man btson du sdod skabs/ (286)nā dzi 'jigs la babs pa (293)'jar pan gyis lab gleng med par mgo btegs pa/ (302)rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa the gor/ (308)zho po nā dang kho'i zlos gar gsar rtsom/ (318)rlabs che ba'i glog brnyan 'khrab ston pa thra phi lin/ (326)'dzam gling gi ri mo ba grags can phi khā so/ (334)2

skya rengs ma shar gongag/spyi lo 1917lo'i zla 3par/༷ u ru sir zla ba gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i las 'gul byung ste gong ma'i srid dbang sger gcod lam lugs rtsa gtor btang / gsar brje'i rjes su/ bzo zhing mang tshogs kyis bzo dmag 'thus tshab su'u we chad 0 rtsa 'dzugs byas shing / 'byor ldan gral rim dang zhing bdag tshos gnas skabs srid gzhung btsugs par brten/ srid dbang gnyis dus mnyam du gnas pa'i rnam pa byung / gnas skabs srid gzhung gis mu mthud du btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'khrug bslangs te rgya che ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs bran du bkol ba ma zad/ thabs brgya jus stong gis bzo dmag 'thus tshab su'u we chad rtsa med gtong rgyu'i ngan sems bcangs lo de'i zla 7par/ gnas skabs srid gzhung gis dmag dpung bsdus te gsar brje'i stobs shugs dang ngal rtsol mi dmangs la phyogs yongs nas rgol mgo bcoms/ des srid dbang gnyis dus mnyam du gnas pa'i rnam pa mjug bsgril ba dang / ngal rtsol mi dmangs sngar mus su sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar med pa mtshon thub/lo de'i zla dgu ba dang bcu ba'i nang / u ru si'i rgyal sa pe ti ku rid ②de rgyal yongs kyi sa khul gzhan dag dang 'dra bar 'bangs mi ser gyi 'tsho ba nyin re bzhin je sdug tu song / grong khyer gyi 'bangs mi rer nyin rer bag : dzñā / ṭwāṃ sdi /gaX zlo ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ stu /

leb pung dugacig re bgo ba de rim gyis pāng re'i bzhi cha'i gsum tsam las med par gyur/ gza' 'khor zhig la bag leb tog tsam yang thob mi thub par/bag leb khang du 6 mkho sprod byed rgyu med ces pa'i byang bu bkal ba'i gnas tshul yang byung / dus der/ pe ti ku rid kyi gnam gshis kyang ha cang sdug ste/skya thing thing gi nam mkhar 'a nye'i mdog gi sprin pa skya bo dma' sar 'khor yod la nyi 'od 'phro ba'i dus yun nyin bzhin je thung du gyur zhing / mtsho khug nas g.yug pa'i grang rlung gis smug sprin stug po gang sar gtor nas khrom srang yongs la khyab par byas/ skabs 'gar drag char sha ra ra 'bab pa'i gnam gshis sdug po'ang yod/ mi rnams kyis srang 'ga' tsam las mi btsong ba'i bag leb de nyo e thub bsam ste char rlung drag po'i nang du gral ring bsgrigs da/sa la bud med re 'gas byis pa'ang pang ste skya rengs ma shar gong nas gral ba ga( rjohā byig gi rin gong bla lhag gis 'phar te shing tog mod pa'i dus tshigs su'ang sil tog rdog rer ro'u pil dugacig re dgos la/ u ru si'i mi la med du mi rung ba'i lham yu ring cha rer ro'u pil brgya lhag ster dgos/skabs de'i las bzo pa'i cha snyoms kyi zla phogs ro'u pil so lnga las med/tshong pa grung po tshos go skabs de dang bstun nas rgyu nor ham thob byas pa dang /gnas skabs srid gzhung gi 'go khrid de tshor ka ra dang mar/ ja/ bag leb sogs ci dgos dgos ma 'dzoms pa gcig kyang med/skabs der/ pe ti ku rid kyi zla bcu ba'i tang mi dang khrims 'dzugs dmangs gtso'i tang / mi dmangs spyi tshogs ring lugs pa/ men hri we khe/rjos // mee/ lto/ dhi/mitstsha /zlos 6rtsag maste/ zhung phyogasapa'i don no

men hri we khi rgyal spyi'i ring lugs pa/ gcig gyur phyogs khag spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang / g.yon phyogs spyi tshogs gsar brje'i tang mi/ ches mtho'i rtsa 'dzin phyogs khag sogs rtsa 'dzugs bcu lhag gis kyang rang rang gi bya bar brtson gyin 'dug de dag las 'ga' re ni mngon gsal gyi rtsa 'dzugs yin la kha cig ni phyed gsang ba'i rtsa 'dzugs yin pa dang / la la ni gsar brje'i dpung khag dang kha gyes te gnas skabs su btsugs pa'i tshogs pa yin la/ 'ga' res gsar brje la yi rang byed mod kyang pul hri we khe dudang mnyam 'brel mi byed cing / kha cig gis gnas skabs srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed pa ma zad pul hri we khe la'ang 'khon sems bcangs yod/ srid tang de tsho'i khrod kyi mi re 'ga' ni 'jon thang che zhing jus la mkhas pa'i srid don pa yin la kho tsho'i mchan 'og tu 〈〈bsgrags gtam 〉〉mam 〈〈'bod skul 〉〉sogs 'dra min gyi yig chas bkang ba'i ko khug re btsir te su'u we chad gnas yul te pho brang si mol ne ༷ru 'gro 'ong byed la/ 'chal gtam sna tshogs spel te gsar brje'i dmigs 'ben gyi kha gzhan du bskor rgyu'i re ngan bcangs/zla 9pa'i zla stod la/②'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang por zhugs pa'i u ru si'i spyi khyab dmag spyi chen mo khur nee lo rmu 0yis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyab skyor 'og g.yul sa nas skya dmag cun shog gsum pa pe ti ku rid la rgol du mngags te nyin re bzhin stobs shugs bskyed kyin pa'i pul hri we khe rtsa med gtong ba'i zhir du gnas skabs srid gzhung las kyang log spyod dang sger gcod che ba'i srid dbang zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i stong bsam bcangs/ pul hri we khe tang krung dbyang gis le nyin gyi 〈〈zla bzhi ba'i rtsa gnad 〉〉gzhir bzung ste/ཿ sa〉〉 gne khe/bya/////shāshā shā spyoḥsbyospyo ste/ mang phyogasapa zhesapa'i don no ཿ sasdo / tā smyugarnyisbyi 'asdi ṭā 5sdumi ༵ 5/4 5550955/0 lkosko77 lko18yo 1854 3

nyin gnyis gsum gyi yun la mi grangs nyis khri lnga stong can gyi dmar srung ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas shing ngo log pa'i khrod du dril bsgrags pa mang po mngags te bsam pa'i slob gso byed du bcug nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes/ ngo log zing 'khrug rdul du brlags pa dang / khur ne lo tru yang dmag dpung nang khul du gsang ba'i sgo nas rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i dmag mi'i u yon lhan khang gis bzung ba red/ thengs 'di'i 'thab rtsod brgyud de/ phul hri we khe'i snyan grags je cher song / rgyal sa dang grong khyer che khag ga'an dag gi su'u we chad kyi dbang cha yod tshad pul hri we khes bdag tu bzung yod/ yin na'ang /gnas skabs srid gzhung gi tsung li khi long si ji 0yis nyin re bzhin rgyas bzhin pa'i gsar brje'i stobs shugs brlag pa'i phyir du/ bzo grwa'i sgo bsdams pa dang lcags lam skyel 'dren byed mtshams 'jog pa sogs gdug rtsub che ba'i bya thabs spyad de gsar brje'i mgo mnan pa ma zad/ tha na mi rigs kyi bla btsong rgyu'i bsam pa'ang skyes te/ dmag dpung phyir 'then te rgyal sa 'jar man gyi dmag la sprad de 'jar man par brten nas gsar brje rdul du brlag rgyu'i re stong bcangs/ de 'dra'i gnad la thug pa'i skabs der/tang krung dbyang gis le nyin hphin lan ṭi du nas gsang stabs kyis phyir pe ti ku rid du bos te 'os langs la dngos su 'go khrid du 'jug rgyur thag bcad/zla bcu ba'i zla stod kyi gnam ngo 'thibs pa'i nyin 'ig la/ bo je li na ya ༷me 'khor sa tshigs nas pe ti ku rid kyi phyogs su skyes pa gnyis dal gyis 'gro ba'in yod/ skra lor dkar rtsi byugs shing kha spu gtsang mar ba'ar te ye shu chos pa'i cha lugs spras pa'i mi zhig gis 'gro grogs kyi gtam la nyan zhing ྅ sni rnyi ṭwāṃ /sgyu /// 〉(31〉sbya4'aXtso 5550456 55tshem mo 1881—1970

'gro/ kho'i grogs pos bshad stunar du jirsha ཿ༅7 〉yar mar la dogs zon gyi mig 'gas 'phen/ de gnyis ni ye shu chos par brdzus pa'i le nyin dang tang krung dbyang rmi gi gsang kyisag pa skyes byedo 95 he 05 () zerdod/ ci kho sanyis nyen kha che ba'i 'grul bzhud ji mjug basmil te le nyin la ched du gra sgrig rdosna byas pa'i shesang ba'i sdod gnas te/ pe tso ti ku rid kyi sher to li(7lolkolko/)lam chen gyi sgo rtags ang 92pa'i hpho hpha zerdo ba () 'phrung 95 11na/ gnas de ṭaḥ/ — tang krung dbyang gis nyin re bzhin zla bca ba'i gsar brje'i skabs kyi gsang yig pa mngags te dza drag che ba'i sdu byad bsgyur ba'i le nyin/gnas bab le nyin la yar zhu byas shing tshags par dang yig cha sna tshogs bskyal/ le nyin gyis gsang ba'i sdod gnas de ru nyin re bzhin mtshan gung bar phyag las gnang zhing / ngal ba'i tshe yar bzhings nas khang pa'i nang nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas la/ khang pa 'og ma'i mi rnams dogs tshom mi yong ched/ khong gi gom sgra shin tu chung /zla 10tshes 8nyin/ le nyin gyis 〈〈'brel ba med pa'i mi zhig gi bsam 'char 〉〉zhes pa'i zin bris nang du/ 66deng gi srid dbang su'u we ed kyis bzung ba de don dngos su drag po'i 'os langs 'byung ba'i snga ltas yin ’ zhes bris yod la / nyin der/ khos tang rtsa 'dzugs la springs pa'i 'phrin yig cig ཿ lha py-i ṭwāṃ bte yas/ tshoḥṭha ṣṭha lo1 5

tu/ 6 deng skabs kyi gnas tshul ltar na/ dus 'gyangs byed pa de 'chi bdag la sgug pa dang mtshungs 7zhes bris yod/ zla bcu ba'i tshes bcu nyin la tang krung dbyang gis dmigs bsal tshogs 'du bsdus shing le nyin gyis tshogs thog tu 'os langs thad kyi gnad don bton pa ma zad gsal bshad kyang byas/nyin de'i dgong mor/ le nyin gyis gnas bab la dbye zhib byas pa ga'ir bzung ste/ tang gis mi 'gyangs par drag po'i 'os langs slong rgyu thag gis bcad pa ma zad/ le nyin gtso byas pa'i chab srid cu dang 'os langs dmas la 'go khrid byed pa'i gsar brje'i dmag don spyi khyab pu'u btsugs pa red/zla 10tshes 16gi dgong mor/ char 'bab kyin yod la/ pe ti ku rid grong 'dabs kyi khang pa nyis thog cig tu 0glo bur mi mang po 'dus la/ skar ma re 'ga'i nang blo mthun re bslebs yong /khang pa'i nye 'khor du glog sgron med pas kho tshos mun nag spar stob kyi tshul gyis 'dam chus bkang ba'i rkang lam brgyud de sems chung ngang gnas der 'dzoms/ der yong mkhan rnams kyis dang thog sa gnas de mi shes /tang gi 'phrin skyel pa'i brda sbyor ltar du kha chad byas pa'i gnas su 'phrad la/de nas mi gcig gis kho tsho bskyal nas der yong ba red/ dgong mo der/tang krung dbyang gis gnas de nas rgya skyed tshogs 'du bsdus te kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi 'os langs gnad don la gros bsdur byas/gnas der yong mkhan tsho'i khrod du krung dbyang gi u yon yod pa ma zad/tang krung dbyang dmag don cu dang pe ti ku rid grong khyer u yon lhan khang /bzo tshogs dang lcags lam ma lag gi blo mthun tsho'ang 'dus yod/ kho tsho 'og zhol gyi khang mig gnyis kyi nang du bkod sgrig byas te dkyil gyi 'ded sgo phye /kye nasasatshal khul bgos rang skyong cus/

yod/ khang par glog sgron gcig las bkar med la sgron khebs kyis btums yonā pas /ga 'od rab rib tsam las med cing dra ma'ang yol ba mthug pos ga gasdo go/ /mo'i chu tshod bdun lon pa dang ye shu chos pa'i cha lugs spras pa'i le nyin blo mthun gzhan zhig dang 'grogs te gnas der thon byung / khos skra rdzun ma de blangs pa na blo mthun tshos da gzod khong le nyin yin pa ngo shes/ de ma thag kho tshos mos gus dang brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus te le nyin gyi g.yas g.yonā mtha' 'khor du 'dzoms/ blo mthun 'gas khang pa'i phyi rol du so srung byas /sa/ tshogs mgyogs por 'tshogs mgo brtsams/ gros tshogs kyi mgo 'dzin pa blo mthun ca li nyen 0gyis skad dma' mos/ 6 rgya skyed gros tshogs da lta mgo rtsom/ thog mar blo mthun le nyin gyis snyan zhu 'bul rgyu red ces bshad/ le nyin yar langs te zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu nyin gyi krung dbyang gis drag po'i 'os langs slong rgyu'i thad kyi chod don bklags rjes/ blo brtan 'gyur med kyis/ 6 deng gi gnas bab ltar na/ blo thag rbad chod kyi srid jus shig cis kyang gtan 'khel bya dgos/ srid jus de ni drag po'i 'os langs bya rgyu nyag cig red ces bshad pa dang / 66chod don 'dir krung dbyang nas gros 'cham byung zin la/ 'thad pa min pa'i shog byang gnyis las med/ de ni blo mthun ca me nyi hphu dudang jis no be yan spru duganyis red/ gal te de ring kho gnyis kyis da dung bsam 'char 'don 'dod na rgya skyed gros tshogs 'di'i steng nas gros bsdur bya chog ces bshad/ཿ ཿ tā snye ṭwā// sdu5pa~X5 5 〉〉mi kāhrīḥzla18/rdo31snye/nyu460 jigano rshayan rmu/ 795la la24gyi 55byag50mtsho sna lko1883—1936 7

de nas/ si ber thu lo rmu 0yis zla bcu ba'i tshes bcu'i gros tshogs steng 'dems pa'i 'os langs 'go khrid pa'i chab srid cu yi mi sna'i ming tho dang gsar brje dmag don spyi khyab pu'u yi mi sna'i ming tho bsgrags pa dang sa gnas so sos drag po'i 'os langs la gra sgrig byas pa'i gnas tshul yar zhu byas/zhib cing phra ba'i yig cha de dag las sa gnas so so'i tang rtsa 'dzugs dang rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyis tang krung dbyang gis 'os langs kyi 'go khrid de gnas skabs srid gzhung gi dbang sgyur gang myur gyis mjug bsgril rgyu'i 'dun pa drag po bcangs yod pa shes thub/rgya skyed gros tshogs su zhugs pa'i jis no be yan hphu yis si ber thu lo hphu yi snyan zhu la mi nyan zhing rgyal yongs kyi gsar brje'i gnas bab snang med du bzhag nas/ skad gdangs drag pos 6 blo mthun ca me nyi rmu nged gnyis kyi lta ba blo mthun tshang mas shes gsal red/ de ring ngas da dung dri ba zhig 'don bsam yod/ 'os langs la rgyal kha thob sha stag gi gdeng tshod yod dam med/'os langs byas nyin nas dri ba 'dir lan yang dag cig yod dgos/ de min na/ zla bdun pa'i ya nga ba'i mjug 'bras de bskyar du myong rgyur gdon mi za/nga tsho'i dgra bor rtsa 'dzugs ldan pa'i jus 'don pu'u chen po zhig yod pa nges par du shes dgos/ nga tshor ci zhig yod ces bshad/ khos bshad mtshams bzhag ste yud tsam yar mar la bltas rjes mu mthud du/ na nga tshos 'os langs slong dgos pa bden mod/ 'on kyang / gal te khyod tshos gza' 'khor gnyis kyi yun la srid dbang 'dzin thub rgyu nga la khag theg byed thub na/ ngas khyod tsho dang lhan du 'os langs bya chog mices bshad/jis no be yad spru yis bshad mtshams bzhag pa dang mnyam du/ ca me nyi /kye giber thu lo spru/ 150 767sgog0 5564jibaX mo po lkolko1883—1919

hphu yis der mthud nas/ 6 krung dbyang gis chod don la gros 'cham byung nas gza' 'khor gcig 'gor rung da dung ci yang bsgrub med pa ma yin nam/ khos bshad phyogs bsgyur te mu mthud du/ smyo tag tag red/ rgol ba'i dus tshod smin zin pa ni dngos gnas red/ 'on kyang / nga tshos zla 'di'i tshes nyi shu nyin 'tshogs rgyu byas pa'i thengs gnyis pa'i su'u we yed 'thus mi'i tshogs chen ma 'tshogs gong la nges par du 'os langs slong dgos pa'i gnad de gang la thug yod/ da lta ma byas na nam yin rung 'os langs mi byed zer bag la yin te/ rgyal kha thob sha stag gi gdeng tshod yod rgyu de gnad dam pa yin pa las skog g.yo ngan jus byed rgyu ni ga la yin zhes bshad/krung dbyang u yon je rin si jiXyis skad cha de thos ma thag yar langs te khro nyams dang bcas/ 6 ca me nyi spru yis blo mthun le nyin gyi thabs jus de g.yo thabs red ces skur ba 'debs pa de 'chal gtam kho na red/ 'os langs la rgyal kha 'thob par g.yo thabs la mi brten par sngon thon gyi gral rim la brten dgos tshul blo mthun le nyin gyis krung dbyang la springs pa'i 'phrin yig tu sngar nas gsal bor bstan yod/ 'phrin yig de blo mthun ca me nyi rmu rang gis bklags myong ba ma zad krung dbyang gis gros bsdur yang byas myong ba de brjed song ngam zhes bshad/rtsod gleng khrod le nyin gyis thengs gsum la gtam bshad de 'os langs byed par 'thad pa med pa dang 'os langs phyir 'gyangs byed 'dod pa'i log par smra ba re re bzhin sun phyungs shing / mthar rting gnon gyi tshul du/ 6 mi la lar/ nga tshos srid dbang 'dzin mi thub snyam pa'i 'jigs snang yod mod kyi/skabs 'di ni nga tshos srid dbang 'dzin pa'i dus bzang nyag cig yin zhes ༷ je rin giji/ 'jalas037776045shācijitshanam45tshe po'i cha1871—1926 9

bshad pa dang / khos da dung / gros tshogs kyis krung dbyang gi chod don la chog mchan bkod de gang myur gyis 'os langs slong rgyu'i gros gzhi bton/'os langs slong pa'i nyi ma nam yin krung dbyang u yon lhan khang nas thag gcod byed dgos mod/ 'on kyang ches 'gyangs na'ang thengs gnyis pa'i su'u we chad 'thus mi'i tshogs chen ma 'tshogs gong yin dgos tshul bshad/le nyin gyis chod don gyi 'char zin bklags rjes/ gros tshogs kyi 'go 'dzin pas/ 6 da lta gros thag gcod ces bsgrags pa dang mnyam du shog byang 'phen pa'i thabs kyis thag bcad la/ yid mthun byung ba'i shog byang dgu basbya ༵nga 'thad pa min pa gnyis/ 'thad min gyi lta ba gang yang mi brjod pa ba byes/ tshogs grol dus tshes bcu bdun gyi skya rengs shar 'dug 'thus mi tsho tshogs ra las thon te 'os langs la gra sgrig byed du song / krung dbyang u yon tsho mu mthud du gnas der 'tshogs te tang krung dbyang gi gsar brje dmag don spyi khyab pu'u ni gsal bsgrags byas pa'i pe ti ku rid kyi su'u we ed gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi grub cha yin pa dang 'os langs la bye brag tu 'go khrid bya rgyur thag bcad do//zhogs pa'i nyi zer 'phros pa dang mnyam du/ krung dbyang u yon tsho'ang re re bzhin tshogs ra las thon song / tshang ma song tshar rjes le nyin yang tshogs ra dang kha bral/ skabs der char 'bab kyin yon pas le nyin gyi gon pa char chus brlan zhing / char rlung drag pos zhwa mo dang skra tshab sar 'phangs pa de khos myur du blangs te mgo la gon rjes mdun du bskyod song /de'i phyi nyin/ men hri we khe'i〈'tsho ba gsar ba〉zhes pa'i tshags par steng du/ na yu ca me nyi hphu yis che'os langs gleng ba : zhes pa'i dpyad bsdokā thung ngu zhig spel yod/ rtsom yig tu/ 6 'os langs slong ba'i gnad

don gang nus ci mgyogs kyis gros bsdur byed byin yod pas/ blo mthun jis no bee yan rmu nged gnyis kyis pe ti ku rid dang mo si kho/duḥn lan ḍi sogs rtsa 'dzugs che khag la 'phrin yig btang nas/ nga tsho'i tang gis nye dus su drag po'i 'os langs slong par rbad chod kyis ngo rgol byas yod/ nyin 'ga' nas su'u we ed 'thus mi'i tshogs chen bsdu ba'i don dngos snang med du bzhag ste drag po'i 'os langs slong rgyu ni gtan nas mi 'os pa zhig yin la/de ni 'byor med gral rim dang gsar brje rtsa med gtong thabs shig red ces 'khod yod/si ber thu lo spru yis nyin de'i snga dror kha par gyi lam nas le nyin la gnas tshul de bshad pas/ le nyin tshig pa gting nas zos te/ 6 'di ni ngo log sha stag red/ drag po'i 'os langs thad kyi gnad don tshabs chen 'di 'dra ba krung dbyang gis thag bcad rjes kho tshos rjod dung tshags par steng du bkod de khi long si ji la gsang ba bsgrags pas mi tshad/ khyab bsgrags ma byas pa'i gros chod la rgol gtam btang ba 'di las thal che ba'i ngo tsha khrel med kyi ngo log cig gang na yod/ 'di las lhag pa'i khrel dang ngo tsha med pa'i bla 'tshong gi spyod la ma zhig gang na yod/ snga na med pa'i bla 'tshong gi sbyor ngan 'di lta bur ya lan mi slog pa ni nyes pa chen po red mi ces bsdigs pa dang /mu mthud du khro nyams dod pa'i sgo nas/ 6 zhabs 'dren 'di gnyis kyi byas nyes kyis nga tsho'i bya gzhag la gnod pa ci 'dra bzos pa ngas yid tshod byed dka' yang / gal te nga tshos mngon gsal 'dzem med kyis sun 'byin byas na bya gzhag thad du nyam nyes de bas che ba thebs srid/ yin na'ang / rkyen ngan 'di nga tshos nges par du bzlog thabs bya dgos/ ngas tang krung dbyang dang ཿ swā trī tta /spru // snashā sna : spru shāganyisabastan 11

'thus mi tshogs chen la re ba bton te kho gnyis ci nas kyang tang rtsa 'dzugs las phyir 'bud gtong dgos ’ zhes bshad/le nyin gyis kha par bzhag ma thag smyu gu blangs te tang yongs la 'phrin yig cig bris/ 'phrin yig gi mjug tu/ 6 gnas bab sdug po/ las 'gan ljid po/ ngo log chen po ’ zhes pa bris te de ma thag tu gsang yig pa mngags te si ber thu lo hphu la sprod du bcugade'i phyi nyin/ tang krung dbyang u yon lhan khang gis ca me nyi hphu krung dbyang las phyir 'bud rgyu thag gis bcad cing / jis no be yad hphu dang ca me nyi hphu yis tang gi gros chod la rgol gtam gtong mi chog pa byas/'os langs kyi gra sgrig bya ba sngar las brel 'tshub ngang sgrub kyin yod/

zabacuba'i dmar 'dzing /wa mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus gsar ba'i glegs bam gyi kha phyes pa/zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer bzhi'i duzhogs par/ char ba sam sem 'bab cing / pe ti ku rid kyi khrom srang gi tshags par btsong sa yongs la nyin de'i tshags par gsar ba bkram 'dug tshags par de dag gi par ngos dang po'i gsar 'gyur thog mar/ gnas skabs srid gzhung gis dmag don slob grwa'i slob ma'i dpung mngags te pul hri we kher rgol rdung byed rgyu yin par ma zad pe ti ku rin kyi su'u we yed kyi 'go khrid dang gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi u yon 'dzin bzung bya rgyu yin pa'i gnas tshul bkod yod/gnas skabs srid gzhung gis da dung sung chen g.yas g.yon gyi gyang ngos yongs la bsgrags yig sbyar te mi dmangs 6 lhod 'jags yong ba'i 'bod skul btang /dgun gnas pho brang gi thang chen du/ me phyogs dmag dpung bstar zhing g.yul ra'i mtha' yongs su sa sgye brtsigs/ spyi khyab jus 'don pu'u yi sgo chen du rlangs 'khor mang po 'dus shing dmag dpon skor dang skor spyi khyab jus 'don pu'u yi gros tshogs khang du 'gro bzhin yod/ gnas de nas kho tshos 'byung nye ba'i 'os langs drag gnon byed thabs la gsang gros byed kyin yod/gnas skabs srid gzhung gis thog mar phul hri we khe tang krung dbyang giX uru si'i lusas rnying / 13

〈bzo pa'i lam〉zhes pa'i tshags par khang gtor ba'i sbyor ba bcoms/ drag chas spras pa'i slob ma'i dpung gas tshags par khang bkag sdom byas shing /tshags par bsdams sgril mang po 'phrog la/ lhag ma rnams ral bar gshags te sar g.yugs/ kho tshos me mda' tho bar byas te lcags par sil bur bcag cing kha gris 'phrul chas kyi 'khor thag bcad/ bzo pa tshos kho tsho'i bya spyod mi 'os tshul bshad par dmag dpon gyi chas spras pa tshig gis me mda' bzung ste khro ngar dang bcas te/ 6 nga chos dmag khul bka' bkod khang gi bka' sgrub kyin yod ’ ces bshad/tshags par 'tshong ba'i byis pa skor zhig nam rgyun ltar tshags par khang gi sgo khar 'dus te tshags par len du yo nga yod pa slob ma'i dmag gis gang sar bdas/zla gnyis pa'i gsar brjer zhugs myong ba'i phu the lo spru (ṣṭhaṣṭha lko)bzo grwa'i dmar srung dmag mi wa zhis le (7khrotsho)tag tag de nas brgyud de 'gro la/ tshags par khang gtor ba'i gnas tshul dngos su mthong bas de ma thag nye logs kyi tshong khang zhig tu song ste pul hri we khe hrin tan khul u la kha par btang ste rang gis mthong ba yod tshad gsal bor bshad pas/ khul mus de ma thag bzo pa'i lam〉gyi sgrig gtso si ta lin tshul yar zhu byas/skabs der/ si ta len dang si ber thu lo rmu/ je rin si ji/ pis ti o ye si jis/ an tung no spru sogs kyis pho brang si mol nee ru gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi gros tshogs 'tshogs kyin yod/ kho tshos gnas tshul de go ma thag gsar brje spyi khyab pu'u yi gnas yul pho brang si mol nee la so srung nan mo byas te 'os langs kyi gra sgrig bya ba gang legs bsgrub rgyu thag gis shā ta lin/ /bya ba mtho(1879—1953)

bcad/ so srung gi 'gan blangs pa'i dmar srung dmag mis pho brang si mol ne yi smi nyis brgya nyi shu'i ring tshad kyi bar khyams su me mda' sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs drangs pa dang thog rim dang po dang gnyis pa'i dra ma'i kha ru 'phrul mda' btsugs shing sgo chen du khrab ldan 'khor lo drug star la bsgrigs/ me mda' thogs pa'i dmar srung dmag gis so srung byas te lam yig med par pho brang si mol ne ru 'gro mi chog pa'i gtan 'khel lag tu bltar/ 'brel gtug pa mang po bzo grwa dang tshogs pa/ las khungs sogs su song ste 'os langs bya ba bsod sgrig byas/ de'i mtshungs su/ gsar brje spyi khyab pu'u yis khrab ldan 'khor lo gnyis btang ste slob ma'i dmag gi lag nas tshags par khang phyir 'phrog pa dang / gsang yig pa mngags te byung ba thams cad le nyin la yar zhu phul2/4nyin gyi snga dro'i chu chod 10thog tu/ dgun gnas pho brang du 'tshogs pa'i gnas skabs srid gzhung gi rgyal srid tshogs 'du'i steng du/ khi long si ji yis khengs pa'i 'dzum gyis/ 8 pul hri we khe'i 〈bzo ba'i lam 〉sgo rgya bsdams zin/ yod tshad 'char gzhi ltar sgrub kyin yod la phan 'bras kyang thon 'dug da ni pul hri we khe'i lce rtsa bcad zin pas/ srid gzhung bslog pa'i dril bsgrags bya thabs med/ dgong mor ngas khyod tshor lag bstar byas pa'i gnas tshul tshang ma gsal bor bshad ces bshad rjes mgyogs por lam la chas te pho brang ma re'u ① na tshogs 'du 'tshogs bzhin pa'i sta gon rgyal tshogs kyi khongs mi rnams la gnas tshul de bshad du song / kho mgo 'phang mthon pos gleng stegs su bud de 'gying stabs dang bcas/ 6 rnam pa tshos rna ba gtod dang / srid gzhung gis da nangs pul hri we khe'i tshags par du ma re'u/ lo 0 lho ༅ 15

khang sgo rgya bsdams pa dang mnyam du/ dmag khul bka' bkod khang la bka' bsgos te grong khyer yongs su 'grul rgya bsdam rgyu byas yod/ phul hri we khe'i lkog g.yo ngan mtshang brtol ba'i ched du/ ngas 'dir le nyin gyis 〈bzo ba'i lam 〉du bkod pa'i blo mthun tshor springs pa zhes pa'i rtsom gyi tshan pa 'ga' 'don rgyu yin pas tshang mas nyon dang zhes bshad pa dang / rtsom de bklags rjes mu mthud du/ 6 tshig 'di dag las le nyin gyis bzo pa dang dmag dpung la 'bod skul btang ste srid gzhung 'di gtor ba'i sbyor ba rtsom pa gsal bshad bya thub ces bshad cing / mjug mthar khos skad shugs gang yod kyis/ 6 da ni/ blo thag rbad chod kyi bya thabs spyad de 'khrug zing la drag gnon byed pa'i dbang cha yod tshad nga la gnang ba'i re ba nan mo zhu mizhes bshad/phyi dro/ khos pul hri we khes tshags par khang phyir 'phrog pa'i gnas tshul go ba dang khro ba'i bred sha langs te mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byas pas gnas bab sngar las dza drag tu gyur/ tshong khang dang dngul khang gi sgo brgyab pa dang grong pa rnams skrag snang gis rang khyim dang 'bral mi phod par gyur/ slob ma'i dmag gis srang gi rlangs 'khor bkag ste zhib bsher byed pa dang dgun gnas pho brang gi sgo khar 'dus pa'i slob ma'i dmag dpung je mang du song /hpho hpha no ba tshang du skung ba'i le nyin gyis slob ma'i dmag gis tshags par khang la rgol ba'i gnas tshul go ma thag tang krung dbyang la kho rang pho brang si mol nee ru 'gro chog pa'i re ba zhu ba'i 'phrin yig bris/'phrin bris tshar ba dang hpho hpha no ba yul la thon/ kho mos grong khyer gyi las khungs dang tshong khang mang po'i sgo brgyab yod tshul dang gang sar slob ma'i dmag gi skor zhib pas gang yod tshul sogs le nyin la yar zhu byas/166 phyogs yongs kyi gnas tshul la bltas na/ 'os langs bya ba'i gnad

'gag la thug 'dug le nyin gyis de ltar bshad rjes 'phrin yig de hpho hpha no ba la gtad de/ 6 khyod kyis 'phrin yig 'di gang myur gyis tang krung dbyang u yon lhan khang la bskyal te lan zhig e lon ltos zhes bshad/cang ma 'gor bar hpho hpha no ba phyir thon te/ kho pho brang si mol nee ru 'gro rgyur tang krung dbyang 'thad pa min pa'i gtam lan smras pas le nyin ci 'dra 'tshab kyang thabs med pas ci bya gtol bral gyi ngang du sa rub rag bar du bsdad/ de nas khos yang bskyar krungadabyang u yon lhan khang la 'phrin yig cig bris pa'i nang du/8 blo mthun rnam pa/yig phreng 'di dag ngas tshes 24nyin gyi dgong mor bris pa yin/ da ni nyenas tshabs chen la thug yod pas/ 'os langs nar 'gyangs byas na thar lam 'phred kyis bcad pa dang mtshungs pa gsal por shes thub/da ni 'gag rtsar thug yod pas/ mig sngar gros bsdur bya rgyu'i gnad don de dag ni/ tshogs 'du'am 'thus mi tshogs chen (su'u we chad 'thus mi tshogs chen 'tshogs na'ang)gyis thag gcod thub pa zhig gtan nas ma yin par/ mi dmangs te drag chas spras pa'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod kho nar brten te thag gcod dgos pa 'ig yin/ci yin gcig min gnyis kyis do dgong srid gzhung gi mi 'dzin dgos la slob ma'i dmag gi drag spras stobs shugs gcog dgos/(gal te kho tshos ngo rgol byas na rtsa med gtong dgos/)lo rgyus kyis go skabs dam 'dzin byed mi thub pa'i gsar brje ba la bzod gsol byed mi srid/ ma gzhir kho tshor rgyal kha thob thub (de ring dgong mor rgyal kha lon sha stag yin/) 'on kyang sang nyin du nar 'gyangs byas te/mang po zhig 'chor ba'am tha na yod tshad 'chor ba'i nyen khar mi 'dzem 1lha de

'chi bdag la sgug pa dang 'dra mi zhes bris yod/le nyin gyis hpho hpha no ba mngags te 'phrin yig de pho brang si mol nee ru bskyal du bcug mo song nas yun ring ma 'gor bar tang krung dbyang gis gsang yig pa lā he ya mngags te le nyin pho brang si mol nee ru 'gro chog pa'i brda bskyal yong / le nyin dga' thag chod de/ 6 khyod kyis nga 'gro mi chog zer ba'i gnas der nga 'gro rgyu yin/ bde mo byos/ yu lis chi ’ zhes bris pa'i shog byang zhig hpho hpha no ba la bzhag ste/ lwa ring rnying ba zhig dang zhwa mo mchu nar zhig gon zhing kha 'gram du rma ras shig sbyar te so nad byung ba'i bzo par brdzus te lā he ya dang lhan du lam la chas/srang lam gyi glog 'od mi gsal la skabs 'gar glog 'khor re gnyis rgyu ba las lam 'gro ba'ang med/ lā he ya dang le nyin glog 'khor las babs te lapa gyi /gyogs mtshams shig tu slebs pa na/ glo bur du skya dmag gnyis rjes la na 6la/ma yig ston mi zhes ngar skad bsgrags/6 lam/ lam yig su zhig su zhig gis lam yig byin pa red/’ lā he ya yis ra bzi ba'i gtam smras pas slob ma'i dmag gis kho gnyis ngo ma bzi bo gnyis su 'dod de 'gro ru bcuganam gung mtshams su/ 'os langs kyi lte ba ste/ pho brang si mol ni ru le nyin 'byor zhing mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus gsar ba'i glegs bam gyi sgo mo 'byed pa'i zla bcu ba'i gsar brje la sne khrid byas/le nyin khong pho brang si mol ne ru thon pa dang mnyam du/ krung dbyang u yon lhan khang gi thag bcad dang bya thabs/ gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gis bkod pa'i bye brag gi 'thab 'dzing 'char gzhi sogs la zhib mo/ sdusan/ khos yar zhu la nyan zhor du spru gus sa khra'i stong rtags 'dra min

mang po bkod/ kho dang blo mthun gzhan dag gros byas te 'os langs kyi gnad tshang ma/ gtan 'khel byas/ pho brang si sol ne ru le nyin thon pa nas bzung ste ༵sa langs kyi 'go khrid dbang cha yod tshad kho dang 'thab grogs tshos bzung da/ pho brang si mol ne dang phyi rol bar 'brel gtug byed spyad kha par gyi skud pa de gnas skabs srid gzhung gis snga mo nas bcad zin rung / gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gis dmar srung dmag mngags nas kha par gyi skud pa 'then pas 'os langs lte ba'i gzhung las khang nas kha par gyi sil sgra rgyun mi chad par grag 'ong /mtshan phyed kyi mtshams su/ hphin laṇa ḍi me 'khor 'bab tshigs kyi glog 'phrin khang dang pho brang tha hphu le ta (stsaṭhatshoṣṭhaṣṭha)sogs dmar srung dmag gis bzung /tshes nyer lnga'i duzhogs pa'i chu tshod gcig dang skar ma nyer lnga'i stong /mtsho dmag dang dmar srung dmag 'os langs dmag bcas kyis sbrag srid spyi khyab khang blangs/ma tshan mo'i chu tshod gnyis kyi steng du ye tsi mer rjodamag tshogs dang mtsho dmag gis mtsho pol te'i dume 'khor 'bab tshigs blangs pa dang / sta gon dam ga ru drug pas ne ku ra me 'khor 'bab tshigs blangs/ de dang dus mnyam du/ gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gis mngags pa'i chab srid u yon grong khyer glog 'don sa tshigs la yong ste srid gzhung gi thog khang chen mo'i glog lam gcod du bcug pas/ srid gzhung gi thog khang chen mo mun pas ཿ sbyo skyu smisdo gardos pa'i tā'i 〉〉 nyin du mtsho pol te //mang camatsho78)lo 19

gtibs la/ de ga'i las byed mi sna dag shin tu dngangs shing 'tshab/zhogs pa'i chu tshod gsum pa'i thog khes khi si ku li mo (sbya/11463 zhilko/glog)nye srung sta gon dmag rus kha par spyi khyab khang bzung ste skam dmag pu'u dang srid gzhung thog khang chen mo'i bar gyi kha par skud pa mang shos bcad/dus tshod phyed tsam gyi rjes su/ 6 ab ro ru miXrtags can gyi dmag gru rna ku ra zam pa'i 'gram du bsdad de/ slob ma'i dmag ru'i tshur rgol phyir bzlog rjes/ mi mngags te mgyogs myur ngang gnas skabs srid gzhung gis bcad pa'i zam lam mthud pas/ drag chas spras pa'i mtsho dmag 8000g.yul 'thab tu zhugs rgyur gra sgrig tshugs su chud pa byung song /zhogs pa'i chu tshod drug gi thog dmar srung dmag dang mtsho dmag gis rgyal khab dngul khang dang krung dbyang gi tshags par so so'i rtsom sgrig khang /skam dmag pu'u sogs bdag tu bzung / dus der/ dgun gnas pho brang 'os langs dmag gis bskor yod rung gnas skabs srid gzhung gis da dung 'chi kha'i 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i dpe ltar mu mthud du phyi phyogs dang 'brel ba byed pa skar gang yang mtshams ma chad/snga dro'i chu tshod bdun gyi steng / 'os langs dmag dpung gis dgun gnas pho brang dang nye ba'i pho brang zam pa bzung pas hir zhin hpho si dunas yong ba'i dmag gru rnams chu bo nee ba ②brgyud de dgun gnas pho brang phar rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug la zhugs thub par gyur/de ltar/ zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lnga'i zhogs pa'i sngon la/ pho brang mdun smyu spri = /snyi 4//stso sbyisbyi

gyi thang chen dang ye sa jis yan hpho si ci kha ༷ thang chen khul dang dgun gnas bye sa ༷pho brang ma gtogs pa'i grong khyer ci shā sta re yongs 'os langs pas bzung yod pas sna dza203 'os langs la rgyal kha chen po thob/ ṣṭṛ — — 144 gnas bab 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/nga —4 tho le nyin gyis gsar brje dmag don u la/(kha snamo rjo yon lhan khang gi ming bzung ste/ 〈u / // ///༷༷ru si'i spyi dmangs la springs pa 〉zhes / / /blare —pa'i rtsom yig bris shing / gsar brje tho sa stu tshormo ngadamag don u yon lhan khang gis snga — dro'i chu tshod bcu'i steng du grong khyer 〈a ru si'i spyi dmangs la yongs la bkram/ chu tshod bcu gcig jidros pa 〉zhes pa bkram pa/thog 6 yab ro ru rtags can gyi dmagagru'i thog gi rgyang bsgrags brgyud de/ 6 gnas skabs srid gzhung gtor zin la/ rgyal khab kyi srid dbang pe ti ku rid kyi bzo dmag 'thus mi su'u we chad rtsa 'dzugs kyis bzung yod ’ ces bsgrags/ phyi dro'i chu tshod gcig dang skar ma so lnga'i thog pho brang si mol ne ru pe ti ku rid kyi su'u we chad gros tshogs bsdus/ gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi 'thus mis gnas skabs srid gzhung gtor ba dang gsar brjer rgyal kha thob pa'i snyan zhu phul ba dang le nyin gyis su'u we yed srid dbang skor gyi snyan zhu phul/0 yosajigayad hpho gikha/ ma chas lo 21

pa rngi tshatsho snye ri — 54 rig 〉 ci/rdo )zersha — sbyo 4〉ṇa7lhape〉rte tshu shādzesalngomi 44411 (snye ciX rda/ —ri dzo / rtsetsālha 〉〉 〉po'irmi she 3 —— — byu666ni tshi dī 07stosgro na 0607 du/khro 3dunache tta ri tshi tho lha༄44 6 / rngo = sgro smu rngi ༷ chosarsā —/ca garteri sgri༄ chesangaḥn ༵ ri ༷ ci (rngo sta smru 4 zlo tsu bye/ci tsho ci shā gcirnge tshi denarūX /pe/ skoX ci nga dgun gnas pho brang dgong mo'i chu tshod bcu dang ska ra ma ba'i bcu'i thog rgyal/ yongs kyi bzo dmag su'u we yed 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa pho brang si mo'/ ne ru 'tshogs/ de dang dus ma tshungs su/ le nyin gyis gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang la 8 nges pa ra du gang myur gyis dgun gnas pho brang dgra lag nas len dgos ’ zhes yang yang skul /tshes nyer lnga'i phyi dro'i chu tshod drug gi thog 'os langs dmag mi dang dmar srung dmag mi nyis khri dang / dmag gru dgu/ khrab ldan 'khor lo bcu yis dgra bo'i mtha' mjug gi g.yu la sa ste/ dgun gnas pho brang bskor/su'u we chad 'thus mi tshogs chen 'tshogs bzhin pa'i dus der/ 6 a ba ro ru mi rtags can gyi dmag gru nas me phyogs 'phangs te dngos su rgol mgo rtsom/ ༵༵ tāswākā sdod btang / skyogs sgra de ni lo rgyus kyi glegs bam gsar ba'i nga sdom ra 'a/ dzing dza drag byas pa brgyud de/ zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer drug gi zhigahuX pa'i chu chod gnyis dang skar lnga bcu'i thog dgun gnas pho brang la

ze ra rsha — ji — tso can tsho ri/————— — ’ ru4 ༷ riX 〉 sde mi — ci zhe nga re ma'i4 6 (23062 9 70rdo ༷ji ga/ ji ciX na kṣe sdu lha/ci'adi) tsho 4 gu shā'i — dzwa bye sdusasnga sti rdo sto/snang chos ketstshaḥru / / nya sna mas min tsaḥ //dzeesgyurnyaXjibye ci ci shang lde 'a sna yi——1 sngu ci la zingapyang 6 ab ro ru rtags can gyi dmag gru/rtsol ba'i dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob/ gnas skabs srid gzhung gi dpon ngan (pu'u krang ) rnams gson ngo ra bzung rngo da/ g.yo sgyu wa las tsha ba'i khi long si jis ni nyin gcig sngon gyi zhigs par a ri'i gzhung tshab khang nas /sdu ṭwā sna'i a ri'i rgyal dar btsugs yod pa'i rlangs 'khor zhig la bsdad de tshes 26nyin gyi zhigs nga 'i chu chod gsum dang skar ma bcu'i thogathengs gnyis pa'i su'u we chad 'thus mi tshogs chen la de'i gnas tshul 'byor 'ing / gnas skabs srid gzhung gi rgyal srid pu'u krang rnam sa btsan mkhar pe ti ro lbu si khe du/ ru bskyal pa dang dmag dpon dang slob ma'i dam/ga gis mgo bskur pa/ cho ti no hphu si jis 0/ dgun gnas pho brang gi snyen srung ru khag gi ru dpon du bskos pa sogs kyi gnas tshul zhus/sdu ཿ/sdo lha trīḥ 1 069kyi smrami 〉〉tsho /7kha lkolko — 23
phul hri we khes 'go khrid byas pa'i zla bcu ba'i gsar brjer rgyal kha thob pa des 'dzam gling lo rgyus dus rabs kyi dbye mtshams phye ba ste/ 'dzam gling 'byorabs gsar ba'i lam chen btod do//

khi 'ong si zhi' yophyir rgol mi rdul du brlags pa/su'u we chad kyi srid dbang gsar ba btsugs pa nas bzung dza drag che ba'i gnad don gang mang 'ig la 'phrad myong /zla 10tshes 25nyin ①gyi snga dro/ khi long si ji brel rtab ngang a ri'i gzhung tshab khang nas g.yar ba'i rlangs 'khor la bsdad de dgun gnas pho brang nas phyi ru bros/ lam bar du dmar srung dmag gis 'ib bsher byed dus/ a ri'i gzhung tshab khang gi drung yig gis tshig ngo len pa las khos mgo bo smad de ci yang ma smras/ rlangs 'khor steng du a ri'i rgyal dar btsugs yod pas 'gag sgo re re nas bde blag ngang thar ba red/ rlangs 'khor grong khyer gyi mtha' ru thon dus su'ang khi long si ji da dung skrag 'dar rgyag gin 'dug mod/yin na'ang kho sems shi ba med pa'i sgo nas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang por zhugs pa'i u ru si'i g.yul sa'i bka' bkod khang du song ste rang dngos kyis dmag dpung bsdus te srid dbang gsar ba brlag rgyu'i stong bsam slar yang bcanga~X /hā /khor de shar rer lho nub phyogs su bskyod de/ dgong mo'i chu tshod dgu'i thog byang phyogs g.yul sa'i bka' bkod khang gi gnas yul phu si khi hpho du ru 'byor/ kho spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa dmag dpon chi le me su hphu rjosar song ste/ pe ti ku rid kyi phyogs su dpung rogs mi mngags pa ci yin ཿ : nd+ra hāddhi lus/ /nga /0mos du : le dma su rmu/ 377 /chos 25

dris par/ bka' bkod pas thabs zad 'u thug gi ngang nas/ smyo rgyal sar dmag mngags rgyu der dmag dpung nang gi 'thab mo ba'i u yon lhan khang dang su'u we chad sogs rtsa 'dzugs mang po'i 'thus mi chos mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byed kyin yod pas/ ngas dmag mngags rgyu'i bka' phyir ma 'then ka med byung / gnas 'dir gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi dbang shugs ha cang che zhing / bka' bkod khang du da dung khyod 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' yig kyang 'byor 'dug mi ces bshad par/ khi long si ji yi gdong mdog de ma thag tu 'gyur pas chi le me su rmu yar langs te zhi ba'i sgo nas/8 khyod rang skrag mi dgos/ ngas lugs dang mi mthun pa'i bka' de 'dra bsgrub mi srid mod/ 'on kyang / khyed rang dgongs pa ma tshom dang / gnas 'di nas ngas khyed kyi bde 'jags kyi 'gan 'khur mi nas pas khyed rang dmag spyi khang chen mor song na dga' mi zhes bshad/khi long si ji yi sems su bka' bkod pa la blo 'khel mi rung snyam pa'i dogs snang skyes shing / de'i phyi nyin kho rang dmag dpon chen mo khi la si no spru ①dang ngo 'phrad du song / dmag dpon de ni khi lun si ji yi blos thub grogs po yin/ tshes 25nyin gyi zhigs par/ khi long si ji yis dgun gnas pho brang nas khi la su no hphu la bka' btang ste gnas skabs srid gzhung gi dpung rogs su dmag gtong dgos zhes bshad mod/ 'on kyang mi ring bar g.yul sa'i bka' bkod khang nas btang ba'i dmag rgyag mi chog pa'i bka' zhig kyang 'byor/ bka' rjes ma der khi la su no rmu dogs pa skyes pas bden rdzun gsal bor 'byed pa'i kun slong gis phu si khi hpho la ched dmigs kyis yong ba la bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni khi long si ji dang dngos su 'phrad rgyu shā khyi la si no sbo/ mas glo

byung bas dga' ba 'bum gyis myos/ khi long si ji yis rang nyid la khi la si no spru blo dkar po yong ched/ kho pa pe ti ku rin la dmag 'dren pa'i spyi dpon du bskos par ma zad/ rkang dmag ru khag 37pa dang dmag tshogs 17pa/ skya dmag ru khag dang po rnams kyang kho'i bka' zhabs su bgos/zla 10pa'i tshes 27nyin gyi zhogs par/ bsdoms pas mi lnga stong yod pa'i khi la si no hphu yi dpung des phu si khi hpho byang rgyud kyi mkhar grong ca chi na du bdag tu bzung pa dang / khi long si ji yang zar rgyal 0sku drag gi gnyen tshan bsdad myong pa'i gna' bo'i pho brang der yong zhing / kho rang gis ming btags lasrid gros pa gcig kyang med pa'i gnas skabs srid gzhung zhig pho brang de /ra btsugs/ khos spro khengs kyi sgo nas dpon po gzhon par bka' bsgos na/ che gnas skabs srid gzhung gi tsung li dang / u ru si spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi drag spras dmag dpung yongs kyi spyi dpon chen mo bdag gis rgyal khab la blo sems dkar ba'i g.yul sa'i drag dpung gi kha lo sgyur rgyu spyi bsgrags byas pa yin/rmongs pa dang ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis jag tshogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dpung thams cad da lta nyid du rang rang gi las gnas su log ste rang gi las 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i bkag phab pa yin/bka' 'di dmag gi dpung khag yongs la bsgrags par gyis/ji gnasnang mchos srid gzhung gi tsung li dang spyi dpon chen mo gcig lcogs khi lun si nas/de ra /thu/da/ de/ khos yang bskyar dmag spyi khang chen mo rjodang 'thab she ཿ ཿpriḥl//dzo/shārnyi/ 0spros 'i'adi ni sngar gyi skadu si'i gong ma'i 'bod ming yin la/ gzar 7gapa 8 rtaju ṭī ṭwāṃ spru ཿ sngusnagashā āḥ /ru padma da/ / /// /spyo /ba juga'adon pu'u rnying ba la'o/ 27

phyogs so so'i bka' bkod pas dpung rogs mngags te pe ti ku rin la rgol dgos pa'i bka' bstud mar phab/g.yul sa'i u dmag rnying ba'i khrod du/ khi long si ji yis 6 tsung li dang spyi dpon chen mo'i dbang shugs la brten nas/ dmag dpung bsdu 'gug byas nas pe ti ku rin btsan gyis len rgyu'i stong sems bcangs/grong khyer pe ti ku rid du/ meng hri we khe dang spyi tshogs gsar brje tang sogs pul hri we khe la sdang ba'i dgra phyogs tshang ma mnyam 'brel byas te 8 rgyal khab dang gsar brje skyob pa'i u yon lhan khang zhes pa rtsa 'dzugs byas shing /su'u we med la ngo rgol byed pa'i zing 'khrug bslang ste/ khi long si ji yi dmag dpung dang phyi nang mnyam rub byed rtsis yod/8 rgyal khab dang gsar brje skyob pa'i u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi ko tshi 0yis/ phyogs gcig nas mi mngags te khi long si ji dang 'brel ba byas shing phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgyal sa'i dmag gi slob grwa so so'i dge slob yongs la gsang ba'i sgo nas bka' phab ste/ sngon gyi dmag khul spyi dpon pol khi hpho nyi khe hpho 0yi bka' dang len gyis zla 10pa'i tshes 29yi zhogs par 'os langs bya rgyu'i 'bod skul btang / sngar bkod kyi 'char gzhi ltar na/ khi long si ji yis kyang nyin de'i snga dro'i chu tshod 11stong dmag dpung khrid nas rgyal sar 'byor rgyu byas/dmag gi slob grwa'i dge slob bsdoms pas mi brgyad brgya lhag yod pa des zla 10pa'i tshes 25nyin la/ su'u we chad dang dgra ru mi langs rgyu dam bcas yod rung / skabs 'dir kha bshad don la mi gnas par ngo log byas pa red/ g.yul sa'i dmag ma thon gong la/ kho chos khrab ldan 'khor lo lnga ༵ / kyā khi/ rnu dzā sgo/ 7pos khu lko

dang me mda' nyis stong lhag 'phrul mda' bcu gnyis la brten nas 8 grong khyer gyi sgrig lam srung ba'i mi 'char gzhi 'then/zla 10tshes 29yi zhogs par/ pho brang si mol ne dang thag mi ring ba'i sa nas slob ma'i dmag gis gsang ba'i 'gag sgo btsugs te/ lam 'gro bar 'dri rtsad byas shing dmar srung dmag mi khor 'gro gsod pa'i sbyor ngan brtsams/ zhogs pa'i chu tshod bzhi'i thog zing slong pa tshos dmag don slob grwar do dam byed mkhan gyi pul hri we khe'i dmag dang dmar srung dmag mi mtshon 'og tu drangs shing grong khyer gyi kha par spyi khyab khang bzung /pol khi hpho nyi khe hpho yis yid tshim pa'i sgo nas ko tshi la/ 6 kha par spyi khyab khang nga tshos blangs zin pas pho brang si mol ne zha ra dang 'on pa lta bu yin ’ zhes bshad/ko tshi dga' thag chod de/ 6 dmag spyi lags/ da ni spyi dmangs la bsgrags yig cig bkram ste/ pul hri we khe srid dbang nyams la nye bas/tshang mas stobs shugs gcig bsdus sgos pul hri we khe'i mtha' mjug gi gnas gzhi gnyis te/ pho brang si mol ne dang btsan mkhar pe ti po len dgos pa'i bka' bsgrag pa'i dus la ran yod ’ ces bshad/6 red/ bsgrags yig de khyod kyis phris/ thog mar glog 'phrin gyi lam /sa gtong ba dang / de nas sung lam du sbyar rgyu byed ’ ces lan btab pa da/ ko tshi yis ma phyi'ang bris ma tshar gong nas/ pe ti ku rin kyi srang lam g.yas g.yon gyi gyang ngos yongs su khos bris pa'i na spyi dmangs la springs pa'i bsgrags yig gis gang yod pa'i 'phrul snang shar/'on kyang / de ni rmi lam lta bu'i 'phrul snang nyag cig las ma 'das/ring po ma 'gor bar/ su'u we ed srid gzhung gis mngags pa'i mtsho hā/ga

dang dmar srung dmag gis pe ti ku rid kyi kha par spyi khyab khang phyir 'phrog pa ma zad/ de ga'i slob ma'i dmag bcu phrag du ma bzung zhing / hpho la je mur dudamag gi slob grwar me skyogs brgyab nas slob ma'i dmag brgya lhag mgo mi sgar thabs med byas pas/ pe ti ku rin kyi slob ma'i dmag gi ngo log zing 'khrug nyin de rang du rdul du brlags/ bla 'khyar zhing hon thor ba'i ko tshi brel rtab kyis ca chi na ru yong ste skyo shu 'don bzhin khi long si ji la gnas tshul yar zhu byas/ khi long li ji yis khro ba'i ngar skad dang bcas te/ 8 de ltar yin na/slob ma'i dmag gi 'os langs 'di ltar tshar song ba yin nam/’ 6 des na/dmag dpon pol khi hpho nyi khe hpho gang du bud song ’ zhes dris/ khos yud tsam la bshad mtshams bzhag rjes mu mthud du/6 pul hri we khe'i dmag gis kha par spyi khyab khang gi mtha' bskor rjes/ dmag don slob grwa dka' gnad la thug skabs der/ dmag spyis tshang mar gon pa brjes te rang rang gi thar lam tshol zhes bshad cing / kho rang gis kyang gon pa brjes nas slob grwa dang gyes song /’ zhes ko tshi lkugs pa dang 'dra bar ngag kyang legs po mi khrol ba'i ngang nas de ltar bshad/6 kho 'gro khar bka' bkod ci yang med dam/’ khi long si ji yis sems gso byed kyi gnas tshul 'dra e yod snyam du de ltar dris/che ci yang med/ 6 pe ti ku rid kyi dmag 'bor mi grangs chig stong yang mi long pas 'thab thengs gcig gis pham zhing / tshang ma 'thor song bas/ bka' bkod su la 'jog da ni g.yul sa'i dpung la brten nas pe ti ku rid len rgyu las thabs gzhan med/ ko tshi yis de ltar lan btab/3༷ spro la je mur/ lkoṣṭha cholo

6 blun po khyod tshos bya ba ci yang bsgrub mi thub/ khi long si ji yis de ltar sdigs 'dod mod kyang 'on kyang kha nas tshig 'bud ma thub par/ mig gnyis btsum nas thang chad pa'i lus po 'bol khri la bsnyes/glo bur du/ khi la si no hphu gzhung sgrub khang du thon te skad mthon pos/6 spyi dpon chen mo lags/ g.yul sa'i dmag mang po 'byor zin mod/ kho tshos pe ti ku rid la rgol dgos pa'i skad cha go ma thag tshang ma g.yul du mi zhugs zer gyin 'dug ces zhus/khi long si ji de ma thag 'bol khri las langs te khi la si no hphu yi mdun du song ste/ 8 ci zer/ khyod kyis gsal bor shod dang ’ zhes dris/6 lho nub g.yul sa nas dmag ru gsum yong mod/ kho tshos rgyal sa'i gnas tshul thos rjes pe ti ku rid du 'thus tshab mngags te phul hri we khe'i srid dbang la ngo rgol mi byed pa'i gtam bsgrags ’ zhes lan btab/66de min gnas tshul ci zhig yod/ 6 o zhi cen be chi ( khrophu'ipo'itsha1)me 'khor 'bab tshigs su thon pa'i me 'khor gnyis kyi nang gi dmag mi tshos u yon lhan khang zhig bdams shing /pe ti ku rid la dmag mi rgyag pa'i gros thag bcad/ khi la si no spru yis mu mthud du/ 6 po lo khi( lo4tsho14)me 'khor 'bab tshigs kyi srung dmag gis gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang la ngo rgol mi byed pa ma zad/ pe ti ku rin du 'bru rigs skyel ba'i gra sgrig byed kyin 'dug ’ ces bshad/gcig 'phror gcig mthud pa'i gtam ngan de dag thos rjes/ khi long si ji ha las te/ 6 bya ba 'di 'dra'ang yod 'dug ’ ces smre sngags bton zhing / tshig pa g.yag la za na mgo lcag rta la byed ces pa'i dpe ltar khi la si no hphu la/ 64des na khyod kyis kho tshor kha ta mi byed pa ci yin ’ zhes bshad par/khi la si no rmu yis 'khang ra'i tshul gyis/ 6 a kha kha/ ngas thabadī zlorgya

jus stong gis kho tshor slob gso btang pa yin/ 'on kyang / don dngos las kho tsho g.yul du zhugs 'jug pa'i re ba rta rnga las kyang nyag phra ba gsal bor shes thub zer/khi long si ji yis yud tsam la bsam blo btang rjes/ 'dzem dogs spu tsam yang med par/ 8 dmag dpon/ sang nyin 'char gzhi ltar phor khi o (ṣṭhaṣṭha14ṣṭha)ri sgang blangs te pe ti ku rid du dmag rgyag pa'i 'gag sgo phye dgos zhes bka' phab/phor khi o ri sgang ni lho lam brgyud de pe ti ku rid du 'gro ba'i lam 'gag gtso bo yin la rgyal sa dang spyi le bco lnga las med/ zla 10pa'i tshes 30yi dgong khar/ dmar srung dmag dang mtsho dmag gis phor khi o sa cha'i dgra dmag pham par brgyab pa ma zad/ nyin gung dgra dmag gi lag tu shor ba'i rgyal grong yang bcings grol btang /pul hri we khes slob gso byas par brten/ dgra bo'i nang khul du'ang 'gal ba sna tshogs byung / nyin de'i mtshan gung la/ khi long si ji'i dpung khag nang gi ki sa khu ①skya dmag gis 'thus mi gsum rgyal grong du mngags te su'u we chad srid gzhung gi 'thus mi ti pin khi rjo dang gros mol byas shing /su'u we ed srid gzhung gi 'bus mi ca chi na dmag sgar du yong nas pe ti ku rid kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod bya dgos pa'i re ba bton pa ma zad/ kho tsho rang 'gul gyis gros mol byed du yong ba yin pas de don khi long si ji dang khi la si no rmu gnyis kyis mi shes tshul yang bshad/phyi nyin zhogs pa'i chu tshod gsum dang phyed ku'i steng / pho brang ca chi na'i sgo drung du rlangs 'khor zhig thon/ de'i nang du ti pin khi dang kho'i lag 3༷ tta pasdo khri/maḥḍā

rogs thu lo hrin/ de min ki sa khu'i dmag dpon gsum bcas yod/ so srung dmag dpon zhig rlangs 'khor las babs ma thag pa'i ti pin khi dang thu lo hrin gyi sngun la bud de/6 khyod tsho su yin/ don dag ci zhig yod ’ ces dris/6 nga tsho su'u we chad kyi 'thus mi yin/ ki sa khu dang gros mol byed du 'ongs pa yin zhes lan btab/6 gong nas nga la mdzub ston de 'dra gnang myong med pas khyod tsho 'dzin rgyu las 'os med/ mtshon cha sprod cig ces bshad par/ti pin khi the tshom spu tsam yang med par de ma thag sked kyi bo'u thung (dkrum mda' )blangs te/ 6 'di ni nga'i mtshon cha yin/ 'on kyang khyod la sprod rgyu min/ gal te khyod kyis nga tsho 'dzin rgyu zer na khyod rang tshos gyong chen po rag nges red ’ ces bshad/ki sa khu'i dmag dpon myur mor sngon la bud de/ smyo kho tsho ni dmag don phyogs kyi pho nya yin pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i ki sa khu yis gdan 'dren zhus pa'i mgron po'ang yin pas/ kho tsho gtan nas 'dzin mi nyan zhes bshad/las res dmag dpon gyis ki sa khu'i mis khrel gzhung brtsi ba'i rang gshes yod pa shes pas/ rnyog zing bzo bar dogs nas rang tshod bzung ste/6 yin na'ang ngas dmag dpon la yar zhu bya dgos zhes bshad/khi long si ji pho brang ca chi na ru yod pa ti pin khi yis shes rjes/ ki sa khu'i 'thus mi gsum la bshad rgyur/ 6 ba'i re ba yin na blo 'khel chog pa'i srung dmag mngags te kho la lta srung bya dgos/ gal te kho bros song tshe/ khyod /sdu 'gan 'khur dgos zhes bshad de ki sa khu'i dmag sgar gyi phyogs su nyinade'i snga dro chu tshod bcu yas mas su/ su'u we chad 'thus mi 3/ sa

khu'i dmag sgar du thon yod pa'i gnas tshul de khi long si ji yis go rjes/ khi la si no rmu la/ 8 dmag dpon/ ti pin khi sogs yong pa'i gnas tshul de khyod kyis nga la mi bshad pa ci yin zhes drag po'i sgo nas dris par/8 bya ba de so srung bas da nangs gzod nga la bshad byung zhes lan btab/che khyod kyi ki sa khu'i dmag gis nga 'dzin rgyu red/ dmag dpon/ khyod kyis nga dgra lag tu bzhag 'dug khi long si ji thabs rdugs nas de ltar bshad/8 dmag mi'i tshogs chen gyis da dung thag gcod gsal bo byas med mod/ 'on kyang /’ khi la si no hphu yi kha nas ngag thon mi thon gyi ngang nas/6 khyod la snying brtse ba'i mi gcig kyang mi 'dug ces bshad/8 su'u we yed kyi 'thus mi gnyis ma gtogs yong med dam/’ khi long si ji gisame tshig sne gzhan la drangs nas de ltar dris// deshā /na khyod kyis kho gnyis mi 'dzin pa ci yin/’ na dang thog so srung bas kho tsho 'dzin bsam rung / ki sa khu yis kho tshos bos pa'i mgron po yin zhes bshad de 'dzin du ma bcug ki sa khu mi rigs kyi bsgrub 'dod pa de sus kyang 'gog mi thub pa'i khyad chos de khyod la'ang gsal zhes bshad/khi long si ji yud tsam la kha rog bsdad rjes/ skad gdangs ring por bsrings te/ 8 da ni ngas ci zhig bya dgos/ zhes dris par/ 6 khyod rang gnas skabs srid gzhung gi 'go 'dzin yin pas/ pe ti ku rid du song ste su'u we ed dang gros mol bya chog khi la si no rmus tsham tshom med par lan de rdo/ btab/ gros sol bya rgyu der khi long si ji gtan nas 'thad pa med

pas kho kta/sa sdi drin byung sa/ khu'i dmag mis ti pin khi dang tha lo hrin gyi rogs ram 'og pho brang phyi'i thang chen du tshogs chen 'tshogs nas pe ti ku rid dang mnyam 'brel ji ltar bya rgyur gros byed bzhin pa de gzhung sgrub khang gi sge'u khung las mthong thub pas/ khi long si ji yis skrag snang khong du sbed de/ 6 ya/dmag dpon/ nga pe ti ku rid du 'gro zhes bshad cing / ma yin yin mdog gi ngang nas dmag dpon gzhon par/ 6 khyod kyis g.yul sa'i dmag spyi khang chen mo'i dmag dpon to hi nyin tshul tar yig btang nas/ khi long si ji pe ti ku rid la gros mol byed du 'gro dgos pas/ khyod kyis spyi dpon chen mo'i 'gan tshab bzhes shig ces shod ces bshad pa dang / kha phyir 'khor te khi la si no hphu la/ 6 chu tshod gnyis kyi rjes nas nga lam la chas rgyu yin/khyod kyis skyel mi blos thub cig mngags rogs zhes bshad pa red/khi la si no rmu gzhung las khang nas song ma thag dpon gzhon pa'i rogs ram 'og tu/ khi long si ji mtsho dmag dkyus mar brdzus te pho brang gi sa dong brgyud de mor man si khi dul 'gro ba'i ser lbe ya'i ༷ me 'khor du bsdad de bros song / de ltar/ khos zhib tshags kyis jus 'god byas pa'i 6 phyir rgol zing 'khrug de yang chu bur ltar stong par gyur/ 8 skyob u'i kru'u zhi ko tshi yang ha lam dus mtshungs su g.yul sa'i dmag sgar du bros song /nyin de'i dgong mor/ mtsho dmag dang dmar srung dmag gis khi la si no rmu bzung ba red/ dgod bro ba zhig la khos da dung yang khi long si ji pe ti ku rid du su'u we chad dang gros mol byed du song tshar 'dod yod do//ཿ ཿ /hā/sa/ snatshos 555/lhashāṅgi snya〉skya4557 ca1876—19179) ser lbe ya/ bya/'di'i 5zo 'ilta6༅7ri 35

pul hri we khe dang le nyin gyi 'go khrid 'og tu/ su'u we ed mi dmangs kyis khi long si ji yi 6 phyir rgol ’ rdul du brlags rjes/ slar yang lo gsum ring gsar brje'i dmag 'khrug brgyud/ rin tshab phon chen po sprad de/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi dgra bo'i tshur rgol bzlog pa'i rkyen gyis da gzod zla bcu ba'i gsar brje'i rgyal kha'i 'bras bu sra brtan du btang la/ rang gi rgyal khab kyi rang btsan dang rang dbang gi bdag dbang srung skyob byed thub pa byung ba red/

mdzo khi zo si ji/u ru si'i zla bcu ba'i gsar brje ma byung gong la/ khi long si ji yi 'byor ldan gral rim gnas skabs srid gzhung gis pul hri we khe la snang sems chen po bcangs yod pas/ dma' 'bebs dang skur 'debs kyi gtam dang brjod pa gang sar khyab yod/ thengs shig la/ ya ma gzugs kyi mchor nyams spras pa'i bud med cig gis nee ba sung lam nas 'chal gtam bsgrags te/ phyi rgyal nas log pa'i le nyin ni 'jar man gyi myul ma yin pas pul hri we khe rgyal khab kyi bla 'tshong phyogs khag yin tshul brjod pas mi mang pos mo'i mtha' bskor te bden rdzun gsal por nyan 'dod pa'i skabs der glo bur du mi zhig gis/ ru we/ lcam mo/ nga'i sgor khug phyir byin zhes skad brgyab byung /6 sgor khug khyod smyos song ngam/’ bud med de skrag nas ngag kyang legs po mi 'khyol bar/ 6 khyod kyis nga la de 'dra zer srol zhig gang na yod/ ngas khyod rig kyang ma myong / khyod la bden dpang ci zhig yod zer/8 khyod kyis pul hri we khe la rgyus lon mi byed par mes rgyal gyi bla 'tshong yin pa'i bden dpang ci zhig yod ces bshad pas mtha' na rub pa'i mi rnams gad mo shor zhing thal mo deb/ bud med de kha gdangs mig cer gyis lan 'debs rgyu ma byung bar brel rtab kyis bros song /le nyin gyi mtshan snyan gces par bsrungs te mi mang 'tshogs sa nas rdzun mthil brtol mkhan de ni phyis su snyan ngag pa chen por gyur ba'i ma ya khi 37
