gnyis dang zla bzhi'i ring la dril bsgrags ri mo lnga brgya lhag bris shing / ri mo dang 'brel pa'i snyan ngag brgya cha'i dgu bcu kho rang gis bcoms pa red/lta/ nā/ rgyun du mtshan gung gi chu tshod gnyis nas gsu/ma bar du bya ba sgrub 1922lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 5nyin gyi〈〈gnas tshul tshags par〉〉steng du ma ya khi hpho si ji yi〈〈tshogs 'du kho nar zhen pa'i mi〉〉zhes pa'i zur za'i snyan ngag cig bkod la/ de'i brjod bya ni/ mi zhig gis las byed pa ye ban tpan ne chi dang 'phrad 'dod kyi bsam pas thengs gang mang la btsal du song yang las byed pa de nyin rgyun du u yon lhan khang ka pa dang / kha pa/ ga pa/ nga pa sogs su tshogs 'du'i las kho nar brel ba'i stabs kyis ngo 'phrad pa'i go skabs gtan nas ma byung / kho'i lag rogs tsho'ang nyin rgyun tshogs 'du'i nang du mgo 'khor 'dug kho tshos tshogs 'du 'tshogs te ci zhig la zhib 'jug byed kyin yod ce na/ bro gar khang dang gzan chas ra ba gnyis zla sgril byed rgyu'am 6 zhing chen mnyam las khang gis snag tsha dam bu gang nyo dgos pa mi sogs la zhib 'jug byed/ kho tshos nyin rer tshogs 'du mang po 'tshogs dgos la skabs rer dus gcig tu tshogs 'du gnyis re 'tshogs dgos pa'i rkyen gyis lus kyi sked pa nas gtub ste khag gnyis su bgo dgos pas tsa lus phyed mi'u thung ’ ru gyur/ snyan ngag pas 'phya smod byas par/6 bdag gisamathong ba ni/tshogasara'i gral du sdod pa yod tshad/lusaphyed ka med pa'i mi'u thung rkyang rkyang red/gtsi tsi/ 'dre rig song /lusakyi phyed ga gang du song ngam/740lhan ngag 'di'i nang don dang rnam pa gang ci'i thad du sgyu rtsal gyi nus pa

mngon gsal thon yod/ snyan ngag de spel ba'i phyi nyin/ le nyin gyis gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po'i sgo nas/ kha sang 〈〈gnas tshul tshags par 〉〉steng nas ma ya khi hpho si ji yi chab srid brjod byar bzung ba'i snyan ngag cig bklags pa yin/ nga ni snyan ngag pa kho'i shes rab la smon pa 'chor mkhan zhig min la snyan ngag gi phyogs su rang nyid la gsal cha med pa'ang khas len mod kyang /chab srid dang srid 'dzin gyi lta ba bzung ste bltas na snyan ngag 'dis bdag la spro ba tshad med byin byung / khos snyan ngag 'di'i nang du tshogs 'du 'tshogs par 'phya smod drag po byas shing nam rgyun tshar rgyu med pa'i tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i gung khran tang mi la zur za byas yod/ 'di snyan ngag legs po'i gras su brtsi min ngas bshad dka' mod/ 'on kyang / chab srid thad nas bltas na/'di ni don dngos nyag cig yin par ngas kha tshon gcod thub/ don dngos su nga tsho dus rgyun par 'tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'am u yon lhan khang 'dzugs pa/1chakā drizhi gtanazhi 'a bas bye/ pa /garsha kyi las la brel gyin yod/ 'di ni sa ma ༵ zlozlo si kā yinā kā bdī kā'is ga sapa dī/khro/ grub 'bras dril bsgrags dang rang gi snyan ngag gyer 'don byed pa'i ched du/ hpha ran si dang 'jar man/ khyi'u bha/dusi phen/0meg si koX.a me ri ga po lan ḍi rjodang cheg si lo wa khi ya dubacas rgyal khab brgyad la 'tshams 'drir thengs dgu song myong la rgyal nang du'ang grong khyer lnga bcu lhag la skor bzhud byas/ gnas de dag gis kho'i mthong rgya yangs por bskyed de bzo ba dang zhing ba/ slob ma dang dmag : sbi ṭwāṃ //koḥshi 5༷1rā ཿ ཿlha rgyutā /wa ṇḍaṃ dzee/ gārdzuX31༷ cho mo ya 41

mi sogs la rgyus lon zab mo byung zhing kho'i snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i nang don yang sngar las phun sum tshogs po byung /1924lo'i zla 1tshes 21nyin/ le nyin nad kyi dbang gis tshe las 'das pas snyan ngag pa skyo gdung drag po'i ngang le nyin gyi mya ngan tshogs 'du la zhugs/ zla 3pa'i tshes 31nyin/ khos 〈〈gung gzhon tshogs pa'i glu 〉〉zhes pa brtsams te le nyin tshe las 'das par mya ngan gyi gdung dbyangs blangs/ snyan ngag sdo /le nyin/ sngon chad 'tsho zhing bzhugs myong /le nyin/ da lta'ang nga tsho'i semasasubazhugs/le nyin/ bskal ba ji srid bar du 'jig pa med/7cesabris yod/snyan ngag thung ngu 'di rmang gzhi byas te/ lo der 〈〈le nyin 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag ring mo zhig brtsams/ snyan ngag de'i nang du/ mi rnams kyis skyo gdung yod tshad stobs shugs su bsgyur te le nyin gyi thugs 'dun mngon 'gyurwa ༵༵ bar hur brtson bya dgos pa bstan yod/ snyan ngag tu/deng gi //sasu'ang /dngos su'atsho ba'i mi las tshe srog gi rin thang zab/le nyin ni nga tsho'i shesarig yin la/ stobs shugabasayin/snatshon rdo/nga yin/7zhesapa dang /༵ rnyisna bye /ji /khol 'og tu//dri sdo ༵ ṭwāṃ mee 'di/42mtsho mo'i 'jingasasu/

mu mthud rgyang skyod byed pa'i phyir/7zhes pa bkod yod/mi kun gyis ma ya khi hpho si ji yi snyan ngag ring mo 〈〈le nyin〉〉ni le nyin la bstod glu blangs pa'i brtsams chos khrod kyi ches legs pa dang ches stobs shugs ldan la mi sems g.yo ba'i snyan ngag tu 'dod/1927lo'i ston kur/ zla bcu ba'i gsar brje la rgyal kha thob nas lo bcu 'khor ba'i rten 'brel du/ khos don brjod rnam pas brtse dung mtshon pa'i snyan ngag 〈〈legs〉〉zhes pa brtsams pa red/ snyan ngag des gnas tshul lhug por brjod pa dang brtse dung drag po ston pa zung du sbrel ba'i thabs kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs su'u len dbu brnyes pa dang dar zhing rgyas pa'i brgyud rim mtshon par byas/ khos rgyal yongs kyi grong khyer mang por snyan ngag de gyer 'don byas myong la nyan pa po'i tshogs kyis nam rgyun du dga' ba'i thal mo deb/thengs shig la/ mo si kho lag rtsal sna 'dzoms dngos mang bshams ston khang du snyan ngag gyer 'don byas par/ khos tsa le nyin nga tsho'i sems su yod la/ me mda' nga tsho'i lag tu yod/ ces pa'i tshig cig gyer pa'i skabs der/ glo bur du 'thab mo ba zhig mi mang po'i gseb nas yar langs te/ blo mthun ma ya khi hpho si ji khyed dang / khyed kyi snyan ngag nga tsho'i snying dbus su gnas yod ces skad brgyab pa red/ma ya khi spro si ji yi snyan ngag ring mo 〈〈le nyin〉〉dang 〈〈legs〉〉zhes pa ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dngos yod ring lugs snyan ngag gi tshad ldan brtsamasachos yin/ khos snyan ngag 'bri ba las gzhan da dung zur za'i zlos gar mang po brtsams myong / khong ni su'u len snyan ngag gi rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan yin zhing / khong gi bcoms chos la gsar brje'i lta ba'am rtags mtshan gsal po yod pa ma zad kho rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal rtsom gshes khyad par ba zhig mngon yod/ chab srid thad nas/ kho rang sus byin

gyi skabs so so'i 'thab rtsod la zhugs myong ba ma zad/ krung go'i gsar brje la'ang thugs khur dang brtse ba chen po gnang / 1929lor/ khos brtsams pa'i 〈〈krung gor springs pa〉〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag tu/6 bzo ba khri ma 'bum gyi krung go ba/phyag zung ring du sringasadang mdza' mthun gyi/'gyur med dam bca' snying gar bkod nas ni/btsan rgyal ring lugasacham la 'bebs par byed/7ces bkod yod/ ma ya khi hpho si ji yi snyan ngag gis krung go'i snyan ngag la'ang nus pa chen po thon myong /dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs sum cu ba dang ba'i bcu ba'i nang du/ krung go'i snyan ngag pa mang po zhig gis kho'i snyan ngag bklags rjes gsar brje'i snyan ngag 'bri ba'i las la zhugs/snyan ngag pa khong la gsar rtsom gyi 'dun pa drag po yod mod/ yid phangs pa zhig la rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis 1930lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 14nyin rang nyid kyi shag tu rang srog bcad/su'u len gyi deng rabs rtsom rig lo rgyus khrod du/ a ma gor ci ni su'u len 'byor med gral rim rtsom rig gi rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan yin pas mi rnams kyis snga mo nas dga' bo byed la/ 'byor med gral rim gyi snyan ngag pa ma ya khi hpho si ji'ang kor ci dang 'dra ste/ kho'i snyan ngag mang po la mang tshogs kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog mang du gtor ro// snyan ngag pa khong gis rang srog snga mo nas brlags na'ang / 'byor med gral rim gyi snying stobs mtshon zhing mi rnams bde bar phyogs pa'i yar skul gyi snyan rtsom de dag dus dang rnam pa kun tu phyi rabs pa'i sems khong du gnas so//44

nyang ga ri su'u we'ad spyi mthun rgyal khab/hang gha ri ༷ srid gzhung 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang por zhugs rjes/rgyal nang gi tshong zog thon skyed la bkag rgya thebs shing 'bru rigs kyis mi 'dang ba'i gnas tshul byung bas/ dngos po'i rin gong gnam la 'phar zhing mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba nyin re bzhin je sdug tu song / 1916lor/ bzo ba tshos spyi'i las mtshams bzhag ste gla phogs snon dgos pa'i re ba bton/1917lor/ u ru si'i zla bcu ba'i gsar brje la rgyal kha thob pa'i gnas tshul bsgrags rjes hang gha ri'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'thab rtsod 'dun pa je drag tu song / 1918lo'i zla dang por/ bzo ba tshos 6 'thab 'khrug rdul du brlags rgyu ’ dang 8 nga tshor zhi bde dang za ma dgos :zhes pa'i 'bod pa byas/sa khul 'ga' re'i khe las dang dmag dpung khrod du/ rang 'gul gyis su'u we ed rtsa 'dzugs btsugs yod la sa khul la la'i bzo ba tshos zla 'ga'i ring la las mtshams bzhag srid gzhung gis dmag mngags te drag gnon byas na'ang bzo ba tshos mtha' gcig tu rgol lan sprad pas 'thab rtsod mi 'jags ka med byung /pu ta phe si'i ②bzo ba tshos dmag mdzod khang 'phrog par brten mtshon cha thob pa red/ 1918lo'i zla 10tshes 31gi zhogs par/ bzo ba dang dmag misa.u ru si'i zla bcu ba'i gsar brje yi byed thabs spyad de/ zam pa dang ཿ ཿ tta sbri trī/ sdu/byipa gānākā/lo 45

sbrag srid khang / glog 'phrin khang gnyis dang grong khyer nyen zon bka' bkod khang bcas btsan gyis bzung pas/ hang gha ri'i dbang 'dzin pas de ma thag sridagazhung bcos sgrig byas te/ zhi bde ring lugs pa'i snyan grags can gyi 66rang btsan tang ’ gi 'go dpon kha ro li me ha ye 0srid gzhung gsar ba'i dpon du bskos shing / spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gi 'go khrid pa ca la me(meb11mo'u)dang khung ཿ(1khyiṣṭhajo)yang srid gzhung der zhugs/ kho tshos dang thog hang snya ri'i gong mar blo kha ga'an la mi phyogs pa'i dam bcas rung mang tshogs kyi las 'gul nyin re bzhin dza drag tu gyur ba'i gnas bab 'og tu rang nyid kyi dam bca' dang mi 'gal ga med byung ste1918lo'i zla 11tshes 16nyin hang gha ri spyi mthun rgyal khab tshugs pa yongs bsgrags byas/kha ro le srid gzhung gis 〈sa zhing do dam bca' khrims 〉dang chu tshod brgyad kyi las byed lam lugs sogs kyi bka' khrims bsgrags myong mod/don dngos su/ bka' khrims de dag ni snying po med pa'i tshig stong tsam yin te/ zhing pa'i sa zhing gi brgya cha'i lnga bcu da dung yang zhing bdag gis bzung yod pas zhing ba'i sa zhing gnad don thag gcod bya ma thub/ de bas zhing ba dbul bo dang gla ba tshos zhing bdag tsho'i lag nas kho tsho'i sa zhing phyir 'phrog pa red/ grong khyer du/ drag chas spras pa'i bzo ba chos bzo grwa'i u yon lhan khang btsugs te bzo grwa bdag tu bzung ba dang / dmag mi tsho'ang bzo ba dang mnyam du srid gzhung la rgol ba'i gsar brje'i las la zhugs/gsar brje'i las 'gul slong ba'i gnad 'gag gi dus der/ su'u len nas phyir log pa'i khod pe la rjodang ra khi zhis ②sogs hang gha ri gung ༷ kri/khraX hastu /ltasakyi ṭwāṃ 6zla'ide (rdoshā/6 sprasaḥ)(1873—1933)

khran tang 'dzugs pa'i las la brtson/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i sngon la kho tsho bzo ba'i las 'gul du zhugs myong la/ 'khrug chen byung rjes dmag nang du mi zhugs ga med byung / 1916lor/ u ru si'i dmag gis bzung ste za'e pu re'u 0yi thom si khi'i dubazung dmag btson rar bcug mi ring bar/khod pe la yis sa de ga'i pul hri we khe dang 'brel ba btsugs te rtsa 'dzugs de'i nang du zhugs/ 1917lo'i u ru si'i zla gnyis pa'i gsar brje'i skabs su/ kho rang pul hri we khe thom si khi zhing chen gyi tang u'i u yon du bdams/de nas khos hang gha ri'i dmag ru btsugs te u ru si'i zla bcu ba'i gsar brje la zhugs pa ma zad gung khran ring lugs tsho chung yang btsugs myong / ra khi zhis sogs tsho chung de'i khongs mi yin/zla 11tshes 17nyin/ hang snya ri'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gi g.yon ru dang yar thon tang khag dang bzo tshogs rtsa 'dzugs khag cig gis pu ta phe si ru mnyam 'brel gros tshogs bsdus te chab srid gnas babs la gros mol byas/ de'i phyi nyin/ khod pe la gtso byas pa'i gung khran tang mis kho tsho dang bgros te zla 11tshes 24nyin hang gha ri gung khran tang 'dzugs rgyu thag gis bcad cing de'i thog tu khod pe la gtso byas pa'i gung khran tang krung dbyang u yon lhan khang bdams pa red/gsar du btsugs pa'i gung khran tang gis gang myur gyis (dmar po'i tshags par 〉zhes pa'i tang gi tshags par bkram pa ma zad/ 6 'byor med gral rim mthun sgril byas te 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gnya' gcog rgyu gludang /6 srid dbang yod tshad su'u we ed la dbang pa/ su'u u dang mna' 'brel 'dzugs pa sogs kyi chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi 'bod pa byas pas ngal rtsol mi ཿ trīḥ sgo/'u//13 hā/hrīhātshom/༅ 47

dmangs kyi 'thab rtsod 'dun pa je drag tu btang /las shor bzo bas tang gi 'go khrid 'og tu/ gzhi khyon che ba'i khrom skor byas/ 1919lo'i zla 2tshes 20nyin gyi nam gung la/ kha ro le srid gzhung gis gung khran tang gi 'go khrid pa bzhi bcu dang yar thon pa mang shos bzung ba ma zad/ gung khron tang gi 〈tshags par dmar po 〉rtsom sgrig khang gtor ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis hang gha ri gung khran tang gsang ba'i rtsa 'dzugs su mi bsgyur thabs med byung /skabs de'i rgyal yongs kyi ches che ba'i khyes phe (/7lo1)bzo grwa'i bzo ba khri kha shas kyis gros byas te/ btson 'jug byas pa'i gung khran tang mi dang yar thon pa rnams zla 3tshes 28nyin skyob rgyu thag gis bcad cing / srid gzhung gis bzung mi yongs rdzogs glod dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa ma zad/gal te srid gzhung gis re ba de dang du mi len na bzo ba chos drag po'i 'os langs slong rgyu'i tha tshig bsgrags/ khul bcu gcig gi grong khyer so so nas bzo ba tshos srid gzhung gi dpon po rnams phyir bskrad de khul srid gzhung btsugs pa dang / zhing pa tshos kyang zhing bdag gi sa zhing 'phrog pas rgyal yongs ngal rdol mi dmangs kyi drag po'i 'os langs slong ba'i gom stabs je mgyogs su nga / gros chings bzhag pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab kyis kha ro le sridagazhung thor nyen la thug pa shes te/ hang gha ri yang zla bcu ba'i gsar brje yi lam du song na 'byor ldan gral rim gyis yo rab skam sa chen po dbang bsgyur byed par nyen kha che bsam nas the gtogs byed mgo bcoms/1919lo'i zla 3tshes 20nyin/ btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab kyis hang gha ri srid gzhung la tha tshig bsgrags te hang snya ri'i mnga' khongs kyi sum cha'i gnyis bdīkā de kho tshor sprod dgos pa'i blang bya bton nas/ hang gha ri'i gsar brje

brlag rgyu'i stong bsam bcangs/ tha tshig der phyogs gcig nas hang gha ri'i 'byor med gral rim gyis rgol lan sprad pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgyal gces ring lugs kyi bsam blo ldan pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa'ang khong khro langs/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og tu/ kha ro le yis skye bo kun gyis smod pa'i las ngan de byed ma phod par/ spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gi g.yas ru tshogs par srid dbang sprad de rang nyid srid stegs las babs/spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gi g.yas ru tshogs pas kyang tang gcig la brten nas rgyal srid las khungs 'dzugs ma phod par btson du bcug yod pa'i gung khron tang gi 'go khrid tshor mnyam 'brel srid gzhung 'dzugs pa'i gros gzhi bton/ gung khran tang gis cha rkyen bton par/ hang gha ri ru su'u we yed spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs pa khyab bsgrags bya dgos pa dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi drag chas gtor nas dmar dmag dang mi dmangs nyen rtog pa 'dzugs dgos pa/ zhing bdag gi sa zhing gzhung bzhes byas te bzo las rgyal khab la dbang ba'i lam lugs 'dzugs dgos pa/ su'u len dang mna' 'brel 'dzugs dgos pa sogs so// gros mol byas pa brgyud de spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gis gong gi cha rkyen de dag dang du blangs pas/ zla 3tshes 21nyin/ hang gha ri su'u we chad spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / su'u we yed srid dbang ste/ mi dmangs u yon lhan khang yang dngos su btsugs/ dus mtshungs su/ hang gha ri gung khron tang dang spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gnyis zla sgril btang ste hang gha ri spyi tshogs tang du )/ bye /ri su'u we chad srid dbang btsugs rjes/ gros tshogs thog ma'i stong du dmar dmag dang mi dmangs nyen rtog pa 'dzugs rgyu la gros 'cham byung / zla 3tshes 26nyin/ su'u we chad srid gzhung gis thag bcad par /mimi

nyi shu yan yod pa'i bzo grwa dang 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren khe las tshang ma rgyal khab la gtogs pa bya rgyu dang / bzo ba'i cha snyoms kyi zla phogs brgya cha'i nyer lnga snon rgyu byas/ zla 4tshes 23nyin/ sa zhing rgyal khab la dbang ba'i bka' khrims thag bcad pa dang / spyi dmangs la gsang ba'i sgo nas krung dbyang dang sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'dems shog 'phen pa'i dbang cha yod pa dang rgyal khab kyi khe las yod tshad kyis chu tshod brgyad kyi las byed lam lugs lag bstar byed pa/ pho mo las mnyam gla mnyam yin pa dang lo brgyad lam lugs kyi slob grwa 'dzugs pa sogs khyab bsgrags byas/hang gha ri su'u we chad srid dbang btsugs par btsan rgyal ring lugs pas 'khon sems bcangs yod/ zla 4ba'i zla dkyil la/ gros chings bzhag pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs pas rgyal khab khag cig la ngan skul byas te chig 'bum lnga khri can gyi dmag gi dpung bsdus nas hang gha rir tshur rgol byas/skabs der/ gsar du btsugs pa'i dmar dmag bzhi khri dgu stong tsam las med na'ang / kho tshos rang srog 'ben la bzhag nas rgol lan sprad pas rgyal kha mi nyung ba blangs myong / yin na'ang / btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab kyi the gtogs dang / nang sgos su gros chings rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i u yon lhanakhang gis tang snya ri su'u we chad srid gzhung la tha tshig nan mo bsgrags pa'i rjes su/ hang gha ri'i gsar brje ba'i gnas bab je sdug nas je sdug tu song / rgyal khab nang khul gyi ngo log pa 'dra min gyis gsar brje bya bar gtor brlag btang ba dang / su'u we ed srid gzhung dang dmag dpung khrod du go gnas gal chen bzung yod pa'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gi g.yas shā zlo /sa ngo log byas te btsan rgyal ring lugs par mgo skur rgyu'i 'dod tshul 50zla 7par/ hang gha ri'i dmar dmag gi spyi khyab jus 'don pa ngo log

byas pas gnas bab sngar las je sdug tu song / zla 8tshes /la/ dgra dmag rgyal sar 'byor par spyi le so bzhi las med pa'i skabs su/ mi dmangs u yon lhan khang srid khri las babs pas spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang gi g.yas ru tshogs pas btsugs pa'i phe tir(lo1tsosnyo1/do)bzo tshogs srid gzhung gis tshab byas/ de ltar/ zla 3tshes 21nas 8pa'i tshes nyin bar gyi nyin brgya dang so gsum ring gi hang gha ri su'u we chad spyi mthun rgyal khab mgo ting bslogs/gung srin tang gi 'go khrid pa mang shos o si 'o ri ya duru mi gyar ga med byung 'ing de gar tang gha ri gung khran tang gi phyir sdod u yon lhan khang btsugs pa dang / rgyal nang du sdod pa'i gung khran tang mi khag cig gis gsang ba'i sgo nas mu mthud du gsar brje las 'gul la 'go khrid byed kyin yod/zla 8tshes 3nyin/ phyi rgyal gyi dmag gis pu ta phe si bdag tu bzung /nyin gsum 'gor rjes phe tir bzo tshogs srid gzhung yang gtor ba red/sngon gyi o hang btsan rgyal dus skabs kyi mtsho dmag gi dmag dpon chen mo hor dhi 0zhes pa de/ hang snya rir su'u we ed srid dbang btsugs rjes phyi rgyal du bros te gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab kyi rogs ram la brten nas log spyod kyi 6 mi rigs dmag (rgyal dmangs dmag kyang zer )btsugs pa red/ zla 11tshes 6nyin/ hor ddha yis dmag sna drangs te grong khyer pu ta phe si bzung / 1920lo'i zla 1por 'dems bsko byas par/ 'dems shog mang shos hor dhe tshogs par thob pas/ hang gha ri'i gong ma'i lam lugs slar gso byas shing zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nyin hor rnyi srid skyong du bskos pa khyab bsgrags byas/ de ltar/ hor ddha hpha shi si 0srid dbang sger 'dzin gyis lo phyu spri/ ṭwāṃ ri |sdu /sdushrī 〉ཿkā 1868—1957 51

nyer lnga'i ring la tang gha ri dbang du bsgyur/hang gha ri'i su'u we chad srid gzhung yun ring ma brtan mod/ hang snya ri'i 'byor med gral rim par nyams myong dang bslab bya gang mang thob pas/gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod gsar bar rmang gzhi bting yod/
zhe sku nywas ji lharji trelhongoX ba rte mbig34 ne 2khang 〉༅tsho chirdo 7 34 sde༄sgyu43 gu spu)lto gzhu

'bring gi sbyang tshan so so'ang po lan ḍi rang gi rgyal khab kyi skad yig gis khrid mi chog pas/ na gzhon slob gnyer ba tsho'i khro ba'i me lce 'bar/bsam blo de 'dra'i rmang gzhi la brten te lo na gzhon pa'i lag dzem lhag slob 'bring du yod dus nas gsar brje ba'i bsam blo chags yod pas/ yar thon gyi slob sbyong tsho chung la zhugs shing po lan ḍi'i spyi tshogs gnad don skor la bgro gleng byed pa dang mi rigs rang btsan gyi mdun lam snyegs pa red/skabs der/ mos bud med slob grogs shig la phul ba'i 'dra par gyi rgyab ngos su/ 6 lhag bsam zol med kyis skye bo kun la dga' ba bzhin du spyi tshogs lam lugs shig la dga' rgyu ni bdag gi phugs bsam yin/ bya gzhag de la brtson zhing bsnyeg pa'i dus kho nar bdag la sdang sems skye srid/ kun slong de lta bu khyod la med pas mi tshe stong zad gtong rgyu las 'os med mices bris yod/lag dzem lhag slob 'bring nas mthar phyin pa'i phyi lo ste 1888lor/ po lan ḍi'i gsar brje ba khag cig gis 6 'byor med gral rim gyi tang khag gnyis pa ’ btsugs/ de dang u ru si'i gsar brje tang khag bar 'brel ba dam po yod/ yin na'ang de'i khrod kyi mi 'ga' res 'jigs skul gyi sbyor ngan brtsams par brten/ lo de'i zla 10par rtsa 'dzugs de'i khongs mi mang shos bzung ba dang / zla 11par 5 zhe phan si jis( 5 7977)bzung /kho'ang rtsa 'dzugs de'i nang gi mi zhig yin la lag dzem lhag dang 'brel ba zab mo yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ lag dzem lhag po lan ḍi dang mi 'bral thabs med byung / grogs po'i rogs ram la brten te mo 'jar man gyi sa mtshams brgal nas si we tser lan ḍi'i dzo re khi 0grong du 'byor/po lan ḍi'i gsar brje bas si we tser lan ḍi la 'gro ba'i lam de snga mo /bye dzo re khi/ 750 su zo ltu

nas btod yod la/ 1888lor po lan ḍi nas 6 'byor med gral rim gyi tang khag gnyis pa 'dzugs dus nas po lan ḍi'i gsar brje'i bas gsang ba'i bya 'gul spel yul dang skung gnas si we tser lan ḍi ru byas yod/ kho chos po lan ḍi'i gsar brje'i las 'gul gyi dgos mkho ltar/ gnas de nas yar thon gyi dpe cha dang dus deb sna tshogs dpar du btab nas phyir po lan ḍi la drangs te gsar brje'i bsam blo khyab bsgrags byas/ lag dzem lhag si we tser lhan ḍi ru yong ba las mo mu mthun du gsar brje'i lam du skyod pa gsal bor sa thursha /mo dzo re khi ru thon rjes/ blo mthun tshos sgor mo bsdus te mo dzo re khi slob grwa chen mo'i spyi tshogs chab srid rig pa'i tshan khag tu slob gnyer la mngag18/92lo'i zla 2tshes 7nyin/ lag dzem bhag dngos su dzo re khi slob grwa chen mo'i mtshan nyid tshan khag gi slob mar gyur zhing / slob dpon rnam pas kho mor slob sbyong la 'bad dgos pa'i bka' slob nan mo gnang / spyir na'ang kho mo ni slob gnyer la goms pa'i don gnyer can zhig yin pas bka' slob de 'dra gnang ba'i dgos pa ma mchis/ kho mos mar khe si ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs dang spyi tshogs rig pa/ dpal 'byor rig pa sogs la sbyangs pa mi dman pa byas yod la gnad don mi nyung bar zhib 'jug kyang byas myong /1897lo'i zla 5par/ lag dzem lhag gis mthar phyin dam bca' bzhag ste khrims rig pa dang dpal 'byor rig pa'i po hri'i (lo )thob thang blangs/kho mo slob mthar phyin rjes/ rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i bde ba tsam la ma chags par rlabs che ba'i chab srid kyi bya gzhag nang zhugs rgyu'i kun slong gis 55

dga' grogs li o yo ce zhe si ①dang kha gyes te/ spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang gi stobs shugs rgyas pa'i 'jar man du song nas gsar brje'i bya ba gnyer rgyu thag gis bcad/ 'jar man nas tang gi bya ba sgrub par nges par du 'jar man gyi rgyal khongs su zhugs dgos pas mo grogs po zhig gi bu dang gnyen sgrig khul mi byed ga med byung / 1898lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 19nyin/ lag dzem bhag gis gnyen sgrig dpang yig blangs rjes/ 'jar man rgyal khongs su zhugs pa/ 'gro lugs bsgrubs te zla 5pa'i nang 'jar man gyi rgyal sa per lin 0du 'byur/lagaldem lhag per lin du thon pa dang thabs lam sna tshogs brgyud de gtam bshad spel bar med du mi rung ba'i 'dzin yig blangs shing / po lan ḍi gsar brje phyogs khag gi rgyal spyi ring lugs pa dang 'brel ba byas/ de ltar/ mo'i lus stobs dang sems shugs yod tshad rang nyid kyis dad mos byed pa'i bya gzhag gi don du phul ba red/1914lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa langs rjes/ 'jar man gyi spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang nang khul du 'thab 'khrug thad kyi lta ba'i khyad par byung nas kha thor du gyur pas/ lag dzem lhag dang 'jar man gyi gsar brje ba grags can khel leb khi ne khrid kyis 6 si pa ta khi du mna' 'brel zhes pa'i rtsa 'dzugs btsugs shing / 1916lor lag jom bhag gis bton pa'i mna' 'brel rtsa 'dzin la gros 'cham byung / lag dzem lhag sogs kyis sne khrid pa'i 6 si pa ta khi mna' 'brel la 6 rgyal spyi'i phyogs khag kyang zer/1917lo'i ston khar/ 'jar man gyi spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang dngos ཿ ṭā/ liX sdu /5sbyinā skrushālko /bye 6pa ta // 5/shāgyi53lo༅lha

su kha 'thor te pul hri we khe'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang (spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang gi g.yas phyogs pa ) dang rang tshugs pa'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang (spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang gi dbus ma ba )gnyis su gyes/ lag dzem lhag dang khel leb khi ne khrid kyis sne khrid pa'i 6 si pa ta khi mna' 'brel de rang tshugs pa'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang (dbus ma ba )du zhugs pa red/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i dus mjug tu/ 'jar man dmag g.yul las pham pa dang / lo mang po'i ring gi 'thab 'khrug gi dbang gis 'bangs mi ser gyi 'tsho ba nyin re bzhin je sdug tu song bar brten/1918lo'i lo stod du 'jar man gyi grong khyer che khag so so nas las mtshams 'jog pa'i las 'gul bslangs shing gsang ba'i su'u we yed rtsa 'dzugs kyang byung /phyi nas g.yul las pham zhing rgyal nang du gsar brje las 'gul byung ba'i gnas bab 'og 'jar man gyi dbang sgyur pa'i nyi ma 'khyol dka' ba'i gnas su gyur/ 'gal ba zhi 'jags su gtong ba'i ched du/ dbang sgyur gra rim gyis srid gzhung bskyar sgrig byed pa'i sbyor ba bcoms nas/ 1918lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 5nyin dbang 'dzin pas 'jar man gyi pul hri we khe'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang (g.yas phyogs pa ) gi 'go khrid pa zhe dhi man rjo dang bho ber dugadan drangs te srid gzhung gsar ba btsugs/ srid gzhung gsar ba'i las 'gan ni nang khul du kho tshos brjod pa'i 8 dmangs gtso lag bstar byed pa dang / phyi phyogs su gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab bar zhi ba'i chings yig gi cha rkyen gros mol bya rgyu de yin/ཿ / :/na/sku/༷ dzīḥshā sku rkugo mcho 1865—1939 57

zla 10pa'i tshes 29nyin/ 'jar man dmag gi spyi khyab bka' 'doms khang gis kel 0grong khyer du sdod pa'i mtsho dmag gis dbyin ji'i mtsho dmag la phar rgol bya dgos pa'i bka' phab pa red/ mtsho dmag gis bka' dang len ma byas par ma zad/ nyin lnga'i rjes su drag po'i 'os langs byas pas 'jar man gyi zla bcu gcig pa'i gsar brje'i las 'gul bslangs/ mtsho dmag gis dmag gru ru khag so po'i gnad sa bzung ba dang mtsho dmag gi dmag dpon la lta rtog nan mo byas shing / sa de'i bzo ba dang skam dmag la 'brel ba btsugs nas dmar srung ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas/ yun ring ma 'gor bar/ gel grong khyer du bzo ba dang mtsho dmag gi 'thus tshab su'u we ed btsugs/ 8 si pa ta khi mna' 'brel gyis bzo ba dang dmag mi la springs pa'i yi ge zhes pa bsgrags te 'jar man rgyal phran mnyam 'brel khag gi rgyal phran so so'i srid dbang gtor dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang zhing per lin gyi su'u we ed lag bstar u yon lhan khang dang lhan du per len bzo bar springs pa'i yi ge spel nas las mtshams 'jog pa dang drag po'i 'os langs slong bar skul ma byas/zla bcu gcig pa'i gsar brje la brten nas gong ma'i srid dbang sger gcod lam lugs gtor ba red/ 'jar man gyi gong ma wi lim skye 'phreng /nyis kāzi 0sri/ dbang pul hri we khe'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang la sprad de lan zla 1 /sna'i zlos/ 9nyin/ per lin gyi 'os langs pas nyen rtog khang dang glog 'phrin khang / rgyal tshogs bcas bdag tu bzung / smyo si pa ta khi mna' ཿ mi trī/ma yā rno/rno misapa/ ya lo 7 5 —tsho/rdo ho lan ḍi/ skoXskyil spra ba

'brel gyi 'go khrid pa khel leb khi ne khrid kyis gong ma'i pho brang gi dra them steng nas khrom skor ba'i tshogs la gtam bshad spel te/ 6 rang dbang gi 'jar man spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes song / spyi mthun rgyal khab 'di'i nang du bran g.yog med la/ gzhung drang gi ngal rtsol par 'os shing 'tsham pa'i las ka dang thob cha yod mices khyab bsgrags byas/khrom skor ba rgyal tshogs kyi mdun du skyod skabs/ pul hri we khe'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang gi 'go khrid zhe dhi man gyis rgyal tshogs thog khang gi dra ma las ske bsrings te brel 'tshub ngang du/ 'jar man ni spyi mthun rgyal khab yin zhes bsgrags pa dang yun ring ma 'gor bar spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi srid gzhung 'dzugs rgyu yin tshul gyi rdzun gtam bshad/zla 11pa'i tshes 11nyin/ pul hri we khe'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang srid gzhung dang gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab bar du dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog pa'i gros mthun yi ge bkod pa dang / kho tsho'i kha bshad ltar na/ 'jar man du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs 'dzugs rgyu zer mod/'on kyang de'i phyi nyin/ srid gzhung gis 'byor ldan gral rim gyi ngan rtags rjen par bstan te/ su'u we ed kyi dbang cha med par bzos pa dang su'u we ed la khrims 'dzugs dbang cha med ces bsgrags pa ma zad/ bzo ba'i lag gi mtshon cha yang rtsis sprod bya dgos pa'i bka' phab cing dmar srung dmag gi rtsa 'dzugs gtor pa dang / ngo log dmag dpung bsdus te per lin dang sa gnas gzhan gyi bzo ba'i las 'gul drag gnon byas/ kho tshos tshags par dang dus deb sogs kyi steng du dkrog gtam spel nas 6si pa ta khi mna' 'brel migyis spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang sgrig lam la gnod pa skyel gyin 'dug ces bsgrags pa red/zla 12pa'i tshes 16nyin/ su'u we chad 'thus mi'i tshogs chen ༵༵sa

dang po per lin du 'tshogs/ su'u we chad 'thus mi mang shos kyis phul hri we khe'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang gi lta ba 'dzin pa dang / zhe si pa ta khi mna' 'brel gyi mi grangs nyung zhing stobs shugs chung ba'i rkyen gyis lag dzem lhag dang leb khi ne khrid gnyis su'u we ed 'thus mi'i tshogs chen du zhugs rgyur mi mang po 'thad pa ma byung ba ma zad/ tshogs 'du'i thog 6 si pa ta khi mna' 'brel gyis bton pa'i 'jar man ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi mthun rgyal khab yin pa'i gros chod la gros 'cham ma byung par srid dbang yongs rdzogs 'byor ldan gral rim gyi srid gzhung la sprod rgyu thag gis bcad/ gsal bor bshad na/ su'u we chad 'thus mi'i tshogs chen steng du/ 'jar man du 'byor ldan gral rim gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs rgyur gros 'cham byung ba red/rang tshugs pa'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang (dbus ma ba )'byor ldan gral rim gyi srid gzhung gi bya bar zhugs ma 'dod par srid stegs las babs pa dang / 66si pa ta khi mna' 'brel yang rang tshugs pa'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang dang kha gyes te 'byor med gral rim gyi srid tang ngo ma ste/ gung khran tang rbetsugs pa red/ kho chos zla 12pa'i tshes 29nas tshes 31bar 'jar man gung khran tang gi 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po per lin du 'tshogs nas 6 'jar man gung khran tang (si pa ta khi mna' 'brel ) btsugs pa khyab bsgrags byas te 'jar man du 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang tshugs par 'bad brtson byas/lag dzem lhag gis 'jar man gung khran tang gi 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po'i thog tu phul ba'i snyan zhu ru/ 6 dus nam zhig la gsar brje'i dmigs 'ben mngon 'gyur yong ba bshad dka' mod/ nga tshos bya gzhag 'di'i don du rang srog blos gtong phod na bsgrub mi thub pa gcig byung med ceX /shad/ skad cha de bshad nas gza' 'khor gnyis tsam las ma 'gor

dīr lag dzem lhag dang leb khi ne khrid gnyis 'jig rten dang gtan du kha bral nga / skabs der/ log spyod srid gzhung gis lag dzem lhag dang leb khi ne khrid sogs kyi gung khran tang mi gsod dgos pa'i yi ge gang sar sbyar ba dang myul ma mang pos per lin grong khyer yongs su sngog bsher byas/ log spyod srid gzhung gis da dung khrag dri bro ba'i dmar gsod la brten nas per lin 'byor med gral rim gyi zla dang po'i 'os langs la drag gnon byas pas 'jar man gyi zla bcu gcig pa'i gsar brje pham pa red/1919lo'i zla 1tshes 13nyin/ 'jar man gung khron tang gi krung dbyang u yon khag cig dgra lag tu shor bas lag dzem lhag dang leb khi nee khrid gnyis khi lon khul(lko4tshe'ita )du nyin gnyis la bskungs rjes per lin khul gyi wer mur sde ba'i(tsho47777)sgo rtags zhe gsum pa mur kho sung(6lo67)tshang du spor/ zla /tshes 15nyin gyi dgong mo/ kho gnyis 'byor ldan gral rem gyi gshed mas bzung nas /e tin ’ (3kyi〉〉)mgron khang gi skya dmag bka' bkod khang du khrid/ drag jus dmag dpon gyis sngon gyi 'char ga'i ltar kho gnyis la yun thung gi 'dri rtsad byas rjes btson khang du 'jug rgyu'i bka' phab/ gdug rtsub che ba'i gshed ma de tshos thog mar khel leb khi nee khrid bsad pa dang / de nas ra'o sa lag dzem bhag kyang mtshon 'og tu drangs/kho tshos mgron khang gi sgo kha nas lag dzem lhag gi lus yongs la mtshon chas bsnun te gcar rdung yid tshim pa byas rjes rlangs 'khor du brdzangs te dmar gsod btang / ro med shul med byed ched/ lag dmar tshos lag dzem lhag gi bem po lcags skud kyis bsdams te lan ḍi ber gtsang por du 'phangs/du lan ḍi ber gtsang po/ zos te lo 61

'byor ldan gral rim gyis bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi las de grub rjes/ leb khi ne khrid 'bro rtsis byas pa'i rkyen gyis bo'u (me mda' )mi 'phen ga med byung tshul dang / lag dzem lhag mi mang gis lkog gsod btang zin pas bem po'ang mi rnyed tshul gyi 'chal gtam bsgrags pa dang / de las kyang snying na ba zhig la/lag dmar khrims la sbyor dgos zhes pa'i ngo tsha khrel med kyi gtam yang smras/zla 6tshes 1nyin/ lan ḍi ber gtsang po nas lag dzem lhag gi bem po rnyed pa red/ zla 6tshes 13nyin/ rngam brjid che ba'i khrom skor mi tshogs kyis lag dzem lhag gi bem po hphu re te ri khi 0dur khrod du bskyal te khel leb khi ne khrid kyi dur gyi 'khris su bcugabagrang bya mang po 'das na'ang / 'jar man gyi rang dbang dang bde skyid/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje bya gzhag gi ched du gces srog phul ba'i dpa' mo/ 'jar man 'byor med gral rim gyi gtso 'dzin lag dzem lhag gi mtshan de dmangs gtso dang spyi tshogs ring lugs/ brtson len byed pa'i mtshon byed du gyur yod/: spru re te ri khi/ 7 ma rsā0ji tshomacholko

ro brangarsār se le'igang gi kha rtsod/wa pha ri si'i zhi ba'i gros tshogs/zla dang po'i pha ri si ༷grong khyer gyi nam zla grang ngar che zhing / pha ri si dang spyi le bco brgyad kyis chod pa'i pho brang khrer se le 0yang kha ba bu yug gi khrod du 'jam thing nger gnas yod/'on kyang / 1919lo'i zla 1por/ pho brang khrer se le glo bur du 'du long gi klong du tshud/ pho brang sgor rlangs 'khor mang po 'dus shing rgyal khab khag cig gi srid gzhung gtso 'dzin dang mi sna gal chen rnams rlangs 'khor las babs te dpon nyams dod po'i ngang pho brang ther se le ru 'gro ba dang / kho tsho'i gzhug tu mi mang po 'tshogs yod/ de'i khrod du chab srid pa dang blo 'don pa/ lo tsā ba/ sku srung ba dang gsar 'god pa sogs yod pa ma zad/ched mngags pa dang lta zhib pa yod la kun slong dang dmigs yul sna tshogs bcangs pa'i ma rtsa can dang tshong dpon chen po/ sku drag mi drag dang chos pa sogs kyang yod/kho tsho gnas 'dir yong don ci yin zhe na/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i khrod du 'jar man la pham nyes chen po byung bas/ 1918lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 11nyin mgo bsgur pa red/ de bas/ dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ a me ཿ sthā/ spyi dri/2 'ishu rdu7lo 63

ri — — —— ༷ tsho—gaḥ tshegs— pho zang zer se le/ri ga dbyi tha li/ 'jar pan dang krung go sogs g.yul las rgyal pa'i rgyal khab nyer bdun gyis gnas 'di nas pha ri si'i zhi ba'i gros tshogs 'tshogs rgyu yin la/ 'jar man gyi 'thus mi'ang gros tshogs su zhugs yod/tshogs mgo rtsom pa'i mdzad sgo de pho brang lnger se le yi me long tshoms chen du bsdus/ mgron bdag hpha ran si yis de ltar bkod sgrig byed par rgyu mtshan chen po yod de/ 1870lo'i phu hpha dmag 'khrug skabs su/ g.yul las rgyal ba'i phu ro zi du gong mas dmag drangs te pho brang khrer se le 'phrog pa dang /de'i phyi lor me long tshoms chen nas rang nyid 'jar man gong ma'i rgyal khab kyi gong mar bskos shing khri 'don mnga' gsol yang byas myong bas/ hpha ran si yis kyang 'jar man la 'i ba'i chings yig 'jog pa'i gros tshogs kyi tshogs ra me long tshoms chen du byas te 'khon lan bslogs pa red/pha ri si'i gros tshogs ma 'tshogs gong gi nyin drug gi sngon la/ a me ri ka dang dbyin ji/ hpha ran si/ dbyi tha li dang 'jar pan bcas rgyal khab lnga zlo phu ro zi/ 94331 0 cha

yis/ g.yul las pham pa'i rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs dang mi ser spel yul 'thob 'dod kyi kun slong gis gra sgrig tshogs 'du zhig bsdus shing / rgyal khab lnga'i srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin dang phyi 'brel blon chen bcas kyis grub pa'i 6 mi bcu'i gros tshogs zhes pa btsugs te pha ri si'i zhi ba'i gros tshogs la kha lo byed pa'i sbyor ba brtsams/ rjes su kho tshos 6 mi bcu'i gros tshogs de srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin kyang kyang zhugs pa'i 8 mi lnga'i gros tshogs su bsgyur cing 'jar pan gyi gtso 'dzin ngo ma thon med par brten/ 8 mi lnga'i gros tshogs nas 8 mi bzhi'i gros tshogs ’ su bsgyur/de nas bzung / 'i ba'i gros tshogs kyi gnad don gal chen tshang ma 6 mi bzhi'i gros tshogs ’ kyis thag gis gcod pa red/ skabs 'gar rgyal khab chung chung ga ge mo'i gnad don gros byed skabs/ rgyal khab de'i bsam 'char la mi nyan par gros thag gcod par byed pas rgyal khab chung ngu'i khe phan la gnod pa chen po byung / 6 mi bzhi'i gros tshogs ’ su'ang 'gal ba yod de/a me ri ka dang dbyin ji/ hpha ran si gsum gyi 'dod tshul la/ dbyi tha li yis 'khrug chen du pham kha mang po khur myong bas nus pa chen po thon med la dpal 'byor yang che cher dar med par 'dod de mthong chung byas pa red/ de bas/8 mi bzhi'i gros tshogs khrod kyi dbyi tha li'i 'thus mi ste/ dbyi tha li'i dbu bzhugs blon chen o lan to tshula'ang mthong chung gis kha ya chen po ma byas pas ru mi gsum gros tshogs su gyur pa'i gnas tshul yang yod/pha ri si'i gros tshogs mgo bcoms pa nas kha rtsod kyi 'go'ang brtsams pa red/ thog mar a me ri ma'i tsung thung wil son dugyis dzig nyams dang bcas/ 6 sku zhabs rnam pa/ nga tsho'i a me ri ga'i 'dod tshul ltar na/ thog ཿ ཿswā 〉/// // ༷ shāzistarmiskya /6ཿ /sdu sku dzāḥṣṭha1//tsho /shāḥ2 65

mar rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel skor gyi gnad don gros bsdur bya dgos la/ de nas tshab dngul gnad don dang rgyal khab gsar ba 'dzugs pa'i gnad don/'thab 'khrug rjes kyi sa mtshams kyi gnad don dang mi ser spel yul gnad don bcas re re bzhin gros bsdur bya rgyu dang / rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel gyi chings yig de zhi ba'i chings yig 'di'i grub cha zhig tu brtsi dgos zhes bshad/hpha ran si'i tsung li khi le min so 0yis de ma thag tu rgol gtam btang par/ 66de ltar bya mi chog nga tsho'i hpha ran sis 'jar man dmag la ngo rgol byed skabs/ ha la ma mi sa ya gcig dang 'bum lnga tsam gyi srog shor ba dang hpha sgor 0dung phyur nyis stong ri ba'i rgyu nor brlag pa sogs kyi gyong gud tshabs chen thebs/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul gzhir bzung nas thog mar hpha ran sis sa khongs phyir len pa'i gnad don dang 'jar man dang 'brel ba'i sa mtshams gnad don la gros byed rgyu dang / de nas mi ser spel yul dang tshab dngul sprod pa sogs kyi gnad don la gros bya dgos ’ zhes bshad ma thagadabyin ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen lo te cor kri 0yis tshig rjes 'brangs te/6 nga tsho'i dbyin ji rgyal khab hpha ran si'i lta ba der 'thad pa yin ’ zhes bshad/de ltar/ hpha ran si'i tsung li dang dbyin ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen gnyis kha 'cham sgos a me ri gas bton pa'i thog mar rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel gnad don la gros bya rgyur rgol gtam btang bas/ zhi ba'i gros mol gyi gros rim gnad don thad la'ang kha rtsod drag po byung / a me ri gas u tshugs sgos thog mar rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel gnad don ཿ tāḥ/na sbya/ 6664khu 70 045 sto /rtsa 1841—1929/bye sla ti 'o/ra sgril0ba 77610576la rtsa zo lkolko1863—1945

la gros bya dgos zer ba de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su a me ri ga phyug por gyur te bu lon khur ba'i rgyal khab nas bun bdag rgyal khab tu gyur/ 'khrug chen skabs su/ a me ri gas gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab khag la a sgor dung phyur brgya lhag gi dngul bun btang 'ing / tha na dbyin ji dang hpha ran si lta bu'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs ldan rgyal khab kyis kyang a me ri ga nas bu lon blangs yod/ 'khrug chen mjug sgril rjes a me ri ga'i dpal 'byor dar rgyas chen po byung yod pas rang nyid kyi rgyu stobs la brten nas 'dzam gling yongs rdzogs kha lo bsgyur rgyu'i ham sems bzung yod/ a ri'i tsung thung khril son gyis kyang 'dzem zol spu tsam med par/ 66rang nyid kyi shes rab la brten te 'dzam gling do dam bya rgyu yin zhes bshad myong / 'khrug chen mjug bsgril ma thag a me ri ku'i 'go gtso tshos 'char gzhi 'di ltar bkod yod de/ sngon chad 'jar man dang de'i mna' 'brel rgyal khab gzhan dag la dbang ba'i e sha ya'i dbus rgyud dang shar rgyud kyi mnga' khongs dang mi ser spel yul dag rang la dbang bar bya rgyu dang / mtsho nag po'i du mtsho 'gag dang tur ki'i mnga' khongs kyi cha shas 'phrog nas e sha ya chung bar rang nyid kyis dbang bsgyur bya rgyu'i ham sems bcangs yod la/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i sa khul du/ sngon chad 'jar man la dbang ba'i gling phran 'ga' yang bdag tu 'dzin bsam yod/ krung go'i gnad don thad du sgo 'byed srid jus lag bstar bya rgyu'i blang bya bton te/krung gor gnas pa'i 'jar man gyi stobs shugs la brten nas 'jar pan gyi gnya' gcog rgyu'i bsam pa bzung / yo rob gling du/ 'jar man gyi dmag don dang dpal 'byor nyams rgud du ma song na dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/du mtsho nag po/ 21gyi bya sa 67

su'u we yed u ru si sogs la kha gtad gcog byed kyi yo byad bya chog pa'i bsam ngan bcangs yod/blul son gyis gong gi ham sems che ba'i 'char gzhi de dag mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du/ rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel 'dzugs pa'i thabs kyis dbyin ji dang hpha ran sis bdag tu bzung pa'i sa cha mang po tshur len pa'i bsam pa bcangs/ wil son gyi 'char gzhi ltar na/ rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel la g.yul las pham pa'i rgyal khab kyi mi ser spel yul dang mnga' khongs kyi cha shas shigargyal khab gcig gam 'ga' re la bka' mngags kyi sgo nas dbang bsgyur du 'jug pa'i dbang cha yod/ de la bsko gzhag byas pa'i dbang bsgyur lam lugs kyang zer/ lam lugs de bstar pa'i sa khul du sgo 'byed kyi rtsa don lag len bya dgos pas/ a me ri gas rang gi tshong zog sa khul de dag tu sdings te dpal 'byor dang chab srid thad nas dngos su dbang bsgyur bya rgyu de na/ a me ri ga'i 'char gzhi der dbyin ji dang hpha ran si sogs kyis rgol gtam gtong ba ni smos ma dgos pa zhig yin te/ hpha ran si yis mnga' khongs sa cha phyir len pa dang 'jar man dang yang bskyar sa mtshams dbye ba/gsab dngul 'bor chen len pa las gzhan da dung / sngon chad 'jar man la dbang pa'i hphe gling gi mi ser spel yul dang e sha ya'i sa cha khag cig 'thob rgyu'i re ba bcangs/ 'jar man bskyar du dar na rang nyid kyi dbang bsgyur la gnod par dogs nas/ 'jar man gyi stobs shugs nyams dmas su gtong rgyu dang tha na 'jar man rgyal khab gtor dgos pa'i 'dod tshul yang bton/dbyin ji bas 'jar man kha thor gtong ba'i gtam der mtha' gcig tu rgol ba sprad/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'jar man med tshe hpha ran si'i stobs shuXsdu je cher 'gro ba dang su'u we chad u ru si dang yo rob gling gi gsar

brje'i la sa 'gul drag gnon byed mkhan med par gyur pa'i rkyen gyis red/yin na'ang / 'jar man gyis rang nyid kyi 'gran ya mi yong ba'i phyir du/dbyin jis kyang 'jar man gyi stobs shugs je zhan du gtong dgos pa'i bsam tshul bton/'jar pan gyis zhi ba'i gros tshogs brgyud de 66khrims mthun sgos 'jar man la gtogs pa'i krung go'i hran tung zhing chen gyi khe dbang rgyud 'dzin byed pa dang 'jar man la dbang pa'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i nang gi gling phran khag cig bdag tu 'dzin rgyu'i re ba bcangs yod/de ltar/ e sha ya'i dbus rgyud dang shar rgyud sa khul thad nas a me ri ka dang hpha ran si gnyis 'gal ba byung zhing zhi bde rgya mtsho'i sa khul gyi thad nas a me ri ka dang 'jar pan bar rtsod pa byung / dbyin ji dang hpha ran si gnyis 'jar pan gyi phyogs su langs te a me ri gar rgol gtam btang ba dang / 'jar man kha thor gtong ba'i gnad don thad nas hpha ran si a me ri ka dang ma mthun pa ma zad dbyin ji'i lta ba dang yang 'gal zlar song /sngar dugand don gros bsdur bya skabs yang a me ri ka dang hpha ran si gnyis bar kha rtsod drag po byung / hpha ran si'i dbu bzhugs blon chen khi le min so yis sngar sa cha hpha ran si la gtogs dgos tshul bshad pas a ri'i tsung thung wil son gyis yi mi rangs pa'i nyams dang bcas te/ 6 bdag gis sngar zhes pa'i sa cha zhig yod pa go ma myong la sa de hpha ran si la gtogs pa de bas kyang go myong med ces smras par/ 6 khyod kyis go myong min de gtso bo zhig ma red/ gal srid sngar sa cha hpha ran si la ma byin na gros chod gang yin tshang ma'i steng du ngas ming 'god rgyu min/ khi le min so yis de ltar bshad pas/du sār/ bya4 tshe 69

blul son gyis kyang/ / de ltar na/ nga phyir a me ri kur log tu mi 'jug gam zhes tshig log brgyab par/ khi le min so snying rlung stod la 'tshang nas/ru min/ 'on kyang ngas de ltar byed dgos ’ zer zhor tshogs ra las phyi ru bros pas gros bya thabs med pa'i gnas su gyur/mdor na/ zhi ba'i gros tshogs steng du/ a me ri ka dang dbyin ji/ hpha ran si/ 'jar pan bcas rgyal khab bzhi yis phan tshun bar sgro 'dogs skur 'debs dang snyad 'tshol 'jigs skul sogs kyi sgo nas kha rtsod drag po byas mthar/ rgyal khab so so'i 'thus mi tshos a ri'i tsung thung gis bton pa'i bsko ga'ag dbang bsgyur la ma lugs dang len byas shing 'i ba'i chings yig la gros 'cham byung / 1919lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 28nyin gyi tshang 'dzoms tshogs chen stong du rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel gyi mna' chings 'char zin la gros 'cham byung ba dang / zla 6pa'i tshes 28gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod gsum gyi thog 'jar man gyi 'thus mi pho brang khrer se le'i me long tshoms chen du yong nas zhi chings steng du ming bkod pa red/ 'i ba'i chings yig des thag bcad pa ltar na/ hpha ran sis al sa si dudang lo ren duphyir len pa dang / sngar rdo sol gter kha lo bco lnga'i ring la hpha ran sis brko rgyu byas/ sngon chad 'jar ma na la dbang ba'i mi ser spel yul yod tshad dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ 'jar pan/ sgyel jam ②sogs kyis bsko gzhag dbang bsgyur gyi rnam pas bgo bsha' brgyab/zhi chings su krung go g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal khab yin pa snang med du bzhag nas sngon chad 'jar man la gtogs pa'i krung go hran tung gi khe dbang yod tshad dang co krug mtsho 'gag(〉kro〉57spyo)'jar pan la byin pas/ krung go mi ཿ zlorjisna si / tshe/sgo ཿ/hā mo/rdo snyelajam/ /༷6go//kṣe lko17

dmangs kyis mtha' gcig tu rgol gtam btang bar brten/ pe dbyang dmag shed can srid gzhung gi 'thus tshab tshogs pas zhi chings steng du ming rtags bkod med/dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ 'jar pan sogs kyis 'phrog rtsod byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel gyi mna' chings dang khrer se le zhi chings kyis a me ri ga'i 'dod pa skong ma thub pas/ a ri'i tsung thun khril son gyis khyer se le zhi chings steng ming rtags bkod na'ang a ri'i rgyal tshogs kyis zhi chings la chog mchan ma bkod cing / a me ri ka rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel gyi gras su'ang mi zhugs pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra byung ba red/khrer se le zhi chings kyis a me ri ka dang dbyin ji/ hpha ran si/ 'jar pan sogs btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi chog shes med pa'i 'dod rngam mtshon par byed la/ de ni btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab bar gyi 'gal ba dang g.yul las pham pa'i rgyal khab bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du bzhag pa'i chings yig cig yin pas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa 'byung ba'i byur rkyen du gyur/71

ke mal 1881lor skyes/ kho'i a pha sngon chad sa gnas kyi khra'/ dpon byas myong / ke mal chung dus nas a pha tshe las 'das pas kho dang a ma/gcen mo gsum gcig la gcig brten gyis 'tsho ba rol/ byis pa'i dus kyi ke mal mda' rtsed bo'u rtsed dang 'thab res byed pa'i rtsed mo rtse rgyur ha cang dga' la dmag dpon gyi 'gro 'dug spyod gsum la de bas mos gus che/ mi ring bar kho'i 'dun pa mngon du gyur te skam dmag gra sgrig slob grwar zhugs pa red/ dge rgan gyis kho la dga' bo byed pas kho'i ming dngos ma mu'u si tha hpha zhes mi 'bod par ke mal du 'bod/0ke mal lo bcu bzhi'i steng gra sgrig slob grwa nas mthar phyin te dmag dpon slob grwar zhugs pa dang / de nas slob gnyer grub rjes e si than pul medamag don slob grwa chen mor rgyugs 'phrod pa red/ slob grwa chen mo ru khos yo rob nub ma'i chab srid skor gyi bcoms chos mang po bklags nas sngon thon gyi bsam blo'i gzhi rkang brtan por tshugs shing ngan rul du gyur pa'i tur ki'i srid gzhung la 'khon sems bcangs/ slob mthar phyin rjes/ skam dmag jus 'don lte gnas su bya ba gnyer zhing gsang ba'i sgo nas rang dbang tang khag cig rtsa 'dzugs byas te tur sku'i gnas bab sdug po bsgyur rgyu'i blo thag bcad/ yin na'ang / ring po ma lon par kho'i bya spyod de skabs de'i dbang 'dzin pas tshor te kho rang btson du bcug pa dang /btson nas grol rjes skam dmag jus 'don lte gnas su sdod du ma bcug par mtha' 'khob kyi skya dmag ru khag tu mngags/1917lo'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su/ pho lo so lnga lon pa'i ke mal gyis srid gzhung la snyan zhu zhig bris te skabs de'i tur ki'i gnas ཿ cho trī pasna 34pa /dri ༷swā spya 〉 〉〉 shān gyi don du go 73
