khos an thu lis ya sa khul gyi kha thor tu gyur ba'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mi rigs rtsa 'dzugs te/ mi rigs khe dbang srung skyob mthun tshogs gcig gyur byas pa ma zad/ rgyal yongs su brda yig bkrams/ brda yig tu/ mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs la phog thug gtong mi rung ba dang nga tsho'i mi rigs rang btsan bya gzhag la khe nyen chen po yod pa/ nga tshos rang nyid kyi rgyal dmangs gros tshogs bsdu dgos la da nas bzung ste e si than phul srid gzhung gis yan thu lis ya sa khul la dbang bsgyur bya mi chog pa ma zad an thu lis ya sa khul gyi khongs su gtogs dgos pa sogs kyi nang don mang po bkod/ ke mal gyi gsar brje'i bya spyod de e si than pul srid gzhung gis tshor song bas kho gang myu ra gyis e si than pul du phyir log dgos pa'i bka' phab na'ang / ke mal gyis srid gzhung la las dgongs zhu yig cig sprad de rang nyid spyi dmangs phal ba zhig gi thob thang gis an thu lis ya ru 'dug rgyu yin zhes bshad/ de nas bzung / khos rang nyid kyi las dbang de tur ki'i mi rigs bcings 'grol la sa 'gul dang dam du sbrel ba red/tur ki'i mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul mgyogs por dar rgyas byung ste/ 1919lo'i zla 9par mi rigs khe dbang srung skyob mthun tshogs kyis rgyal yongs 'thus mi tshogs chen 'tshogs shing / gros tshogs su 'thus mi'i u yon lhan khang bdams pa dang ke mal kru'u 'i ru bskos/ ke mal gyis 'thus mi u yon lhan khang gi gnas yul de se lnga si dunas an thu lis ya sa khul gyi dbus 'gyur grong khyer an kha ra du ru gnas spar pas grong khyer de mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul gyi lte ba ru gyur/ gros chings ba'ag pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs rgyal khab kyis btsan thabs la brten nas tur ki'i mi rigs ཿ ṭā/ hā /ra/bya/rdoji swā 〉〉ṣṭha 75

las 'gul la drag gnon byed rgyu thag gis bcad pa dang / 1920lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 16nyin/ dbyin ji'i mtsho dam ga e si than phul du thon te grong khyer de bdag tu bzung yod ces bsgrags pa dang / tur ki srid gzhung dang dbyin ji'i dmag gis ke mal nyes can du brtsis te dmag don khrims khang gis mi med ming stong gi srog khrims bcad/yin na'ang mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul gyi 'go khrid pa de 'jigs pa spu tsam med par 1920lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 23nyin yon kha ra nas tur ki'i rgyal dmangs dbyi hu'e gros tshogs bsdus shing ke mal dbyi hu'e kru'u zhir bskos/ rgyal dmangs dbyi hu'e yis rang gi rtsa 'dzugs de ni tur ki'i khrims mthun srid gzhung nyag cig yin pa khyab bsgrags byas/ dbyi hu'e gros tshogs 'tshogs pa'i nyin gsum par/ ke mal gyis le nyin la 'phrin yig springs te phan tshun bar phyi 'brel 'dzugs rgyu'i gros gzhi bton pa ma zad/su'u u yis tur ki'i btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod la rgyab skyor byed pa'i blang bya bton/ lo de'i ston gar rgyal khab gnyis kyi bar du gzhung tshab rim pa'i phyi 'brel btsugs pa red/dbyin ji srid gzhung gi 'dod tshul ltar na/ kho tshos tur ki'i mnga' khongs bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i lam gyi 'gag rdo gtso bo ni an thu lis ya sa khul gyi mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul yin pas/ dbyin ji dang gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i tur ki srid gzhung gis zla 6pa'i nang dmag mngags te an kha ra la rgol ba'i sbyor ba brtsams/ yin na'ang bye ma'i changs bu dang 'dra ba'i dpung de 'thab thengs gcig la g.yul las pham pa red/de nas grabs gshom gang legs byas te/ 'gro song dbyin jis btang zhing dmag mi ghi ri sis btang ba'i dmag gi dpung chen po zhig ye tsi mer na/ sdum la chas te an kha ra'i phyogs su bskyod/ zla 8par/ gros chings

ba'ag pa'i rgyal khab kyis ga'an dbang du gyur pa'i tur ki'i srid gzhung la btsan dbang gi sgo nas pha ri si'i nye 'gram gyi si spror ༷ grong brdal du 〈〈si klor 'i chings 〉〉zhes pa'i rgyal khab kyi la rgya dang bdag dbang shor ba'i chings yig 'jog tu bcug chings yig de gzhir bzung na/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor thad nas tur ki'i rang btsan rang bdag gi dbang cha yod tshad shor te dbyin ji dang hpha ran si/ dbyi tha li'i mi ser spel yul du gyur/phyi rgyal gyi dam/ga gis tshur rgol byas pa dang si spror chings yig bzhag pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis tur ki'i mi dmangs rnams kyi sems gting nas khro ba'i me lce drag tu 'bar te sngon chad bar ma'i tshul du gnas pa'i 'ing ba rnams dmag nang du zhugs shing tshong dpon tshos kyang gtong phod chen pos ke mal srid gzhung la rogs skyor byas/1921lo'i dbyar khar ghi ri si'i dmag gis yang bskyar tshur rgol byas te zla brgyad pa'i stod la an kha ra dang thag mi ring ba'i sa nas g.yul bshams pas/ ke mal srid gzhung dang tur ki'i mi dmangs nyen kha che ba'i gnas su gyar/ zla 8pa'i tshes 15nyin/ ghi ri si'i gong ma khon si than thin ②gyis/ 8 an kha ra la dpung 'jug byed ces pa'i bka' btsan po gnam lcags thog 'dra ba phab pa red/ de lta bu'i gnad 'gag gi dus su/ rgyal dmangs dbyi hu'e yis ke mal spyi khyab bkod 'doms par bskos te gnad don yod tshad thag gcod pa'i dbang cha gnang ba red/ ke mal gyis de ma thag dmag ru bskyar sgrig byas shing g.yul bsham pa'i 'char ga'i gtan la phab/ zla 8pa'i tshes 23nyin/ an kha ra dang spyi le bzhi bcu yis chod pa'i sa ཿ 'o/ sru/thadzo rmā/4/ chinā nā kyis za khri1 77

kha lis ya(9rdos/༅)chu bo'i shar 'gram du phan tshun g.yul gyi sbyor ba bshams shing nyin nyer gnyis ring dmar 'dzing byas pa brgyud de ghi ri si'i dpung tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlags/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'thab la rgyal kha thob par brten/ rgyal dmangs dbyi hu'e yis ke mal la dmag spyi'i thob thang dang 6 ca tshi (rnam par rgyal ba )zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gnang /sa kha lis ya g.yul 'gyed kyi rjes nas ghi ri si'i btsan 'dzul dmag bsdud mar g.yul las pham zhing 'dzam gling yongs kyi gleng phyogs kyis kyang spyi ri si'i bya spyod la rgol gtam btang bas/ ghi ri si'i dmag mi tshos kyang rang nyid btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi lag cha yin pa ngos zin byung ste/ dmag sga ra gyi sgo chen du 6 nga tsho gnas 'dir skyel ma/khan de tsho'i bya ba lam 'gro mi yong bar smon/’ zhes pa'i yi ge sbyar/1922lo'i zla 8par/ ke mal gyi dmag dpung gis phar rgol byed pa'i mgo brtsams pa red/ tshes nyer lnga'i mtshan mor gsang ba'i sgo nas g.yul sa bzung pa dang phyi nyin skya mda' shar ba dang mnyam du/ ke mal rgyal dmangs dmag gis gnam lcags thog mda' 'bab pa ltar ghi ri si'i btsan 'dzul dmag la rgol ba sprad/ nyin lnga'i ring la 'khrug pa brgyab nas ghi ri si'i dpung shugs gtso bo cham la phab pa dang / zla 9pa'i tshes 2nyin/ ghi ri si'i btsan 'dzul dmag gi spyi khyab bka' 'joms dmag dpon tho li ku pe(〉skyospri147ri)gson por bzung / zla 9pa'i tshes 9nyin/ ke mal gyi dpung gi kha lo ghi ri si'i dmag gis yun ring bdag tu bzung ba'i ye tsi mer grong du bsgyur te ghi ri si'i dmag mi lnga khri bzung ba red/ zla 9pa'i tshes 18nyin la bslebs tshe/ an thu lis ya sa khul gyi ghi ri si'i btsan 'dzul dmag yongs rdzogs cham la phab zin/ ke mal gyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i tur ki'i dmag gis gadhikā gyi rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs te mtsho 'gag dang e si than pul

phyogs su dpung gi kha lo bsgyur/ lo gsum ring la dka' spyad 'bad 'thab byas pa brgyud de/ ke mal gyis sne khrid pa'i tur ki'i mi rigs rang btsan gyi 'thab 'khrug la dngos su rgyal kha thob/gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og tu/ 1923lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 24nyin si we tser lan ḍi rgyal khab kyi la'o san dugrong khyer nas 'tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng du/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis tur ki rang btsan yin par khas len pa'i 〈〈la'o san chings yig 〉〉mi 'jog thabs med byung /zla 10par/ tur ki spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes/ ke mal tsung thung thog ma ra bdams pa dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsgyur bcos rab dang rim pa byas/ de ltar/ o si man btsan po'i rgyal khyab kyi shul du 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mi rigs rang btsan rgyal khab cig btsugs pa red/du la'o san/ ji 5mtshoba'achi 79

lha the khen rgyal phran/'jom gling na rgyal khab cig yod pa de grong khyer chung chung zhig gi che chung tsam las med de/ mnga' khongs spyi le gru bzhi ma 0 44tsam las med la/rkang thang gis thengs gcig la bskor ba byas na chu chod skar ma 45 tsam gyis chog rgyal khab 'dir mi grangs 1000yas mas yod la/— de las 8596 ni dbyi tha li pa rjodang / 157ni si we tser lan ḍi dang rgyal khab gzhan pa'i mi red/ yul 'di'i mi phal che bas dbyi tha la'i skad dang la ting skad du bshad/rgyal khab hril bo san thi pe tu thang chen du las gzhan tshang ma mkhar gyang mthon pos yul gru gzhan dang bar mtshams bcad yod/ rgyal phran 'di ni dbyi tha li'i rgyal sa ste/ mdzes shing sdug pa'i gna' bo'i rom 0grong gi nub byang na yod pa'i sa mtho zhig gi steng du chags yod la/ sa mtho 'di'i ming la ༵ ༵ ngakhi zlo ༵ khi/ ༵ ṭī /sna snas kā /nga yul la thogs nas rgyal khab de'i ming lba the khrin rgyal phran ni lo rgyus thog gi chos bdag rgyal po'i rgyal rabs kyi rgyud yin te/ der 'dzam gling gi lha khang chen po ste/ san thi pe tu lha khang yod la/ lha khang gi mdun du mi khri 10lhag shong ba'i san thi pe tu thang chen yod/thang chen gyi gzhigs gnyis kyi khyams ra rdo ka ma ru'i ka ba 240yis grub cing ཿ shārnyi ཿ pa// / 7 zloṣṭhaḥtsho lasbya rdo/ ṭwāṃ tram̐ /shu kau nī/༵ mtsho 07 thamatsho cha'i nga
tsho po ri byu༄go pye ba kwa ri rigartsa tshotshorachi wa shāshrī'e)spu // khusnid

bdag gi yan du dbang chen med par ma zad/ rang nyid ni 6 ye shu'i 'jig rten 'di'i sku tshab mi yin par sgrog la/ 'dzam gling gi gnam bdag chos lugs kyi do dam las khungs thams cad la kha lo bsgyur ba'i dbang cha bdag tu nyar/ rgyal khab 'dir chos bdag rgyal po las gzhan da dung chos dpon gzan dmar pa 100lhag gis grub pa'i gzan dmar can gyi chos tshogs sheg yod pa chos bdag rgyal po'i blo 'dri las khungs so// gzhan rgyal srid drung yig khru'u dang chos tshogs thun mong las 'dzin lhan tshogs kyang btsugs yod/rtsa 'dzugs 'di rnams la'ang dbang cha chen po yod la/ srid don dang phyi 'brel gyi bya ga'ag dag thag gcod pa'i 'gan khur/da lta lba the khin la 6 phyi 'brel sku tshab ’ 134yod pa so sor 'brel yod rgyal khab dang sa khul/ rgyal spyi'i rtsa 'dzugs las khungs sogs na sdod cing /phyi'i rgyal khab 100lhag gis kyang rgyal khab 'dir phyi 'brel bca' sdod sku tshab mngags yod/ 1942lo'i zla 6par/ lba the khin dang krung go go min tang gi cang ce hri srid gzhung gnyis kyis phan tshun phyi 'brel btsugs pa nas da ltar thug gi bar the wan dang zer sgros kyi ra phyi 'brel da dung rgyun bcad med/bshad rgyun ltar na/ rom chos bdag la khri rabs bsdoms pas 266yod la/ de dag las khri yun ches ring pa ni khri rabs 257pa ste si dgu pa 0yin te/ khong lo 32la (1846wa 1878lo)srid khrir bsdad/ khri yun /snadu gādī dī spya / darabs 23pa bo'u 'ar pan bdun pa 0yin te/ khrir nyin lba the khin ni sa lag mthil lta bu zhig las med na'ang / des skad ཿ ཿ zlo /sdo thon/ ba/ni sna/pyahārngo3967ma khri112—1tshestoyas rmi sa//bye 15masa'i 9pa' tshes15nas 9pa'i tshe 27nyin bar/

rigs mi 'dra ba 6gis gzhung phyogs tshags par 〈rdom lta dpyad tshags par 〉dang / dus deb 〈chos skyong srid gzhung gi yig rigs phyogs bsdus〉/ lo deb 〈chos ston pa'i lo deb 〉rnams spel myong / 1926lor rgyal spyi'i hphe thi ( 74lha3)'phrin gtong khang btsugs la / 1957lor rgyang bsgrags las khungs btsugs nas nyin mtshan gang bor mtshams mi chad par skad rigs 30lhagagis 'dzam gling sa khul yongs la rgyang sgrog byed/ lpa the khin la rgyal lab rang gi nyen srung dmag dpung dang khrims khang / sbrag srid/ dngul lor bcas yod par ma zad/ rang nyid kyi rgyal dar dang rgyal rtags sogs kyang yod/ riḥ gras dang gtan 'khel thams cad rang btsan rang dbang gi rgyal khab lta/ dzabye gli/ nga thog sa bzung tshad ches chung yang thun mong ma yin pa'i bkod pas mdzes pa'i rgyal phran 'di ji ltar byung ba yin zhe na/spyi lo dus rabs 4pa'i skabs/ khon si than thin ①btsan rgyal chen pos rom btsan rgyal gcig gyur byas rjes/ skabs de'i chos tshogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs kyang btsan rgyal gyi rnam pa ltar chos khul 5ru phyes/ de'i lte ba ni rom dang / khon si than thin pol/༷je ro sa lem/0e leg zan der/0an this ā khi 0bcas so// sa khul 'di 5bo rgan rabs lngas so sor bdag gnyer byed la thams cad rom gong ma'i mnga' 'og yin/ spyi lo 476lor rom nub ma'i btsan rgyal 'jig rjes rom chos khul gyi bdag pos yo rob nub ma'i chab srid yun ring mor sde gzar zing slong nang lhung ba'i skabs su rang nyid kyi 0 khon si than thin/ 00 3 la sa za ma1shā ཿ /sdi swā nānā dzin 5 sdu 3/chis/shā skya tshi/za ma12 ཿ ṭā/ krā /smu khyer〉〉〉pa sa ༅77ma 83

dbang shugs rim bzhin je cher btang ste/ rjes su chos bdag rgyal po zhes par gyur/ spyi lo 756lor hpha ran khi'i ༷rgyal po phe phen ②gyis 'phrog yong ba'i sa cha ste/ rom mkhar grong dang de'i mtha' bzhi'i sa khul chos bdag rgyal por sprad de dbang bsgyur du bcug pa nas chos bdag rgyal po'i rgyal khab chags mgo brtsams/ rjes su chos bdag rgyal po'i dbang shugs nyin re las nyin rer ches cher rgyas pas/ chos bdag rgyal po'i pho brang (nang chen )de yo rab nub ma'i chos tshogs kyi chab srid 'tsho ba'i dkyil snying du gyur/ chos bdag rgyal pos thad kur bdag tu bzung pa'i sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma khri 4yod/1870lor dbyi tha li gcig gyur du byas rjes/ dbyi tha li rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyis chos bdag rgyal pos bzung ba'i rom mkhar grong dang de'i mtha' bzhi'i sa rnams phyir bsdus pas/ chos bdag rgyal po 'u thug nas rom mkhar grong gi nub byang phyogs kyi sa mtho lba the khen la phyir bsdur te der gnas bcos/ 1871lor dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis chos bdag rgyal por 〈'gan srung khrims 〉bsgrags nas/ chos kyi gong ma'i srid phyogs kyi dbang cha phyir 'phrog skabs de'i chos bdag rgyal po bhe si sku phreng dgu bas 〈'gan srung khrims 〉khas ma blangs/ khong gis chos bdag rgyal po ni ye shu'i bkas mngags pa yin pas rgyal khab gang gis kyang khas len dgos don med la de tsho'i tshod gcun yang myong don med par 'dod/ khong dang kho'i rjes 'jug pa tshos lo bcu phrag du mar 〈'gan srung khrims 〉khas mi len pa'i mtshon don du lnga the khin las phar gom gang yang mi spor ba'i dam bcas nas/ rang nyid rang gis lnga the khin gyi btson mar bsgrags/ chos bdag rgyal pos gnam sdu : rshatna khi/21//sduhrīḥzo

bdag chos la dad pa'i rgyal khab yod tshad kyi 'go gtso thams cad lnga the khin la chos bdag rgyal por mjal du yong dgos par ma zad/ dbyi tha li rgyal po dngade'i srid gzhung la 'brel ba ci yang bzung mi chog par bkas bcad la/da dung dbyi tha li'i gnam bdag chos pa rnams dbyi tha li'i rgyal tshogs bya 'gul la zhugs mi chog par thag bcad pa na/ dbyi tha li'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung gis de mur mdung rtse kha sprod kyis gnam bdag chos kyi dge sgrub khang stong phrag lhag gtor zhing / rgyu nor rnams gzhung bzhes byas par ma zad/ slob grwa nas chos lugs slob gso 'gog pa sogs thabs la brten nas chos tshogs la 'khon lan bslogs/ dus de nas chos bdag rgyal po'i rgyal khab kyi ming 'di spyir btang du mi spyod do//yin na'ang / chos bdag rgyal po dang dbyi tha li srid gzhung bar gyi 'gal ba mtha' dag de la brten nas thag gcod ma thub par/ hpha shi si ring lugs pa mu so li nyi 0 srid khrir 'khod rag bar du rtsod pa'i rgyun bskyangs/mu so li nyi yis dbang bzung rjes rang nyid kyi hpha shi si ring lugs phyogs bzhir spel ched/ 1926lo nas bzung chos bdag rgyal po la gsang stabs kyis gros mol byed/ 1929lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 11nyin/ phyogs gnyis gas phan tshun mthun 'grig legs lam du gnas pa'i nyer bsdogs la brten nas lba the khin gyi lā thu lan (ṣṭha/rshazo)pho brang nas chings yig la ming rtags bkod pa de la rjes su〈〈lha thu lan chings yig 〉〉zer/ de'i nang don gtso bo ni/ dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis lba the khin ni 6 rang btsan gyi rang bdag rgyal khab cig tu khas len par ma zad/ a sgor khri 9000btegs nas chos bdag rgyal por sngon chad thebs pa'i gyong gud 'jal byed du byin/ chos 0 mu soli nyi/ chas ༷55376 sa cha chokhu 85

bdag rgyal po dbyi tha li srid gzhung dang mnyam 'brel byas nas dbyi tha li'i gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis nges par du hpha shi si ring lugs kyi srid gzhung la sri zhu bsgrub par thag gcod par 'thad/ lba the khin rgyal phran 'di ltar tshul min gyi nyo tshong la brten nas btsugs shing / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su kha g.yar sa mang po btsal nas thog mtha' bar gsum du 'jar man dang / dbyi tha li/ 'jar pan sogs btsan 'dzul rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs so//

she thi leral ji ltar dbang thang rgyas pa/6 gsham gyi slob ma dag gi rgyugs 'bras mi bzang bas slob grwas mi bsdu/ a to hphu'u she thi ler 0 ni/ pha yul/ o si 'o ri ya'i po la'o na'o(70cha )grong sde/skyes skar/ 1889lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 20nyin/ mi rigs/ 'jar man pa/0chos lugs/gnam bdag chos lugs/ pa'i las rigs/ gzhung zhabs pa/ slob sbyong gi brgyud rim/ 'bring rim lo bzhi/ rgyugs tshig mgo ris/ dpyad gtam/ tshod ltar bris pa'i rgyugs 'bras yid tshim pa zhig med/ 'di ni 1907lo'i zla 10par o si 'o ri ya'i rgyal sa we en na'i mdzes rtsal slob grwa chen mo'i rgyugs phul slob ma'i ming tho zhig gi steng shi thi ler la bris pa'i dpyad gtam mo//skabs der she thi ler lo na 18yin zhing / khos rang nyid la mdzes rtsal phyogs kyi skyes stobs kyi yon tan yod pas mdzes rtsal slob grwa chen mor rgyugs bde blag sgos 'phrod par 'dod yod kyang mjug mthar slob grwar zhugs ma thub/ don la khos slob sbyong la sdug rus gtan nas mi byed pa dang / lo na 16steng du glo nad byung nas slob mtshams 'jog dgos pa byung ba la dga' drags nas chang btung ste ra bzi/ lo ngo 30lhag 'gor ba'i rjes su khos lan grangs du mar rang nyid kyi rgyugs 'bras mi legs pa'i khag dge rgan la bkal nas 6 ngas rang nyid slob grwa 'grim skabs kyi dge rgan tsho sems la dran thengs rer kho tsho'i phyed ka rgyun ldan min par 'dod/ kho tsho ni ba'i lhan skyes kyi ཿ pa/ / 〉na /thi gāswā/nga sbyiXshā〉 tshi ba/ lko lko 0 87

dgra'o zhes bshad/she thi ler rgyugs ma 'phrod par po la'o na'o grong sde la phyir log rjes/a pha lo 'ga'i sngon la tshe las 'das pas khyim gyi 'byor ba ha cang 'an stabs/a ma dang gnyen nye rnams kyis kho la las ka 'ig btsal te lag rtsal sna 'ig sbyangs nas khyim gyi dka' ngal sel bar skul ma byas kyang khos gtan nas mi nyan par grong dang grong gseb kyi la lung kun tu nyul ba dang / grogs po tsho dang mnyam du brgya bshad stong bshad kyi lab gleng ngang la dus 'da' zhing /khos bshad pa'i 6 snying bos dben pa'i bag yangs kyi 'tsho ba ma nyams su myangs/cang ma 'gor bar she thi ler gyi a ma'i nad je sdug tu song nas las kur 'gro ma thub pas/ bza' tshang gang bo'i 'tsho rten gnyen grogs tsho'i rogs skyor la brten dgos par gyur yang / she thi ler da dung sngon ltar bag med ngang 'khyam zhing / rang nyid rang gis che 'byung 'gyur gyi sgyu rtsal bar ’ dbang bskur nas nyi ma 'khyol thabs byas/ 1908lo'i zla 12pa ste/ she thi ler lo 19lon dus kho'i a ma tshe las 'das/ de'i skabs kyi she thi ler la lag rtsal sna gcig kyang med la/ rang kha rang gis gso rgyu'i bsam pa rtsa ba nas med cing / gnyen grogs tshos kyang las la mi spro ba phag pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin mkhan gyi mi 'di la rogs byed ma 'dod pas/ kho bo 'u thug thabs zad kyis sems la skyid po dran zhir yul nas ma bsdad par ldom du phyin/ring po ma 'gor bar we en na khrom nas mi tshos rgyun du gos rnying hrul bosgyu pa lta bu'i lu ring nag po zhig gyon zhing / lag tu kha dog sna lnga'i tshon ris 'ga' bzung nas khe ba nyi tshe ba rnams la 6 sgyu rtsal brtsams chos ’ 'tshong bar 'dur bzhin pa zhig mthong thub pa de ni she thi ler red/88kho'i brtsams chos dag ni gzhan gyi brtsams chos 'dra bshus brgyab pa'i

we en na'i yul ljongs kyi ri mo red/ khos tshong khang chung chung dag gi tshong bdag tshor sbyar ris 'bri ba dang / bse dri sel bcos byed mkhan tsho'i bse sel byugs rdzas sogs la mtshams sbyor brda yig 'bri ba/ skabs la lar mi'i 'dra brnyan kyang 'bri yang / kho la skya ris kyi rmang gzhi med pas mi tshos khos bris pa'i 'dra ris 6 srin po sha za ’ dang 6 brjid chags pho brang phyi rol gyi bye phung dang 'dra zer/ 'di ni she thi ler gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du rang nyid rang gis 66sgyu rtsal la skyes thob kyi shes rab can du dbang bskur ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi grub 'bras ngo ma red la/ de las kyang dgod bro ba zhig ni khos shi rag bar du rang nyid che skyes thob kyi sgyu rtsal pa zhig yin par 'dod pa de'o//she thi ler gyi 8 brtsams chos ’ nam rgyun phyir btsong thub pa zhig min la/'tsho ba'i ched du byis pa dang rgan pa med po 'ga' dang grogs bsgrigs nas we zin na'i hri krug 'bab tshigs kyi rkub bkyag steng gi mgron po mi bca' thabs mad byuzlo e/ na na nas lo ba'i lhag bsdad ring / she thi ler nyal sa kho na las med pa'i tshong 'grul gnas tshang chung chung zhig gi nang bsdad nas 'khyam por gyur/ khos dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par tshil dreg chags nas 'od 'phro pa'i zhwa mo nag po 'ig gyon la/ zhwa mo'i 'og na skra rnams rab tu 'dzing zhing gnya' gong gi skra lo gcig tu 'ching nas dreg pas btum pa'i lwa ba'i gong ba rdzob po de yongs su bkab yod pas ya ma gzugs su snang ngo //she thi ler we yen nar sdod skabs dpe cha bklags myong ste/ lo rgyus phyogs kyi dpe cha las gzhan/ le'u the la rgol ba'i ring lugs(khu7lta4zhulha5)pa'i dpe cha'ang mang po bklags myong / rjes nas 66nga kho tshor zhe sdang skyes mgo brtsams shing / ye'u the la rgol ba'i ring lugs pa 'ig tu gyur ’ zhes bshad cing / 'jar man mi rigs kho nas o si 'o ri ya'i ma 'o|sdu pa

skyob thub par 'dod/1913lo'i zla 5par she thi ler we en na nas nyi ma gtong dka' bar gyur pas thabs zad de 'jar man la song nas stabs ka re e 'grig la blta sa na 'dod kyang / 'jar man gyi mu nyi chi dul thon rjes/ bya ba ngo ma zhig ma rnyed pas sngon ba'in bkren par gyur/ 1914lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po rgyag skabs kho 'jar man nas rang 'dod kyis pa hphu ri ya 0 rkang dmag mda' shog tu zhugs/ 'di'i skor la khos rjes kyi 8 〈ba'i 'bad brtson 〉〉zhes pa'i nang na 'dis nga rang na gzhon skabs nas man ra yong ba'i med po'i sdug bsngal gyi khur chen de las grol du bcug pa 'dra/ spro sems bzod med cig gi rkyen gyis ngas pus mo sa la btsugs nas gnam rgan mas skal bzang gi go skabs 'di gnangs par bka' drin zhus tshul de gsang zol med par khas blangs pa yin ’ zhes bris yod/yin na'ang she thi ler gyis we en na'i 'tsho ba gtan nas brjed thub med de/ rjes su phyir dran gyis 66de ring yin yang grong khyer 'dis nga'i sems la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba kho na sbyin par byed/ nga la mtshon na mos dal bag phebs kyi grong khyer 'di'i ming gis mtshon pa ni lo lnga tsam gyi dbul phongs dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba de'o// lo lnga bo de'i nang nga rang dbang med par sdug gis ded nas bya ba re btsal te kha gso thabs byas pa yin/ de yang thog mar gzhan gyi gla pa byas shing gzhug nas ri mo ba chung chung jig byas mod/ 'on kyang yong sgo nyung drags pas nyin re'i ltogs skom yang sel dka' mi zhes zer/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po mjug rdzogs rjes/ 'jar man pham kha ༵ sa spra sdi /ya/gshāḥshā 〉shā snyiḥshāḥ༅

nyo mkhan gyi rgyal khab tu gyur/ zla bcu ba'i gsar brje'i shan shugs kyis 'jar man gyi bzo ba gral rim dang sngon thon mi snas so sor 1918lo'i zla 11pa dang 1919lo'i zla 4par snga phyir bzo zhing gi tshab byed su'u we chad dang su'u we chad spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs kyang / cang ma 'gor bar drag gnon gyis gtor/ skabs der she thi ler o si 'i ri ya'i mtha' mtshams kyi bzung dmag gi sgar zhig na nyen srung ba'i 'gan khur yod/ 1919lo'i dpyid kur mu nyi chi la phyir log 'jar man srid gzhung gas skabs der log spyod kyi brtag dpyad u yon lhan khang zhig btsugs te/ su'u we chad srid dbang byung don la ched du brtag dpyad byas/ she thi ler brtag dpyad tshogs pa der zhugs par ma zad/ rin thang chen po yod skad kyi gsang 'phrin zhig lag son byang / kho'i log spyod kyi bsam blo dang le'u the la rgol ba'i ring lugs tshabs sdu ba'i rkyen gyis gong rim gyi gzengs bstod thob cing / cang ma 'gor bar mda' shog cig tu mngags te khrid dpon gyi 'gan sprad/lo de'i zla 9par she thi ler slar yang mu nyi chi na yod pa'i 6 'jar man bzo ba'i tang zer ba'i chab srid tshogs pa chung chung jig la brtag dpyad byed du song / de'i khongs mi bsdoms pas 40tsam las med la/ gzhan pa'i chab srid tshogs chung mang po dang 'dra bar spyi tshogs steng na grags 'gul chen po med/ nyin zhig she thi ler bka' bkod ltar tang 'dis hri tan nā khi pa'o lo(so'iyoskopo777)wu chang khang gi khang mig mun nag 'thibs pa zhig tu tshogs bzhin pa'i tshogs 'du der zhugs la/ tshogs zhugs mi grangs 25tsam las med/ nyin gnyis par kho la shog ldebs 'phrin yig 'byor nas 6 'jar man bzo ba'i tang la zhugs chog pa'i brda brgyab/ de bas kho tang 'di'i u yon ang 7par gyur/de nas bzung she thi ler gyi chab srid kyi 'dod rngam yun gyis je rdo /sa

je cher song ste/ dmag dpung dang spyi tshogs steng gi bsam pa ngan zhing sbyor ba rtsub pa/ snying rje med par gtum spyod la dga' ba'i mi rnams ched du btsal nas tang nang du blangs/ 1920lor khos chu bzhur ba lta bu'i kha lce dang sa bshad gnam bshad kyi ngag gi rtsal la brten nas 'jar man bzo ba'i tang gi dril bsgrags bya ba'i 'gan khur/ ga sa gar song nas tshogs 'du bsdus te gtam brjod spel zhing / thabs 'di 'drar brten nas rang nyid kyi tang nang dang spyi tshogs steng gi go gnas je mthor yong ba'i 'dun pa bcangs/tang 'di'i 'gug shugs dang bslu brid kyi nus pa je cher gtong ched/she thi ler dang kho'i rogs pa tshos 1920lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 24nyin bsdus pa'i tang yongs kyi tshogs chen thog rtsa 'dzin sna kha 25bton/ rtsa 'dzin de dag yi thang chad pa'i shu sgra'i khrod nas bklag tshar ba yin yang / she thi ler gyis gdong lpags mthug pos rtsa 'dzin la tshogs chen thun mong nas mos mthun byung bar bsgrags/ rtsa 'dzin nang du/ she thi ler gyis 'jar man mi rigs thams cad ta'e dbyi tri(006)rgyal khab chen po(btsan rgyal ang gsum pa zer)nas gcig gyur byed dgos pa gsal bor bstan te/ 'jar man gyi khyim mtshes rgyal khab o si 'o ri ya dang / cheg si lo wa khi ya/༷po lan ḍi dusogs kyi 'jar man pa tsho'i gnas yul dag kyang 'jar man gyi mnga' khongs su 'gyur dgos pa de'o// rtsa 'dzin gyis da dung 'jar man rgyal khab nas ye'u the pa tshos gzhung 'gan khur mi chog pa dang / spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha'ang yod mi chog pa/ gsar 'gyur las ka bsgrub mi chog pa/ 1914lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi gzhug nas 'jar man la 'byor ba'i ye'u the pa tshang ma snro ཿgā gni shā wa trī sdusgo/ /7251༷ spe cho lo sa

rgyal khongs nas phyir mthar skyod gtong dgos pa sogs thag bcad cing /ye'u the la rgol ba'i bsam blo de rtsa 'dzin nang shin tu gsal por mtshon yod/she thi ler gyis 'jar man pham rjes dka' sdug khrod gnas pa'i 'bring 'bas rim pa'i mi dmangs kyi 'dod pa la bstun ched/ mnyam 'brel chen po'i khe las dag rgyal khab la dbang dgos pa dang / sa bogs len mi chog pa dang mgo bde glags 'tshong 'gog pa/ rgyal tshong chom thun dang skyed che'i bu lon len mkhan/ mgo bde skabs 'tshol can rnams srog thog tu gtong ba'i re ba rnams bton zhing / sger sdom can gyi tshong zog sna 'dzoms tshong khang rnams gzhung la blangs te gong dma' mos tshong ba chung chung rnams la gla dgos pa'i lta ba bzung / 'di ltar byas na bzo ba'i tang 'dir ru spyi tshogs ring lugs ’ kyi bsam blo ngo ma yod par mi rnams yid ches su 'jug thub/ dril bsgrags bya 'gul 'ga' spel ba'i rjes nas 'jar man bzo ba'i tang gi ming 66rgyal khab spyi tshogs ring lugs 'jar man bzo ba'i tang ’ 0du bsgyur zhing / dmigs yul ni mgo skor bslu brid kyis mi mang po tang 'dir zhugs su 'jug rgyu de'o//she thi ler tshogs pas phyogs gcig nas kho tsho'i 6 spyi tshogs ring lugs mil tshad brgal gyis 'ud bstod byed pa dang / phyogs gzhan 'ig nas skam dmag la 'brel ba bzung nas drag shugs kyi rgyab rten btsal/ gzhan ma snro can gyi khrod du 'chad skor la phyin te de tsho'i sa nas rogs dngul 'bor na bla/ ༵/ ler gyis rang nyid kyi stobs shugs je cher gtong ched/ tang nang gdamag khongs nas phyir log pa'i dmag mi rtsing spyod can tsho las grub pa'i 6 rtog zhib ru dpung zhig btsugs shing / 1921lo'i zla 10par 6 rtog zhib 0 rgyal khab spyi tshogs ring lugasa'ajar man bzo ba'i tang / bsdus ming la rgyal spyi tang 7zer la/ snye na dzi gluni tang 'di' bsdusaming gi sgra ra red/ 93

ru dpung ’ la gdong mchong ru dpung zhes pa'i ming dngos su btags/gdong mchong ru dpung gis mdog kham ser can gyi las gos gyon zhing / yi ge〉ris can gyi dpung rtags 'dogs/ de'i thog ma'i 'gan khur nā dzi ⑦tang gi tshogs 'du'i sgrig lam la srung skyob byed rgyu yin mod kyang / cang ma 'gor bar srid tang gzhan pa'i 'du tshogs la phung dkrug byas par ma zad/bzo ba'i las 'gul la gnod bskyal ba dang / mi gsod 'jigs skul byas pas/ nā dzi tang gi dmag don gyi rang bzhin phyed tsam yod pa'i rtsa 'dzugs shig tu gyur/ de dang mnyam du she thi ler gyis da dung phyogs ris 'then 'khyer 'jigs skul dang dbyen dkrug sogs g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba la brten nas/kho'i tang nang gi las grogs rnams la kha gtad bcags pa dang / tang gi dbang cha rang lag tu lon ma thag tang gi rtsa 'dzin bzo bcos dang / 'go khrid las khungs gtor nas/ rang nyid gtso 'dzin la bsdad de/ dbang cha bdag gir bzung nas dbang cha sger gcod byas/1919lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 28nyin zer se le'i chings yig la ming rtags bkod pa des 'jar man mi dmangs la khong khro bslangs pa na/ 'dod rngam me ltar 'bar ba'i she thi ler gyis go skabs slobs song snyam nas/ thog mar pa blu ri ya nas srid dbang 'phrog la/ de nas mu mthud du per len la dmag drangs te rang nyid kyis yongs su dbang bsgyur chog pa'i ta'i dbyi tri'i rgyal khab 'dzugs rtsis byas/ 1923lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 8nyin khos 'phrin gsar gal chen zhig thos pa ni khul srid gzhung gi dpon rigs chen po gsum ste/khul dpon khā 'ar(rdopo)dang / pa rmu ri yar sdod pa'i rgyal srung dmag gi dmag spyi la'o so hphu'u(lkolkolko)/ nyen rtogs cu dpon sā 'ar(zloṣṭha)༵༵ nā dzi gakhu mas

gsum po khe las che ba'i tshogs pa kha shas kyis gdan drangs te/ mu nyi chi shar lho mtshams kyi ming la pa'i ki pa'o lo khi na(767077)zer ba'i wu chang khang chen po nas tshogs 'du chen po zhig 'tshogs rgyu de'o// dgong mo de'i dus tshod 8dang skar ma 45stong ste/ khul dpon khā 'ar gyis grong mi 3000lhag la gtam bshad gnang nas dus tshod phyed tsam la nye ba'i skabs su/she thi ler gyis gdong mchong ru dpung drangs yong ste wu chang khang yongs su bskor rjes/ sgo chen khar me mda' sbag sbag btsugs/ kho rang tang mi mang pos phyi nang du bskor te tshogs rar thon 'ing / sgrog tse zhig gi thog la lding nas dkrum mda' yis khang pa'i gnam gcal steng du mda' gcig 'phangs pa na/ der tshogs kyi khrom pa rnams dal cag ger btang la khā 'ar gyis kyang gtam bshad mtshams chad pas/ mi mang gis de mur kha phyir 'khor nas yang snying don dag ci byung la lta dus/ she thi ler khro ba'i rdzi sha rgyug bzhin 'chad stegs phyogs su yong zhor khyad mtshar gyi lab brdol mgo brtsams pa mthong /6 rgyal yongs gsar brje mgo brtsams song /’ she thi ler gyis nyan mkhan rnams la 'jigs skul gyi skad cor chen po brgyab nas/ 8 sa khul 'di drag chas mi sna drug brgyas bzung tshar/ mi su yang tshogs rwa las sgor song mi chog tshang ma kha rog la mi 'dug na khang pa'i nang du me mda' btsugs nas drag gnod byed rgyu yin/ pa rmu ri ya srid gzhung dang rgyal yongs gnas skabs srid gzhung gi dbu brnyes song ba red/ rgyal srung dmag sgar dang nyen rtog cu tshang ma bzung zin la/ dmag mi dang nyen rtog rnams yi ge garis can gyi dar cha'i 'og grong khyer nang dpung 'jug byed bzhin yod ces bshad/der mthun nas she thi ler gyis gdong mchong ru dpung gi dkyil nas dkrum mda'i kha dpon po gsum la gtad de/ kho tsho btsan gyis stegs bu'i rgyab kyi khang chung zhig nang du khrid rjes khram pa'i rdzog nyams kyi sgo nas //da

gsum pos legs par nyon dang / nga'i bka' med par su yang gson por khang pa 'di las 'gro ma 'dod/ khyod tshos yin gcig min gnyis nga dang mnyam du gsar brje byed rgyu bsgrags nas/ srid gzhung gsar bar zhugs te ngas khyod tshor gtad pa'i 'gan dang du len dgos/ sus kha la mi nyan na gson rgyu'i re thag chod cig ’ ces btsan btsugs/ dpon rigs gsum pos mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs dang du blangs nas kho la kha ya ma byas/ she thi ler gyis lag gi me mda' bskor bzhin je btsan du song nas 64nga'i dkrum mda' nang na mde'u bzhi yod/ gal te khyod tsho nga dang lag gdang mi sbrel na/mde'u gsum gyis khyod tsho srog thog tu gtong la/ mde'u gzhug ma nga rang la 'jog pa yin/ zhes 'jigs skul rjes/ yang dkrum mda' rang gi dpral bar 'dzugs bzhin 8 gal te sang nyin phyi dror nga'i bya ba da dung ma 'grub tshe nga la srog 'di mi dgos ’ zhes skad cor brgyab/skabs 'dir dpon rigs gsum po'i gras kyi khā 'ar gyis 6 sku zhabs she thi ler/ khyod kyi gdong mchong ru dpung la bka' gnangs te gsod pa'am khyod rang nyid kyis lag 'gul ba gang byas kyang rung ste/ nga shi rung gson rung ha las dgos don gang yang med ces lan btab/nyen rtog cu dpon sā 'ar gyis she thi ler gyi bya spyod la rgol gtam btang ska/ bas 'dir/ she thi ler sgyu ma mkhan zhig dang 'dra bar glo bur du rgyal gces pa zhig tu spras te/ ngag 'jam pos dpon rigs gsum la 6 khyod tsho thugs rgyal ma bzhengs dang / ngas mes rgyal gyi ched du 'di ltar mi bsgrub thabs med byung zhes smras/yin na'ang khā 'ar gyis mi gzhan zhig dang skad dma' mos gros byed pa na/mis thi ler gyis de ma thag 6 kha rog tu sdod/ nga'i chog mchan med par kha

brda byas mi chog ’ ces skad cor brgyab/pa hphu ri ya srid gzhung gi dpon rigs gsum po she thi ler gyi me mda'i 'jigs 'og tu tshud yod kyang / kho dang gros yong rgyur gcig kyang ma 'thad pas/ she thi ler gyi 'char gzhi 'grub ma thub/ yin na'ang / khos tshig gcig kyang mi bshad par sgo phyi'i tshogs rar brgyugs nas 'chad stegs steng du bud de/ btsan gyis bkag pa'i nyan mkhan 3000la dpon po gsum po kho dang mnyam du rgyal yongs srid gzhung gsar ba zhig 'dzugs rgyur 'thad pa byung bar rdzun smras nas 66de ring srid gzhung gsar ba mu nyi chi yi sa cha 'di nas dbu brnyes par bsgrags pa yin/ 'jar man rgyal srung dmag dpung myur du 'dzugs rgyu yin la/ ngas rgyal yongs srid gzhung gi srid jus khrid ston bya ba'i 'gan len rgyu'i 'dod blo bstan pa yin :zer/de dang mnyam du she thi ler gyis pho nya mngags te srid gzhung la mi dga' ba'i dmag dpon lu'u tin ta'o blu ༷sa chang khang la bos nas yong / dmag dpon 'dis sngun la she thi ler gyi g.yo jus mi shes kyang / she thi ler gyis srid 'gyur slong bzhin pa dang srid gzhung gsar ba'i dbu 'dzin rang nyid min pa shes rjes cung zhig mi dga' bar gyur mod/ 'on kyang khos dpon rigs gsum por she thi ler dang mnyam 'brel bya rgyu'i kha ta byas/ dpon rigs gsum pos dmag dpon lu'u nyin ta'o rmus rnam 'gyur de 'dra bzung yod pa mthong rjes she thi ler dang gros mthun par byas/she thi ler dga' spro tshad med skyes shing brel myur gyi sgo nas dmag dpon lu'u tin ta'o spu dang dpon rigs gsum po 'chad stegs su khrid de gtam bshad du bcug kho tsho re re nas srid dbang gsar bar 'bas zhu sgrub rgyur 0 lu'u tin ta'o spru/ stus 05657༷sa ༷rwa skyas 97

mos mthun byung ba'i skad cha 'ga' re smras pa na/ she thi ler gyi rdzun gtam tshang ma skad cig der bden par gyur pas/ she thi ler dga' drags nas kha yang zum mi thub par gyur te/ 6 da lta'i 'jar man gyi nyam thag pa'i gyang ro'i steng stobs dang ldan zhing rang dbang yod la dpal gyis phyug pa'i 'jar man zhig 'dzugs rgyu yin zhes yang bskyar rdzun gyi rnga ma bskyangs/she thi ler gyis nyan mkhan rnams la btsan gyis kho'i rdzun la nyan tshar du bcug rjes da gzod tshogs ra dang 'bral du bcugayin na'ang she thi ler dga' rgyu snga drags song ba ste/ khul dpon khā 'ar glod grol byung rjes mu nyi chi yi ga sa gang du brda yig sbyar nas 6 nga dang nyen rtog cu dpon dang rgyal srung dmag spyi gsum pos me mda'i 'jigs skul 'og nas rang dbang med par spel ba'i gtam bshad tshang ma da nas bzung mi brtsi/rgyal khab kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs bzo ba'i tang yin gcig min gnyis la thor dgos mi zhes kun la bsgrags/ gnas bab 'di 'drar thug na ci zhig byed dam/ lu'u nyin ta'o rmu yis she thi ler la/ skam dmag dang nyen rtog pas khor me mdas mi rgyag par yid ches zab mo yod la/ kho gnyis kyis rgyab skyob mkhanadang gdong mchong ru dpung khrid de grong khyer gyi dkyil la khrom skor du song rjes/ skam dmag pu'u tshur la len rgyu'i gros gzhi bton 'ing / she thi ler la'ang de las lhag pa'i thabs yag po med pas lu'u tin da'o hphu yi bsam 'char dang du blangs/nyin gnyis pa ste/ zla 11pa'i tshes 9nyin she thi ler dang lu'u tin da'o hphu gnyis kyis ha spam mi grangs 3000yod pa 'i dmag dpung zhig khrid nas/wu chang khang gi me tog ldum ra nas lam la chas te mu nyi chi grong dkyil du dpung 'jug byas/ kho gnyis dang dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis 'gro mkhan la gdong ma~X ru dpung gi ru gtso ko len dang nā dzi yi 'go ba 'ga' mchis/

ru dpung gi sne len mkhan gyis ngos su yi ge garis can yod pa'i dar cha zhig khur yo da la/ nā dzi 'go ba rnam sa kyi rjes su dam por 'brang bzhin pa ni zong skyel rlangs 'khor steng na me mda' sbag sbag btsugs yod pa zhig red/de'i rjes na phrag tu me mda' khur pa'i gdong mchong ru dpung yod la/ 'ga' zhig gi lag tu rtse gri yang thogs yod/ dmag dpung 'phrang dog pa'i hphu'u ti(slo1yi)lam gyi phu la thon pa na nyen rtog pas bkag nā dzi pa chos sngon la lag 'gul nas me mda' brgyab kyang / skar ma gcig tsam 'gor rjes kho tsho pham par brgyab/ nā dzi pa 16thang la bsgyel zhing / la la shi zhing la la rmas/she thi ler ni thams cad kyi sngon la thang du nyal mkhan yin la/ ches sngun mar yar langs nas 'bro mkhan yang red/ khos shi rmas byung ba'i zla bo tshor kha ya byed khom tsam yang med par dngangs 'tshab kyis sngon la gra sgrig byas yod pa'i rlangs 'khor du 'dzul nas bros/ nyin gnyis 'gor rjes srid gzhung gis kho bzung ba dang / kho'i zer sgros kyi 6 lu chang khang gi drag po'i yar langs ’zhes pa pham par gyur/'jar man rgyal khab kyi nyes khrims su gtan 'khel byas pa ltar na/ she thi ler tshe btson du 'jug dgos kyang / 'jar man gyi skabs de'i rnyog dra che ba'i chab srid gnas bab dang log spyod pa'i stobs shugs mu mthud nas je cher 'gro bzhin pa'i stabs kyis/ 1924lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 1nyin lo lnga tsam gyi khrim sa thag las ma bcad/ 'on kyang she thi ler gyis khrims khur nas zla 9yang ma 'gor ba ste/ lo de'i zla 12pa'i tshes 20la btson nas glod grol byung /btson nas thar rjes khos ngan pa skyag lang gis nā dzi tang dang rang nyid ni 6 spyi tshogs ring lugs pa ’ 'khrul med yin pa ra 'ur bsgrags la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas thabs shes gang yod kyis 'byor ldan gral rim dang skam dmag gi rgyab rten btsal bar ma zad/ nyen srung ru khag gi tang srung hā/ga

btsugs te gdong mchong ru dpung gi stobs shugs rgya bskyed pas mang tshogs skor zhig gi yid ches thob/ lo du ma'i ring gi 66'bad pa mi brgyurdo nas/ nā dzi tang 1932lor 'jar man gyi tang chen ang dang por gyur/ lo der she thi ler 'jar man gyi rgyal khongs su tshud/1933lo'i zla 1tshes 30nyin/ she thi ler gyis rang nyid tang chen ang dang po'i 'go gtso yin pa'i cha rkyen bed spyad nas/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi sbyor ba mang du brtsams te 'jar man gyi tsung li la bsdad/ khos 'gan khur ma thag 'dzem pa med par 6 'jar man la 'tsho gnas kyi yul dgos zhes sgrog cing / dmag dpung rgya bskyed nas dmag 'khrug gi sta gon bgyis te/mtha' mjug 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa bslangs/ de nas bzung 'jar man mi dmangs dang / yo rob rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs/'dzam gling hril bo'i mi dmangs rnams dmag 'khrug gi sdug 'obs su ded nas/ dka' sdug dang mnar gcod tshad med myangs pa yin no//100

ritsā ri zla 3pa'i tshes 5la 'jar man 4ca tsho kā gyis dbyi hu'e / kānyutshung) gros tshogs 'dems bsko bya rgyu red la / she thi ler kyi rgyal spyi tang ste/hpha shi si nā dzi tang nas 'dem sa chi sko'i khrod rgyal dku blangs te sger — — gcod spel 'dod nga de'o/ ja man thu la hphu gros tshogs thog rgyal kha 'thob dgos na thog ma ra cis kyang hpha shi si la ngo rtsol byed mkhan dang gung khran tang gnyis khrim sa ma thun rngi na pa bsgra gas dgos/ de ltar ma byas tshe kho rang tshor 'dem sa thog ma nga po 'thob tu 'jug rgyu'i 'char ga'i de stong bar 'gyur 'gro/mig sngar byung ba'i rgyal tshogs thog khang mer bsregs pa'i gyod gzhi ni she thi ler hpha shi si'i ngan g.yo 'i sbyo ra ba dang po brtsam sa pa red de/ don ngo ma ra ko ren ①gyis rgyus khyi ma ngags nas byas pa red/ kho tsho'i dmigs yu la rmi don dag der khas brkyal nas hpha shi ser ngo rtsol byed ma khan tsho'i sto bas shusas dang 'jar man gung khran tang gi ma go mar gnon rgyu de'o//je man thu lo tru la 'jar ma na gung khron tang gi bya ba bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen je sdug nas je sdug tu 'gro nges bsam pa snga mo nas yod la/ don la'ang tag tas de ltar byung ste/ kho rang per lin la phyir log pa'i nyin 'asa'i nang /'jar ma na gung khran tang gi kru'u 'i en si zi nāl man 0 bzung 'ing / de dang chabs cig 'jar man gung khron tang yon dang sngon thon dag sel pa/gsar 'god pa/ shes yon mi sna gzhan pa bgrang gis mi la nga pa zhig bzung /192ཿ/rgyu /sprosu rshahāswārnyi 6༷/ chirdo rānu kṣe sa ṣṭhamos 9 pos

sngon thon gyi tshags par dang dus deb kyang mtshams bcad pas/ kho rang mu mthud du per lin nas bsdad na'ang bya ba nyin re las nyen rer bsgrub je dka' ru gyur/ skabs der khos gung khran rgyal spyi'i yo rob nub ma cu yi 'go khrid kyi 'gan khur yod la/ bya ba'i dgos dbang gis 'jar man dang yo rob rgyal khab gzhan pa dag tu 'gro 'ong byas te rgyal khab de dag gi gung khran tang yon gyi bya 'gul la rgyus lon dang mdzub ston bya dgos/ khos phyogs gcig nas sbrul man gyi bde 'jags la sems khur byed cing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rgyal khab gzhan par gnas spor rgyu'i gra sgrig kyang byas/ zla 3pa'i tshes 9nyin/ je man thu lo hphu per lin gyi las mjug bsdu ba la brel ba'i skabs der/ hpha shi si'i sdig grogs ter man (7lotstsha)gyis gtug pas kho bzung la/ kho dang lhan du da dung yul gne ri ya'i gung khran tang yon gnyis kyang bzung/she thi ler hpha shi si'i tshags par gyis/ zla 3pa'i tshes 9la bzung ba'i rgyal gne ri ya'i gung khran tang yon gsum po dang zla 2pa'i tshes 27la rgyal tshogs khang chen sreg skabs sa de ga nas bzung ba'i 8 gung khran tang yon yin skad kyi phod ) lu'u pe (7 7 97)sogs ni rgyal tshogs thog khang la me sgron mkhan nyes can yin la/ mi 'di rigs bzung ba yis 'dzam sprang sbring khran ring lugs kyi lkog g.yo'i ngan spyod rdul du brlags zhes 'ud na zlo kta ṭī/ kā/gas par gyis 'ur gtam yud tsam la bsgrags rjes/ zla 8pa'i tshes 3nyin rdzun dang ngan g.yo'i tshig gis khengs pa'i yig gtam shog lhe 235lhag longs pa'i gtug yig cig rdo chag btsan sgrig byas/ gtug yig gi mjug tu yul gne ri ya'i gung khran tang yon gyi 'go khrid je man thu lo rmu ma mtha' yang rgyal tshogs thog khang bsregs pa mdzub ston dang skul slos spyad

par zhugs yod ces bris/ hpha shi sis yang bskyar mno bsam nan mos ngan jus shig bshams pa ni/ khrims thag gcod pa'i go skabs bed spyad de/ rgyal tshogs thog khang mer bsregs pa'i nyes pa je man thu lo spru dang 'jar man gung khran tang yon tsho'i steng du bkal nas/ gung rgol mtho rlabs shig slong bsam mo// kho tshos yid sems rab tu tshim pa'i sgo nas rgyal tshogs la me btang pa'i gyon don de na lu'u pe dang de'i sdig grogs kyi gyod don :zhes par bsgrags shing / gyod don btsan rgyal khrims khang thin ang bzhi bar sprad de le phu zeg sa cha nas zhib bsher byed rgyu byas shing / dus tshod 1933lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 21nyin la gtan 'khel byas/je man thu lo hphu sogs bzung rjes/ 'jar man gyi sngon thon mi snas rgyal spyi rogs skyor u yon lhan tshogs btsugs/ kho tshos dag sel pa grags can mang po bsdus nas rgyal spyi brtag dpyad u yon lhan tshogs shig btsugs nas/rgyal tshogs thog khang bsregs pa'i gnas tshul ngo mar brtag dpyad nan mo byas te/ rgyal tshogs la me bsgron pa'i gyod gzhi'i gnas tshul ngo ma'i skor gyi dpe cha zhig kyang dpar/ zla 9pa'i tshes 21gi yar sngon la rgyal spyi brtag dpyad u yon lhan tshogs pas dbyin ji'i dag sel pa grags can tan phu'u lis thu((1 dzā'itsho chu)yi 'go 'dzin 'og nas tshogs 'du bsdus/ 'di ni 'dzam gling na grags che ba'i 6 lon ton ①zhal lce dgag pa'i mi don rkyen de red/ 66lon ton zhal lce dgag pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis btsan rgyal khrims khang gis 'al lce gcod pa'i nyin sngon ma ste/ zla 9pa'i tshes 20nyin la je man thu lo rmu dang gung khran tang yon tshor nyes pa med pa'i sdom tshig yongs khyab tu bsgrags/ de dang mnyam du sgrub byed nus ldan dpang du bcol te/ rgyal ༵༵lon ton/ jiXrsā70ye ma

tshogs thog khang ni nā dzi'i 'go 'dzin pas bsregs pa'am kho tsho'i khrid ston 'og nas bsregs pa yin pa'i dogs slong chen po byas/rgyal spyi'i brtag dpyad u yon tshogs pa'i 'al lce dgag pa'i yig rigs kyis/ rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs la shugs rkyen chen po thebs pas/ le phu zig gi zhib dpyod nga dang khrims dpon gyis kyang rgyal spyi'i brtag dpyad u yon tshogs pa'i sdom tshig la 'dang mi rgyag thabs med byung /zla 9pa'i tshes 21nyin/ le phu zeg nas khrims thag gcod mgo bcoms/hpha shi si nā dzi pa rnams kyis gdeng tshod dang bcas te mkha' bsher glog sgron dang sgra phab 'phrul 'khor/ glog brnyan par chas sogs khyer yong zhing / sgra skyed glog dung rgya srang gi bzhi mdo ru btsugs te/ phar 'gro tshur 'ong gi mi rnams la nang don nyan du bcug par ma zad/ phyi rgyal gyi gsar 'god pa mang po bos yong nas zhal lce la nyan du bcuganyin dang po dang gnyis par lu'u pe la zhal lce bcad cing / nyin gsum par je man thu lo rmu la zhal lce bcad/ skabs der rgyal khab gang mang nas 'ong ba'i khrims rtsod mkhan grags can rnams kyis rang rtogs kyi sgo nas je man thu lo spru la dag sel byed par 'dod/ btsan rgyal khrims khang gis kho la dag sel mkhan rang mos kyis gdam du ma bcug par/ 'jar man gyi dag sel pa thu chur po hri(77po tsho)dag sel mkhan du bskos pas/ je man thu lo rmu yis rang gis rang la dag sel byed rgyu'i thag bcad/ de'i rkyen gyis kho khrims thog tu 6 zhu sbyor phyi ma ’ red la/ 6 zhu sbyor phyi ma yi dag sel mkhan yang red/zla 9pa'i tshes 23nyin/ 1882lor skyes shing lo na 12nas bzung par 'debs bzo ba byas pa dang / lo na 20nas bzung rang nyid 'byor med gral rim gyi bya gzhag ched phul ba'i byul gne ri ya'i gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 07 je

man thu lo spru gzi brjid kyi ngang la khrims khang du langs shing / dpa' ngar zhum med sgo nas rang nyid ni 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje ba yin zhing /kho rang gi 'tsho ba'i don snying yang gung khran ring lugs kyi rgyal kha'i ched du 'bad 'bungs byed rgyu de yin lugs khyab bsgrags byas la/ gnongs 'gyod ci yang med par rtsod rigs kyi lam nas rgyal tshogs la me shor dus/ kho rang nyid per lin du gtan nas med pas rgyal tshogs bsregs pa'i ngan spyod kyi sbyor ba ni gung khran ring lugs kyi dgra bos byas pa yin par ra sprad/je man thu lo hphu yis bden lugs la brten nas nā dzi pa tshos rang nyid la zhal lce gcod pa'i khrims khang de gung khran ring lugs dril sgrog byed sa dang hpha shi si'i nag nyes dang lkog g.yo ther 'don byed sa ru btang 'i// khrims khangagi khrims dpon la'ang kho'i lag gi dri ba 'don pa'i dbang cha 'phrog ste/je man thu lo spru yis 'dri rtsad kyi kha phyogs la dbang sgyur bzhin yod pa lta bu'i snang ba skye ru bcug khrims dpon gyis myur du zhal lce gcod mtshams bzhag nas lhan rgyas gros mol byas pa'i 'bras bu ni/ je man thu lo rmu yis gang 'dod du gung khran ring lugs dril bsgrags byed pa'i dbang bkol pas/ kho la dri ba 'don pa'i dbang med par thag bcad/ yin na'ang khrims khang nang gi phyi gling gsar 'god pa dang srang lam gyi mang tshogs rnams kyis je man thu lo spru yi blo brtan 'gyur med kyi gtam bshad thos pas/ tshang mas 6 rje man thu lo rmu ni blo rno zhing shes rab me ltar 'bar bas rang nyid zhu sbyor phyi ma nas zhu sbyor sngon mar btang song ’ zhes bstod pa'i mthe bong sgreng bar byed/nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes / je man thu lo hphu yis khrims khang nas lu'u pe la mi tshogs kyi mdun du rang nyid mthong myong min bshad du bcug par/ lu'u pe yis ngas ngo mi shes la mthong yang ma myong zhes lan btab/ khong gis 6 nyi1/ sduga'i sngon la lu'u pe yis spyi tshogs phan bde cu yi shing khang chung chung

zhig kyang mer bsgron mi thub na/ ngar lcags dang ar 'dam gyis bzos pa'i rgyal tshogs thog khang la me de 'dra chen po ji ltar bsgron thub ’ ces yang bskyar dri ba 'phangs shing / nu mthun nas skad gseng mthon pos gung khran rgyal spyis rgyal tshogs thog khang mer bsregs pa'i gnas tshul ngo ma rtsad gcod gsal bo byed par re ba che la/ sem sa can gyis de'i la na la sgug yod ces bshad pa na/ khrims dpon gyi ha las hon thor gyis kha la rgya btab ba'in smra ba med par gyur pas/ 'tshub cha langs nas 'al lce ma tshams mi 'jog thabs med byung / yud tsam 'gor rjes/ khrim/sa dpon gyis ma yin yin mdog gis na zhu sbyor phyi ma dang khrims dpon gnyis go rim gnad don thog la kha rtsod byung myong bas/ khrims khang gis je man thu lo hphu thengs gsum la khrims rar zhugs mi chog pa'i thag bcad pa yin mi'es bsgrags/je ma na thu lo rmu yis de ma thag khrims khang la 'phrin yig gi lam nas dgag pa btang bar ma zad/ rgol ba'i sbyor ba'ang brtsam sa/ khos 'phrin gyi mjug tu/ 6 nga ni rang nyid kyi dag sel pa yin/ khyod chos 'di ltar byed pa ni nga'i khrims rtsod kyi dbang cha mngon sum du 'phrog pa red/ gal srid khyod tshos nga khrims rar zhugs su mi 'jug na/ bdag gis da dung khrim sa rar zhugs pa'i dgos pa yod med la bsam blo gtong rgyu yin zhes bris/zla 11pa'i tshes 4nyin/ rgyal tshogs kyi gros dpon te/ nā dzi yi 'go ba'i gras mi ko ren dngos su mi 'ong thabs med byung / ko ren gyis gdong mchong ru dpung gi lwa ba gyon zhing / 'bas zhu ba skor zhig khrid nas gung khran ring lugs rtsa med du gtong rgyu'i tshugs ka ston gyin khrims khang la yong /satam brjod nya nyog mang pos dus tshod gcig dang phyed ka phar bskyal rjes/sgrub byed snga phyi 'gal ba'i dpang tshig dang dpang po rdzun ma 6 gal chen yin zer ba de byas/ ko ren gyis skad cha bshad tshar ma thag je man thu lo ༵ dis

6 sku zhabs ko ren lags/ nga la 'dri rgyu zhig yod pa ni khyod kyis lu'u pe yi lus na gung khron tang yon gyi lag khyer yod zer te/ lu'u pe 'dzin mkhan gyi nyen rtog pa gsum pos khrims ra nas lag khyer ci yang ma rnyed pa bden dpang byas zin pa 'di ci yin zhes dris pa na/ ko ren gyi rdzog nyams 'dra chags kyi bzo lta de mur shor zhing / lan 'debs dus tshig snga phyi 'brel mi chags shing ci bshad 'di bshad med par gyur/ ko ren thabs bkod zad tsam na rang gi ngo bo dngos ma rjen par bstan nas 8 rgyal tshogs la me bsgron pa'i gyod ga'i gung khran tang yon gyis byas pas/ gung khran tang yon rtsa med du btang na 'grig mi ces skad cor brgyab/ je man thu lo rmu yis 'jigs pa med par 6 rtsa med du gtong 'os ’ pa'i tang gis sa'i go la'i176ste/ su'u len dbang du sgyur bzhin yod/ rgyal khab 'di dang 'jar man gnyis la rgyun ldan gyi phyi 'brel dang nyo tshong gi 'brel ba yod la/ 'di'i rkyen gyis 'jar man pa khri stong mang por bya ba las rgyu yod pas las shor byung med ces rgol lan btab/ko ren gyis je man thu lo rmu la sdang mig gis lta ba'in klad pa dkrug yag cig byas kyang ngag nas pha rol po bzlog nus pa'i tshig gcig kyang ma thon pa na/ khrims bdag myur du yar langs te 6 zhu sbyor phyi mas gung khran ring lugs dril sgrog byed mi chog mi ces bshad nas kho la rogs byas/ yin na'ang rig pa myur zhing shes rab phul du byung ba'i rtsod gleng mkhan po je man thu lo rmu yis 6 sku zhabs ko ren gyis 'di na rgyal khab spyi tshogs tang dril sgrog byed bzhin 'dug ’ ces tshig gcig gis ko ren gyi gtam brjod kyi ngo bo gsal rjen du bton/ ko ren ni khro ba bslangs pa'i gcan gzan gtum po zhig dang 'dra bar re thag chad nas ngar skad rgyag cing / je man thu lo rmu la ru sgor song / khram pa/tā 8 ces skad brgyab/ mtshams 'dir thon dus hpha shi si'i mi sna 'dis

rang nyid kyis dngos su zhib dpyod 6 mdzad sgo'i phyi pags bshus shing ming yang brlags/ hpha shi sis je man thu lo hphu sogs la skyon brjod dang 6 bden dpang byas pa rnams gong 'og snga phyi 'gal zhing skyon gyis yongs su gang bas/mjug mthar khrims dpon gyis 'tshab be 'tshub be'i ngang nyen rtog par je man thu lo hphu khrims ra las sgor khrid pa'i bka' phab/ je man thu lo rmu khrims ra nas sgor 'gro skabs bshad pa'i tshig gcig ni 6 sku zhabs ko ren lags/khyod phal cher nga'i dri bar lan gdab rgyur dpa' zhum pa red ces pa ste/hpha shi si'i ngan grogs rnams kyis thos na dngangs 'dar rgyag cing bzod glags dang bral ba de'o//zla 12pa'i tshes 6nyin/ zhal lce 52pa bcad nas/ khrims bdag gis khrims khang gi brtag dpyad mjug bsgril bar bsgrags/ zla 12pa'i tshes 13nyin ni gyod bdag gi mtha' mjug gi gtam bshad kyi nyi mar thag bcad/nyin 'dir/ zhib bsher dpon pos kha nas mi thon dgu smras byas te/ rgyal tshogs thog khang la me bsgo pa ni 6 rgyal spyi ang gsum pa'i bkod pa ltar 'jar man nas su'u we ed rgyal khab 'dzugs rgyu'i brda rtags red ces bshad/khos da dung gyod ya tshang ma gung khran tang yon red la/ lu'u pe tang yon min rling / de'i dad pa dang bya 'gul la bltos nas bshad na gung khran tang yon na pazlo sdu/tā/ tshes 6nyin/ je man thu lo hphu yis gtam bshad pa'i dus thon/nyin der 'dzam gling la grags pa'i 〈〈zhal lce'i zhu sbyor 〉〉ces pa spel/ khos 6 ngas nga rang nyid de/ gzhan dbang du tshud pa'i gung khran tang yon zhig la dag sel byed rgyu yin la/ rang nyid kyi gung khran ring lugs kyi dad mos ched du dag sel byed rgyu/ ngas rang nyid 'tsho ba'i snying bo dang nang don la dag sel byed rgyu zhes bshad/ je man thu lo hphu yis hpha shi si nā dzi pa tshos gyoslo /zhi

'di bzos pa'i ngan g.yo'i dmigs yul dmar rjen du phyir phyungs/ khos rgyal tshogs mer bsreg gyod ga'i ni sngon nas gra sgrig 'ib mor byas yod pa'i 'jar man bzo ba gral rim dang de'i gdong len ru dpung gung khran tang rtsa med du gtong rgyu'i g.yo thabs kho na yin par nan gyis bstan/ khos da dung hpha shi si'i 'jigs skul gyi gnod 'tshe myong mkhan gung khran tang rtsa 'dzugs yin par ma zad/ bzo ba'i rtsa 'dzugs gzhan pa'ang yod pa de tsho re re bzhin med par btang tshar bar bshad/ mjug ma thar khos khrims khang nas spobs pa chen po'i ngang 6 ka li le'o dul nyes chad gcod dus/ khong gis sa'i go la sngar ltar 'khor skyod byed bzhin yod ces bsgrags pa de ba'in/ka li le'o ltar dam bca' shin tu brtan pa'i gung khran tang yon 'ig gis kyang de ring sa'i go la sngar ltar 'khor ba'in yod la / lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo 'gog par dka' zhing / mar gnon thabs med pa'i gung khran ring lugs kyi mtha' mjug gi dmigs 'dun phyogs su 'khor bzhin yod mices bsgrags/je man thu lo hphu yi gtam bshad 'di ni hpha shi si la btang ba'i snying stobs chen po'i rgol gtam red la/ de dang lhan cig gung khran ring 'u gas bya /'ag la ༵sa kyang rgyal kha 'thob nges pa'i blo brtan 'gyur med kyi 'dun mos 'ang /ja/ /man hpha shi si'i khrims khang gis gung khran tang yon tsho rgyal tshogs mer bsregs pa'i nyes can gtso bo yin pa'i sgrub byed dang khungs lung gtan nas ma rnyed pas/ rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs kyi gnon shugs chen po dang je ma na thu lo rmu yi dpa' ngar zhum med kyi 'thab rtsod 'og 1933lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 23nyin la je man thu lo rmu dang yul gne ri ya'i gung khran tang yon gzhan pa /sdu0ka la 'o/ 6770khrim/lo 154—192

bcomarinag tugatangari'i spyi mthun rgyal khab gsarab/1934lo'i zla 3pa'i nyin 'ig dbyi tha li srid gzhung gi sne len khang du dbyi tha li hpha shi si'i 'go ba dang si pan gyi log spyod srid gzhung gi tshab byed pa dmag spyi 'bring ba pā la'e lā ( ༅ṣṭha111)gnyis gas gsang stabs kyis gleng sol skyug bro ba zhig byed bzhin yod/ mu so li nyi yid tshim ste/ 8 khyod tshos 'gan nges can zhig khur thub na/ dngos po'i phyogs nas nga tshos rogs skyor gang legs byed nges yin zhes smras/ dmag spyi 'bring ba pā la'i lā yis mu so li nyi yis bshad pa'i 6 'gan nges can 'khur ’ zhes pa ni da so ma btsugs pa'i si pan spyi mthun rgyal khab gtor dgos zer ba yin pa nyan ma thag gis shes pas/ shog byang zhig gi steng du dmag don mtshon cha mang pos rogs skyor byed pa'i re ba bris te mu so li nyi la byin/ mu so li nyis shog byang stengagi nang don la bltas rjes/ snye nga tshos da lta nyid du me mda' khri gcig dang lag 'bom khri gnyis/ me mda' sbag sbag khri gnyis/ pa'e sad thā ༷khri 150ster la khyod tshos ci dgar spyod chog ’ ces smras shing / cung tsam 'gor rjes 'tsher snang ci yang med par yang bskyar 6 rjes su gnas tshul la bltas nas rogs skyor gyi tshad je mang du btang chog 7zer/dmag spyi 'bring ba pā la'i lā ni mu so li nyi'i 6 gtong phod la dga' ba rab tu skyes nas/ phyir 'gro khar mu so li nyi la phyag 'bul ba dang mgo sgur gnya' zhum byas te sems 'gul chen po thebs pa'i tshugs ka bstan/|lha pan gyi dngul gyi ming /

'di ni si pan gyi gong ma'i srid dbang lam lugs gtor te/ spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs rjes kyi lo gsum pa'i nang byung ba'i don zhig red/de dang mnyam du/ si pan gyi sger gcod pa sngon ma phu'u le ma'o ti le ba'i lā (rsātshorsā ṣṭhatsho:ṣṭhaṣṭha)yi bu hi sad 'an ta'o nyi a'o ti lā ba'i chis (sa lngalkokhyaṭha ṣṭhaṣṭhatsho4rsha)kyis rang nyid kyi srid tang ste hpha shi si 6 bo'u ring tang mi ( ṣṭhaṣṭhaṣṭha)gi tshab byas te per lin la 'tshams 'dri zhus shing / 'jar man hpha shi si srid gzhung gi bsu ba rgya chen thob/ gleng mol byasanas cung tsam 'gor rjes she thi ler gyis gsang zol med par bo'u ring tang la dgos mkho yod tshe/ 'jar man gyis rogs ram dang rgyab skyor byed 'dod yod tshul bstan/'di ltar/ pā la'i lā dang ti lā ba'e chis gnyis kyis 'go khrid pa'i si pan spyi mthun rgyal khab la rgol ba'i log spyod pa'i stobs shugs gnyis la hpha shi si 'jar man dang dbyi tha li yi dmag don rgyab skyor thob/ cung 'gor rjes 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i spyi'i jus 'don pa thad kur si pan log spyod pa'i dmag don zing 'khrug gi byed sgo ji ltar rtsom pa'i 'char gzhi'i bkod sgrig la zhugs/hpha shi si 'jar man dang dbyi tha li gnyis kyis si pan nas gsang myul dra ba btsugs/ si pan gyi gnam gru 'bab tshigs sogs nas phar 'gro tshur yong gi mi rgyus med je mang du song zhing / de tshos 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i mkha' nas skyel ba'i dmag don dngos rdzas kyi sa gnas la myul zhib byed bzhin yod/ rgyal sa ma ti rid 0 kyi chang khang chung chung kha shas su chang dang zas rigs 'tshong bar kha g.yar nas lkog tu mtshon cha bskyel/ kho chos da dung du ma ti rid/ 57076 2 113

thob thang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su spras nas/ spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi sde khag so so las gsang 'phrin btsal zhing / spyi mthun rgyal khab gtor rgyur gra sgrig sna tshogs byed bzhin yod/dmag dpung nang gi dmag dpon log spyod pa kha shas kyis kha nas spyi mthun rgyal khab la blo dkar zhing / rgyal khab bsrung ched 'bad pa hur thag byed rgyur dam bcas kyang / lkog tu zing 'khrug la gra sgrig byed kyin yod de/6 si pan dmag don mnyam 'brel btsugs nas/ si pan gyi zhing chen yongs dang mi ser spel yul mo ro ko'i tshubaca' sdod dmag dpung la 'brel ba dam po bzung / rtsa 'dzugs 'di'i u yon lhan tshogs kyis 〈〈brda khyab 〉〉mtshams ma chad par btang nas/ drag chas zing 'khrug gi gra sgrig bya bar bkod sgrig dang 6 mdzub ston ’ byed/ 〈〈brda khyab 〉〉tu/ don dag grub rjes 6 las 'gul 7la zhugs pa'i dmag dpon yod tshad la go gnas 'phar du 'jug rgyu dang tshe gang gi zla phogs ster rgyu yin tshul bsgrags/chos 'chad pa dang grwa pa log spyod pa mang po yang log spyod tshogs khag 'dir zhugs/ de tshos lu ring phud de spyir btang gi lu ba gyon zhing nyul ma'i las ka dang du blangs/ de dag gi dgon pa dang lha khang tshang ma mtshon cha skung sa dang drag po'i yar langs la gra sgrig byed sar gyur/yin na'ang gsar brje'i stobs shugs si pan nas nyin re las nyin rer je cher song ste/ yun gyis gnas bab legs po bzung / 1936lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 16la/ si pan dbyi hu'e gros tshogs kyis 'dems bsko byas shing /gung khran tang dang g.yon phyogs spyi tshogs tang / spyi mthun mna' 'brel/ si pan bzo ba spyi tshogs tang / bzo ba'i spyi khyab lhan tshogs/ spyi tshogs ring /sdu4moro ko ༷ 47༷ chi

lugs na gzhon mna' 'brel/ bzo tshogs ring lugs tang / mar khe si ring lugs gcig gyur bzo ba tang sogs rtsa 'dzugs brgyad kyis grub pa'i 6 mi dmangs 'thab phyogs la 'dems bsko'i khrod rgyal kha thob/ dbyi yon 472la sa 268ni mi dmangs 'thab phyogs kyi 'thus mi yin pas/ mi dmangs 'jib phyogs kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas te spyi mthun rgyal khab srid gzhung btsugs pa dmi/ dmangs 'thab phyogs srid gzhung btsugs rjes/ sa zhing bcos bsgyu ra sogs dngos su lag tu bstar rgyu khyab bsgrags byas/ zla lnga tsam gyi dus tshod thung ngu'i nang zhing ba la sa zhing mu'u khri 71 2bgos/ sngon chad chab srid kyi rkyen gyis phyir phud pa'i bzo ba rnams la bya ba bgos par ma zad/ zla 3pa nas 6pa'i bar gyi zla phogs kha gsab kyang brgyab/ srid gzhung gis rgyal nang gi mi rigs tshang mar rang skyong gi dbang cha byin te/ si pan ngal rtsol mi dam ngas kyi 'tsho ba je bzang du btang /yin na'ang si pan gyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi rnam pa de log spyod pa dang hpha shi si 'jar man/ dbyi tha li bcas kyi mig nang du ma song ba red/ mi ser spel yul rngo ro ko ru sdod pa'i ma'e lis li yu(shāsgrolko/215khyo)log spyod dmag dpung gis thog mar zing 'khrug bslangs shing / de'i 'phror gung khran tang la sol ba las nar son pa'i sngon chad kyi juga'agod pa'i 'go ba dang bo'u ring tangagi 'go 'dzin gyi khongs mi ) spu'u lung gi(nyasgo lta'itshotsho1)yis srid gzhung la rgol ba'i gsal brda zhirge bsgrags te/ si pan gyi 'byor med gral rim gsar brjer ngo rgol dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs la 'gyur du mi 'jug ched zing cha slong rgyu yin zer/ nyin der/ zing 'khrug gi brda rtags 6 zha'e 115

na'o ta tru'u(ltotshoṣṭharsā) ༷zhes pa si pan sa khul yongs kyi bca' sdod dmag dpung du bkram/ rgyal yongs dmag dpung gi 807ste/ dmag mi khri 20lhag zing 'khrug slong mkhan gyi lag 'og na yod/zing 'khrug bslangs rjes/ rgyal yongs sa khul so sos spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung la glog 'phrin btang ste/ mi dmangs la mtshon cha byin nas drag chas spras te zing 'khrug 'gog rgyu'i re ba bton/ skabs der lho phyogs kyi grongakhyer drug bdun tsam log spyod pa'i lag tu shor/ yin na'ang spyi mthun rgyal khab srid gzhung gi srid blon khya cis la'o cwa ( rdo ṣṭha༅(5)yis mi dmangs rtsa 'dzugs byas te zing 'khrug 'gog rgyu de khas ma blangs/ nyen kha'i gnas tshul 'di 'drar thug pas bzo zhing mang tshogs kyis spyi mthun rgyal khab bsrung ched/ rgyal sa ma ti rid kyi sung lam dang srid gzhung thog khang gi sgo kha ru sems la 'tshub cha langs te 6 drag chas/ drag chas/ drag chas ’ zhes skad mthon po brgyab/ srid skyong blon chen khya cis ra'o cwa yis mi dmangs la drag chas spras ma 'dod la mang tshogs kyi mgo gnon yang mi phod pas/ mjug mthar las 'khyur mi byed thabs med byung / zla 7pa'i tshes 19nyin/ spyi mthun tang mi gzhan pa hi sad zhis lhar(76 lkoṣṭhapo)gyis srid 'gan bzhes la/ srid gzhung gsar bas de ma thag mi dmangs la mtshon cha byin zhing / grong khyer gzhan dag gis kyang de ltar bsgrub pa na/ si pan mi dmangs dang ngo log zing slong dmag bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyang mgo bcoms/'thab rtsod mgo brtsams ma thag pho mo khri phrag 30lhag phyogs gcig tu 'dus nas yul dmag gi ru khag 'bring ba dang / ru khag che ba/ dpung sbrel /sdu6don ni thamasacad rgyun ldan yin 7zhesapa'o

ru khag bcas btsugs/ kho tshos mtshon cha sna tshogs 0kyis rang nyid la drag chas spras/ mtshon cha med pa'i mi mang po zhig lag stong du g.yul sar song nas/ phyogs gcig nas rang nyid kyi rmas ma phyir 'khur ba dang / phyogs gcig nas de tsho'i lag gi mtshon cha bzung ste 'thab 'dzing du zhugs/ nyin 'di dag gi ring la si pan gung khran tang mis rang srog phangs med dang dpa' ngar zhum med kyi snying stobs tshad med de mngon par bstan/si pan gyi log spyod dmag dpung la 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i rgyab skyor chen po thob/ de tshos mo ro ko'i ngo log dmag khri 1dang stong 4lhag dang /dmagaspyod dngos rdzas mang po si pan la gnam grus bskyal/ phor ju ghal rjogyis kyang si pan log spyod dmag la rgyal mtshams kyi sgo phyes par ma zad/'jar man gyi me phyogs dang than khi/ me mda' sbag sbag sogs phor ju ghal gyi rgyal sa li si pon gyidang gru kha mang por skyel du bcug nas/ si pan log spyod dmag la mtshon cha chad pa med par bkol rgyu yod par byas/ bsdoms rtsis ltar na/ mu so li nyis log spyod dmag la me skyogs 2000dang / than khi 900rlangs 'khor 12000'drud 'then 'khor lo 800rang 'gul mtshon cha khri 1me mda' khri 24chu 'dzul dmag gru 2mthar skyod dmag gru 4gnam gru 100dmag spyod dngos po gzhan pa sogs bsdoms na gong thang rī la ༷dung phyur 140tsam byin zhing / de las gzhan dngos gzhi'i dmag dpung khri 15dang gnam gru'i kha lo ba 600tsam log spyod dmag gi grogs su mngags/rwadzi 'jar man gyis kyang lag 'jom 'gas gtor gnam gru 66ra'o khi siwa rdzasasoXs/per na chamada' 'khor lo can dang me mda' rnying ba/ rngon mda'/ ral gri/ lag 'bom/ 'gad : bye ṭī smri snyi// /sto / snroshā /skya/ 117

mngon sum du the gtogs byed pa'i skabs su/ si pan gyi nang 'khrug rgya je cher song ste/ mjug mthar si pan mi dmangs kyis hpha shi si'i btsan 'dzul la sol ba'i mi rigs gsar brje'i 'thab 'khrug tu gyur ba red/ 'thab 'khrug 'dis 'jar i hpha shi sis rgyal khab gzhan par btsan 'dzul byed pa'i bya spyod la bkag 'gog thebs shing / 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyis hpha shi si'i btsan 'dzul la 'thab rtsod byed par byas rjes chen po bzhagayin na'ang / hpha ran si srid gzhung gas zla 8pa'i tshes 2nyin si pan gyi don dag la 6 the gtogs mi byed pa'i gros gzhi bton zhing / zla 9pa'i tshes 9nyin/ the gtogs mi byed pa'i u yon lhan tshogs kyis lon ton nas bya ba'i mgo brtsams/ u yon lhan tshogs 'dir rgyal khab 27zhugs yod/ don ngo mar nub phyogs rgyal khab dbang chen stobs ldan gyi 6 the gtogs mi byed pa'i srid jus ni phyi'i rnam pa ste/ phyi tshul nas rgyal khab so sos si pan dmag 'khrug gi phyogs gnyis kur mtshon cha skyel ba bkag kyang / don du si pan/gra mthun rgyal khab la bkag sdom byas pa ma gtogs/ 'jar i gnyis kyipa sta'u lung ki log spyod dmag la mtshon cha mkho sprod byed pa ci dgar 'jog pa 'o//na kyang / 'dzam gling gi hpha shi si la rgol mkhan rnams spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi phyogs su langs/ su'u len gyis dngos rdzas dang drang bden phyogs nas rgyab skyor chen po byas la/ rgyal khab gzhan pa'i mi dmangs kyis kyang de la rgyab skyor byas/ rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i sgo nas rogs ram byed ched/ 'dzam gling gi mi sna grags can ra'o man ra'o lan rjodang zho po nā/༷ en si then/sdidī rsha3 〉na /spya ༷/ /4misdu ba / ༷ 0 tshordo51 stuzlo/shāḥhā 194 119
