dang chag skyon shor ba'i gru gzings 8dang / so gru dang lta rtog gru gzings sogs dmag gru sna tshogs 10lhag mtsho gting du nub pa'am chag skyon shor ba red/ a ri'i gnam gru 188brlag cing skam dmag dang mtsho dmag gi gnam gru thang rnams gtor te bde thang du bsgyur/ a ri'i dmag dpon dang dmag mi 4500lhag bsad pa'am rmas pa red/'jar pan gyis mu tig gru kha la 'jab rgol byas te chu tshod 1dang skar ma 10'gor rjes/ a ri'i 'jar pan gyi gzhung tshab pa ye tshong ci zan lang dang 6 zhi bde'i gzhung tshab khyad par ba ’ le chi zan lang gnyis a ri'i rgyal don mgo 'dzin pa hul gyi gzhung las khang du gleng nas/ mjug mtha'i tha tshig bsgrags pa red/du'adi ni rgyal spyi'i steng du ma bsgrags par 'thab pa'i ches tha mal gyi bya spyod cig yin/ zla 12pa'i tshes 8nyin a ris 'jar pan la dngos su 'thab rgyu yin pa bsgrags/ a ri'i rgyang sgrog khang gis 6 mu tig gru kha la tha shal gyi 'jab sol phog ces yang dang yang du bsgrags/ a ri'i tsung thung ro se wel gyis ngar skad chen pos 6 ngo tsha khrel med nyos pa'i nyin 'di rtag tu brjed mi nyan :zhes bsgrags/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i khrod kyi 'i bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug ni 'jar pan gyis mu tig gru kha la 'jab rgol byas pa las mgo brtsams so//0 sngar gtan 'khel byas pa la chu tshod gcig lhas gis phyi/ 217

bar lam gling phran gyi mtsho kha'i dmag 'khruga'ajar pan btsan 'dzul dmag gis mu tig gru kha la 'jab rtsol byed zhir/ e sha ya'i lho shar dang 'i bde rgya mtsho'i lho nub kyi gling phran so sor sang 'dod du phar rtsol byas/ 1942lo'i lo ma gor bslebs skabs 'jar pa na btsan 'dzul pas gnas skabs rgya'i kha lon pas/ kho tsho gang du thon na 'phrog bcom dang dmar gsod/ btsan g.yem/ sdod khang mer sreg pa sogs mi la sa dgu la sa byas te/ sa gnas de dag gi mi dmangs la nyes pa chen po bsags/1942lo'i zla 1por/ 'jar pan gyi mnyam 'brel gru dpung gi drag jus dmag cang dpon mcho dam ga dpon chung yus yo na ( 67)gyis da dung btsan 'dzul dang 'phros bcom gsar pa byed pa'i 'char ga'i 'then te/khos mu mthud du hi wa i la phar sol byas te hi wa i gling phran 'phrog cing a ri'i 'i bde rgya ma tsho'i sanam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings kyi stobs shusas rtsa brlag gtong dgos zhes bshad/ 'jar dmag b.la' sgrog khang gis cib 'jug byas ma thar/ thog mar mu tig gru kha'i nub byang du mcho le 1136gi mtsham sa kyi rgya khyon la spyi le gru ba'i ma gsum lhag la sa med pa'i bar lam gling phran du'aphrog ste mkha' lam myul 'ib byed pa 'i lte gnas byed dgos/ de dang chabs cig tu phar rgol byas te a ri'i 'i bde rgya mtsho'i gru dpung khrod kyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings g.yul la tshur bkug rjes rtsa med gtong rgyur shāḥbar la ma gling phran lo 77 kyi 15 tsho'i

thag bzlo )pa/'i zla mjug tu bar lam gling phran la phar rgol byed pa'i 'char gzhir bka' sgro ga khang gi spyi dpon mtsho dmag dpon chen yung ye (ma(ṣṭha1)yis chog mchan bkod/ zla 5pa'i tshes 5nyin dmag dpon chen po yu nga ye yis gnam bskos gong ma'i bka' ste/ bar lam gling phran la dpung 'jug pa'i〈〈dmag sgar lte gnas kyi mtsho dmag khang gi bka' yis ang 18pa〉〉zhes pa bsgrags/ dmag rgyag gi 'char ga'ir zla 6pa'i zla sto da dam zla dkyil du nges par dpung 'jug bya rgyu dang / thog mar bar lam gling phran gyi nub phyogs kyi khu le gling phran(sgorsālo)len dgos shing / de nas bar lam gling phran blangs te der chu ngos dang skam sa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i lte gnas 'dzusas rgyu thag bcad/ a ri'i dmag shugs la tshod 'dzin ched de dang ma nyam du bar lam gling phran gyi byang phyogs kyi pe ren mtsho du/ la bcar ba'i a ri'i gling tshom ga'an pa 'ig ste a lo'u hrin gling tshom ②gyi ho lan mtsho 'gag la dpung 'jug bya rgyu byas / 〈〈bka' yig 〉〉tu ma nyam 'brel gru dpung gi spyi dpon ya ma mo to bar lam gling phran la dmag 'dren pa'i mtsho dam ga gi bkod 'doms pa dang yi nu kri(wa ske4)skam dmag gi bkod 'doms par bskos/'jar dmag gis a ri'i 'i bde rgya mtsho'i gru dpung rmas ma de dang bsdur na rang nyid kyi ma tsho dmag gi stobs shugs ha cang che bar 'dod/skabs der/ a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gru dpung la gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 4tsam las med cing / 'jar pan la gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings chen po 7dang chung ba 4de min dmag gru ma/nga ngo/ yod/ phyogs gnyis kyi stobs shugs la gnam sa'i khyad par yod stabs 'jar pan gyis thengs du peran0ཿshā 0 kyi cas khri/rke/lha① tsho'o 'u hrin gling tshom / me pa chis/lha mtsho tsha 3 219

'ahā'i dmag 'khrug khrod nas rgyal kha lon min la the tshom skye mi dgos par 'a da/gru dpung gis phar sol ma byas pa'i sngon la ya ma mo to yi 6 tā hu (shā7)zhes pa'i dar cha sgreng ba'i gru gzings steng nas nyin 4la 6 dpe ris steng nas sbyong brdar byas/ sbyong brdar skabs su dmag shugs gtso bo ste lho sprin gru dpung 'jab rgol khrod nas a ri'i gnam grus bkad pa red/ shan 'byed pas tshod dpag byas pa ltar na 'jar pan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings la 'bar mdel thengs 9phog stabs/ gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gnyis mtshor bsnubs pa red/ 'on kyang dpe ris steng nas sbyong brdar byed pa'i mgo 'dren jus dpon yus yon gyis 'jar pan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings la 'bar mdel thengs 9phog pa de gang 'dod du thengs 3la bcos shing / gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gnyis mtsho gting du nub pa de gcig nub cing gcig la skyon tsam las ma bzos par bsgyur/ mu mthud du sbyong brdar byed pa'i khrod du rgya mtshor nub pa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings de slar yang dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa red/ gang ltar dpe ris steng nas sbyong brdar byas na ci ltar byas kyang nam yang 'jar pan la rgyal kha thob pa red/dmag stobs gtso bo nan yun gyi ru dpung gis nga tshos rang nyid kyi stobs shugs la yid ches byed chog tha na 'thab 'dzing dmag gru'i rgyab skyor med rungang tsho gcig pus kyang dgra bo'i gru dpung rdul du brlag thub ces bshad/dpe ris steng gi sbyor brdar 'di ltar ru rgyal kha'i ngang mjug rdzogs/ zla 5pa'i tshes 20nyin/ ya ma mo to yis ches mjug mtha'i dmag 'khrug gi bka' phab/ kho tshos a ri'i bar lam gling phran dang hi wa i sogs sa gnas kyi stobs shugs la tshod dpag byas te/ bar lam gling phran du a ri'i dam ga la bas/sdu pas gnam gru 56dang lta rtog gru gzings 'ga'/ chur 'dzul dam sa

gru kha shas las med stabs dmag stobs kyis gtan nas mi 'dang bar 'dod/hi wa i sa khul du phal cher gnam gru 360dang / mtsho dmag la gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings gnyis gsum tsam dang mtsho skor dmag gru/ gru srung dmag gru/ chur 'dzul dmag gru sogs bsdoms pas 50lhag las med/ a lo'u hrin gling tshom la ho lan gru kha las a rir mtsho dmag dang skam dmag gi stobs shugs med par snyam/ 'jar pan gyis da dung a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gru dpung de nam yang 1941lo'i zla 12par kho tshos mu tig gru kha la 'jab rgol byas pa ltar lhod g.yeng du mchis pa'am 'jar pan gyi mtsho dmag gi stobs la skrag ste dmag 'khrug rgyag mi phod par 'dod/ der brten/ 'jar dmag gi bka' sgrog khang gi mgrin tshab pas bar lam gling phran la dpung 'jug byed par zhib 'jug byed pa'i mnyam 'dus tshogs 'du zhig gi steng nas/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug khrod du nga tshos ches sems khur byed sa ni dgra bo'i gru dpung nga tsho'i gdong la bud de tshur rgol byed mi phod par dmag sgar nas phyir 'bud mi 'dod pa de red ces bsgrags/ 'jar dmag gis a ri'i gnas tshul de kho tshos sngon dpag byas pa dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar ye nas ma 'dod pa'am bsam mi 'dod par kho tsho gcig pus gnam 'og la dbang bsgyur ba'i rmi lam gyis bzi ba red/skabs 'dir a ris bar lam gling phran de rgya bskyed de mtsho dmag gi mtsho skor lte gnas byas yod/ gal te de mdun phyogs kyi so bas lta zhib byed sa ma byas na mu tig gru kha mkhregs srung bya rgyu shin tu dka' bar ma zad/ 'i bde rgya mtsho yang rim gyis 'jar pan gyi lag tu 'chor srid/phal cher de dang mnyam du mu tig gru kha'i a ri'i tar yig gsang rtol bas(tsho jo(7)'jar pan pa'i gsang brtol ba red/ 1941lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 10nyin 'jar pan gyis hi wa i gling tshom gyi nub phyogs ༵ dir

thag mtsho le 1300lhag yod pa'i wu khe gling phran (shākri116)la thengs dang por 'jab rgol byed skabs/ a ri'i dmag gis rgya mtshor bsnubs pa'i 'jar pan gyi dmag gru las 'jar dmag gis skabs der bkol pa'i gsang yig 'bri deb kyang rnyed/ gsang deb tu rgyun du 6647 zhes pa'i gsal byed gnyisaspyad pa shin tu mang / gsang rtol pas yun ring la 'bad pa chen po byas mthar 6647 zhes pa'i tshab rtags ma lag gis bar lam gling phran mtshon pa rtogs/ a ris 'jar pan gyi gsang deb dang dmag don gyi glog 'phrin mang po las 'jar pan gyi dmag don gyi gnas tshul rnams shes te/ 'jar pan la 'thab 'dzing dmag gru ci tsam yod pa dang dmag dpung ci tsam zhig bar lam gling phran la skyod pa shes/ tha na thengs 'di'i dpung 'jug tu zhugs pa'i dmag dpung gang yin dang dmag gru so so'i gru dpon gyi ming / dmag gru'i gru lam sogs kyang gsal bor rtogs pa red/de bas a ri'i dmag gis myur du rang gi dmag 'khrug gi 'char gzhi legs par bcos shing / rang gi gru dpung tshad yod pa de bar lam gling phran gyi byang shar du mtsho le 200yod pa'i mtsho ngos su bskungs/ 'di ltar byas na 'jar pan gyi gru dpung la lkog nas rgol thub par ma zad/ hi wa i lam a ri'i nub phyogs kyi mtsho ngogs kyang srung thub/ de dang chabs cig tu a ri'i srid gzhung gis myur du rgyab skyor gyi stobs shugs je cher btang nas bar lam gling phran du mngags/zla 5pa'i tshes 27nyin mnyam 'brel gru dpung gi dmag spyi ya ma mo to yis kho'i mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs yongs rdzogs te/ dmag gru 350rjodang /gnam gru 1000 dmag mi khri 10bcas kyi sne khrid de dzig dzig rngam rngam dang dmaX khri2/sdo //la dushugab zlo /dro sna/sa 'a rsharsha shātnakā sna ṅgi 〉lha shā mai gzings/ mtsho skor dmag gru rtog

bcas te dmigs yul gyi phyogs su bskyod/ 'jar pan gyi mtsho dmag gis nye ba'i lo ngo bdun cu'i lo rgyus steng gi dam ga 'khrug ches che ba de 'di ltar mgo bcoms/ ya ma mo to yi gru dpung khag gnyis su bgos te/ gcig ni ma tsho dmag cang dpon 'bring ba 'i zhin hru'u tsi lang(lkoṣṭhaṣṭha1ṣṭhakhya)gis gtso byas pa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings chung ngu gnyis byang shar phyogs su bskyod/ dmigs yul ni a li'u hrin gling tshom gyi ho lan mtsho 'gag la 'bar mdel 'pher rgyu dang / a ri'i gru dpung gi mig lam dkrug rgyu de yin/gzhan de ya ma mo to rang nyid kyis 'go 'khrid pa'i dpung shugs gtso bo yin/dmag dpung gtso bo de yang khag bzhi ru bgos te/ cang dpon 'bring ba lho sprin gyis 'go 'khrid pa'i dmag stobs gtso bo ste gnam gru 'bab sa'i gnam gru chen po ba'i bo de thad kur bar lam gling phran la brgyugs/ ya ma mo to yi 'thab 'dzing dmag gru lho sprin dmag dpung gi rjes kyi rme tsho le 300yi ma tshams su yod/ cin theng ( lojo)gi drag 'dul dmag dpung de bar lam gling phran gyi lho nub mtshams su yod/ li then(zojucha)gzhogs 'degs dmag dpung dang 'grim 'grul mtsho gru rnams lho nub phyogs nas bar lam gling phran la bcar/ ya ma mo to yis gnas tshul de gsang ba'i ched du khos kho'i gru gzings phan tshun bar la skud med glog 'phrin bkol mi chog pa gtan la phab/zla 5pa'i tshes 30nyin/ 'i bde rgya mtsho'i kha ru rlung chen po g.yug cing drag char babs/ rba rlabs dgung du 'phyo ba'in 'jar pan gyi gru dpung gi gru khar skabs 'gar 'phyur stabs/ gru dpung gis gru gzings je dal du mi gtong ka med byung / nyin 'dir ya ma mo to yi 67 hu mi zhes pa'i gru gzings kyi skud med glog brtag pa zhig gis nye 'khor du a ri'i chur 'dzul dmag gru zhig bar lam gling phran du skyod pa'i glog 'phrin gal chen zhig thob/ glog 'phrin gyi gsang ba brtol ma thub mod 'jar pan gyi gru dpung la nye 'a~X du

a ri'i chur 'dzul dmag gru yod pa ma zad/ des kho tsho rig yod pa gsal bor mtshon yod/ 'on kyang 'jar pan gru dpung gi dmag spyi khang gi jus dpon rnams kyis bab col ngang gal te a ris nga tsho'i 'dod tshul shes na da lta kho tsho'i gru dpung gis 'gog rgol byed nges/ de 'dra byas na dgra bo nga tsho'i g.yo 'og tu tshud pas/ de nas kho tsho rtsa med du gtong chog par 'dod/zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod 2dang skar ma 45steng bar lam gling phran la mkha' lam nas rgol ba'i dus tshod la thug lho sprin dmag dpung gi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 16 lcags mkhar dmar bo zhes pa'i rgyang sgrog tu 'jab rgol la gra sgrig gi bka' bsgrags/ gnam gru'i kha lo ba rnams kyis bka' la sgug 'dug skabs 'dir lho sprin gyis dgra bos 'jar pan gyi 'dod tshul ma shes shing 'jar pan gyi gru dpung yang rig mi 'dug pas/ 'jar pan gyis bar lam gling phran la mkha' lam nas 'jab rgol byas te gling phran steng gi a ri'i gnam gru dang dmag dpung rtsa med btang rjes/ /ra 'khor nas gdong la bud pa'i a ri'i gru dpung rtsa med gtong chog par 'chu byed/ 4dang skar ma 30steng du nan yun gyis myul zhib gnam gru 7la bka' phab te shar lho byang gsum gyi phyogs su myul zhib tu mngags/ de dang chabs cig skar ma 15nang du nan yun gru dpung gi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 4yi steng nas gnam gru 108thad kur bar lam gling phran du 'phur nas 'bar mdel gang dgar 'phangs pa red/ de nas nan yun gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings kyi gnam gru'i bang mdzod las yang bskyar gnam gru 108blangs te thengs gnyis par bar lam gling phran la 'gad gtor gtong du mngags rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ 'on kyang bar lam gling phran gyi a ri'i dmag gis snga shā sdus gra sgrig legs po byas te kho chos gling phran steng gi gnam gru tshang ma

'phur du bcug cing / la las 'jar pan gyi gnam gru la rgol lan sprod pa'am phar rgol byas/ la la sprin rum nas yud tsam la bskungs nas bsdad de chag sgo med par byas/ 'jar pan gyi gnam grus bar lam gling phran la 'gad gtor btang ba des sa ngos la gtor bshig cung zad thebs pa las kho tshos sngon dpag byas pa'i dmigs yul gtan nas ma 'grub/chu tshod 7dang skar ma 28steng du/ 'jar pan gyi myul zhib gnam grus nan yun gru dpung nas mtsho le 200yi mtsho kha na a ri'i gru dpung gis gra sgrig byas yod pa shes te nan yun la snyan zhu byas/ des a 'jar gnyis ga'i gru dpung so so'i rdung rdeg bya ba'i g.yul khongs su bslebs yod pa mtshon/ nan yun gyis gnas tshul de shes rjes dngangs 'tshab chen pos bar lam gling phran gtor du song ba'i gnam gru khag gnyis ka myur du phyir log dgos pa'i bka' bsgrags shing / de dang mnyam du gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 4bo'i steng gi gnam gru gzhan pa rnams mdzod las phyir blangs te gru khar bzhag nas/ a ri'iganam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings la gang nus kyis phar rgol byed par gra sgrig byed du bcug chu tshod 10dang skar ma 24steng du nan yun gyis a ri'i gru dpung gtor ba'i bka' bsgos/ glo bur du sprin rum nas a ri'i 'gad gtor gnam gru mang po zhig 'dzul nas thon/ de dag gis lho sprin gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 6 khri hrun ( ṣṭha1rsā)zhes pa de'i steng du 'bar mdel ser ba babs pa bzhin du g.yugs pas/ gru steng gi rlangs snum dang 'gad rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin gad de 66khri hrun zhes pa'i gru gzings de yud tsam du me yi rgya mtsho zhig tu gyur/ mthar 6 khri hrun ’ zhes pa'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings dang gru thog gi gnam gru tshang ma lcags snyigs kyi phung bo zhig tu gyur/ lho sprin gyi dmag dpon 'bring ba dmag gru gzhan pa zhig tu mi 'bro ka med byung / lho sprin gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings chen po 2)byin

gsum ste 6 rten 'brel ’ dang 8 g.yu 'brug 6 'brug 'phur zhes pa rnams kyang / gnam gru brgya phrag du ma dang bcas la a ri'i sanam gru'i 'bar ma del phog ste rgya mtshor rim gyis nub/ 'jar pan gyi ches che 'ing spus legs pa gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 4de ltar brlas pa red/ de ni deng rasdus ṭwāṃ mtsho 'khrug khrod du phar rtsol gyi sro ga shing nyam sa pa dang sanyis su ma ma sa lho spri// na gru dpung gis pham kha ya nga ba 'ig nyos kyang dras jus dmag dpon ya ma mo to yis snga ra ba'in 'jar pan gyi mtsho dmag pham par khas len mi 'dod/ khos shul du lus pa'i dmag gru rmas ma yongs rdzogs phyogs gcig tu bsdus te dam ra 'dzing byed rgyu thag bcad/ chu tshod 13dang skar ma 10yi steng du a ri'i gru dpung dang dmar 'dzing bya rgyu'i b.la' bsgra gas/ 'on kyang chu tshod 20dang skar ma 30steng du gsang myul bas ya ma mo to la a ri'i gru dpung la gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings bsdoms pas 5dang ma tsho skor dam ga gru 6 lta rtog dmag gru 15yod la de dag tshang ma ya ma rngo to yi gru dpung gi nye sar bcar gyin 'dug ces snyan seng zhus/ zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin gyi dgong mo/'i chu tshod bcu gnyis steng du/ phyogs gnyis kyi dmag stobs bar la gnam sa'i khyad par yod sta bas ya ma mo to yis dmar 'dzing dang mtshan mo ra me phyogs rgyag rgyu'i bka' mi ldo ga ka med byung la/ chu tshod 2dang skar ma 55steng du bar la ma gling phran la dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i 'char ga'i med par mi bzo thabs med byung /bar la ma gling phran gyi dmag 'khrug ni 'jar pan gyis pham kha chen po nyos nas ma jug bsdus te/ 'jar pan gyi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 4dang mtsho skor dmag gru 1bkad de rgya ma tshor nub cing / gnam gru 33༷༵༵ga nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i gnam gru'i kha lo ba dang la sa

nā dzi ba'i gzung byar gyur pas/ mthar khong 1933lor 'jar man rgyal khab dang gyes te a rir mi 'bro thabs med byung / de nas phu lin si ton (—snrornyespyi46rsālko)mtho rim rig gzhung zhib 'jug gling gi tshe gang zhib 'jug pa mdzad/yin yang khong a rir spos rjes kyang khong rang byung tshan rig pa zhig yin phyin 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi bya gzhag gi 'os 'gan dang 'gan 'khri de nam yang ma brjed pa red/1939lo'i nyin zhig la/ en si then a rir 'byor rjes nam rgyun rang nyid la goms phyogs yod pa ltar/ nangs ja bzhes zhor zhogs par bskyal yong ba'i 'phrin yig bklags pa red/ khong gis gang 'dod du per lin du dpar ba'i 〈〈rang byung tshan rig 〉〉ces pa blangs shing nges gtan med par dkar chag la gzigs skabs/ glo bur du khong la cha rgyus che ba'i ming gnyis mngon byung bas/ khong gis myur du mig shel gon nas bltas tshe dus deb steng du/ ha in(lhariṣṭha)dang hri tho la si(ma'i/ci1146)gnyis kyis mnyam du bcoms pa'i 〈〈ma rdul drag tu brdab pa'i khrod yu kya 〉〉zhes bkod 'dugakhong gis 6 ha in/ o/ 'jar man gyi tshod lta ba bzang bo de zhes rang dbang med par ngag nas shor/nyin de'i zhogs par thag ring gi mgron po zhig ste dngos lugs rig pa ba por 0gyis 'jar man nā dzi'i phyogs kyi gsar 'gyur khyer yong ste/ 'jar man nā dzi bas yu yi nying rdul gas pa'i 'gyur ldog la zhib 'jug byed kyin 'dug ces bshad/ en si then gyis de ring zhogs par ngas ha yin sogs kyi dpyad rtsom rig ma thag yin/ ngas kyang gnad don 'dir 'dang rgyag gin ཿ snar//7skya rngu'i45༷ba ba 746 rsā71883—1962 229

yod ces por la bshad zhor/ rang gi rwa tse(lo4)la gzigs te 'dang rgyag tu lhung 'duga.en si then gyis yu rer nying rdul 235gas skabs bar rdul 'ga' gtong 'ing / bar rdul re res yu nying rdul 235gas su 'jug thub pa mkhyen/'di ltar khā( rdo )khri dung phyur gyi nus pa phyir shor yong la/ gal te des ma rdul 'bar mdel bzos na de'i nus pa 'bar ma/del spyir btang ba la sa lda ba ci tsam che ba mi shes/ gal srid 'gad nus 'di 'dra che ba'i rdul phran mtshon cha smyon pa she thi ler dang mu so li nyi gnyis kyi la sa tu shor na/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs dar rgyas kyi bya ga'ag la gtor brlag ji 'dra thebs pa blo yul la sa 'das pa red/'o de'i dbyar kha/ gnam gshis shin tu tsha bas mi rnams ma tsho 'gram du kham sa bas ngas la 'dus 'ong / 'on kyang a ri'i rab 'byam sa pa tsā to mur( di 6712)gyi sdod shag tu/ en si then dang khong gi la sa rosas 'gres sem sa sdug chen ngo sa 'jar ma na nā dzi bas rdul phran ma tshon cha bzo ma go bcom sa pa de 'dzam gling gi bde 'jags dang 'brel ba'i don dag gal chen 'ig yin si 'i thad gros bsdur byed kyin 'dusagros bsdur yun ring byas ma thar en si then sadong la bud de a ri'i tsung thung ro se spel la 'phrin yig cig bris te a ris rang nyid srung ba'i ched dang 'jar ma na hpha shi ses bzos pa'i rdul phran ma tshon cha la 'gran 'dzugs pa 'i ched du/ ma gyogs myur ngang ma rdul gyi nus par 'ib 'jug byed 'go rtsom dgos nges tshul zhu rgyu'i thag bcad/'phrin yig 'di sa khul mang po 'grim sa rjes mthar a ri'i tsung thung ro se wel gyi lag tu 'byor/ 'phrin du 'di ltar bris yo da de/23sdu 'bas tsung thung lags/

bdag gis tshan rig pa hpher mi rjodang 'i la te du gnyis kyi nye char zhib 'jug byas pa'i zin bris bklags rjes/ gzhi rgyu yu ni yun ring mi 'gor bar nus pa'i 'byung khungs gsar pa gal chen zhig tu 'gyur rgyu sngon dpag byed thub/ gnas tshul 'di la gzhigs na mi rnams kyis dogs zon nan mo bya dgos/ dgos mkho che na da dung srid gzhung gis myur du thag gcod dgos/ der brten/ bdag gi 'gan khur ni gsham gyi /shā /ngos dang bsam 'char 'don rgyu yin pas khyed kyis thugs mnyam bzhes rogs nye ba'i nyin 'ga'i ring la zil shugs ha cang che ba'i 'bar mdel gsar pa zhig bzo rgyu yin pa 'dra/ gru gcig gis 'bar mdel de 'dra gcig tsam drangs nas/ de gru kha nas 'gad du bcug na gru kha yongs rdzogs dang nye 'dabs kyi sa khul bcas gtor rgyu spyan tu sla py-i zhi/ red/ 'on kyang 'bar mdel 'di rigs gnam grus bskyal na shin tu drags sgod khyed// kyis rang nyid yid ches sa'i mi zhig mngags te kho la lkog nas gsham gyi 'gan khur 'di dag bsgrub tu bcug chog1 srid gzhung gi las khungs so sor 'brel ba byas te rgyun du kho tshor 'ib 'jug byas pa'i gnas tshul snyan zhu byed cing / kho tsho la bsam 'char 'don pa dang / lhag par du a ri'i yu yi gter rdo mkho 'don la khag theg bya dgos/2 'brel yod mi sna dang khe las rigs kyi tshod lta'i khang dang 'brel ba byas te/tshod lta bya ba'i myur tshad je mgyogs su gtong dgos(mig sngar tshod lta'i bya ba rnams slob grwa chen mo so so'i tshod lta'i khang du sgrub kyin yod mod/ slob grwa chen mo so so'i tshod lta'i gron dngul la ha cang tshad yod)/ngas shes pa ltar na/ mig sngar 'jar man gyis btsan du bzung ba'i cheg ②gi yu ༵ sdiX rnyi khu ni/ tstsha sku mchi 231

yi gter rdo phyir 'tshong mtshams bzhag pa red/ gal te 'jar man gyi phyi 'brel pu'u krang hpheng we tsi sa khi(/9 7797)yi bu tsha yis per lin li lan gong ma'i zhib 'jugatang du bya ba sgrub pa'i gnas tshul dang / zhib 'jug khang des mig sngar a ri dang 'dra bar yu la zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa'i gnas tshul shes na/ 'jar man gyis ci'i phyir bya ba de bsgrub par go ba len mi dka' 'o//khyed la blo dkar che ba'i/a en si then/(ming rtags bkod pa)tsung thung gis 'dang zhig brgyab rjes en si then gyi skad cha la gnas lugs yod de/ 'jar man nā dzis rdul phran mtshon cha bzos par dogs zon bya dgos snyam nas/ en si then gyi 'phrin yig kho'i drung yig dmag dpon wa sin( 70)la ster zhor 6 myur du sgrubs shig ces bshad/ nyin de'i dgong mor u yon tshogs pa zhig btsugs pa red/ nyin bcu'i rjes su u yon tshogs pas gros tshogs thengs dang po bsdus shing / tshan rig pa grags can mang po tshogs 'du 'dir zhugs te rdul phran mtshon cha ji ltar bzo tshul la gtam mang po bshad/'di ltar a ris en si then gyi bsam 'char la nyan nas ma rdul nus par zhib 'jug byas mthar/ 'jar man gyi sngon nas rdul phran mtshon cha gsar gtod byas stabs/ 'jar man nā dzi bas 'dzam gling dbang du bsgyur 'dod pa'i re ba rtsa med btang / en si then gyis sngon chad mi rnams la 6 bdag la mtshon nas bshad na/tshe srog gi don snying ni 'gro ba mi'i bde sdug la 'dang rgyag pa de yin/ gzhan skyo na rang yang skyo/ gzhan dga' na rang yang dga' zhes bshad myong /khoX snyisna dang thog rdul phran mtshon cha bzo bar hur brtson byas pa de yod tshad/

'jar man nā dzi ba la 'gran ya 'dzugs ched dang 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi zhi bde dang bde 'jags kyi ched du dgongs pa red/ yid phangs pa zhig la/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i rjes su btsan 'dzul ba 'ga' re'i stobs shugs kyis mu mthud du ma rdul g.yo thabs kyis bkol te 'dzam gling dbang du bsgyur bar 'dod/ 'di ni en si then gyi thog ma'i thugs 'dun dang yongs su 'gal stabs nga tshos dogs zon nan mo mi byed ka med byung ngo //

ljid chu'i dmag 'khrug1942lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 28nyin gyi skya rengs ma shar gong / ming la yin nar (༅lkoṣṭha)zhes pa'i nor we pa byang cha lda na pa zhig mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi gnam grus 'dzam gling du snyan grags che ba'i gangs shud gtong sa ste/ nor we'i the mar kho(lkophopom)zhing chen du mkha' dbyings su bskyal nas dbab/ kho thang la bslebs ma thag dogs zon chen pos mtha' 'khor gyi khor yug la zhib lta zhig byas shing / myur du 'bebs gdugs bsdus te 'bebs sa de dang gyes nas nye 'dabs kyi gzhung lam steng du bslobs/ kho ni sa de ga'i spyi dmangs sheg dang 'dra bar rlangs 'khor zhig la bsdad de sus kyang ma tshor pa'i sgo nas rang gi dmigs sa der phyin song /kho ci'i phyir mkha' dbyings nas dbab dgos sam/ las 'gan ci zhig bsgrubs sam/'di ni 1939lo nas gleng dgos/ lo der a ri'i tsung thung ro se wel gyis tshan rig pa'i bsam 'char la nyan nas rdul phran mtshon cha bzo rgyu thag bcad/ tshan rig pa la las 'jar man nā dzi pa'i 'di'i phyogs kyi gnas tshul la rgyus lon thabs byed dgos zhes bsam 'char bton/ a dbyin rgyal khab gnyis kyis 'jar man nā dzi bas rdul phran mtshon cha bzo bar sngon 'gog bya rgyu dang / ched du gsang myul ba'i tshogs pa dang lta rtog pa'i sde btsugs nas 'jar man nā dzi'i ma rdul bzo grwa dang tshod lta khang sa cha gang du yod par rtsar gcod bya rgyu yang thag bcad/234

gsang 'phrin ltar na nor we'i the mar khe zhing chen gyi wi mo kho(lo61grum)grong khyer gyi nor si sa(lkoṣṭhaspom)ching dbugs(za')bzo grwa'i khrod du/ ljid chu(tsho15)thon skyed byed pa'i sa 'og bzo grwa zhig kyang yod/bzo grwa 'di ni 'dzam gling steng du ljid chu ches mang po thon skyed byed pa'i bzo grwa 'ig yin/ ljid chu ni ma rdul 'gyur ldog gi phung bo'i khrod kyi bar rdul je dal du gtong ba'i rgyu cha yin/ ljid chu yod na 'gyur ldog phung bor tshod 'dzin thub pas rdul phran mtshon cha bzos chog 'jar man gyis nor we dbang du bsdus rjes ljid chu bzo grwa 'dir kho tshos thad gar kha lo bsgyur zhing /da dung drag dpung mngags te lta rtog nan mo byas pa red/gong gi gnas tshul la gzhigs nas mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i tshogs 'dus rin dod ji tsam gtong dgos kyang nor si khe yi ching dbugs bzo grwa'i ljid chu bzo grwa gtor te/ she thi ler la rdul phran mtshon cha gtan nas bzo ru 'jug mi rung ces thag bcad/dbyin nar ni nor we yi nā dzi'i las 'gul la rgol ba'i gsang ba'i las byed pa zhig yin/ kho da thengs mkha' dbyings nas ther ma khe zhing chen du babs pa'i 'gan khur ni/ ljid chu bzo grwa'i sa gnas dang sgrig chas / thon skyed kyi tshad dang 'jar man nā dzi'i srung dmag gi gnas tshul sogs la rgyus len rgyu dang / gnas tshul dang 'tsham pa'i dpung 'jug gi 'char gzhi bzo rgyu de red/ dbyin nar gyis nā dzi'i tang gi jag dmag gis gang ba'i 'jigs rung khor yug khrod du/ rang gi tshe srog la ma 'dzems par sa gnas der dngos su lta rtog byas shing / de dang chabs cig tu thabs bkod mang po 'then nas dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bsags te phyogs yongs nas dbye 'ib byas/khos brel 'tshub chen pos zla ba 'ga' la bya ba bsgrubs mthar don snying che ba'i snyan zhu zhig bris te a dbyin gyi ched btsugs gsang myul ba'i tsho chung la 24)/

snyan zhu der 'di ltar bris yod de/ 'phrul chas kyi khang pa dang ljid chu bzo grwa gnyis bar gyi dmag gur ra ba'i nang du 'jar man gyi srung dmag 15yod cing / nyin re'i chu tshod 18dang 20stong du brje spor byed kyin 'dug spyir btang du 'jar dmag gnyis zam pa'i steng du yod/ don dag byung na so skyod ru khag gis bzo grwa'i sa khul nang du zhib bsher glog sgron bkol te wi mo khe nas khrir(shāyo〈khu)bar gyi gzhung lam thog tu 'ib bsher byed pa red/ bzo grwa'i ra nang du rgyun du mtshan mor nor we'i dmag gnyis dang / de min sgo srung ba gcig me gsod chu sgo srung mkhan gcig ma gtogs med/ ljid chu bzo grwar 'gro sa'i sgo yongs las ra nang du 'gro sa'i sgo tsam ma gtogs tshang mar zwa brgyab yod/ de gzhir bzung nas ched btsugs gsang myul tsho chung gis 'char gzhi zhib cing gra dag pa zhig bzos/1943lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 17nyin/ long nar (ṣṭhapopo)gtso bo byas pa'i 'phral rgol ru khag cig btsugs shing ljid chu bzo grwar 'jab rgol bya rgyu'i bka' yang phab/ bka' ru nam gung ma lon pa'i sngon du so ba brjes pa'i srung dmag nam zhig la dmag sgar du phyir log pa mthong bde ba'i ched/ phar rgol byed pa'i g.yul sa bzang bo zin dgos/ nam gung gi chu tshod 12dang skar ma 30yi steng du phar rgol byed pa mgo rtsom dgos pa dang / 'gad gtor ru khag dang 'gebs srung ru khag gis phar rgol dang phyir nur skabs lag 'khyer glog sgron gtan nas bkol mi chog rang gis bzung ba'i mtshon cha'i khrod nas me mdar stong mda' shor te dgra bo mi dkrogs pa'i ched du/ mde'u me mda'i khog tu gtan nas 'jug mi chog ces dang / bka' yig gi ches mjug mtha'i tshig gcig la nan rtags bkod de/ mi su zhig yin rung gal te thaXdī /spya gnus sta lhuXng nu dang nyid daXgra laXg tyā sdu rjerdo gong ༷nga lhag rgeXde

dgos zhes gtan la phab pa red/༷ 'phral rgol ru khag si kod lan ḍi du nas gnam grur bsdad de mkha' dbyings nas nor we la 'phangs/ kho tsho wi mo khe'i ching dbugs bzo grwa'i ltag rgyab tu bslebs rjes/ khag gnyis su bgos te ru chung gcig la 6 khug rta zhes btags shing 'gebs srung bya ba'i 'gan 'khur/ ru chung gzhan de la 6 me phyogs mi zhes btags la 'gad gtor gyi 'gan 'khur/ 'phral rgol ru khag gis mtshan mo'i mun nag dang bstun nas/ brel 'tshub che zhing sems chung sgos bka' yig ltar sa gnas gtan 'khel byas yod pa der bslebs/dmag dpung gi mi ches sdun ma des rno skud gtub spyad kyi skam pa bzung nas nur te mdun du skyod cing / gzhan pa rnams kyis gzhug nas kho la 'gebs srung byas/ glo bur du mdun phyogs nas glog 'od cig 'phros pas kho myur du sa la 'byar nas ma 'gul bar bsdad/ gzhug gi 'gebs srung ba rnams kyis dbugs bsran nas gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog 'byung bar gra sgrig byas nas bsdad/ las yag pa zhig la glog 'od dkar nas song mod don dag gzhan ma byung / de nas mi ches sngun ma rnams mu mthud mdun du bskyod de mgyogs shing byang ba'i sgo nas ching dbugs bzo grwa'i sgo chen gyi zwa dang lcags thag gtor te sgo phye ba red/ 'gad gtor ba rnams kyis lag tu 'gad rdzas dang mtshon cha bzung zhing lus sgur sgur gyis gcig rjes gnyis mthud du bzo grwa'i nang du dro// snato/ ra ba 6bzo grwar 'dzul rjes thog mar sa 'og gi ljid chu bzo grwar 'gro sa'i sgo btsal/ 'on kyang sa 'og tu 'gro sa'i sgor zwa brgyab pas nang du 'dzul ma thub/ de nas kho tsho mi gnyis re byas te skor bgos nas sgo du kod lan ḍi/ chaX /la smo ༅ 237

gzhan pa btsal/ kho tsho'i khrod kyi skor gcig gis lcags sbug gi lam ded nas ljid chu bzo grwar nye ba'i khang mig cig tu thon/ khang mig 'di'i ljid chu bzo grwar 'gro sa'i sgo de tag tag phye 'dug pas 'gad gtor ba gnyis ka myur du nang la song nas srung dmag cig bzung / de nas mgyogs myur sgos ljid chu bsags pa'i mdzod khang du brgyugs te 'gad rdzas bzhag nas sgo brgyab/ me ma sbar ba'i sngon du yang bskyar zhib bsher zhig byas rjes me rta la me sbar cing /de sngon gyi kha chad ltar brda btang nas 'gad gtor ba yongs rdzogs myur du ljid chu bzo grwa dang gyes su bcugaphyi rol tu rgyug pa'i 'gad gtor ba rnams kyis 6 ldir zhes 'gad rdzas gad pa'i sgra thos rjes dga' mgu tshad med skyes/ 'jar dmag gi so ba rnams ljid chu bzo grwar rgyug cing 'gad gtor ba rnams smag rum stug po'i khrod du ching dbugs bzo grwa'i sgo chen gyi phyogs su brgyugs te lcags lam la 'gos te/ bzo grwa'i phyi rol tu sgug pa'i 'gebs srung ru khag dang mnyam du gnas de dang kha bral/ kho tshos rmas skyon phog pa'i mi gcig kyang med par thengs 'di'i 'gan gtor gyi 'gan 'khri bde blag ngang 'grub song / thengs 'di'i dpung 'jug khrod nā dzi ba'i ljid chu pāng 380dang ljid chu bzo grwa'i sgrig chas gtso bo rnams brlags pas gyong gud chen po thebs pa red/'gad gtor ru khag las mi 5yis gangs shud btang nas spyi le 400song ste phyir bde 'jags sa khul du bslebs/ yun ring po ma 'gor bar gnam grur bsdad de dbyin jir slar log pa red/ 'gad gtor ru khag gi mi gcig dang 6 khug rta zhes pa'i ru khag gi khongs mi yongs bsdad de dmag 'khrug gzhan pa zhig gi 'gan 'khri la sgug cing bsdad/1943lo'i zla 11par lon ton la gsang 'phrin 'byor nas nor we'i ljitā rta8 bzo grwa slar gsos te thon skyed byas par bshad/ thengs 'dir sngar gyi

dpung 'jug byed thabs de bskyar zlos byed mi thub stabs/ mna' 'brel dmag gis mkha' dbyings nas bzo grwa 'di bkad rgyu byas kyang / phan 'bras shin tu chung ba red/1944lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes gnyin yang bskyar gsang 'phrin zhig 'byor ba ltar na/ 'jar man nā dzis zla 2pa'i tshes 20nyin la/ nor we'i he te ro gru kha'i 6 he te ro ’ (770)zhes pa'i gru gzings kyis nor we'i ljid chu thon byed sgrig chas 'jar man gyi sa char 'dren rgyu thag bcad tshul bshad/ljid chu thon skyed gnas spor bar srung skyob khag theg byed pa'i ched du bzo grwa nas he te ro gru kha'i bar gyi lam 'gram du 'jar man tang srung dmag gis gang zhing grag 'gul ci yod la lta rtog nan mo byed kyin yod mod 'on kyang / 6 he ta ro zhes pa'i gru gzings steng du 'jar man gyi srung dmag gcig kyang mi 'dugazla 2pa'i tshes 20nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod gcig gi stong du/ mun nag khrod nas rlangs 'khor zhig gis nā dzi'i tang srung dmag dang rgyun gos gyon pa'i myul ma las byol te/ dal 'thib pa'i cag ger he te ro gru kha'i nye 'gram du bslebs/ rlangs 'khor las mi bzhi babs shing gcig rlangs 'khor 'gram nas bsdad/ gzhan gsum po de ma thag smag rum khrod du yal/ kho tsho tshang ma 'gog rgol ru khag gi khongs mi red/'gog rgol ba 3gyis 6 he te ro zhes pa'i gru gzings steng 'gro thabs byas shing gru steng gi khung bu sgor sgor 'ig tu 'dzul nas gru khang du thon/ myur du dus bcad 'bar mdel bzhag cing 'bar mdel 'gad rgyu'i dus tshod ni chu tshod 10dang skar ma 45stong du yin/ rgyu mtshan ni 6 te te ro zhes pa 'gad pa'i dus skabs ches bzang po yin te/ skabs 'dir 8 he to ro zhes pa'i gru gzings su ljid chu thon skyed kyi 'phrul chas tshang ma bzhag nas sdu/ la

byi( pa/ skabs yin stabs 'gad gtor gyi las dbang las thar mi thub pa'i de tshang ma las tshar skabs zhigs pa'i chu tshod 4yin/ mun nag khrod nas 'gog rgol ba rnams myur du rlangs 'khor du log nyin de'i sa srod la kho tsho bde 'jags ngang nor we'i rgyal sa o si lu la bslebs te zing zing lang long gi mi tshogs khrod du gar song rgyus med du gyur/ 6 he te ro zhes pa'i gru gzings 'bar mdel la dus chad bgos pa ltar nyin de'i zhogs pa'i chu tshod 10dang skar ma 45steng du gad de rgya mtshor nub pa red/ 6 he te ro zhes pa'i gru gzings bkad stabs tang srung dmag dpon rnams khong khro me ltar 'bar yang ci bya gtol med du gyur/6 he te ro zhes pa'i gru gzings nub pas ljid chu dang 'brel ba yod pa'i 'phrul chas pāng stong phrag 'ga' shor stabs 'jar man nā dzis dus yun thung ngu'i nang du rdul phran mtshon cha bzo mi thub par gyur/thengs 'di'i 'gad gtor 'gan 'khri sgrub pa'i mi 4bo ni sngar gyi 8 me sbyogs 7ru khag gi khongs mi yin/ 6 me smyogs ’ dang 6 khug rta ’ zhes pa'i ru khag so so'i khongs mi dang / da dung gsang myul gyi 'gan khur ba'i ming med dpa' bo rnams kyis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i khrod du 'jar man nā dzis rdul phran mtshon cha bzo bar 'gog rgol byas te mdzad rjes rlabs bo che bzhag go / 240

si ta yin ku'ad kyi srung skyob dmag 'khrugadape'adzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i dkyogs mtshams/si ta lin ku rid(1614rnyekhritshanalha'i)kyi thog ma'i ming la khra li cin(:rtsotshoṭha)zhes 'bod cing de snga'i su'u len gyi lho nub phyogs su yod/ de'i byang phyogs rgyal sa mo si kho la thug cing / nub tu ton gtsang po ① dang spyi le lnga bcu drug cu tsam las med/ shar du chu bo yol ka yi nub rgyud dang bcar te/wu lar(6(1lo)bzo las sa khul gsar pa dang 'thab jus gra sgrig ru khag 'dus sdod sa khul dang 'brel pas/ chu bo wol ka yi gru kha gal chen zhig yin la/ u ru su'i lho nub phyogs kyi lcags lam 'grim 'grul gyi lte ba dang 'bru rigs/ rdo snum/ rdo sol bcas kyi thon yul gtso bo yang yin/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i sngon du 'dir mi khri 60yod cing 'thab jus kyi go gnas ha cang gal chen yod pa zhig yin/ skabs der mi zhig gis dpe 'di 'dra zhig bzhag yod de/ gal te mo si kho ni de snga'i su'u len gyi mgo yin na/ si ta lin ku rin ni de snga'i su'u len gyi'i snying yin zhes bshad myong ngo //'jar man hpha shi si yis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa bslangs te yo rob gling gi rgyal khab mang po pham par brgyab mthar u ru su la dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i thag bcad/ 1940lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 31nyin/ she thi ler gyis pe ge ho chu(sgri/1tshanahārjesgrosgo)yi nā dzi'i mtho rim 'go khrid kyi tshogs 'du'i thog nas/ 8 nga tshos nges par su'u len rtsa med gtong thub par ma zad/0 ton gtsang po/ baX rsā༅ 241

'jar man gyis 'dzam gling dbang du bsdu ba'i nyi ma nges par bsleb srid ’ ces bshad/ 1941lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin 'jar man hpha shi si yis su'u 'jar phan tshun btsan 'dzul mi byed pa'i chings yig dugator te/ su'u len la glo bur du 'jab rgol byas/ she thi ler gyis u ru si la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i dmag mi khri 550dang than khe 3712'thab 'dzing gnam gru 4950dang me stogs 47260sogs sngar lo rgyus steng byung ma myong ba'i dmag dpung rgya che ba zhig mngags/u ru sis spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed mtshams mi 'jog ka med byung zhing / rlabs che ba'i rgyal srung dmag 'khrug dus rim du zhugs/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i khrod du khyon ches che zhing thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i dmag 'khrug chen po de ni u ru si'i sa thog nas mgo bcoms/ 1941lo'i lo mjug nas 1942lo'i lo mgo bar 'jar man hpha shi si yis mo si kho yi dmag 'khrug khrod pham kha nyos/ 'on kyang she thi ler gyis pham kha khas len ma 'dod par yang bskyar hrag bsdus dmag sde hri 50phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ u ru si'i lho nub phyogs nas lam sgo phye ba dang / si ta lin ku rid btsan bzung byas te/ sa de ga'i rdo snum dang rdo sol/ 'bru rigs sogs 'thab jus dmag chas ha cang gal che ba dag 'phrog rgyu'i bkod pa 'then/ 'jar man hpha shi si'i dmag dpung gi dpung 'jug la gdong gtad de/ u ru si'i ches mtho'i spyi khyab bkod 'dom/sa khang gis 1942lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 28nyin la/ 6 dpa' ngar zhum med kyis g.yul sa re redang u ru si'i mnga' khongs gom pa re re nges par bsrungs nas/ ches mjusamatha'i khrag thigs gcig gi bar du u ru si'i sa cha tshang ma gang nus ci nus22193yo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 23nyin bzhag

kyis bsrung dgos zhes bka' bsgrags/'on kyang 'jar man hpha shi si'i dmag dpung gnas 'dir 'dus pa u ru si'i dmag dpung las ma nga stabs u dmag gnas skabs pham nyen che/1942lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 23nyin gyi nyin gung / 'jar ma/na hpha shi si yi than khe si ta lin ku rid grong khyer gyi byang phyogs kyi 'drud 'then 'phrul 'khor bzo grwa'i bar spyi le 3ma gtogs med pa'i sar bslebs/ phyi dro'i chu tshod 5steng du grong khyer gyi mkha' dbyings nas 'jigs rung mi sem sa 'gas pa 'i ma kha' 'gog nyen brda grags byung / de ma thag grong khyer gyi mi rnams mkha' sol dong lam du sbas/ grong mi khri 1 5yis sa gnas mkha' rtsol ru khag dang rang srung ru khag btsugs nas myur du dmag 'khrug tu zhugs te/ me gsod pa dang rmas ma myur skyob kyi gra sgrig legs po byas/de nas ring po ma 'gor bar gnam gru'i ldir sgra je nye je nyer grags byung / 'jar man gyi gnam gru 1000lhag gis chu tshod du ma 'i ring la gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis sdod khang khul dang bzo grwa la yang dang bskyar du bkad la / ma/ra 'phangs pa tshang ma 'gad gtor 'bar mdel dang me spar 'bar ma del red/ grong khyer de me yi rgya mtsho zhig tu bsgyur/ khang pa rnams brdibs shing glog 'don sgrig chas gtor brlags btang ba/ kha par las khungs la 'gad gtor 'bar mdel dbyugs nas bkad/ glog 'khor dang snye redabs kyi me 'khor 'gro mtshams ba'ag pa/ bud med dang byis pa/ rgan po rnams kyi khrag dron gyis grong khyer gyi so phag dang gyang chag zhig ral rnams spyamar por btang / grong khyer yongs rdzogs yud tsam la gad snyigs kyi phung bo ga tu sdu/ ya/nga si ta lin ku rid kyi mi dmangs skra ga nas dpa' ma zhum pa ste/ming la phe ma dbyi hphan no spu(ṣṭha tsho 7lo ༅lko)zhes pa'i na 2)spyan

zhig dang kho'i pha rgan 'dug sa'i bzo grwa bkad pa red/ las khungs kyis kho pha bu gnyis la 'bro yig byin/ kho gnyis myur du phyir rang yul la song nas dbyi hphan no hphu yi a ma dang mnyam du 'bro bsam/ 'on kyang kho tsho yul la 'byor dus a ma 'jar man gyi gnam gru las 'bar mdel dbugs nas bkad de bsad cing gzhug tu kho mo'i gos hrul tsam las lus mi 'dug pha bu gnyis ka mdel shul gyi dong 'gram nas yun ring zhig la khu sim mer langs nas bsdad rjes/ dbyi hphan no spru yi a phas sdug bsngal dang blo spobs chen pos/ 6 nga gang la'ang mi 'gro nga si ta lin ku rin dang kha mi 'bral/ nga nges med rgol rdung ru khag tu zhugs rgyu yin zhes dal mo dal mor bshad/pha bu gnyis dang nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi dmag mi gzhan rnams mnyam du nyin mtshan med par dgra bo la 'jab rgol byas stabs/ 'jar man hpha shi si ba'i snying 'phar deb ling ling byed cing nam yin yang nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi 'jab rgol la dogs zon mi byed ka med byung /'di ltar dka' sdug ha cang che ba'i skabs su si ta len ku rid nas mi khri 7 5lhag dmar dmag gi dpung khag tu zhugs pa red/ gung gzhon tshogs pa'i khul u hru'u ci 78khrod nas 47g.yul gyi mdun sar zhugs/ gung gzhon tshogs mi khri 5lhag grong khyer gyi 'gog srung dmag 'khrug tu zhugs/ kho tsho dang grong mi gzhan rnams kyis mnyam du nyin mtshan bar med la grong khyer du 'thab ra dang 'dzing rags brtsigs shing / me mda' 'phen sa dang myur skyob pa bkod sgrig byas/ da dung dmag dpung dang mnyam du grong khyer gyi srog rtsa ste chu bo yol ka yi rab kha de rang srog la mi 'dzem par srung ba'i dam bcas shing /zhor la gzhug phyogs kyi dmag mi dang mtshon cha rgyun mi 'chad par grong khyer du skyel ba dang / grong khyer gyi rgan po dang byis pa/ rmas ma sogs dus ltar chu bordi ༵༵ khar bskyal rgyu byas/

zla 9pa'i tshes 13nyin 'jar dmag gis slar yang sa gzhan nas dmag dpung bskong yong / kho tshor si ta lin ku rid grong khyer la dpung 'jug byed mkhanadamag mi khri 17dang / me phyogs che chung gnyis ka 1700 than khe phal cher 500yod kyang / su'u len gyi dmag la grong khyer 'gebs srung ba dang lho nub sa khul gyi dmag shugs yongs la dmag khri 9tsam dang / me sgrogs che chung gnyis ka 1000than khe 120tsam las med/ grong khyer len pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod 'jar dmag gis dmag stobs dang mtshon cha gnyis ga'i cha nas shugs chen po zin yod pa red/si ta len ku rid grong khyer yongs kyi sa dbyibs ni nub phyogs mtho zhing shar phyogs dma' la lho byang dog cing ring / sa dbyibs 'di ni nub phyogs nas dpung 'jug byed pa'i 'jar dmag la phan khe ha cang che/ chu bo'i bzhur rgyun dang ldog nas 'gog rgol byed pa'i su'u dmag la dka' khag chen po bzos pa red/ su'u dmag gis g.yul sa dog cing ring ba 'di nas dmag 'khrug rgyag pa las thabs gzhan med cing / gzhug phyogs dang 'brel ba byed na nges par zheng la spyi le 3yod pa'i chu bo wol ka 'phred du gcad dgos/zla 9pa'i zla dkyil du 'jar dmag gis ma ma ye hphu gang (66༅lko༅)dang me 'khor sa tshigs la dpung 'jug byas/ ma ma ye rmu sgang ni grong khyer gyi dkyil na yod cing chu bo yol ka yi bar du smi 1000lhag las med/gang gi rtse mor 'gos na grong khyer yongs rdzogs rig thub/ dmag 'khrug dza drag ha cang che/ 'dzing rags gal chen 'ga' re phan tshun gyi lag tu thengs du mar 'chor res byas/ u ru si'i dpung tshogs 62pa'i spyi khyab khang la 'byor ba'i dmag don snyan zhu la bltas na dmag 'khrug dza drag che pa'i tshad rtogs thub ste/6 chu tshod 7dang skar ma 30steng du dgra bo slob gling sung chen du bslebs/ 245

chu tshod 7dang skar ma 40steng du 'phrul chas lu'i thog ang 30ba'i rang dmag gi ru shog dang po dang gtso shugs dpung khag bar 'brel ba chad/chu tshod 7dang skar ma 50yi steng du dgra bo dang nga tshos ma ma ye spru sgang sa khul dang me 'khor 'bab tshigs kyi nye 'dabs su 'thab/chu tshod ཿkyi steng du me 'khor 'bab tshigs dgra lag tu shor/yo chu tshod 8dang skar ma 40yi stong me 'khor 'bab tshigs nga tsho'i dmag gi lag tu da/ chu tshod midang skar ma 40yi steng du me 'khor 'bab tshigs slar yang dgra bos blangasachu/ chod 10dang skar ma 40yi steng du dgra bo phu hri khin dusrang chen du slebs shing /nga tsho'i dpung tshogs kyi bkod 'doms khang gi bar la smi 60)pas med/chu tshod 11steng du dgra dmag mda' shog gnyis than khe 30yi rgyab skyor 'og ched mkhas thog khang du bsres pa red/lon/ chu tshod 13dang skar ma 20steng du me 'khor 'bab tshigs slar yang nga tsho'i lag tu snga gzhug tu me 'khor sa tshigs thengs 13la bdag po brjes zhes bris 'dugazla 9pa nas bzung si ta lin ku rid grong khyer gyi srang lam dang thang chen tshang ma dza drag che ba'i g.yul sar gyur/ dka' tshegs che ba'i srang 'gag dmag 'khrug 'di ltar mgo brtsams song / dgra dang rang phyogs gnyis so dang mche ba brdab pa bzhin gcig gis gcig la 'jig par byed/ rtsa ba'i dmag 'khrug rgyag thabs ni dpung khag chung ngu bcar nas 'thab pa dang /mtshan 'thab/ dmar 'dzing yin stabs 'jar dmag gi than khe dang gnam ༵༵6phu hri khin/ me/ tshol 072436ji sa lko

gru sayul sar bkol thabs bral/ u ru si'i rgyal srung dmag gis mtshams mtsham sa su nyin rer dgra bo'i dpung 'jug drag po thengs 10lhag bzlog dgos/ kho tshos lag 'bom dang rtse gri bzung nas thog khang re re dang / khang mig re re/ glog skas re re'i nang du 'thab pa red/ mes rgyal gyi sa tshun gang re srung ba'i ched du 'chi ba la ji mi snya ma pa'i snying stobs bskyed pa red/zla 9pa'i zla mjug tu/ dmag 'thab kyi gtso bo grong khyer byang phyogs kyi bzo grwa'i sa khul du 'khor zhing / skabs 'dir u ru si'i 'gog srung dmag khri 5 5la sa lhag mi 'dug la / sgrogs chen skyogs chung 1400yod mod/ than sba 80dang gnam gru 190las med/ dgra bos sa ga'an nas slar yang mi khri 20bskongs pa red/ thad gar u ru si'i rgyal srung dmag la rgol mkhan mi khri 9dang me skyogs 2300 than khi 300 gnam gru 1000yod/ gnas tshul 'di su'u dmag la gtan nas mi phan mod/ 'on kyang si ta lin ku rid kyi dmag dmangs kyis sngar ba'in 'chi dgos kyang rung dmag sa srung pa'i dam bca' brtan por bkod/zla 11pa'i zla mgor zla bcu ba'i gsar brje byas nas lo ngo 25'khor la nye ba'i skabs der/ si ta lin ku rid kyi dpa' bo rnams kyis si ta lin la 'phrin yig bskur nas/ 66 de ring nga tshos si ta lin ku rid du dmag 'khrug rgyag gin yo da la / nga tshos srung skyob byed dgos pa si ta lin ku rid gcig pu min par kun gyis shes/ si ta len ku rid kyi dmag 'khrug gis nga tsho'i mes rgyal gyi las dbang thag gcod pa/ nga tshos khyed la 'di ltar dam bcas chog ste/ nga tshos ches mjug mtha'i khrag thigs gcig dang ches ma jug ma tha'i snying gi 'phar lding de'i bar 'thab 'khrug rgyag rgyu yin/gang ltar dbugs rta rnga tsam/ yo da tshe nga tshos si ta lin ku rid bsrung rgyu yin la/dgra bo chu bo wol 7 la gtan nas brgal du mi 'jug ces bris/ si ༵ /na

srung nan mo byas te dgra bo thang chad du 'jug pa/ gnyis pa/ bab dang bstun nas 'gog rgol la gra sgrig byas te/ si ta lin ku rid sa khul gyi dgra bo rtsa med gtong ba'i rdung rdeg dang / u ru si'i lho phyogs kyi 'thab jus tshang ma bsgyur nas u ru si la phan pa zhig tu bya rgyu de'o/ zla 9pa'i zla mjug tu/ kru khe hphu dang hwa zhi le rmu si ci gnyis kyis bris pa'i 'gog rgol 'char gzhi zhig la si ta lin gyi chog mchan thob/zla 11pa'i tshes 19nyin/ su'u len gyi dmar dmag gis si ta lin gyi bka' ste/ 6 mdun du skyod/ 'jar man btsan rgyal ba rtsa med gtong / kho tsho nga tsho'i mes rgyal nas phar skyod cig ces pa dang du blangs nas 'jar dmag la 'gog rgol byas/ nyin de'i zhogs pa'i chu tshod 7dang skar ma 30stong du/si ta lin ku rid kyi nub byang phyogs nas u ru si'i dmag dpung gi smyogs chen 2000ldir sgra dang bcas rgyag mgo brtsams/zla 11pa'i tshes 20nyin gyi skya rengs dus su/ su'u dmag gi lho nub phyogs kyi dmag dang ton gtsang po'i phyogs kyi dmag dpung gnyis skam pa'i dbyibs kyis si ta lin ku rid kyi mtha' bskor ba'i dgra dmag gi 'dzing rags gtor nas skam dbyibs dpung 'jug myur du legs 'grub byung / si ta lin ku rid dang grong 'dabs kyi 'jar dmag khri 33tshang ma 6 khug ma'i ’ nang dum dīnās /bskor ba'i dgra dmag khri 33la nyin rer dngos rdzas kun 750dgos shing 'jar man hpha shi si'i mkha' dmag dmag spyi ko ren gyis nyin rer dngos rdzas tun 500re mkha' lam nas bskyal rgyu khas blangs kyang / don dngos thog kun 100las ma bskyal/ 'jar man skam dmag gi drag jus dmag dpon tshe tshi li (1jonya368)yis she thi ler la/ ru dmag mi ltogs skom gyis mnar nas blo pham nas yid chad cing / ches mtho'i da//kto spyi

shi la nye/ da dung mi khri stong mang po 'khyag nas shi zhes snyan zhu phul nas she thi ler gyis skor ba grol thabs bya rgyur chog mchan 'god pa'i re ba zhus kyang / she thi ler gyis de la kha ya ma byas/ 1943lo'i zla 1po'i zla mgor mtha' bskor ba'i 'jar dmag gi gnas bab je sdug tu song ste/ mi rer nyin rer go re gcig tsam las mi thob/ skya dmag gi rta yang bshas nas zos tshar la/ mi rer nyin rer mde'u 30tsam las mi thob/ than khe yi snam tshar bas 'gro mi thub/ me skyogs kyi smyogs mdel tshar bas 'phen mtshams chad/gnas skabs tsam la smyo ham langs pa'i hpha shi si'i jag dmag rnams/ ltogs skom dang grang ngar la bzod bsran gyis 'thab dong 'khyag pa ru 'khums nas/'chi ba'i las dbang la ngang sgug gis mi 'dug thabs med byung /1943lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 8nyin/ su'u dmag gis mtha' bskor ba'i 'jar dmag la ches mjug mtha'i tha tshig bsgrags te kho tshor mgo sgur ces bka' phab/ 'jar dmag gi dmag spyi po lo si(65tshoskosko)yis myur du she thi ler la glog 'phrin btang nas 6 skabs bstun ’ bya rgyu'i re ba zhus kyang khas ma blangs/zla 1tshes 10nyin gyi zhogs par su'u dmag gis phyogs chen 50)gyildir sgra dang bcas mtha' bskor pa'i dgra bo la 'phangs/ skyogs dmag gi ram 'degs 'og su'u dmag gi than khi dang rkang dmag myur la bar gyis g.yul bsres/ nyin 6gi nang du 'jar dmag gi dmag sa phyed tsam je chung du song /zla 1tshes 24nyin po lo si yis yang bskyar she thi ler la 'jar dmag 'u thug pa'i gnas tshul zhus te/ 6 dmag dpung gi 'bar mdel dang 'bru rigs tshar la phan nus che ba'i bkod pa 'then thabs mi 'dug rmas ma khri 1 8yod la gon rgyu dang za rgyu mi 'dug sman rdzas kyang mi 'dug mu mthud du 'gog rgol byas na don snying ci yang mi 'dug pham kha nyo rgyu bzlog ba~X mi
