2pa'i tshes 3nyin spyi bsgrags khyad par ba zhig spel la/ rtsom yongs kyi nang don ni/ 6 si ta lin ku rid kyi dmag 'khrug mtshams bzhag song / cun tshogs drug pas dmag spyi po lo si yi rmad du byung ba'i 'go khrid 'og lhag bsam rnam dag gas ches mjug mtha'i dbugs rgyun gyi bar 'thab pa'i dam bca' lag len byas mod/ 'on kyang dgra bor stabs ka 'grig cing nga tsho'i dmag la mi phan pa'i cha rkyen gyis gegs shugs thebs pa red ces bsgrags/de dang chabs cig tu/ rgyal yongs kyis nyin 4la mya ngan byas te rtsed rigs kyi bya 'gul thams cad mtshams bzhag she thi ler gyi bya spyod 'dis kho'i na me tog rnyid par ci bya'i gtol ci zhig snyam pa'i sems khams shin bstan no// si ta lin ku rid kyi srung skyob dmag 'khrug gis 'jar su'u dmag 'khrug gi 'thab jus kyi gnas tshul tshang ma bsgyur ba red/ de ni su'u len gyi rgyal srung dmag 'khrug dang 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i dkyogs mtshams yin/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gi rjes su dmar dmag phar rgol byed mkhan du gyur cing hpha shi si ni 'thab thengs re re bzhin pham nas phyir star te 'thab jus thog 'gog srung byed mkhan du gyur la mthar rtsa med du song 253

sbrag rtags kyi 'thab 'dzing / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su 'jar man nā dzi yis per len nye 'dabs kyi sa khe zin ho zin ( tshimatshoṇḍizla(〉tsā)zhes pa'i gcig sdud btson sgar du/ khang pa ha cang btsan po zhig bdams shing logs su bkar te gsang ba'i par khang zhig btsugs/ de tang srung dmag dpon chung ba yin ha te khe lu'i ko (lhakhyaṣṭha ༅༅lko)yis bdag gnyer byas/par rgyag pa rnams ni btson sgar gyi btson ma yin te/ la la ni bzung dmag yin la/ la la ni 'jar man gyi le'u the ba red/ nā dzi bas btson ma 'di dag par rgyag pa byas na de las 'os shing 'tsham pa 'ig mi 'dug snyam/ rgyu mtshan ni mi 'di dag la lta rtog nan rngo byed kyin yod stabs phyi rol yul la 'brel ba gtan nas byed mi thub pa'i phyir ro//'o na par rgyag pa 'di dag gis ci zhig dpar ba red ce na/ sbrag rtags dpar gyin yod/ 'jar man nā dzi bas drag shugs la brten nas rgyal khab gzhan par btsan 'dzul byed par ma zad/ da dung su'u dbyin sogs rgyal khab la dril bsgrags kyi 'thab rtsod brgyab na 'dod pa red/ 'jar man nā dzi bas dril bsgrags byed thabs mang po las sbrag rtags bkram thabs 'di bdams/ tshosbrag rtags ni mi mang che bar mtshon na 'phrin yig phar sku ra tshur skur la med du mi rung ba zhig yin par ma zad/ sbrag rtags las rgyal khab dang sa khuX ༵ 'dra ba'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi

gnas tshul dang rgyal khab so so'i yul srol goms 'dris kyang rtogs thub/tag tag sbrag rtags la rgya che ba'i khebs rgya dang dril bsgrasas rang bzhin mchis stabs/ 'jar ma na nā dzi bas hpha shi sir rgol ba'i mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi sbrag rtags rdzun ma mang po dpar te/ dngos don log bsgyur gyis mgo bskor gyi dril bsgrags shugs chen byas/ mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi sbrag rtags rdzun ma dpar ba yin stabs dpar 'debs kyi bya ba de nges par du gsang ba chen po'i gnas tshul 'og bsgrub dgos/nā dzi bas dpar ba'i sbrag rtags rdzun ma la rigs gsum yod de/gcig ni dbyin jis 1935lor bkram pa'i dbyin rgyal jor je sku phreng lnga ba khri la bzhugs nas lo 'khor 25lon pa'i rjes dran sbrag rtags ngos kyi ri mo la lad mo byas te dpar mod/ 'on kyang si ta lin gyi dbu par gyis dbyin rgyal gyi dbu par gyi tshab byas shing sngar gyi sbrag rtags thog gi 8 dbyin rgyal gyi bkra shis pa'i dngul zhes pa'i tshab la 8 thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug ni le'u the ba yi dmag 'khrug cig yin mi zhes bris/ zor ba dang tho ba/ skar lnga bcas kyis sngar gyi sbrag rtags steng gi me tos a long gi tshab byas/ sbrag rtags kyi gong zur la le'u the chos lugs mtshon pa'i skar ma zur drug can yang bris/ 'on kyang gzab nan ma byas pa'i dbang gis sbrag rtags steng gi dbyin yig /071 bya'i(ye'u the ba yi)zhes pa'i khrod kyi gsal byed 661 ’ chad/ sbrag rtags rdzun ma ga'an gcig ni dbyin jis 1937lor bkram pa'i dbyin rgyal jor je sku phreng drug pa khrir bskos par rjes dran zhu rten sbrag rtags kyi par ngos la lad mo byas mod/ 'on kyang si ta lin gyi dbu par gyis btsun mo e li 255

dza pi 0yi dbu par gyi tshab byas shing / 6 the he ran/2 1943lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 28nyin zhes pas dbyin rgyal khrir bzhugs pa'i zla tshes kyi tshab byas la/sbrag rtags kyi gong zur la sngar bzhin skar ma zur drug can chen po zhig dpar/sbrag rtags rdzun ma gzhan de ni dbyin jis 1937lor bkram pa'i dbyin rgyal jor je sku phreng drug pa'i dbu par yod pa'i sbrag rtags spyir btang ba la lad mo byas te dpar mod/ sbrag rtags kyi gong zur la zor ba dang tho ba/ skar ma chen po'i 'dra ris dpar/ sbrag rtags rdzun ma 'di dag tshang ma la rgyab spyin dang khog par yod pas sbrag rtags ngo ma dang khyad par chen po med/ dril bsgrags kyi phan nus je cher gtong ba'i ched du sbrag rtags kyi rgyab ngos su 8 shog ya/ 'jar man gyis khyod la bsgug yod ces dang / che dbyin ji thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug tu pham/’ / si ta lin gyi bka' la nyon/mi 8 'dzam gling ye'u the ring lugs ’ dang 6 'dzam gling pul hri we khe ring lugs zhes pa sogs dbyin yig gi 'bod tshig dpar ba red/'jar man nā dzi bas sbrag rtags rdzun ma 'di gsu ma dpar ba ni dbyin ji'i mi dmangs kyi sems khams dkrugs shing 'jigs snang skul ba dang /dbyin ji mi 'gyangs par ye'u the ba dang su'u len gyi dbang 'og tu tshud par nges pa shugs ston byed ched red//sbrag rtags rdzun ma 'di dag dpar tshar rjes thad kur dbyin ji la bskur gang nas chog 'jar man gyi gsang myul ba brgyud de bar gnas rgyal khab kyi sbrag rtags tshong bar btsong 'ing / de nas sbrag rtags tshong bas dbyin ji ba la btsong ba red/sbrag rtags rdzun ma dbyin ji nas rgya cher bkram rjes dbyin ji'i srid snro6ཿ tta sdo/// /sdurdozlormirngapa༅ mchi lko/myo khye

gzhung gis de la mthong snang chen po byas pa red/ rgyu mtshan ni sbrag rtags rdzun ma de dag gis dbyin ji'i srid gzhung la bston chen po btang zhing dbyin ji'i mi dmangs kyi la rgya la'ang gnod 'tshe chen po btang yod pas so// de la 'khon lan bslog ched du dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gis myur du lon ton gyi san mar thin sung lam nas de dang 'dra ba'i par khang zhig btsugs te/ 'jar man nā dzi bas bzos pa'i dkrog gtam la rgol lan sprad/ las khungs der skam dmag gi dmag dpon ar meng hir(7lo7 77)gyis 'gan khur/ dmag dpon hir ni dmag 'khrug gi sngon dpar rtsal la ha cang mkhas pa zhig yin pas/ kho la dpar bskrun dang bskyar dpar gyi lag rtsal phun sum tshogs po ldan/ sbrag rtags rdzun ma'i gsang ba mi brdol ba'i chen du/ dbyin ji'i par skrun khe las ches che ba zhig ste hwa te lu(lha65rmi )pha bu'i las khungs kyis par skrun lag rtsal steng nas hir la rogs skyor mang po byas/hir gyis skabs der 'jar man gyis she thi ler gyi mgo par bkod pa'i sbrag rtags mang po de dag la dpe byas te/ hpha shi si tang srung dmag gi mgo gtso 'i mu le 0yi mgo par gyis sngar gyi sbrag rtags steng gi she thi ler gyi mgo par gyi tshab byas stabs/ 'jar dmag nang khul du 'gal ba drag po bzos nas tang srung dmag gi mgo gtso zhi mu le 'dug bzod mi bde ba'i gnas su gyar/ hir gyi lag rtsal khyad du 'phags stabs dbyin jis dpar ba'i sbrag rtags rdzun ma de sbrag rtags ngo mar 'khrul ba'i tshad la thon/ tha na skabs der si we tser lan ḍi ༷yis sbrag rtags sna tshogs bsdus pa'i dus deb cig dpar ba de'i rtsom sgrig pa yis kyang / de ni 'jar man gyi sbrag rtags ngo ma zhig yin par 'dod/ hir gyis mgo byas nas dpar ba'i sbrag rtags rdzun ma ཿ trīḥ myur/ sgo ṇḍaṃ/00// sdushāziḥswā 257

ga'an cig ni 'jar man gyis 1943lor bkram pa/'i she thi ler srid 'gyur 'o 'khor 10lo na pa'i dran rten sbrag rtags la lad mo byas nas bzos/ she thi ler rtsa slog gtong bar 'dod pa'i 8 bdun pa'i nyi shu'i las 'gul la zhugs stabs thag pa ske la bskon te srog chad bcad pa'i 'jar man skam dmag gi dmag spyi er lin hphin we tshi li pin (ṣṭhapo khri/kru tshoṣṭha ṣṭha 74)gyi mgo par gyis sngar gyi sbrag rtags steng gi gdong mchong ru mi'i par gyi tshab byas/ gzhan yang hir gyis 'jar man gyi 8 dgun kha'i mug skyob ces pa'i sbrag rtags la dpe byas nas/ sbrag rtags rigs gnyis bzos te/ gcig ni zhi mu le yis lag pa gcig tu me mda' bzung zhing gcig tu dug rdzas phor ba gang bzung ba zhig dang / da dung sbrag rtags shig gi rgyab ljongs la tsho zhing rgyags pa'i dmag dpon gnyis dga' spro'i bag g.ye nga la rol ba'i 'og tu/mgo phyed bkad pa'i 'jar dmag cig gi mgo par dpar ba red/ des nā dzi'i mgo bas 'jar dmag gi shi rmas la nges par 'gan 'khur dgos zhes pa'i brjod bya mtshon pa red/dbyin ji bas sbrag rtags 'di dag bzos tshar rjes skor 'ig bar gnas rgyal khab kyi sbrag khang brgyud de 'jar man la bskur cing / skor gzhan zhig kho chos mi ched du mngags te sbrag rtags gyon gos kyi nang ma dang gong ba'i nang du btsem rjes 'jar man dang 'jar man gyis dbang bsgyur ba'i sa khul du song nas phyogs kun tu 'grem sa thabs byas/ juskabs der su'u len yang rjes su lus mi 'dod par thengs 'di'i sbrag rtags khyab spel gyi 'thab 'khrug khrod zhugs pa red/ de'i dmigs 'ben ni 'jar man nā dzi 'o sa yin/ su'u len gyis 'jar man gyi mngon gsal 'phrin shog la dpe byas nas/ de'i ma dun ngos su sngar gyi 'jar man gyi skam dmag da~X sbyo ten ten pog gi mgo par yod pa'i sbrag rtags dpar 'ing / de'i

ltag rgyab tu kha g.yang dang 'dra par 'ga' dpar la de dag gi nang don ni hpha shi si la ngo rgol bya ba red/ dper na/ de'i khrod kyi mngon gsal 'phrin shog cig gi rgyab ljongs su kha ba'i khrod du shing las bzos pa'i rgya gram mang po bslangs shing / rgya gram gyi steng du 'jar dmag gi rmog zhwa bskon pa de dag gi khrod du thang dkar tshogs kyis lding skor rgyag ba'in 'dug de'i thag nyer 'jar dmag gi rmog zhwa chag po zhig bris yod cing / par ngos kyi gsham du ru shar phyogs kyi 'tsho gnas go sa zhes bris yod/ des she thi ler gyis skad gseng mthon pos 6 shar phyogs kyi 'tsho gnas go sa 'thob dgos : zhes 'bod pa der sgug pa ni 'jar dam ga rang nyid dur sbed gtong sa btsal ba yin pa mtshon/ su'u len gyis sbrag rtags de dag bar gnas rgyal khab brgyud nas bkram pa ma yin par su'u len gyi mkha' dmag gis thad kur nam mkha' nas 'jar dmag gi dmag sar 'phangs/a me ri ga yang thengs 'di'i sbrag rtags dril bsgrags kyi 'thab 'dzing khrod ltad mor bltas nas ma bsdad/ a ris dpar ba'i sbrag rtags rdzun ma'i steng du she thi ler gyi mgo par de rus skogs su bris yod/ kho tshos 'jar man gyi yig shub rdzun ma bzos nas steng du sbrag rtags rdzun ma sbyar rjes/ a ri'i mkha' dmag dpung 'bring 15pas mde' shar bgyi ba'i skabs su 'jar man gyi rlangs 'khor bkod mngags dang me 'khor 'bab tshigs su dor te/ gas gtor btang ba'i 'jar man gyi sbrag 'khor las lhung ba yin pa 'dra ba'i rnam pa bzos/ de nas 'jar dmag gis yig khug de dag 'jar man gyi sbrag srid skyel 'dren ma lag tu bskur nas sa phyogs so sor bskyal ba na/ a ri'i dril bsgrags kyi dmigs yul yongs su grub pa red/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su sbrag rtags rdzun ma bzo tshul ni thog mar 'jar man nā dzis gsar gtod byas mod/ 'o/ snang

dbyin a su'u sogs rgyal khab kyis nā dzi'i gsar gtod 'di spyad de sbrag rtags rdzun ma mang po dpar nas dril bsgrags kyi rgol lan bslogs/ der brten 'jar man nā dzi ba'i nang khul du zing cha chen po bslangs la/ de las sems khams kyi steng nas 'jar dmag thor zhig tu gtong ba'i nus pa thon no//

nu so pi4)〈pe phyags 'bras/'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i g.yul bshams nas spyi lo 1943lor bslebs tsa na/ 'khrug chen slong mkhan gyi rgyal khab gtso bo 'jar man dang dbyi tha li gnyis la g.yul gyi gnas so so nas pham nyen byung yang /dbyi tha li hpha shi si yi 8 gtso 'dzin mu so li nyi yis da dung mu mthud du she thi ler la sri zhu bsgrub rgyu'i dam bcas par ma zad/ da dung pho lo bcu bzhi nas bdun cu'i bar dang / mo lo bcu bzhi nas drug cu'i bar gyi mi khri phrag brgya lhag la hpha shi si'i dmag skul dang len bya dgos pa'i skul ma byas/skabs der rang 'dod kho nar bstun mkhan gyi mu so li nyi yi spyod lam la dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul du yi rangs gtan nas ma byung / tha na dus rgyun smrar mi spro zhing don la gzab nan can gyi dbyi tha li'i rgyal po e man nor(ṣṭha༅07)gsum pas lo de'i zla lnga bar bris pa'i zin tho'i nang du'ang /6 'jar man g.yul la zhugs te lo lnga 'gor ba na blo pham zhing lus dub par gyur/ dbyi tha li'i dpung la 'jar man gyi than khi 'ga' las khrab ldan 'khor lo'i dpung khag cig kyang med pa'i nyam chung gi rnam pa de/ mna' 'brel gyi dmag dpung gis ci la mi shes mizhes dang / 6 a ri dang dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gi 'go khrid pas nga tshor bkur bsti gnangs pa'i rnam pa re re nga chos gtan nas brjed mi rung zhes bkod 'dug zla 7par bslebs pa na/ rgyal po dang spyi'i jus dpon an phu ro se o (ṣṭhalotshomatsho)/ dmag spyi bha tho le o ( ༅45spri1khyargyu)sogs mi 'gas mu so li nyi srid khri las ༵ sbyor

dbyung rgyu la gsang gros mdzad/mu so li nyi yi gtum spyod dang dbyi tha li 'jar man gyi rim pa gnyis pa'i grogs po ru gyur pa'i tshul der hpha shi si'i tang nang gi dmag spyi rgan gas khag la sngar nas mi mthun pa'i lta tshul byung yod pa dang / kho tshos 'das pa'i lo ba'i'i ring la bsdu ma thub pa'i hpha shi si tang nang gi ches mtho ba'i u yon lhan tshogs bsdus te mig snga ra gyi gnad don 'di thag gcod byed rtsis yod/zla 7pa'i tshes 24nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod lnga'i steng du tshogs 'du de rom gyi pho brang we ne si yi ne tso tshoms chen du bsdus pa dang / tshogs 'du mgo bcoms ma thag nas mi rnams kyis mu so li nyi yis she thi ler dang khyi spyang ngan 'brel sgos dbyi tha li'i la rgya 'chor du bcug pa la skyon gyi mdzub mo btsugs/tha na kho'i ngan grogs te/ yar sngon phyi 'brel pu'u krang dang dbyin ji ru sdod pa'i gzhung tshab chen mo'i 'gan blangs myong ba'i hpha shi si tang nang gi rgan gras dhe no ki ran dhe( 7glo zo 7)yis kyang kho'i sbyor ngan la skyon brjod byas pa ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims sla ra gso byed pa/ rgyal pos sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas dmag srid gnyis kyi dbang cha 'dzin dgos shing / mu so li nyi yis tang gi dbu khrid kho na'i 'gan 'khur na 'grig pa'i blang bya bton/de lta bu'i dza drag gi gros mol chu tshod bcu tsam gyi yun la bsdus te/ nyin gnyis pa'i nam gung gi chu tshod gsum pa'i steng / mu so li nyi srid khri las dbab rgyur 'thad pa yin min la mtha' mjug gi lta tshul bsdus/ de'i 'bras bu ni/ 'thad pa byung mkhan gyi mi bcu dgu dang / mi 'thad mkhan brgyad/dbang 'dor mkhan gyi mi gcig bcas yod/ kho'i mag pas kyang 'thad pa'i shog byang 'phangs pa na/ mu so li nyi yi gdong la khro ba'i nyams dang bcas yar langs te 'di skad/ 6 ji 'dra'i yid phangs pa la/ khyod tshos srid dbang la ༵༵༵ nyen bzos song 9zer zhor du su la'ang kha ya mi byed par tshogs ra

las phyir 'gro rtsis byas/ hpha shi si tang gi hru'u ci si kho ṭa yis ci mi snyam par kha nas 6 gtso 'dzin la gus phyag 'bul zhes pa'i srol tshig de shor ba na/mu so li nyis kyang mi 'dod ba'in du lag g.yas pas phyir brda 'ag bstan te bud song la/ tshoms chen 'jam cag ger ha la ma mi gcis kyang med pa dang kun nas mtshungs/mu so li nyi khyim du 'byor dus nam phyed du slebs yod la / khos chung mar tshogs 'du'i gnas tshul bshad rjes/ mos kho la 6 khyod kyis mi mngags te mi de tsho 'dzin du bcug gam zhes dris pa'i lan du/ khos mgo g.yug gin 6 ma bcug sang nyin mngags rtsis yod ces lan btab/ kho'i bsam par tang gi ches mtho ba'i u yon lhan tshogs kyi chod don 'dir slob sto na tsam las khrims kyi nus pa cher med rkyen/ rjes phyogs kyi bya ba legs 'grub yong bar nges snyam pas/ khos da dung ma 'ongs pa la re ba legs po bcangs yod/tshes 25nyin gyi phyi dror/ mu so li nyi rgyal por mjal du song / khos rang nyid ma nyes par bston btsugs pa bzhin snga nyin gyi tshogs 'du'i gnas tshul rgyal por zhus te rang nyid kyi blon chen 'ga' brje ba la chog mchan yong bar zhus/ 'on te rgyal pos kho la tang gi 6 ches mtho ba'i u yon lhan tshogs ni khyod rang gis dngos su btsugs pa dang / de yis don phran tshegs tsam thag gcod byas pa la'ang don snying ches cher ldan pa yin/’ 8 ba'i gces su rung ba'i gtso 'dzin ya/ mig snga'i gnas babs la dza drag ha cang che ste/ dbyi tha li chags 'jig gi 'gag rtsar slebs 'dug dmag dpung gi dpa' spobs nyams zin la/ al phi si 0skya dam ga gis kyang khyod mu so li nyi la sri zhu sgrub wa du yolabasi ste 1rmyaci mo263

'dod med/ da lta khyod ni rgyal yongs kyi ches yi rangs bya mi 'dod pa'i mi zhig tu gyur yod pas/ nga ni khyod kyi ches mtha' mjug gi blos thub grogs po gcig pu red ’ ces bshad/ skabs der rgyal pos mu so li ha las pa'i nyams 'gyur de la'ang snang 'jog long ma byung bar mu mthud du bshad don/ bltas tshod du mig sngar gyi gnas tshul zhol 'jags gtong thub mkhan dmag spyi bha tho le o las mi 'dug pas/ rgyal srid zhang blon gyi go gnas kho rang la sprad na 'grig zer/ mu so li nyi yis rgyal po'i tshig mtshams bcad de 'tshab 'tshub ngang na re/ dmag dpung gis mu mthud du nga la rgyab skyor byed nges yin/ gal te nga rang las gnas dang bral na nub phyogs mna' mthun rgyalatab dag gi 'dod thog tu rta brgyugs pa ma red dam zhes pa la/ rgyal pos nan gyis bshad rgyur/ 6 nga rang yid skyo yang thabs mi 'dug dngos gnas thabs mi 'dug gnad don 'di thag gcod par thabs gzhan zhig mi rnyed ces bshad/ mu so li nyi 'u thug nas 6 gal te rgyal pos gsungs pa bden na/ nga rang las gnas nas 'bud pa las 'os med zer ba na/rgyal pos skad cha de thos ma thag yag po 'dug / nga la cha rkyen ci yang med par khyod rang srid gzhung gi 'go khrid kyi las gnas las 'bud rgyu'i gnas tshul dang len bya nges yin mi zhes gsungs/yud tsam na mu so li nyi glo bur du gnyid las sangs pa bzhin/ yid thang chad pa'i ngang yang bskyar rgyal po la/ 6 da ni yod tshad tshar zin/ o na ngas ci bya/ nga'i khyim tshang gis /’ zer ba la rgyal pos blo khog yangs po'i sgo nas khyod kyi bde 'jags la ngas 'gan blangs chog de'i thad kyi bya ba rnams snga mo nas bkod sgrig byas tshar yod zer zhor du sgo'i phyi rol tu phebs song / khong gnyis kyi skar ma nyi shu'i ring gi mjal 'phrad kyang de nas mardo~X bzhag ste mu so li nyi rgyal po dang mi 'bral ka med byung /

mo so li nyi yis 'khyar 'khyor gyi gom pa spos te rang gi rlangs 'khor gyi phyogs su 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs der/ dmag srid nyen rtog pa zhig kho'i mdun nas langs te gus 'dud dang bcas na re/ 6 dbu 'dzin lags/ go thos su khyed rang nyen khar 'phrad 'dug zer bas nga tsho ched du khyed rang srung skyob byed du 'ong ba yin zer/ der khos 6 nga la rang gi srung dmag yod pas khyod tshos ci bya ’ zer/ nyen rtog pas tshig rtsub po'i ngang 6 nga tsho rgyal po'i bka' bzhin khyod rang srung du 'ong pa yin pas/ de ga la rung zhes bshad/ mu so li nyi yis lan du/ 6 rgyal po'i bka' yin na de ltar bya/ ya 'o na rlangs 'khor la sdod zer bar/ nyen rtog pas/ che de ma red/ mdun phyogs kyi myur skyob rlangs 'khor de'i nang du phebs rogs zer zhor du mu so li nyi la kha gcig kyang grags dbang ma byin par rgyab nas gtad de rlangs 'khor du bzhag rlangs 'khor du dmag chas cha tshang spras pa'i dmag mi 'ga' dang / da dung kho dang mnyam du nang la bud pa'i dmag dpon gcigadamagasrid nyen rtog pa gsum dang nyen rtog pa gnyis bcas mi bcu kha zhig 'dug cing / rlangs 'khor mda' 'phangs pa bzhin mdun du bskyod la/ mu so li nyi de ltar bkag bzung byas/mu so li nyi thog mar hphin khra (zlejotshadzu)gling phran du bskyal ba dang / rjes su nyin rgyun dmag srid nyen rtog pa brgya las ci yang mthong rgyu med pa'i mya ngam gyi thang chen po ma ḍa le na (6 747)gling phran du khrid/ de ru kho rang de snga dbyin ji bas bzos pa'i gzhis shag cig tu bcug ste/ gza' 'khor gsum la bsdad/ dka' sdug gi nyin mo 'khyol thabs su khos srung dmag gi lag nas shog bu dang spru gu blangs te nyin tho re 'bri ba'i mgo bcoms/ khos nam zhig la nyin tho de dag deb cig tu 'god thub par re zhing sgug zla 8pa'i tshes 29nyin kho rang gnas spar te a rol chi (khu1rsā'ichad)ri rgyud kyi ma/ rdos

'gul skyod tsho chung zhig dang mnyam du dbyi tha li'i rom du 'phur/ skabs der per lin nas kyang tang srung dmag mi lnga bcu mkha' dmag ru khag dang por zhugs te dbyi tha li lho phyogs su si khor thin dang mnyam 'brel byed par mngags pa red/si khor thin sogs dbyi tha li la 'byor rjes 'brel ba sna tshogs brgyud de mu so li nyi gang du yod pa rtsad gcod byas pa dang / ma 'gyangs par 'jar man gyi gsang myul tshogs pa'i lag tu dbyi tha li'i dmag dpon kho e li (lha༅lko/)yis nang srid pu'u la btang ba'i tar yig cig thon nga/ dang / tar yig tu ghi ran se so mtha' 'khor gyi bde srung gi bkod sgrig legs par grub 'dug ces pa'i tshig cig mthong ba la brtag pas/ si khor thin sogs kyis mu so li nyi ghi ran se so rgyal po'i sgar du btson 'jug byas yod pa gzhi nas shes/'jar ma na pas zla 9pa'i tshes 12ni gza' nyi ma yin phyin sa de ga'i bde srung gi bya ba'ang dus rgyun dang bsdur na cung lhod po e yod snyam ste nyin de la 'gul skyod bya rgyu gtan 'khel byas/ phyi dro'i chu tshod gcig gi steng gnam gru bcu gnyis btson khang yod sa'i khang rtsegs shig gi mdun du babs pa dang /skabs der mu so li nyi sum thog gi sge'u khung zhig gi mdun du langs 'dug pa las/ khos ci yin gang yin gtan nas ma shes/ gnam gru las 'jar man gyi dmag lu gyon pa'i dmag mi skor 'ig thang la babs pa na/ khos da gzod rang srog la thar lam zhig yod song snyam nas de phyogs su lag g.yab byas/dmag mi tshos srung dmag 'ga' bsad de mu so li nyi yi khang pa'i sgo phye/ si khor thin sngon la bud de na re/ dbu 'dzin lags/ nga tsho gtso 'dzin she thi ler gyis khyod rang skyob par mngags pa yin/ da ni khyed la rang dbang thob song zhes zhus pa la/ nu so li nyi kho'i lus la 'tham ste nga'i grogs po e lha rmu she thi ler gyis nga rang 'di ltar bskyur mi phod pa ngas sngar nas shes yonā /ra/

de tsa na yang gnam gru ga'an 'ig khang mdun du babs pa dang / si khor thin gyis kho la khyod rang gnam gru 'di las rom ru thon rjes yang bskyar gnam gru gzhan zhig gis we en na ru bskyal nges yin zhes bshad pa la/ mu so li nyi yis mgo bo lcog lcog gis legs so legs so zer zhor gnam grur bsdad de stse en na'i phyogs su bskyod song /nyin gcig gi rjes su mu so li nyi phu ro zi shar ma (lko 0ljo )ru rang nyid kyi srog skyob mkhan she thi ler dang mjal 'dzoms byung / khos ngag cal col ngang rang nyid srid kyi bya gzhag las phyir 'bud 'dod kyi gnas tshul zhus mod/ she thi ler gyis kho'i srog bskyabs pa'i dmigs yul ni de las ldog ste da dung mu mthud du hpha shi si yi las don sgrub tu 'jug rgyu de red/ de bas she thi ler gyis kho'i bsam thog tu 'jog rgyu phar zhog kho la 'jar man pas dbang bsgyur ba'i dbyi tha li yi byang rgyud kyi srid 'gan dkris/ de nas bzung mu so li nyi yis rgyal khab kyi ming bsgyur te dbyi tha li spyi tshogs spyi mthun rgyal khab ces ming btags/ 'khon lan slog pa'i ched du khos sngar rang nyid las gnas las dbyung mkhan dag lkog gsod bya bar bka' bsgo byas te yang bskyar lo gcig gi ring la sbyor ngan bshams/1944lo'i dpyid kyi dus su 'jar man hpha shi si yis byang nub phyogs gnyis nas pham kha chen po nyos pa dang / mu so li nyi yis kyang rang tshe'i mthar thug pa ngang gis tshor/mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi dpung gi snga ma dag dbyi tha li'i smi lan 0grong khyer du bslebs pa dang / zla 4pa'i tshes 25nyin gyi mtshan mo der mu so li nyi yis 'tshab 'tshub ngang rang gi dga' rogs khi ler lha bha zhi dang ngan grogs 0 me lan/ 5 /goXchi༅268

'ga'/ da dung drag chas nyen rtog pa skor zhig khrid de smi lan byang phyogs kyi khi mo dumatshe'u brgyud de si we tser lan ḍi la 'bro ba'i lkog g.yo bshams pa red/tshes 26nyin dbyi tha li yi nges med rgol rdung ru khag gis tung gi(lko2)grong khyer bcings grol byas pa dang / 'jar man dmag gis rim bzhin mgo 'dogs pa'i las bcoms/ nam gung gi tshe na nges med rgol rdung ru khag la/ 'jar man hpha shi si yi rlangs 'khor sum cu lhag dbyi tha li dang si we tser lan ḍi yi sa mtshams kyi mu so(ṣṭharsā)grong gi nye 'dabs su thon yod pa dang /mu so li nyi'ang de'i gras su yod pa'i gsang brda 'byor bas/ nges med rgol rdung ru khag dang rgyal gces mi snas sa mtshams dam por bsrungs pas ma 'gyangs par rlangs 'khor de tsho lag tu tshud pa red/ nam gung gi smag rum dang rlangs 'khor bsdad ma thag pa'i 'du 'dzi'i go skabs bed spyad de/ mu so li nyi yis bhe ṭha 'i bskyur te rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig las sar babs pa dang /mgo la 'jar dmag gi khrab dang lus la mkha' dmag gi lu ring zhig gon zhing mchan du go khug chung chung 'ig 'bral med du btsur nas/ 'jar dmag khrod du dmag mi dkyus ma zhig tu brdzus nas 'dzul te/ 'jar dmag gi skyogs dmag rtog dpyod ru khag gi rlangs 'khor zhig gi steng du 'gos nas sbas/nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi tshogs mi nee li(lkotsho)dmag dpon sogs kyis rlangs 'khor re re bzhin zhib bsher nan mo byas mthar/ rlangs 'khor 'ig la yod pa'i 'jar dmag rnams cung stabs stabs por gyur yod pa mthong bas/ kho tsho rlangs 'khor du bud nas bltas pa na/ rlangs 'khor gyi phugs su lus bskums shing steng la lwa ring zhig gis g.yogs pa/ lwa ring du 'i mo/ 50707 269

lasatpa shi si'i dmag dpon gyi dor ma gser skud bar 'jog can gyon pa'i rkang ba gnyis phyir mngon 'dug pa mthong bas/ nee li yis su yin dris pa la/dmag mi phal ba zhig gis de 6 chang bzi ’ zhig red zer/ nee li yis ci yang ma shes pa'i zol gyis rlangs 'khor las sar babs rjes grogs po rnams la rlangs 'khor der mnyam 'jog yag po bya dgos par bskul rjes/ rang nyid gong rim la gnas tshul de snyan seng zhu ru song /nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi dmag spyi gzhon pa ster( 667)tshur 'ong nas bltas ma thag mu so li nyi yin pa shes song / khos zur za'i tshig gis 'di ni 6 skya rgod ste nee tho sa so li nyi ma red dam ces pa la/ mu so li nyi yis myur du lag zung mgor btegs te mgo 'dogs pa'i tshul bstan/chu tshod gnyis tsam gyi rjes su mu so li nyi nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi bkod 'doms pu'u te tung ki grong khyer srid gzhung gi tshogs khang du khrid/ de ru kho dang 'dra bar me lan nas phyi yul du 'bro rtsis byas pa'i sgye ṭha zhi dang hpha shi si yi 'go ba mi bcu drug lhan du bzung yod/ nges med rgol rdung ru khag gis kho tsho'i thob thang sogs la 'dri gcod nan mor byas rjes/ dgong mo de'i chu tshod bdun gyi steng tung ki dang thag mi ring sa'i krong cer ma khri no(la pophar cha)grong du bskyal ba dang / hpha shi si yi srog skyob dmag mgo bskor ched du mu so li nyi rmas ma yin khul gyis bhe ṭha zhi dang mnyam du a ḍa no zhes pa'i grong tsho gzhan zhig tu khrid/tshes 28nyin nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi dmag spyi chen mos 'thus mi gnyis dang dmag mi bco lnga mngags nas spyi khyab jus 'don khang gi chod don te/ mu so li nyi dang bhe bla zhi gnyis kyi srog gcod rgyu'i bya ba lag bstar byed du bcug pa red/ mu so li nyi dang kho'i dga' rogs gnyis pu tshi nee gi(70khushā /yi khyer men ṭhā spro khang dang nye sa'i mtho sgang zhig tu khrid de srog chad

bcad pa dang / dpung dmag tshos mi dmangs kyi re ba bzhin de gnyis kyi bem po me lan gyi ro le tho(ga rsā7)thang chen du drud de nyin 'ga' la de gar bzhag de ni dbyi tha li mi dmangs kyis nam yang brjed dka' ba'i drang bden gyi bcad khra zhig lags/ de nas bzung dbyi tha li mi dmangs mu so li spya ṣṭṛ hā /'i sger gcod kyi dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba dang gtan du 'bral thub pa

ya ma mo to sgo zu ro khub tsher phung mugawor dur 'thug byas pa/bar lam gling phran gyi 'thab 'khrug la pham nyes byung rjes su/ 'jar pan mnyam 'brel gru dpung gi si ling spyi khyab ya ma mo to sgo rju ro khub ( 7lham/la)yi gdong gi sngar yod kyi dzig nyams de ma thag yal bar gyur/ da ni kha mi grags shing gdong la nam yang sdug mdog cig 'char 'dug pa dang /rgyun par las shag tu phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed bzhin pa'i ngang tshul la bltas na ṭā rang sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung yod pa'i nyams snang zhig cis kyang ster sa/ bar lam gling phran dmag 'khrug las pham rjes su 'jar pan pa'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i steng gi dbang cha yod tshad mna' 'brel dmag gi lag tu shor ba red/ ya ma mo to rang nyid la mtshon na'ang 'jar pan la zhi bde rgya mtsho'i lho phyogs su nyen kha je che yin khar/ srid gzhung dang mtsho dmag thad kyi rang gi mtshan snyan dang go babs kyang rim bzhin rgyad 'gro ba la sems khur che/ nye ba'i char kho rang la grags 'gul ci yang ma byung rung / kho'i snying nye dang 'khor g.yog rnams kyis kho'i ya chung na khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar bzhin zhi bde rgya mtsho'i klong yangs nas a ri'i dpung dang bzang ngan 'gran pa'i go skabs sheg la sgrag yod pa snga mo nas shes 'dugabasamagazhigs thengs gang mang zhig gi rjes su/ ya ma mo to yis rang nyid2 tta~X dngos su lho khul du rang gi gru dpung ru khag la lta zhib cig bya dgos

pa'i sems thag bcad la/ lta zhib kyi zhor du rang gi dpung la rting skul dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'thab jus thad bsam blo yag po zhig gtong dgos snyam/ lam du ma chas pa'i snga rol tu/ khos zhi bde rgya mtsho'i lho phyogs dang krung go'i mtsho khug btsan bzung byas yod pa'i 'jar pan gru dpung khag gi dmag spyi rnams la gsang tar las lta zhib tu 'ong rgyu'i gnas tshul gsal bor bskur/spyi lo 1943lo'i zla 4pa'i nang a ri'i gsang myul tshogs pa'i ched mkhas pa rnams kyis 'jar pan mtsho dmag dmag spyi khang nas btang ba'i gsang 'phrin zhig gi gsang ba brtol/ ma gzhi de ni ya ma mo to yis rang gi 'khor la kho rang bya bar lta zhib tu 'ong rgyu'i gnas tshul bsgrags pa'i brda yig de red/brda yig gi steng du lta zhib kyi sa gnas dang dus tshod/ lam thag sogs gsal bor bkod 'dug thob par dka' ba'i gsang 'phrin de da lta a ri'i mtsho dmag gi pu'u krang hphu ran khi rdo khi si(lko〉〉 glo lo)yi lag tu 'byor yod la/ khos gsang 'phrin de'i gal chen rang bzhin mthong bas de ma thag tsung thung ro se wel gyi drung du bskyal/a ri'i dmag gi 'go 'dzin rnams khrod dza drag che ba'i rtsod gleng zhig byung / skya rgod kyi gzi nyams dod pa'i gna' bo'i g.yul 'thab skabs yig thog tu ma bkod pa'i rgyun srol zhig chags yod pa ni/ 'thab ya'i bkod 'doms pa lkog gsod bya mi rung ba de red/ de bas mi skor zhig gis lta ba de rgyun 'khyongs kyis ya ma mo to yi gnam grur phar rgol bya rgyur ngo rgol byas la/gzhan skor cig gis/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs 'jar man pa'i dmag gru zhig gis tsung thung ro se wel yod pa'i gru chung la 'bar 'del 'phang yang / skabs de'i srung skyob kyi bya bar zhib cha che bas kho la phog ma thub pa de dang / yang yo rob kyi g.yul 'thab cig tu 'jar man pas dmag dpon chen mo e sin ho bur lkog gsod kyi 'char ga'i 'then myong ༵ 7tāng /

yang thengs shig dbu bzhugs blon chen chur chil gyis sa khug rgya mtsho nas ngal gsos te phyir log pa'i tshe na/ 'jar man pas kho'i gnam grur 'jab rgol bya ba'i lkog g.yo bshams kyang / mtha' mar dmigs 'ben nor te glog brnyan 'khrab ston pa ros si le do wa ti(lko lko1rsā47)yi gnam gru gtor la/chur chil skabs legs te gson thub pa byung tshul sogs dper blangs nas/dmag 'thab la g.yo jus dgos te/ 'thab 'dzing slong mkhan rgyal khab kyis sbyor ba de 'dra brtsom rung na nga tshos ci la mi rung zhes bshad la/ de dag gis da dung bshad rgyur/ 6 ya ma mo to yis de snga dmag 'khrug gi 'gro lugs snang med du bzos te mu tig gru kha la 'jab rgol byas myong bas/ da lan nga tshos kho'i gnam grur 'jab rgol bya cir mi 'os/’ ru da ni kho rang g.yul gyi gnas su lta zhib tu 'gro ba yin pas/ g.yul gyi gnas su dmag dpon zhig dang dmag mi dkyus ma zhig la khyad med de/ tshang ma lugs mthun gyi 'ben du 'jog rung ba red ces bshad/phyi ma'i sgrub byed nus ldan des tsung thung ro se wel la chod don bzo ru bcug la/ khos ya ma mo to lta zhib tu bgrod byed gnam grur rgol rdung byed dgos pa dang / bya ba de'i mgo mjug bar gsum gyi 'thab jus yod tshad mtsho dmag gi pu'u krang nu'o khi si nyid nas dngos su lag bltar bya dgos zhes bka' phabs so//yud tsam na a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho lho phyogs kyi skam sa'i dmag dpung gi dmag spyi khang du g.yul bshams pa'i bka' yig cig 'byor 'ong ba dang /bka' yig tu/ nus shugs yod dgu bton te dmigs 'ben rdul du rlogs/bya ba'i rjes su dal 'byangs med par sngar gyi gnas su phyir log pa las/las 'gan gzhan mi dbyung bya dgos/ der ma zad/ las 'gan ma bcoms pardi lto rol tu ci nas kyang gsang rgya dam por sdom dgos zhes bris 'dug

spyi lo 1943lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 17nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod bzhi ba'i steng /a ri'i mkha' dmag gi kha lo ba jon mu chir(phregis sko7lo)dang zho ju ma hri lin hpher ( 776 ༅lkolko)gnyis gsang ba'i sgo nas skam sa'i dmag gi dmag spyi khang du 'byor ba dang / kho gnyis nas ya ma mo to yi gnam grugator rgyu'i las 'gan phrag la babs pa shes rjes spro sems rab tu 'khol byung / yang bskyar gros zhib mo zhig byas rjes/ ya ma mo to 'bab sa'i gnas dang dbyin le so lnga yod pa'i kha zhi le (rdozlotsho)mtsho khug tu 'jab rgol bya rgyu thag gis bcad/ ma ga'i de nas gnam gru 'bab thang du chu tshod skar ma bdun gyi lam thag las med pas 'jab rgol gyi gnas la ha cang 'tsham pa red/zla 4pa'i tshes 18nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod bdun dang skar ma so lnga'i steng / a ri'i 'thab 'dzing gnam gru'i tsho chung dgung sngon dbyings su bskyod/kho tsho mtho tshad la dbyin le 435yi mtshams nas 'jar pan gyis btsan bzung byas pa'i yul dag g.yol te bskyod pa dang / de yi lam bar du skud med kha par yang ma spyad par phyogs ston 'khor lo dang myur tshad 'khor lo kho nar bston te kha lo bsgyur ba red/ kho tsho tshod rtsis kyi dus tshod ltar dmigs yul du 'byor thub pa byung /snga dro'i chu tshod dgu dang skar ma zhe lnga'i steng gnam gru 'phur bskyod kyi sgra zhig grags 'ong ba dang mnyam du/ ya ma mo to dang kho'i lag g.yog tsho'i san len rtags can gyi 'gas gtor gnam gru gnyis 'thab gru drug gis srung skyob dang bcas rgyang ring gi mkha' dbyings su mthong byung / bro'o zha'o mu chir gyi gnam gru'i tshogs kyang de ma thag dbyin khri nyis khri lhag gi sprin rim du 'dzul te 'jar dmag gi 'thab gru drug po tshur 'gugs thabs byas pa na/ de dag kyang bsru brid kyi dbang du song ste ya ma mo to dang lag 'khor gyi gnam gru gnyis ka dang gyes te a ri'i gnam grur rgol du song ba na/ hra'o zhanā byin

hpher gyis bkod 'doms byed pa'i gnam gru'i tshogs kyis skabs de dang bstun nas gang myur sgos ya ma mo to yi gnam grur 'jab rgol bya bar bsnyegs/'jar dmag gi 'thab gru drug po'i kha lo bas kho tshor mgo skor thebs pa shes rjes myur bar dmag dpon gyi phyogs su smad kyang / lin hpher gyis mdel shar btang pas ya ma mo to yi gnam gru'i g.yas phyogs kyi 'phrul 'khor dang g.yon phyogs kyi gshog par gas sgra dang bcas te me lce mched la/ gnam gru de kha zhi le mtsho khug gi phyogs su lhung ba'i tshe na/ lin hpher gyis yang bzu ra mda' skor gcig drag tu 'phangs pas gshog zung bcad pas/ gnam gru'i shar du phyogs te drang mor lhung song / ya ma mo to'i gnam gru de dmigs yul kha zhi le dang dbyin le 'ga' las med pa'i tsher phung zhig tu lhung ste gas gtor du gyur/kho'i lag grogs 'dug sa'i gnam gru gzhan de yang krung we bha lhar gyi mdel phog ste sar lhung / dpung stobs la gzhan gyis 'gran 'dzugs dka' tshod du yod pa'i 'jar pan mnyam 'brel dmag gru'i dmag spyi chen mo ya ma mo to go cug ro khu ni/ skad cig tsam la tshang tshing stug po'i tsher gseng du thal gyi phung bor gyur/ de ni btsan 'dzul pa dag la 'bab 'os pa'i sdug 'bras red/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa mjug bsgril nas ring po ma 'gor bar/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi tshogs 'du zhig gi steng du/ gsar 'god pa zhig gis a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag gi mtho rim dmag dpon zhig la/ 6 khyod tshos ji ltar 'jar pan mkha' dmag gi dmag spyi chen mo ya ma mo to'i gnam gru mar 'phangs pa yin mi zhes dris pa la/dmag dpon des/ 8 nga tsho la 'jar pan mtsho dmag gi dmag spyi pu'u nas btang ba'i gsang tar zhig lag son byung ba las/ ya ma mo to'i gnam gru gang nas 'phur rgyu dang gang la 'bab rgyu'i gnas tshul gsal bor shes song /de 136/ ya ma mo to la 'chi lam gcig pu las med do ’ zhes lan btab/

nor mnadhe skam sarabaskyod pa/wa yo rob gling gi g.yul sa gnyis pa'i yo lang phye/spyi lo 1944lo'i dpyid kyi dpal yon rnam par bzhad pa'i tshe na/dbyin ji'i lho khul du 'thab 'dzing la sgug pa'i mna' 'brel rgyal khab kyi dmag mi tshos 'tshang kha shig shig byed bzhin mchis/ kho tshos g.yul sa gnyis pa'i yo lang phye ched/ yo rab nub ma nas 'jar dmag pham par byas rjes/tshang mas 'thab 'dzing gi bka' brda la thung myur du yong bar re sgug byas 'dugadabyin ji'i lho khul gyi phor tshi mu si ༷grong du yod pa'i yo rob nub byang gi mna' 'brel rgyang skyod dmag mi'i spyi khyab bkod 'dom khang du/ spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa ste/ a ri'i dmag dpon lha be thi ma sin ho bur dang dmagadapon ga'an dag gis dpung 'jug sngon gyi bya ba sna tshogs la gra sgrig byed bzhin mchis la/ mkha' dmag gi dmag spyi chen mo ste/ dbyin ji'i dmag dpon li ma ro le(lko/ za/62)yis blo rtse gcig sgrim ngang gra sgrig byas pa'i gnam gru khri gcig lhag 'dug pa des dgra bo'i mkha' lam ji ltar 'gog par zhib 'jug byed bzhin yod/spyi lo 1943lo'i lo mjug tu bsdus pa'i the he ran tshogs 'du'i stong /ro se wel dang chur chil/ si ta lin gsum nas yo rob gling gi g.yul sa gnyis pa'i yo lang spyi lo 1944lo'i zla 5par phye rgyu gtan 'khel byas zin mod/༷ phor tshi mu si/ sngaXpa guX 'i nems 277

phyi nang gi rkyen sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis zla gcig tsam phyi sdur mi byed ka med byung / dbyin ji li mcho 'gag brgal te hpha ran si'i byang rgyud kyi nor man dhe dugling phran du g.yul sa gnyis pa'i yo lang phyes pa de ni/ dmag don lo rgyus stong gi rlabs chen gyi las 'gul zhig yin/ thengs 'de'i dmag 'thab la rgyalakha 'byung min de rang ngos kyi cha rkyen kho na la rag las pa ma yin par/gnamagashes la sogs pa'i phyi rkyen la'ang 'brel ba dam po yod phyir/ nges par du phyogs yongs la bsam mno yag por gtong dgos la/ phyi rkyen thad kyi bsam mno gtong sa gtso bo ni/ dang po/ dpung 'jug gi bya ba nges par du smag rum khrod bgyi dgos pa dang / de ltar byas na da gzod dpung dmag dang dngos zong skyel 'dren gyi gru gzings dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag nas bde blag ngang dmigs yul du 'byor thub pa red/ gnyis pa/ skam sar 'go ba'i 'thab 'dzing gi skabs su mna' 'brel dmag gis mkha' dbyings nas zla 'od la brten te 'jab rgol bya dgos pa dang / de dang sa ngos kyi phar rgol bar da dung skar ma bzhi bcu'i dus tshod yod pa der/ mkha' dmag gis skabs bstun gyis sa de ga'i gzhung lam dang lcags lam gtor nas 'jar dmag gis skyel 'dren la gtor brlags byas chog pa red/ gsum pa/ skam sar 'go ba'i dmag dpung gis mtsho rlabs ha cang dma' ba'i dus su da gzod phar rgol byed 'os te/ de ltar byas na 'jar dam ga gis bzos pa'i skam sar 'go ba'i 'gog byed dang 'gad rdzas sogs sel te dmag dpung bde blag ngang skam sar bud de nor man dhe la bskyod thub pa red/ cha rkyen de dag gi rkyen gyis skam sar 'go ba'i phar rgol byed pa la nges par du zla 'od shāḥnor man dhe/ saXng la rngu ma

sasal ba dang mtsho rlabs dma' ba/ nyi ma rtse shar gsum 'dzoms pa'i dus chod cig dgos la/ de lta bu'i cha rkyen gsum dus gcig la ldan pa ni zla 6pa'i tshes 5nas 7bar gyi nyin gsum las med/der brten mna' 'brel dpung khag gi bkod 'doms pu'u nas a ri dang dbyin ji'i gnam gshis ched mkhas pa bkod sgrig byas te gnam gshes u yon tshogs pa zhig btsugs/ kho tshos nyin ba'in thengs gnyis la dbyi ji li ma tsho 'gag dang 'gram rgyud kyi gnam gshis 'gyur ldog la brtag dpyad yang dag byas rjes/ bkod 'doms pu'u la dpung 'jug gi dus nam zhig 'tsham pa mkho sprod byas/ 1944lo'i zla 6par dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag tu de snga lo nyi shu'i ring la byung myong med pa'i drag rlung ldang / mna' 'brel dpung khag gis ma ga'i zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin phar rgol bya rgyu gtan la phab zin mod/ zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi zhogs par bkod 'doms khang tu 'byor ba'i gnam gshis gnas tshul du/ sprin rim dma' zhing rlung shugs drag ces 'dug de lta bu'i gnam gshis kyi cha rkyen 'og g.yul bshams na nyen kha ha cang che ba red/nyin de'i mtshan mo'i gnam gshis gnas tshul gyis kyang kho tsho'i sems lhod la 'bab tu ma bcug la/ tshes 5nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod gsum dang phyed ga'i steng ya nga bskyar drag rlung ldang zhing 'tshub ma langs te/ dpung dmag sdod sa'i ras gur rnams kyang tshugs ma zin par g.yo la/ der bsdongs nas drag char skyi g.ya' ba zhig babs/ skabs der/ hpha ran si'i mcho 'gram gyi gnam gshis kyang dbyin ji dang 'dra bar ha cang skyi g.ya' ba zhig yin pas/ sngar zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin phar rgol bya rgyur gtan la phab pa'i dus tshod de phyir 'gyangs mi byed mthu med byung / mna' 'brel dmag gi bkod 'doms khang gi tshogs mi tsho yang dang bskyar sgor bud de nam mkhar lta bzhin gnam gshis legs po zhig la re ltos kyis sgug 279

thengs gnyis pa'i gnam gshis sngon brda'i snyan zhu 'byor ba na/ mi rnams kyi gdong las bcos min gyi 'dzum mdangs sheg mngon yong ste/ zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin nas bzung chu tshod 36ring gnam gshis drod 'jam du 'gyur rgyu'i gtam bzang de thos pas/ spyi khyab bkod 'dom tshogs pas de ma thag tshogs 'du bsdus te zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i gros thag bcad/ gsang rgya'i ched du nyin mo de'i mtshon rtags su 6 nyin mo ba ru btaga~X /6pa'i tshes 6gi snga mo chu tshod gcig dang phyed ku'i stong / smag rum sdug po'i khrod gru kha so so na yod pa'i dmag gru rnams dal gyis 'gul byung /dpung dmag khri 17 6dang de dag la mkho ba'i yo byad sogs 'dren byed kyi gru lnga stong lhag dal gyis dbyin ji'i lho rgyud dang gyes te rim bzhin nor man dhe phyogs su bskyod/ de dang lhan du a ri dang dbyin ji'i mkha' dmag gis bskyed 'dren gnam gru 2395dang / mkha' lding gnam gru 847la gdugs dmag hri shog gsum dang bcas pas nam mkha'i dbyings rim brtol/ nor man dhe mtsho 'gram gyi mkha' dbyings nas sngon dpag byas pa'i sa gnas su babs/ nyi gzhon gyi dus la dbyin ji'i sku drag mkha' dmag gi gnam gru 1136gis dgra dmag gi skyogs rdzong bcu ru 'gad rdzas tun 5853'phangs pa dang / nam langs kyi rjes su a ri'i mkha' dmag ru khag brgyad pas mkha' gtor gnam gru 1013gyis 'jar man dmag phyogs kyi mtsho kha'i 'gog srung sgrig chas la 'gad rdzas tun 1763'phangs pa red/ der mna' 'brel dmag dpung gis rigs 'dra min gyi 'thab 'dzing gnam gru'i dpung chen pos phyogs yongs nas 'jar man gyi dmag don dmigs 'ben dang / skam sa'i phyogs dmag gi dmag sgar/ da dung gal che ba'i 'grim 'grul sa tshigs so~X /da brlags su btang / tshes 6gi zhigs pa'i chu tshod lnga dang skar ma lnga

chu 'gram du chu tshod gsum tsam gyi ring la de yi 'jar dmag yod tshad yongs su bcom pa dang / nyin der a ri'i dmag mi nyis khri sum stong tsam le'u the chu 'gram du 'byor byung / o ma hwa chu 'gram du snga rjes su thengs gnyis la a ri'i dmag mtsho gru las babs ma thag 'jar dmag gi 'jab sol gyis mi mang po zhig shi rmas bzos/ de lta bu'i nyams nyen gyi dus su a ri'i thol rgol ru shog gnyis mtsho 'gram gyi g.yang gzar la 'dzegs te dgra bo'i phyogs dmag gi g.yul sa blangs kyang / stogs stegs gcig las gtor ma nus phyir gzhan rnams las sngar ba'in tshur rgol drag po byas/ skabs der/ a ri'i rkang dmag gi hri shog dang po'i spyi dpon 'i khu'u zhus na (/ lo7)yis mthar skrod gru dpung la rang dmag gi srog la nyen kha yod kyang 'jar dmag gi me shugs lte gnas dang thag nye sar bcar nas phar rgol byed rgyu'i bka' babs pas/ 'jar dmag rnams lag zung btegs te phyir mi 'ong thabs med du btang / a ri'i rkang dmag gi hri dang po'i 'thab mo ba rnams kyis dka' sdug gi dmar 'dzing brgyud de/ mthar ring tshad la spyi le gsum dang ldan pa'i chu 'gram gyi 'thab ra de 'dzin thub pa byung /dbyin ji'i dpung tshogs gnyis pa'ang dza drag gi 'thab 'dzing khrod gser thang (rsā༅7)dang chi'u no thang (677)/ ral gri'i thang (2nt+ra//7)sogs su rgyal kha'i ngang skam sar bskyod thub pa byung / tshes 6gi sa srod kyi tshun du mnyam 'brel dam ga hri shog bcu dang than khe/ me phyogs/ da dung nyer mkho'i mtshon cha sogs ma tsho 'gram du 'byor yod pa dang / kho tshos yo rab gling gi skam sa'i steng rang nyid kyi rkang 'dzugs sa'i rten gnas shig zin par gyur la/ gzhug mthud kyi dmag dpung mu mthud du 'byor bas mna' 'brel dmag gi stobs shugs 'jar man gyi gnas de'i srung dmag las lhag par gyur/282

mna' 'brel dmag gi btsan thabs kyis skam sar 'go ba'i 'thab mo legs grub byung ba de/ dgra bor rmongs tshom skye ru 'jug pa'i dmag thabs spyad de 'jar dmag la 'thab rtsal thad nor 'chug byung du bcug pa dang 'bral thabs med/ kho tshos dpung 'jug ma byas pa'i yar sngon du/ nyer mkho'i dngos zong dang g.yul gyi 'thab jus sogs thad gra sgrig gang legs byas pa las ga'an/ da dung g.yul nyams sna tshogs dang brda 'phrin rdzun ma sogs bzos te dgra bo rmongs su bcug 'jar dmag gi nub khul gyi dmag spyi chen mo dun si te tag tag kho tsho'i g.yo 'og tu tshud de/ mna' 'brel dmag dpung skam sar 'go sa ni dbyi ji li rgya mtsho'i 'gag phreng ha cang dog pa'i kha le (mebarnajo)sa khul yin par 'dod pas/ sa de ru dpung gi stobs shugs ches che ba spyad la sngar gyi hri shog bcu'i steng du slar yang hri shog lnga bsnan/ zla 3pa'i nang she thi ler gyis rang gi dmag dpon rnams la nor man dhe la mnyam 'jog bzang po bya dgos par bskul yang / 'jar dmag gi dpung khag chen po dag sngar bzhin se na chu bo'i (tshipo7)byang rgyud kyi a rmur (777)dang kun kho(mo〉 /)bar nas bsdad pa dang / dun si te sogs kyis thog mar snang 'jog byed sa'ang sngar ba'in kha le sa khul yin pa las nor man dhe ma yin/ yang cig na/ 'jar man gyi pha ri si mkha' dmag gnam gshes brtag dpyad khang gis zla 6pa'i tshes 4nyin bsgrags pa'i gnam gshis gnas tshul ltar na'ang / zla 6pa'i phyed stod du dbyin ji li mtsho 'gag gi gnam gshes ha cang sdug pa'i sngon dpag byas pas/ dmag dpon chos mna' 'brel dmag gis nyung ma thar yang zla phyed der skam sar 'go ba'i dpung 'jug byed mi srid par 'dod/ de bas nub khul gyi g.yul sar bkol 283

'doms byed mkhan 'jar dmag gi dmag dpon rom me'o 0zhes pa'ang zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin sems bde mo'i ngang phyir 'jar man du rang gi chung ma'i skyes skar la rten 'brel zhu ru song yod/mna' 'brel dmag dpung nor man dhe la 'byor ma thag 'jar dmag gi 'dzing rags dang gal che'i 'grim 'grul sa tshigs sogs gtor bas/ kho tsho'i dpung gi mjug ma rnams g.yul sar 'byor ma thub/ nyin drug gi rjes su mna' 'brel dmag gis skam sar 'go pa'i dpung khag so so'i snga mjug 'brel chags su bcug ste/ zheng la spyi le brgyad cu dang srid la spyi le bcu gsum nas bco brgyad yod pa zhig tu grub la/ dmag mi khri 32 6lhag dang /'gad rdzas sogs nyer mkho'i dngos po 'bor chen 'dzoms thub pa byung /zla 6pa'i tshes 6nas zla 7pa'i tshes 27bar gyi nyin lnga bcu ni mna' 'brel dmag gis phar rgol bya rgyur thag gcod rang bzhin gyi dge mtshan yod pa'i dus rim zhig yin pa dang / mi rnams kyis de la 6 nor man dhe chu 'gram brtson len gyi 'thab 'dzing ’ zhes bya/zla 7pa'i tshes 25nyin mna' 'brel dmag dpung gis phyogs yongs nas 'jar dmag la dpung 'jug byas pa dang / zla 8pa'i tshes 25nyin bar 'jar dmag khri nyi shu bsad la gson bzung byas pa'i dmag mi'ang khri nyi shu lhag la son/ de ltar/ she thi ler gyi nub rgyud kyi dpung tshogs nyams thor du song /yo rob gling gi g.yul sa gnyis pa'i yo lang phyes pa yis/ 'jar man gyi dmag dpung de su'u len dmar dmag dang a dbyin mna' 'brel dmag bcas kyis shar nub btsir rdung gi khrod lhung du bcug su'u len dang / a ri/ dbyin ji so sos shar lho nub gsum nas dus mtshungs su 'jar dmag la shā rom me'o/ stuX rku /lha po
mo rob mi dmang 'jar man phyob

the o man btson du'od skabs/spyi lo 1944lo 'i zla 9pa'i tshes — mig tsho14nyin/ 'jar ma na nā dzi rlung 'phrin lang gis zla 8pa'i tshes 28nyin ma na' 'brel ri dam ga gis we ma (rngolko13)grong 'dabs gas — —— — gtor gtong skabs/ pu hing lngar ti ( oṃ/ 〉〉 ri ra/sgroṣṭha 7 1)/ tsārsā ) btson ra yang sator bas / rsha kā na ci ri tsa sngar 'jar ma na rgyal/ tshogs kyi tshogs mi en ༷1 4 3) mi nga si tho the o ma na pyi/ sogs mi mi nyung ba cig 2 / zhe bsad pa dang / nga tsho'i don rkyen ngan pa/ lha / der yid skyo ba byung so nga ches pa'i 'phrin the yo mnagasar 'ig yang dang yang du bsgra gas/ma sa'i de ni she thi mer gyi sayo zol gyis bzos pa'i gsar 'gyur rdzun ma 'ig red/the o man bya ba'i mi de gleng ba la ci nas kyang lo bcu'i sngo na nas ma go rtsom dgos/de snga spyi 'o 1933lor nā dzi tang gi 'go ba she thi ler tsung li la bskos pa nas bzung / gung khran tang gi las khungs rnam sa la sngog bsher byas pa ma zad/ de la brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor bya ba'i khrom/ skor so gas gtan nas mi — 2rdoX.erte sitātāzloman sta nga ca 1/kyi 7/ma ma 1 6/carme yo/ ‘ 21ri smo

rung ba'i gsal brda btang ba red/ zla 2pa'i tshes 27nyin gyi nam gung gi 6 rgyal tshogs mer bsregs don rkyen de byung rjes/ mtshan mo de gcig pur 'jar man pa'i gung khran tang yo na dang yar thon mi sna khri gcig lhag btson 'jug byas pa dang / tang gi tshags pa ra dang dus deb sogs la'ang bkag rgya sbyar/ de lta bu'i nyams nyen gyi rnam pa dang she thi ler gyis gung khran tang la rtsol ba'i sbyo ra ngan sogs la dmigs te/ 'jar man gung khran tang krung dbyang u yo na tshogs pas per lin du gsang ba'i gros tshogs bsdus la/tshogs thog tu hpha shi sir sol ba'i zhum med dpa 'a thod dang tang gi kru'u 'i the o ma na gyis rgyal nang gi gnas tshul la dbye 'ib byas shing / ma/nga tshogs la skul slong byas te 'gog sol las 'gul sna tshogs bslangs nas she thi ler srid dbang rtsa med du gtong ba'i dmisas 'ben 'grub pa bya dgos pa'i bsam tshul bton/ zla 2pa'i tshes 27nyin gyi zhus khi sen bzo ba'i tshags par 〉steng bkod pa 'i the o ma na gyi gsal bsgrags yi ger/ bzo tshogs la hpha shi sir ngo rtsol byed pa dang hpha shi sir sol ba'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur 'dzusas pa'i 'bod skul btang /nā dzi tang gis mu mthud du gtum spyod sgos gung khran tang mi la 'jigs snang bskul pa red/ zla 2pa'i tshes 28nyin gyi phyi dro rlangs 'khor 'ig per lin gyi phe si mur sung lam na 'gul bskyod byed ba'in pa dang / re 'ig na sgo rtags ang nyer ba'i pa ste the o ma na gyi khang pa'i sgo khar bsdad byung / rlangs 'khor 'a sa nyen rtog pa 'ga' thang la babs pa dang / de las gnyis kyis the o man gyi sgo srung la/ gzhan rnams kyi lag tu ma da' thung thogs shing myur bar nang du mchongs/ skabs der khang pa na mi gcig kyang mi 'dug khang bdag mas bshad rgyur/ ngas 'grul ba de ma mthong bar nyin bcu ba'i 'gor zin zer ba na/ nyen rtos tshos gdong la pham mdangs shig shar te zlo/ mi

'gro ka med byung /'jar man gung khran tang chab srid cu'u yis tang gi dbu khrid dang gsar brje'i stobs shugs srung skyob bya ba'i phyir the o man phyi rgyal du mngags rgyu dang / kho la de ru phyi'i stobs shugs gcig sgril byed du bcug ste rgyal nang gi srid shugs dang mnyam 'brel sgos hpha shi si la ngo rgol bya rgyu'i gros thag bcad/ the o man phyi rgyal du bskyod pa'i dus ni zla 3pa'i tshes 5nyin la gtan khel byas kyang / stabs ma legs pa zhig la kho rang lam du ma chas pa'i nyin gnyis kyi sngon la nā dzi nyen rtog ru khag cig glo bur du kho'i bzhugs gnas gsar bar 'ong ste kho rang bzung / de ma thag e leg zan der thang chen gyi per lin nyen rtog khang du khrid de 'dri gcod byas rjes mo'o a bhe 'u(rsā༅6khu7)btson khang du bcugathe o man btson du bcug rjes khos khrims dang bstun te ches mtho ba'i 'ib dpyod 'go 'dzin la gtug yig bris nas rang nyid kyi gyod don la mngon sum du zhib dpyod gang myur bya bar zhus/ thog ma'i 'dri gcod kyi go rim nang the o man gyis rang la ma nyes khas g.yogs thebs pa la sgrub byed nus ldan bton ste nā dzi pham nyes btang / lo gnyis pa ste/ spyi lo 1934lo'i zla 1por kho rang gne si the po yi spyi'i las shag tu khrid pa dang/ de tshos kho'i kha nas skad cha len par brtson yang / khos kha gcig kyang ma grags pas gcar rdung drag pos kho'i kha nang gi so bzhi 'phangs pa ma zad/ da dung kho la bzi sman blud nas dran pa 'chor du bcug rjes kha nas skad cha dris kyang gsar brje'i snying stobs bla na med pa'i the o man gyi ngag las tshig zur tsam yang ma lon/gdug rtsub can gyi nā dzi bas yang bskyar dus tshod ba'i lhag gi ring kho'i ngo gdong dang spyi bo/ brang rgyab sogs la glang lcag gis brabs pas/ the o man gyi ༵༵ 8gi 'phar tshad je mgyogs dang 'u sa kyi zungs bcud zad par gyur te/

rim gyis kho'i mig dbang dang rna dbang yang nyam sa pa red/ de lta bu'i mnar gcod btang rjes khyi ro 'dud 'dud ngang thog khang gi sa 'og btson khang du bcug pho shi si'i jag pa rnams kyis thabs bkol ci 'dra bzos kyang the o ma na gyi ngag la sa rin thang can gyi tshig gcig kyang ma lon/the o man btson du bcug nas zla gcis 'gor ba'i rjes su/ tang krung dbyang gis mi mngags te kho'i skyam rngo ro sā(79)han po(tsho6)nas per lin du drangs pa dang / kho mo'i rosas ram la brten nas btson du yo da pa'i the o man dang 'brel gtugs byas/ kho chos tang gi 'phrin gsar dang chod don sna tshogs ro sā brgyud de the o ma na la bskur ba dang / ro sā phyir 'ong nas the o man la gdug rtsub kyi log khrims sbyar yo da pa'i gnas tshul tang la yar zhu byas pa na/ tang krung dbyang gis de ma thag tu mang tshogs dang rgyal spyi'i khrims lugs pa tshor gsang myul pa tsho'i gtum spyod kyi rnam pa bsgrags byung/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi gleng phyogs kyi gnon shugs la 'jigs te gsang rtog pa tshos the o man slar yang mo'o a bhe thu btson khang du mi skyel ka med byung /the o man gyis btson khang nas hpha shi si yis log 'dogs gtug bsher byas par rgol lan sprod ched 'bri deb bcu gnyis bris pa ma zad/ da dung shog ngos nyis brgya dang drug bcu can gyi khrims khang gi gtugs yig ces pa shog ngos re re bzhin gsang ba'i sgo nas bshus te/ bu mo kho la lta ru yong skabs gsang ste khyer nas tang rtsa 'dzugs la sprod du bcug de min khos da dung srid gzhung gis kho'i dag sel par gtan 'khel byas pa'i hpho ros si lo ju we se(lkotshoṣṭha aṣṭhatshoṣṭhazlo)yi bsam blo'ang rang phyogs su bsgyur/ lo lhu we se ni rmi gzhi nā dzi tang gi mi yin mod/ kho rang the o man la blo dkar bas rang nyid kyi thob thang la brten nas the o man gyi gsang 'phrin dang nā dzi pas 'dri rtog byas pa'i gnas tshul tshang ma 'jar man gung khran tang ༵ /da

pa'am yang na brda sbyar/ the o man gyi dag sel pa ga'an 'ig ni hpho ros ju ros se ra thu po hri yin pa dang / khos kyang nā dzi'i ham spyod de dag blos ma bzod pas/ khrim/sa khang gis the o man la khrims gcod bya ba'i gtugs yig gi ma phyi khyer te 'jar ma na dang ring du gyes/tang krung dbyang gis de ji btson 'phrog ru khag cig rtsa 'dzugs byas te the o man btson nas skyob rgyu'i gros byas pa dang / nam skyob kyi dus tshod dang gsang brda la sogs pa'ang gcig thog tu ba'ag ste the o man gyi rna rtsar bskyal na yang / sbyor ba ma bcom pa'i yar sngon du nang dul pa zhig gis 'char bkod phyi rdol byas pas/ srog skyob ru khag gi mi rnams bzung bar ma zad/the o man yang btson khang gzhan zhig tu bcug 'char ga'i de 'dod thog tu ma song ba'i rjes su/ kho chos yang bskyar hpha ran si'i pha ri si grong khyer du the o man dang da dung btson 'jug byas yod pa'i hpha shi si la rgol ba'i dmag mi rnams kyi srog skyob pa'i u yon khang 'ig 'dzugs rtsis byas pa dang / de la 'dzam gling gi sngon thon mi sna dag gis ngag skyor byas/ 'dri gcod las rogs pa chi ker po hri yis the o man la bshad rgyur/ ngo ma bzang gi da lta 'dzam gling gi khrims lugs pa mi sto nga lhag gis khyod la zhal lce gcod pa'i tshogs rar zhugs 'dod kyi re ba 'don gyin yod zer/the o ma na gyis btson khang du dgra bor 'thab rtsod bya ba'i zhor du rang gi btson grogs la thugs khur dang skul lcag btabs/ na gzhon grogs po zhig gi yig lan du khos yid ches brtan po'i ngang 'di ltar bris 'dug ste/ nga tshos yid la 'dzin dgos pa zhig ni/ 'tsho bas mi rnams 'thab rtsod kyi lam du bcug pa ste/ 'thab rtsod la kha lo bsgyur ba'i ched du la sa 'thab rtsod kyi mdun du mgo bo sgur rgyu'i ched ni rtsa ba nas ma red/ nga chos snying stobs cher bsditā sdus rang gi rlabs chen gyi bya ga'ag la 'bad dgos te/ khyod rang gis

blo brtan 'gyur med ngang 'bad brtson gyis rang na ma dun du lhags pa'i dala' sdug yod tshad sel thub na/ khyod dang nga'i re ba'agre gi dus rim de'ang nga tsho dang rgyang thag mi ring / de ma tshungs su khyod kyang spyi tshogs ring lu sas kyi rigs so so'i mi dam/ngas kyi ma/dza' brtse'i rgyun dang bsdongs te dka' sdug gi lo zla ring mo 'i ma nar gcod las thar nges yin zhes gda'/she thi ler nā dzis je man thu lo rmu la 'al lce gcod dus su khrel med kyi bzo lta gang ma nga bstan pa dang / de min the o man gyi dag sel pa rnams nā dzi 'jar man dang ring du gyes pa sogs kyi dbang gis/ nā dzi bas the o man la mi tshogs kyi mdun du 'dri gcod byed ma phod pa red/spyi lo 1944lo'i zla 8tshes 14nyin she thi ler dang tang srung dam ga gi ma go ba him ler gnyis kyis rgyal nang gi sasar brje'i stobs shugs kyi mgo ci ltar gnon par gros mol bya ba'i tshe na/ se nu re yis the o man ci lta ra thag gcod bya rgyu'i skor gleng ba la/ she thi ler gyis gdong la gdug rtsub kyi nyams dang bcas 6 bo rang shi la ma du bcug na 'grig zer/zla 8pa'i tshes 17gyi nam gung gi cha la gsang nyen pas the o man sa khe sin( ༅ma rsā)gyi po tshin(lkolha)btson khang nas rlangs 'khor 'ig la ba'ag ste we ma grong 'dabs kyi pu hin par ju 'dus sdod btson khang du bskyal /tag tag sngon de la btson khang gi dmag spyi ste/ tang srung dmag gi hrang 'a'o har man phe si thir la gsang nyen spyi khyab pu'u nas tang srung dmag gi yan lag ru khag a nga go dgu ba'i mi ma ngags te the o man gsod par bskul ba'i bka' babs pa red/tshes 18kyi nam gung gi dus tshod gcig dang skar ma bco lnga'i steng / lo bcu gcig dang zla lnga'i ring du btson la bcug pa'i 'jar man gung khron tang gi kru'u 'i the o man nyid pu hing war ti btson khang du dam ra gsod shāsnying /

khong gis 'jar ma na mi dam ngas kyi bde skyid dang gung khran ring lugs kyi rlabs chen bya ga'ag gi ched du rang sro ga blos btang ba red/the o man sko ga gsod byas pa de ni she thi ler nā dzi rgyal tshob phyi nang gi gleng phyogs la skrag nga dang / kho pa tsho'i phugs 'dun hpha shi si ring lugs la yid ches nyams pa'i ma/ngon rtags shig red/ nā dzi bas the o rme na bsad pa'i gnas tshul phyi la brdol te hpha shi ser rtsol ba'i ma tho rlabs la ngas par dogs nas/ the o man gyi srog 'gad rdzas kyis 'phrog song zhes pa'i gtam rdzun ma 'ig phyi la bsgrags te nyis khag gzhan la dkri ba'i sbyor ba bcoms/yin na yang / kho tshos rdzun gtam de phyi la bsgrags rjes/ 'jar man gung khran tang gis thabs sna tshogs spyad de kho tsho'i skos g.yo dang sbyo ra ngan gyi ma tshang phug brtol bas/ 'jar man rgyal nang dang 'dzam gling gi gleng phyogs yo ngas kyis gleng brjod chen po byas la/ mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis hpha shi si'i gtum spyod dang ngan rul gyi ngo bo gsal rjen du mthong ngo //292

nā gi 'jigs la babs pa/'dzam gling 'khrus chen gnyis pa'i ska bas / spyi lo 1945lo 'i dpyid la'i dus su 'jar ma na hpha shi si la ga'i nas 'o rgyus kyi nyes chad phog she thi ler gyis lo sngo na ma ra rgyal rngo ngas su gzhon 'o bco lnga nas chas 'o drug cu'i bar gyi mi rnam sa dam ga la 'jus pa'i 8 phyogs yo ngas skul slong bya ba'i thabs spyad rngo da/ 'on kyang des kho pa'i nyin ba'in nyam sa rgud du 'gro ba'i las skal de sa la bsgyu ra thub/shar rgyud kyi su'u len dmag dang nub rgyud kyi nub phyogs ma na' 'brel dmag khag gnyis dus mtshungs su ma dun du bcar bas/ 'jar man gyi yo rob gling gi mna' 'brel rgyal khab dang bran 'khor rgyal khab dag pham par byas pa ma zad/ 'grim 'grul dang bzo la sa khul la 'gas mdel drag tu 'phangs pas 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor phyogs yongs nas rgud par gyur/1945lo'i zla 3par spyi bsdoms byas pa ltar na/ sol ba'i zla re'i thon tshad lo gong ma las cha snyoms byas na 16cha dang bar lcags 157 ma ra bri yod/mkha' dam ga la zla rer 'bar rdzas tun khri 12dgos mo da/ zla rer tun khri 1las thon skyed byed thub kyin med pa dang / rlangs 'khor dang than khe la zla rer snum rdzas kun khri 18dgos kyang / don dngos thos tun khri 4nas 6tsam la sa ma kho sprod byed kyin med/ de bas 'jar man pa'i gnam gru dang than khe rlangs 'khor gang ma nga zhig gi bkol spyo da kyi nus pa 'an pa ra gyur pa la dmag chas ma kho sprod dang 'thab 'dzing thon skyed pu'u yi pu'u krang si phe19 /lo

khri/lo)gyis / zla 3pa'i tshes 18nyin she thi ler la sprad pa 'i zin thor ha cang thabs zang pa'i ngang rusaza' 'khor ba'i nas brgyad kyi nang la 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor yo ngas su nyam sa dam sa su 'gro rgyu ni dpog sla ba 'is red/ dpal 'byor yo ngas su nyams pa na 'thab 'khrug gi rgyun yang skyong thabs bral ’ zhes bris yo da/she thi ler gyis de bklags rjes lag zung 'dar 'ing mig gnyis cer nas sar lhung la khad byas/ khos 'jar man rgyal khab mi 'gyangs par 'thor zhig tu 'gyur rgyu yin pa gsal bor shes mod/ su'u len dang a ri/ dbyin ji so gas kyi mna' 'brel dmag gis 'jar man gyi bzo gter khe las dang lcags lam 'grim 'grul sogs sgrig chas yod tshad dbang du bsdu bar kho mi 'thad pa ma zad/ 'jar man mi dmangs la bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol bar 'jug mi 'dod pas/ zla 3pa'i tshes 19nyin kho rang dbang khams 'khrugs pa'i smyon pa ji bzhin 6 bzo grwa dang glog shugs sgrig chas/ rang 'bab chu 'dren bzo grwa/ sol rlangs bzo grwa/ zas sbyor bzo grwa/ gyon chas tshong khang /lcags la ma dang zam pa/ 'grim 'grul sgrig chas bcas yod tshad dang / chu la ma dang gru dang me 'khor yod tshad/ zong 'dren rlangs 'khor yo da tshad med par gyis shis ces skad cor chen po brgyab mo da/ mna' 'brel dam ga myur du thon pa dang si pher sogs kyis dmag 'khrug de'i rjes kyi 'jar man gyi 'tsho gnas gnad don la bsam pa'i rkyen gyis kho'i bka' la ga bstar ma byas pas/da gzod 'jar ma na rtsa med du 'gro ba'i nyen kha las thar tsam byung /1945lo'i zla 3par/ su'u len gyi dam ga per lin dang bar thag spyi le 60nas 70 yod pa'i o dhi chu bo dunas nee si chu bo'i(7lo/tswa)rgyud du 'byor/—/nā rte(tābo sang sa tsho lcam

kho tshor spyi'i dam ga shugs khri 250yan dang / gnam gru 7500 skyogs mdel 41600 than khe dang shugs ldan me skyogs 6250yod/ su'u len dmag gi 'gan khur ni per lin nye 'khor gyi 'jar dmag yod tshad rtsa med du gtong ba dang hpha shi si ga'i ma la per lin blangs nas 'jar man la cha rkyen med pa'i sgo nas mgo 'dogs su 'jug rgyu de red/ de dang mnyam du/ nub phyogs mna' 'brel dmag gi khrod/ a me ri ga'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs ang dang po/gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bdun pa/ dgu ba bcas dang / dbyin ji'i dpung tshogs ang gnyis pa/ hpha ran si'i dpung tshogs ang dang po/ khe na ṭa'i dpung tshogs ang dang po bcas e sin ho ber gyi gcig gyur gyis bkod 'doms 'og sngon gyi 'char ga'i ltar nub nas shar la bskyod/ zla 3pa'i tshes 25nyin/ a ri dang dbyin ji'i dmag gis ri nyen 0 chu bo'i nub 'gram bstang ba ma zad/ sa cha gnyis nas chu la brgal te zam mgor btsan rdzong bdugalha/ thi ler gyis tshe mjug gi nyin mor slebs zin pa shes mod/ kho dang kho'i rjes 'brang pas da dung mtha' mjug gi skar cha gcig po de la'ang bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung ste kho tsho thar rgyu'i re ba bcangs yod/zla 4pa'i zla stod kyi dgong mo 'ig la/ 'jar man gyi dril bsgrags pu'u yi pu'u krang ki phel rjo gyis him ler gyi chod lta'i khang nas dpyad skar ris dbyibs shig she thi ler gyi las shag tu khyer yong nas mo ltas la dpyad pa na/mo yig tu/ 8 zla 4pa'i zla mgor gyong gud tshabs che la/ zla mjug tu gnas skabs kyi rgyal kha zhig thob rjes/ rgyun 'khyongs kyi dus nges can 'ig 'byung la/ ge ཿ trīḥtā / rtedhertumi600khyi / 238nya ci 295

zla 8pa'i nang da gzod 'i 'jags yo nga ’ zhes babs 'dug gtum spyod can gyi hpha shi si yi jag pa rnams rtsa med du 'gyur la nye dus 'u thug nas dpyad skar ris dbyibs la mi brten thabs med byung / de ni kho tsho'i nus med kyi mngon rtags shig kyang red/dpyad skar ri mor skyabs bcol mkhan gyi she thi ler dang ska phel gnyis nas mo yig des kho tsho'i dmag dpung la bsru brid byed rtsis byas/ zla 4pa'i tshes 6nyin ki phel gyis pham kha myangs pa'i dmag mi rnams la yid ches dka' ba'i 'bod brda btang ba la/ 6 nga tsho'i gtso bdag gis ma 'ongs pa'i don mkhyen te/ khong ni las dbang gis nga tsho la thob pa yin/ nga tshos mi 'gyangs par ltas legs po dngos su mthong nges red zer/'gyur ldog byung zin mod/ yin na yang de ni kho tshos re ba'i 'gyur ldo ga de ma yin te/ zla 4pa'i tshes 16gi nangs mor/ su'u len dmag gis 'jar man gyi per lin dmag la phyogs yongs nas rgol 'go bcoms/zla 4pa'i tshes 20nyin ni she thi ler lo nga drug la son pa'i skyes skar red/spyir yin na kho'i skyes skar gyi mdzad sgo de tshes 19yi dgong mo nas 20bar yin la/ rten 'brel zhu mkhan rgyun mi 'chad mod/ thengs 'dir sngon dang mi 'dra bar ha cang snying 'jags shig red/ tshes 19yi nam gung / tsung li'i sgar gyi 'og khang gi khang mig chung chung 'ig tu mi bdun 'dus te she thi ler gyi skyes skar la rten 'brel zhus/ rten 'brel zhus tshar rjes she thi ler la ches blo dkar ba'i nang blon him ler dang ko ren gnyis kha rog ger bros song /gcan gzan zhig dang 'dra ba'i she thi ler gyis kho'i skyes skar gyi phyi nyin te/ zla 4pa'i tshes 21nyin/ hri than yen na (lkom༅7)la per lin lho phyogs kyi su'u len dmag la rgol lan slog dgos pa'i bka' bsgos pa ma zad/gdī /6 g.yul la zhugs mi 'dod pa'i dmag spyi yod na dus tshod lnga'i nang srog

chad gcod rgyur bsgrags/ kho da dung blo ma bde bar per lin byang phyogs kyi dmag gis lho phyogs kyi hri than yen na'i dmag la rogs skyor byas nas rgol lan slog rgyu byas mod/ mtha' mjug don de gtan nas ma 'grub ste/ hri than yon na yang gar bros ma rnyed pa'i khar/ per lin byang phyogs kyi 'jar dmag gis lho phyogs la rgol lan slog rogs byas pas/ byang phyogs kyi dmag shugs kyang nyams nas su'u len dmag gi than khe per lin grong khyer du thon/gnas tshul tshabs chen 'di dag khos dang thog shes med la/ gnas tshul de dag shes pa na kho khong khro chen po langs nas 6 tshang mas nga la mgo bskor btang song / nga la don dngos kyi gnas tshul bshad mkhan gcig kyang ma byung / nga'i dmag gis nga la mgo bskor btang song ’ zhes skad cor chen po brgyab/ kho khang pa'i nang nas phar 'gro tshur 'ong zhig byas rjes yang bskyar 6 mi tshang mas nga la rgyab 'gal byas/ khyod tsho su 'gro 'dod na song chog nga sbyar lin nas bsdad de btsan rgyal gsum pa'i rgyal sa srung rgyu yin ’ zhes skad ra ba/ zlod/ kyi dus su/ su'u len dmag gis me phyogs she thi ler gyi yib gnas te tsung li'i sgar gyi nye 'dabs su rdeg 'go bcoms/zla 4pa'i tshes 23nyin/ nā dzi ba ko ren gyis mu nyi chi yi sa si rdzong du she thi ler per lin dang kha 'bral mi 'dod pa shes rjes/ 6 rgyud 'dzin gyi dus sdibs song snyam nas brel 'tshub ngang she thi ler la glog 'phrin 'di btang pa da/ 6 bdag gi gtso bdagakhyod rang per lin dang mi 'bral bar bltas na/ khyod kyis 1941lo'i 297

zla 6pa'i tshes 29nyin gnangs pa'i bka'adultar du/ bdag gis myur du btsan rgyal gyi 'go khrid dbang cha yongs su bzung nas khyed kyi tshab byas te rang dbang gis dbang bsgyur ba khyed rang 'thad pa e yin/ gal te do dgung gi dus tshod 10lon tshe da dung khyed kyi lan ma 'byor na/ bdag gis bka' de dang len byed pa'i cha rkyen 'dzoms par bsams nges pa ma zad/ khyed kyi bka' lag tu bstar ba'i cha rkyen 'dzoms par brtsi nges yin/ bdag gis rgyal khyab dang mi dmangs kyi ches che ba'i khe phan gyi ched du hur thas byed nges yin/ nga'i mi tshe'i khrod ches gal che ba'i dus su khyod la bcangs pa'i brtse dung de skad cha'i lam nas cis kyang ston thabs bral khyod la blo dkar ba'i hir man ko ren/ ’ko ren gyi glog 'phrin de tsung li'i pho brang gi sa 'og ma del g.yo la khang du 'byor ba na/ thog mar kho dang dgra zlar gyur pa'i nā dzi'i tang gi 'go ba po men(rnya'istso'i)gyi lag tu son/ po men gyis glog 'phrin de she thi ler la byin nas zur du ko ren gyi nyes skyon ma nga po bgrangs/ po men gyi ngan skul 'og she thi ler gyis glog 'phrin las ko ren la khyod kyis 8 rgyal khab dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa bsags pas srog don dums gcod dgos 'os kyang / khyod kyis yun ring por tang dang rgyal khab kyi 'bad pa byas yod pas/ gal te la sa 'asan yod tshad phyir 'bul zhus na tshe la bar chad ma btang chog de bas ko ren gyis las 'gan phyir 'bul zhu min gyi lan du glog 'phrin 'ig myur mor gtong dgos zhes bka' phab/ yin na'ang po men she thi ler gyi bka' la yid de 'dra tshim po med pas lkog tu glog 'phrin bzo bcos byas te/ ko ren yo da sa'i tang srung ru khag spyi khyab khang la/ rgyal khab dang 'gal ba'i nyes skyon gyi nyama~X rdo py-i sdo/ ṅgi 〉〉 〉〉 rnyi kta ldu rdo kto sdi tā tā ñdza kta rsha nā nā nā tānā /dū /dzin pa dang kho'i srid 'dzin gyi nus pa

ko ren dang kho'i lag 'khor 'dzin bzung byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ nyin gnyis par skad grags che ba'i ko ren te/ btsan rgyal gsum di 'i dam ga spyi chen rngo dang ma kha' dmag gi dmag spyi de tang srung dmag gi btson rme ra gyur/nyin der she thi ler la blo dkar mkhan ga'an 'is ste him ler gyis kho la gros ma byas par lkog tu pol te'i mtsho 'gram du yo da pa'i lo bho khi ((pa 441/)yi si we ḍan don gcod khang du song ste/ la sa 'dzin bho na to thi ( 4(/48phro(ṅgersha)dang ma jal 'phrad byas te 'jar ma na nub phyogs par ma go 'dogs rgyur mo/sa tshul bstan la/ him ler gyis kyang lkog tu she thi ler gyi dbang cha rgyun 'dzin byed rgyu'i sbyo ra ba rtsom/ de das tham sa cad kyis she thi ler dbang smu ra tshosas khas nang rol tu 'gal bas gang cing 'thor 'ig tu 'gro ba'i gnas su bslebs zin pa ma tshon thub/ tshul de ma thong nas she thi ler gyis 6 da ni tshar song / nga'i yod tshad tshar so nga ’ zhes re chad kyi sdug skad bton no//zla 4pa'i tshes 25nyin/ su'u len dam ga gis per len grong khyer gyi ma tha' bslo ra rgyu'i 'thab jus de yo ngas 'grub byas/ nyin de'i phyi dro dus tshod 4dang skar ma 40steng / su'u len dam ga dang a ri'i dam ga shugs per lin lho nub kyi spyi le 50ma tsham sa kyi yil pe chu bo'i ① nub 'gram gyi ther go (chang/dzā/) sa char ma nyam 'dzom sa byung bas/ 'jar man gyi mnga' khungs dang g.yul sa yongs lho byang dum bu sanyis su phye ba dang / 'jar man dam ga gis pe ra lin la rogs skyor gyi bgrod lam yongs su bcad/ de nas bzung lo rgyus kyi don snying lda na pa'i 88per len g.yu la 'thab ma go bcom sa pa red/ she thi ler gyis lha sa 'u sa kyi dam ga 'a ma tha' gcig tu per lin srung dgos pa'i batha' babs byung bas/ sra nga 'thab shin tu dza dras che ba byas/ yin yang pyi/ — khrol nge chu ngo / khyi 6 7pa'i 1 299

per lin ni grong khyer kher rkyang du gyur 'ing / 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu bgyi ba'i she thi ler la skabs der rgyab dpung dang rogs dam ga gang yang med pas thar sa ci la yod/zla 4pa'i tshes 27nyin/ su'u len dmag grong khyer gyi lte bar bslebs te thad gar 'jar man gyi rgyal tshogs khang chen la bcar/ nyin der tsung li'i pho brang gi sa 'og mdel g.yol khang du yib pa'i she thi ler gyis da ni rang nyid kyi mtha' ma'i nyi mar bslebs pa pas/ rang gi gzhung las khang gi cog tse'i zur du langs te 'khor g.yog hin tshi lin gi(76khrig〈yi rnyesatsharme)la stobs med shugs zad kyis bshad rgyur/ 6 ngas khyod la don zhig bcol khyod rang song ste bal phyar gnyis dang / da dung bem ro gnyis bsreg nus pa'i rlangs snum gra sgrig byas te nged kyi mal sar zhogs/ nga dang e wa por en (32yi'i lha/hom 76)(she thi ler gyi dga' rogs) gnyis gnas 'dir rang sro ga gcod rgyu yin/ nged gnyis shi rjes/ khyed kyis bem po bal gdan la bsdams te ldum ra gong ma'i nang mer bsreg dgos zhes bshad/lin ki song rjes/ she thi ler dang e wa gnyis kyis ru 'chi kha'i gnyen ston ’ gyi cho ga spel te bzhad gad bslangs / zla 4pa'i tshes 29nyin gyi mtshan phyed nas tshes 30nyin gyi zhigs pa'i bar/ per lin gyi spyi gros pa wa ki li(ca'ilkolhatho7)tsung li'i gzim shag tu bos te she thi ler la 'chi kha'i gnyen sto na spel du bcug she thi ler gyi ngan grogs bi phel dang po men gnyis khong nyid kyi gnyen dpang byas/gnyen bsgrigs nas dus tshod 'ga' 'gor rjes su/ su'u len dmag gis 'jar man pa'i dbang shugs kyi lte ba ma tshon pa'i rgyal tshogs khang chen dbang du bzung / mig sngar lhag yo da pa ni 'jar man srid gzhung gi gnas sa~Xng li'i pho brang gcig pu red/ da cha de ru yod pa'ang 'gad rdzas kyis

gtor ba'i rdo ka ma ru'i chag ro kho na'o// khang tshan mang po'i gnam gcal gyi glog sgron rnams bcag ste lcags kyi dra ba tsam 'phyang zhing / gzhung las khang gi dpe sgom sogs g.yas 'gyel g.yon rdib tu gyur yo da pas dngos gnas 'jig bskal mngon sum du bslebs pa ltar du 'duga'adzam gling mi dmangs kyi nyes chad la byol ched/ she thi ler gyis zla 4pa'i tshes 30nyin gyi phyi dro'i dus tshod gsum yas ma sa su rang gi mal sar e wa dang mnyam du rang srog bcad/ kho gnyis kyi bem po 'khor g.yog lin ki yis mer bsregs/ mi gsod par ya mi nga 'ing gtum spyod gdug rtsub che ba'i hpha shi si yi mgo gtso mi tshe gang bo 'di ltar mjug rdzogs song /she thi ler 'chi khar kho'i rgyud 'dzin pa 'dems rgyu da dung brjed med/kho'i 6 chab srid kha chems su mtsho dmag gi dam ga spyi chen ne tshi(7khyakhucho )'jar man gyi tsung thung dang drag chas dmag dpung gi ches ma tho ba'i mgo ba/ki phel tsung li/ po men tang srid tsu'u krang du bdam sa rno da/ ki phel yang rang gi nag nyes la ngo gnongs nas zla 5pa'i tshes 1nyin rang srog bcad/zla 5pa'i tshes 1nyin/ 'jar man dmag gi 'thus tshab kyis su'u len la dmag mtshams pa'i re ba zhus mo da/ su'u len phyogs nas re ba de dang len ma byas par ma zad/ 'jan man cha rkyen med pa ra ma go 'dogs pa thabs gzhan med pa gsal bor bshad/ zla 5pa'i tshes 2nyin/ 'jar dmag gis rgol lan slog mtshams bzhag zla 5pa'i tshes 8nyin gyi dus tshod 24steng /'jar man gyis cha rkyen med par ma go 'dogs pa'i mdzad sgo per lin du 'tshogs pa ma zad/ 'jar man pas mgo 'dogs yi ge'i steng ming rtags bkod/ 'dis o rob g.yul sa'i hpha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing rgyal kha'i ngang mjug rdzogs pa mtshon no//301

'jar pan gyis lab gling med par mgo btegs pa/wa 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa zhon 'jags su song /spyi lo 1945lo'i zla 7pa'i zla smad nas zla 8pa'i zla stod bar/ she ro rju ma(/46)yi mkha' dbyings de 'jar pan gyi grong khyer ga'an dag dang 'dra bar/ nyin ma tshan med par nam mkha' las shog lho 'bum ther du ma sa la babs pa red/ de ni mna' 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis gnam gru las bkram pa'i yig cha ste/ nang don ni a ri dang dbyin ji/ krung go bcas rgyal khab gsum gyi dbu khrid pas zla 7pa'i tshes 26nyin bsgrags pa'i 'jar pan srid gzhung la mgo 'dogs par skul ba'i 〈〈pho tshi tam duspyi bsgrags 〉〉bya ba de red/ yig cha la lar 'jar pan hpha shi si yis gal nyi mgo 'dogs mi byed na de yi grong khyer 'ga' rdul du brlag rgyu yin pa'i 'jigs skul gyi gtam bris 'dug〈〈pho tshi tam spyi bsgrags 〉〉khyab bsgrags byas rjes 'jar pan pas mgo 'dogs rgyu phar zhog da dung zla 7pa'i tshes 28nyin 'jar pan dbu bzhugs blon chen si dzu khe/〉〉thong)yis srid gzhung gis yig cha'i nang don la do snang byed mi chog par/ mu mthud du g.yul gyi rgyal pham rtsod dgos pa'i gtam bshad gnang / de ma zad zla 7pa'i tshes 30nyin gyi 'jar pan 〈〈lho gzhon gsar 'gyur 〉〉steng 6'jar pan gyis gzhan la mgo 'dogs bya bar re ba ni stong sems kho na yin la/ gal te dgra bos g.yul mtshams 'jog par 'dod tshe 'jar pan la mgo 'dogs gyis dang zhes pa'i rtsom yang spel yod//wa(3 phamatam stuXm la chos 302

a ri'i tsung thung ro se wel gyis 'jar pan gyi rnam 'gyur mthong rjes de la rdul phran mtshon cha 'phen rgyu thag gis bcad/ yin na'ang 'thab 'khrug la rdul phran mtshon cha spyad rung min thad a ri'i rgyal nang du rtsod ga'i ha cang che ba red/ thog mar rdul phran mtshon cha bzo mkhan gyi tshan rig pa tshos de la rtsa ba nas ngo rgol byed pa dang / kho tsho'i bsam tshul ni/ de snga 'jar man hpha shi si la'ang rdul mtshon spyad med pas phyis su she thi ler gyis kyang rdul mtshon bzo thub med pa ma zad/ da lta rgyal srid la nyam chag byung yod pa dang / 'jar pan pas kyang rdul phran mtshon cha bzo thub rgyu mi srid pas/ kho tshor rdul phran mtshon cha ma spyad kyang cham la phab thub nges yin/ yang cig na/ rdul phran mtshon cha la srog gcod kyi nus pa shin tu chen po lda na rkyen/ ma 'ongs par shes rig gi dpal yon rgyas pa 'a gegs su 'gyur nges pa de red/ 'on kyang srid gzhung gi 'dod pa ni/ rdul phran ma tshon cha la drag shugs cher mnga' bas 'jar pan myur mor cham la dbab nus pa dang / de yi zil shugs la brten nas su'u len dang krung go'i snyan pa'ang chung ngur bzo thub pas cis kyang spyod dgos pa de red/ skabs der 'jar pan srid gzhung gis mgo 'dogs ma byas pa ni/ a ri'i srid gzhung gis rdul phran mtshon cha spyod pa'i kha g.yor sa lta bur gyur song /zla 8pa'i she ro rju ma sa khul ni tsha ba ha cang che/ tshes 6gi zhogs par sa de ga'i gzhis sdod mang tshogs khri bcu phrag 'ga' bo snga mo nas langs te sngar dang 'dra bar nyin gcig gi dam ga 'khrug gi 'tsho ba'i mgo brtsams/ chu tshod bdun dang skar ma dgu'i steng rna la gzan pa'i 'jab rgol gyi nyen brda grong khyer gyi mkha' dbyings su bsgrags/ mang tshogs la mtshon na de ni ha cang rgyun ldan du gyur yod de/ phal cher nyin rer thengs shig dang / mtshams la lar thengs 'gar gtong ba'i gnas tshul yang yod pas so// nyen brda btashā sna'i

rjes su a ri'i gnam gru 'ga' she ro rju ma grong gi mkha' la lding bskor 'ga' brgyab te phyir 'phur song / chu tshod brgyad pa'i steng yang bskyar a ri'i gnam gru 2wa 29gsum grong khyer gyi mkha' la rgyu ba dang / skabs der 'obs dong la ma 'dzul ba'i mi mang po 'ig gis ma go bo btegs nas ltad mor bltas/ kho tshor mtshon na de lta bu'i rnam pa rgyun du mthong bas ya mtshar rgyu ci yang mi 'dug kyang / thengs 'di ni snga ma dag dang mi 'dra ste/ gnam gru snga ma dag ni rtog 'ib pa yin la / 'di gsum las e no ra ke(777 7)zhes pa'i gnam gru la tun 5can gyi rdul phran ma tshon cha zhig bcus yod do//chu tshod 9dang skar ma 14skar cha 17gyi steng e no ra ke yis tshod dpag byas pa'i dmigs 'ben te/ she ro rju ma grong gi zam chen 'ig la gtad pa dang / kha lo ba hra'o 'a'o tho ma se trel sgye yis glog sgo phye ba tsam gyis 'gad rdzas sgam gyi kha rang 'gul du phyes pa dang / skar cha 60yi rjes su gnam gru'i steng gi rdul phran mtshon cha gcig pu thur du 'phangs pa red/ 'gad rdzas gtor sa'i gnas dang thag bkyed pa'i ched du/ kha lo bas sngar gyi bkod sgrig ltar tu'u 155dkyogs te gnam gru'i kha lo bsgyur ba dang / gnam gru glo bur du smi 300yi mtshams la smad de she ro rju ma 'i sa mtha' la 'phur/ gnam gru'i kha lo ba lnga bos gnam gru'i dra ma las 'gad rdzas gtor sa'i phyogs su cer 'dug skar cha zhe lnga 'gor ba na 'gad rdzas de she ro rju ma dang smi 600mtsham sa kyi mkha' dbyings su gas pa red/ kun gyi rnar gzan pa'i stong sgra dang mnyam du mig gis lta mi bzod pa'i 'od dkar po 'ig 'khyug pa des/'ogs pa'i nyi gzhon gyi snang ba'ang skad cig tu zil gyis mnan/ drag tu 'khyug pa'i 'od dkar po des mi khri stong mang po'i mig gi dbang bo nyam sa par byas pa red/ rdul phran mtshon cha gas pa'i drod grangs tu'u dung phyur bcu la bzhi~X pas/ sa de ga'i snod kyi bkod pa rnams thal bar brlags shing /

bgrang gis mi lang ba'i sem sa can dag lnga lam du brdzangs byung / dug ma da' phogs pa'i mi mang po 'ig phyis kyi lo bcu kha'i nang rim gyis srog nyam sa pa dang / yul de dang spyi le 16gi nang khul gyi mi rnams la tshad 'dra rngi na gyi gnod skyon phogs te dbang po skyon can du gyur ba red/rtog 'ib byas pa'i 'dra par las mthong tshod du/ thengs de'i dpung 'jug gis she ro rju ma'i sa rgya'i 60cha'ajig par byas pa dang / rdul phran ma tshon cha gas sa'i nye 'khor gyi mi phal chen gyi sros 'phrog pa red/ skabs der she ro rju ma yi 'tsho sdod mi grangs khri 34lhag la son pa dang / de las mi grangs khri 7 8tshe 'das byung / rmas skyon phog mkhan dang gar song bi cha ma 'tshal ba mi khri 5 1lhag la son pa dang / grong khyer spyi la yo da pa'i bzo bkod kyi grangs khri 7 6las khri 4 8shul med du brlags shing de las khri 2 2la tshad 'dra min gyi chag skyon bzos pa red/thengs 'di'i chag 'jig tshabs che yang 'jar pan gyis pho tshi tam spyi bsgrags kyi dgongs don dang len byed du 'jug ma nas/ srid gzhung gis don dngos rnams sbed gsang byed ci thub byas/ 'on kyang rgyal nang du mgo 'dogs pa'i thad rtsod pa sna tshogs byung zhing / la las su'u len gyis gzu byed par re ba bcangs/ yin na'ang / su'u lin gyis zla 7pa'i tshes 18nyin nas 'jar pan srid gzhung la gzu mi byed pa'i gsal brda btang zin pa ma zad/ su'u len srid gzhung gis da dung su'u len gyi 'jar pan gzhung tshab pa la zla 8pa'i tshes minas bzung 'jar pa na la dpung 'jug bya rgyu yin pa'i gtam bsgrags pa red/su'u len g.yul du zhugs tshe 'jar pan la gnod pa ha cang che rkyen/tshes 9nyin gyi snga dro'i chu tshod 10dang phyed kwa'i steng 'jar pan srid gzhung gis pho tshi tam gyi dgongs don dang len byed min gyi gros mol tshogs 'du rgya~X sbya'i

pho brang du bsdus/ gros rngo la gyi sang la a ri dam sa gis 'jar nga/na gyi na nga sa le( khri 6ni/ )grong khyer du rdul phran mtshon cha gnyis pa 'phangs pa dang / grong khyer der me yi ma tsho rngo 'khyil ba ji ba'in ya nga bskya ra sems can grangs med pa 'ig gson bsres byas song /snga phyi thengs gnyis kyi rdul phran mtshon cha gyi zil shugs dang / su'u len sa ru la du zhugs nga ra brten 'jar pan gyidabang sgyur gral rim nang khul du 'khrug rtsod byung ba dang / zla 8pa'i tshes 14nyin 〈〈pho tshi tam spyi bsgra sas 〉〉kyi dgongs don dang len bya rgyu thag gis bcad/ dgong mo de'i chu tshod 11steng gnam bskos gong ma sa 〈〈g.yul gcod pa'i bka' yig 〉〉khyab bsgrags byas pa ma zad/ tshes bco lnga 'i dros kha sku dngos nas lab gleng med par mgo 'dogs rgyu'i gtam bshad rgyang bsgrags las bsgrags/zla 9pa'i tshes 2nyin tho khe'o (70)mtsho 'gag tu bsdad pa'i a ri'i 'thab gru 8 mu so re mi yi steng du 'jar pan gyis cha rkyen med par mgo 'dogs bya rgyu'i mdzad sgo bsdus pa dang / mgo 'dogs yi ge'i steng thog mar yi ge phab mkhan ni 'jar pan gyi phyi 'brel blon chen khron geng khe/1176tsajo)dang dmag spyi me cin me kri lang(skesgro'okhrizezhu/mijikhu)gnyis yin/ de rjes su mna' 'brel rgyal khab dag gi 'thus tshab spyi ba dmag dpon me khi a si( zledzarteco(1rwa1)dang / rim bzhin a ri dang dbyin ji/ krung go su'u len/ o si sto ri ya/ khe na ṭa/ hpha ran si/ ho lan ḍi/ ni'u dzi lan ḍi sogs rgyal khab dgu'i 'thus mis ming rtags bkod pa red de nas bzung lo ngo drug lhag rgyun bsrings pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa de hpha shi si 'jar man dang dbyi tha li/ 'jar pan gsum rtsa ba nas pham par byas shing /'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi hpha shi sir sol ba'i 'thab rtsod la rlabs che ba'i rgyal kha rdo36 ste mjug bsdus so//
