rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa the gor/dpyid kyi sbrang char sam sem du babs byung /chu shing gi 'dab mar babs te dal gyis g.yo ba'i steng /bgrang las 'das pa'i mu tig gi rdog pa 'od du 'tsher ba ba'in/mtshe'u rdzing du babs te 'jing ngogs kyi ngur mo dga' bas rtsed pa dgagos dkar lha mo re re khrus su rol dang mtshungs/g.yu lo'i ljon par babs te thigs phreng shar shar 'dzar ba ni/sma ra khur du lci ba'i bgres po krong nger 'gyings pa 'dra/kye kye/ yid 'ong gi lha mo lags/ khyed gang tshig nas phebs lags sam/kye kye/ smra ra ring ba'i bgres po lags/ khyed kyis yang snying ci 'ig la 'gyod bshags byed/snyan tshig 'di ni rang lo drug la son pa'i byis pa zhig gis/ me tog skyed tshal gyi mdzes pa'i dpal yon mthong ba las bris pa'i snyan ngag cig red/khong ni phyis su rgya gar dang 'dzam gling mi dmangs yongs kyis dga' gus tshad med byed pa'i snyan ngag pa chen po ro snyen lhu ra na thi ba gor ༷te/ mi rnams kyis gaṅgā'i 'gram gyi 66zla ba gzhon nur mi bsngags pa de red/the gor ni ka li ka ta grong gi rang dbang gi bsam blo shugs chen ldan pa'i phyug po 'ig gi khyim du skyes/ khong chung dus nas rig pa sod la rtog sgo yangs shing gsar gtod kyi nus pa dang ldan pa 'ig yin 'ing / rtsom rig la —/sdusnodango tespyo dar tsho the gor/ 5lo mas la 61860707 (77 pos cha༅1sku 1861—1941

dga' zhen shin tu che ba 'ig yin/ lo bcu gcig gi steng a phas mes rgyal gyi ri chu sogs rang byung khams chen po'i ltad mo ston ched/ kho rang hi ma la ya'i lho rgyud du ljongs rgyu ru khrid pa dang / de yi tshang tshing stug po'i nags klung dang lhung lhung 'bab pa'i rbab chu/ me tog sna brgya'i lding khang / dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu rgyun sogs kyis khong gi sems kyi dang ba dbang med du 'phrogaljongs rgyu thengs shig gis kho'i bsam pa'i 'char sgo dang snyan ngag pa'i blo spobs sogs la gnam sa'i 'gyur ldo ga byung ba red/ phyir log rjes su khong gis rgya gar gyi byung brjod snyan ngag 〈rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud nyidang / gnam dpyad dang sa khams/ lo rgyus sogs kyi dpe cha mi nyung ba 'ig la bltas pas/yo na tan gyi rmang brtan po 'ig tshugs par gyur/1877lor the gor gyi phu bo tshos 〈lha ra ta 〉zhes pa'i dus deb cig bsgrigs pa dang / lo bcu drug la bud ma thag pa'i khong rang dus deb de'i rtsom sgrig par gyur pa ma zad/ 'don thengs dang po'i steng rang gi snyan rtsom 〈snyan ngag pa'i gtam rgyud 〉ces pa dang dpyad brjod kyi rtsom yig cig kyang spel ba red/ phyis su/ deb de'i steng sgrung rtsom yang spel myong / lo phyi mar/khong gis spobs pa cher skyed kyis dus deb sgrig ba'in pa'i skabs su/ a pha dang phu bo gnyis kyis kho rang dbyin ji ru slob sbyong du mngags rgyu thag gis bcad/a phas kho rang dbyin jir mngags te khrims lugs la slob gnyer bya ba dang / phyir log rjes phu bo dang 'dra bar las rigs ha cang brtan pa'i khrims dpon gyi las ka 'ig 'tshol du 'jug par bsam yang / snyan ngag mkhan gyi gshes ka dang lda na pa'i khong khrim sa lusas la gtan nas dga' bo ma byung / khong gis dbyin ji ru dbyin ji'i rtsom rig dang nub phyogs kyi rol mo la slob sbyong byas pa dang / slob sbyong gi zhor du khom 'o nga re byung tshe rdo 0byi spyi

rdogs kyi gnas tshul la rgyus blangs pa ma zad/ de ru mi mang po 'ig dang gas stu hā/lo/ra lo gnyis tsam gyi slob sbyong mjug rdzogs te lon ton nas phyir pha yul du 'byor/ skabs der khong rang lo bco brgyad la bslebs zin pas/ blo spobs che zhing brtse dung rgyas pa'i gzhon dar zhig tu gyur yod/the gor phyir rang yul du thon rjes bsam blo'i brtse dung mngon pa'i snyan rtsom gang mang zhig bris pa dang / khong gis de la 66rang nyid kyi glu ga'as su 'bod/ ma 'gyangs par snyan rtsom de dag gcig tu bsdus te 〈sang rnyi ya sang ji thu 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb cig bskrun pa dang / skabs de dag la khos 'khrab gzhung dang sgrung gtam mi nyung ba zhig kyang bcoms pa red/the gor gyi a pha ni mtshan nyid pa smra ba 'ig yin la/ khos rang gi bu the gor gyis snyan ngag pa zhig la 'bad pa ni 'grig par bsam med kyang / the gor gyi snyan rtsom gyi grags pa je rgyas su phyin pa shes rjes/ nyin zhig khos glo bur du rang gi bu ma dun du bos te na re/ khyod kyis 'di ru myur ba myur du nga la snyan rtsom 'ig phris dang zhes pa la/ the gor gyis de ma thag sems 'phreng ba'i snyan ngag cig bris te ngag la gyer ba 'di ltar/6 khyed nga'i mig lam na rgyun du rgyu na yang / ngas khyed mthong ma byung /khyed nga'i sem sa khong na dal 'jags ger gtan du bzhugs na yang /ngas khyed tshor ma byung /grogs po bral ba'i mi yis/ khyed kyi byams pa nyams su myong /khyim ga'is med pa'i mi yis/ khyed kyi dbugs dbyung ngang gis thob/pha yis snyan ngag gyer 'don der nyan rjes sems 'gul shin tu thebs paX 10 nas/ 8 da lta/ ngas lhan skyes kyi yon tan can khyod ngo shes song ’

zhes bshad/1890lo ste the gor lo nyi shu 'a son pa na/ a phas kho rang ga'is ka hri li dha(747)yi thon las bdag gnyer byed du btang / hri li dha ni gaṅgā'i chu la ga pā dhe ma yi 'gram rgyud du chags yod la/ de yi yul ljongs ni mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba skad cig la 'dren pa jig ste/ tshigs drug smyug ma ring po'i ljang lo ldem ldem du g.yo 'ing / a mra'i lo 'dab tshang tshing 'khrugs pa'i gseng la dwangs gtsang chu phran bag phebs ngang gya gyur rgyu zhing rgyu bas/ khong mdangs ldan gyi mdzes ris shig gi khrod du bkod pa dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i spro dga' rgyas/ khong gis rkang 'og gi sa ga'ir lag pas byug gin dungs pa zab mos/ 8 rlabs chen gyi sa gzhi lags/ ngas rang nyid lus po 'di khyed kyi khod yangs pa'i brang la gan rkyal du nyal te/ a sngon nas 'byor ba'i 'tshams 'dri la lan pa slog rgyu zhes smras so// de nas bzung / hri li dha yi rang byung gi mdzes ljongs de khong gi yid 'ong gi longs spyod chen po zhig tu gyur/ de dus rgya gar ni dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul yin la/ dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan gyis snga gzhug tu rgya gar gyi yon tan can mang po zhig la gnod 'tshe btang ba ma zad/ 'ing ba mang tshogs la dpal 'byor thad nas bshu gzhog gi sbyor ba'ang rgya cher spel/ the gor gyis rnam pa de la dmigs te rgya gar mi dmangs la mi rigs bcings 'grol bya bar spel bar skul slong byed pa'i snyan rtsom 'bri mgo bcoms pa red/ kho'i snyan rtsom zhig tu/6 nga rang khyed la dungs/ nga'i gser mdangs rgyas pa'i bhaṅgā la/ brtse ldan gyi ma yum lags/khyed kyi mkha' dbyings dang khyed kyi dbugs rgyun gyis rgyun par nga'i sems kyi rgyud mangs sbreng 'ong / 311

dpyid kyi dus/ khyed kyi a mra'i me tog gi dri bsung bag med du 'thul la/'o ston gyi tshe/ khyed kyis lo legs kyi shis brjod ngogs dgyes 'dzum ma na/ma yum lags/ khyed kyi byams brtse yi mdzes mchor gos lwa 'dis/chu gtsang bo'i phar 'gram tshur ngogs dang / shing ljon pa'i grib bsil yang 'di ltar du spras byung yang /kye ma yum la gas/ ngas dang dad rnam dag gis mgo bo smad nas/ khyed kyi brang khar sbyar la/zi ngas rang gi yod tshad khyed kyi 'bas skyes su 'bul rgyu'i sta gon byas na/ the gor hri li dha la thon nas lo ba'i 'gor ba'i nyin zhig char ba chen po 'ig babs byung / grwa pa zhig gom pa 'khyar 'khor ngang khong gi sgo khar langs te ha cang nyam thag pa'i ngag gis slong mo byas pa na/ the gor gyis spro bag phebs pa'i sgo nas grwa pa de khyim du drangs te bzhugs su gsol 'ing a mra'i sil khu phor ba gang phul/ grwa pa des sil khu btung rjes mig zung mchi mas brlan zhing dungs pa zab mos the gor la dmigs 'dug de la the gor gyis ru btsun pa lags/ khyed kyi khyim gang na yod ces dris pa la/ grwa pas rang tshang gi kha rgyab kyi rten ni mi rabs bdun du brgyud pa'i khyad nor te/ sa 'ing mu'u gnyis yod pa de kho na yin pa dang / da ni de yang rje bos 'phrog pa'i gnas tshul sdug po de gsong bor brjod/kho'i skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas tshul de thos pas the gor gyi thugs rab tu khros par gyur nas/ de mar 'di ltar bris byung /31khro rje bo'i lag zung gis sprang khyim gyi yod tshad brkus tshar/

a ho/ 'jig rten 'dir su zhig tam sems gang mtha' med na de la 'byor phyug 'o nga /the gor gyis rang gi gral rim la ngo log bya ba'i mtshon byed snyan rtsom grags can 〈sa mu'u do 〉zhes pa ni de ltar bcoms pa red/hri li dha ru sdod pa'i lo ngo bcu yi ring / the gor gyis sa bdag rnams kyis zhing ba la bshu gzhog ji ltar byed pa dngos su mthong la/ rgya gar spyi tshogs kyi lugs 'gal gyi gnas tshul dang dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur byas pa las byung ba'i yid skyo ba'i gnas babs kyang mngon sum du mthong bas/ khong la spyi tshogs kyi gnas babs de nges par du bsgyur dgos pa'i 'dun pa skyes/ khong gis spyi tshogs bsgyur bcos byed na nges par du slob gso 'dzin dgos par dgongs nas/ hri li dha'i gzhis ka dang gyes nas ka li ka ta rjodang dbyin le 90yi mtshams kyi sang dzña nee khu than (rsā7779)grong tsho'i zhi bde gling (kho'i a phas sgrub sbyangs byed sa )bya ba ru/ slob chung zhig btsugs te mi sna yon tan can bskyed bsring bya ba'i las bsgrubs/thegor gyis slob grwa gnyer pa'i zhor du spyi tshogs la rgyus blangs te rtsom rig gi las kyang gnyer/ khong 1905lo'i rgya gar mi dmangs kyis dbyin jir ngo rgol byed pa'i bya 'gul la zhugs pa'i dus mtshungs su rgyal gces glu tshig mi nyung ba zhig kyang bcoms/ spyi lo 1913lor kho'i chos lugs kyi bsam blo dang 'jig rten lta tshul mngon par mtshon pa'i snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〈ki ṭhan ka li 〉zhes par no pel ①rtsom rig gi rtags ma thob/ de nas bzung khong gi snyan pa'i grags pa sa steng kun la khyab ste/ 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi dga' ① /lis ta/ 50/ji chime)lo stsarjo pel/ saX 1 (7 313

gus phyi phyir chen po thob/khong gi 〈rgya gar ba'i las dbang gi lha 〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom de rgya gar rang btsan byung ba'i rjes su/ rgya gar spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal glur gyur/1919lor dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur mkhan gyis a mi li tsi(a76lko/lko//)thang chen du rgya gar gyi lag na mtshon cha ci yang med pa'i mi dmangs me mdas dmar gsod btang ba la ngo rgol byed ched/ the gor gyis dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gis gnangs pa'i jo thob dor/ khong gis bsam par/rgyal khab dang mi rigs la bran bsgyur dang gnya' gnon myong ba'i las skal de bsgyur dgos na/ nges par du skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i na gzhon mi rabs gcig gi rtogs pa sad du 'jug dgos par snyam nas/ sngar bsgrubs pa'i slob chung gi rmang gzhi'i stong yang bskyar slob chen zhig btsugs/the gor gyis ma dngul grabs gsog dang dge rgan gdan 'dren gyi phyir du dka' ba khyad du bsal te gang sar 'brel gtug byas shing phyir rgyal du bcar 'drir phebs pa'i go skabs kyang spyad de/ dril bsgrags dang ma dngul bsdu ba sogs thabs lam sna tshogs spyad la/ khong rang nyid kyi bdog pa ji snyed de/ tha na rang la thob pa'i no pel bya dga' yi dngul de'ang slob grwar zhal 'debs su phul ba red/1921lor sang rnyi ne khu than rgyal spyi'i slob chen legs grub byung nas slob mgo dngos su brtsams/ de nas bzung 'dzam gling gi sa khul so so nas slob ma bsdus pas/ e sha ya dang 'dzam gling shar nub kyi rig gnas brje spel lte gnas shig tu gyur/slob grwa 'di'i dge rgan chen mo'i zla phogs ni slob chen spyir btang ba zhig gi lnga cha'i gcig las med mod/ 'on kyang de ru rgya gar rang gi dge rgan yi/ spyading 'dra/ rgyal khab gzhan gyi dge rgan yin yang rung ste/ tshang ma

las la spro shugs shin tu che ste/ rgyu ma/tshan ni kho tsho tshang ma the gor gyi rgyal gces snying stobs dang zhi bde'i lhag bsam la sems gting yi rangs pas so//slob grwa de ru/ dge slob su yin yang rgyal khab dang gral rim/ rigs dus/ dad mos sogs gang yin la khyad med 'dra mnyam du lta la/ kho tsho'i slob sbyong gi thabs lam yang rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ dge rgan gyis phyogs gcig nas slob ma rnams la chos lugs dang rtsom rig der rabs tshan rig bcas la zhib 'jug byed du 'jug pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas slob ma'i sger tshugs kyi mi gshis dang mi rigs rang gces kyi yid ches/ rgyal gces ring lugs dang zhi bde la dga' ba'i snying stobs skyed sring bya ba shin tu gtsigs chen byed/ de min slob grwa der krung go'i slob gling zhes pa zhig kyang btsugs te krung go'i mkhas pa grogs po rnams der slob khrid gnang bar gdan drangs/thegor gyis rgyal spyi'i slob chen je legs su spel phyir snga rjes su 'jar pan dang a ri/ yo rob sogs su lta skor du bskyod de rgyal khab so so'i slob gso'i gnas tshul la zhib 'jug bya ba'i zhor du/ slob grwar ma dngul gyi zhal 'debs bsdus shing / yon tan can skor zhig kyang bsdu 'gug byas/ de ltar khong gi hur brtson la brten nas rgyal spyi'i slob chen gyi gzhi khyon je che je rgyas dang sgrig chas sngar las je legs 'dzoms su gyur la/ dpe mdzod khang du'ang lo ngo nyis stong nas sum stong sngon gyi glegs bam stong phrag 'ga' bsgrigs yod pa dag ni 'dzam gling gi rig dngos shin tu rtsa chen zhig yin/ 〈lo rgyus nyer bzhi ba snyadang 〈〈dpyad skyong me long 〉〉0〈gtsug lag bcu gsum pa 〉sogs krung go'i dpe rnying skor kyang nyar tshags byas yod/0 〈〈dpyad skyong me long〉〉 mas 〉〉 315

ring min du slob chen der sgyu rtsal slob gling zhig kyang btsugs pa dang /de ru 'dzam gling na grags che ba'i tshon ris dang brkos ris/ gna' sgor/gna' bo'i rol chas/ de min rtsa che ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi dngos po sna tshogs bsdu nyar byas yod/the gor gyis btsugs pa'i slob chen des yon tan can gang mang zhig skyed sring byas la/ 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so so'i sngon thon mi sna tshos slob grwa der mthong chen dang rgyab skyor gang legs gnangs pa red/the gor krung go'i rig gnas la dga' zhing khong gis krung go'i mi dmangs la brtse dung rnal ma zhig bcangs yod de/ 1924lor khong gis krung go dang rgya gar bar mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba 'dzugs pa'i 'os 'gan phrag tu bsnams te krung gor 'tshams 'drir phebs/ dgung lo re gsum la son pa'i the gor gyis rang nyid la bsu ba byed mkhan gyi grogs po tshor gsungs rgyur/6 grogs po rnam pa/ rkyen gang zhig gis yin mi shes mod/ gang ltar nga krung gor bslebs pa na rang gi pha yul du 'byor ba'i snang ba zhig skyes byung la/ nga la nam rgyun rgya gar ni krung go'i ches nye ba'i gnyen mi yin pa dang / krung go dang rgya gar ni lo rgyus shin tu ring zhing dungs pa shin tu zab pa'i spun mched yin snyam skye/ de ring / nga mdzes sdug gi rgyal khams 'dir 'byor bas snga na med pa'i spro ba zhig skyes/ nga tshos gna' bo'i mdza' 'brel gyi rgyun thag de sra mkhregs su btang ste mi phyed sems kyi mdza' zla zhig tu 'gyur bar brtson dgos zhes gsungs/ khong gi gsung bshad kyis mi rnams la bsub tu med pa'i yid 'ong gi dran pa bzhag song /1929lor khong yang bskyar krung gor 'tshams 'drir thengs shig phebs pa dang / phyir log pa'i tshe sung ching lin (lkoṣṭha༅)gyis skyel ma'i cho ga rgya chedi sdu/bas pa dang / khong phyir log rjes ched du krung go'i phyi 'grim slob

mar ma dngul gyi rogs ram byed pa'i rnam grangs shig kyang btsugs pa red/1937lor 'jar pan gyis krung gor btsan 'dzul byas pa na/ the gor khro ba'i ngang nas 'jar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs la sun 'byin byed pa'i snyan rtsom 〈〈gus phyag 'bul/ sangs rgyas pa 〉〉zhes pa zhig bris/ dbyin ji'i o khi si rmur ti 0slob grwa chen mos 1940lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 7nyin the gor la rtsom rig gi po hri'i gzi brjid thob thang gnangs/ skabs der de lta bu'i mtshan gnas ni 'dzam gling shar phyogs su khong las mi gzhan la thob myong med/rlabs chen gyi snyan ngag pa dang slob gso ba/ rgyal gces ring lugs pa gang nyid 1941lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 7nyin/ khong dgung lo brgyad cu steng 'jig rten dang gtan du gyes song / snyan ngag pa'i dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'jags zin kyang/ khong gi rlabs che ba'i snyan rtsom de dag ni rgya gar mi dmangs dang 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi sems khongs su nyams pa med pa'i gson shugs rgyas bzhin yod/khong gis sku tshe gang bor dkad spyad 'bad 'bungs kyis snyan ngag deb lnga bcu lhag dang / 'khyab gzhung dang lhug rtsom/ rtogs brjod/ rtsom rig lo rgyus/ bslab deb/ chos lugs dpyad brjod sogs gsar rtsom 'bor chen gnangs pas/ mi'i rigs la byas rjes bla na med pa zhig bzhag yod pa dang / de dag las gtso che bar dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur mkhan la mtshang 'byin dang / rigs rgyud lam lugs la skyon brjod/ zhing pa'i nyam nga ba'i gnas babs la thugs khur gnang yod par ma zad/ da dung khong gi snyan ngag la 'gyur khugs gsal zhing snyan ro phun sum tshogs shing /thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang ldan no//du khi gisprur ti/ 059༷ sku 317

zho po nā dang kho'i zlos gar gsar rtsom/lon ton grong khyer gyi byang phyogs dang nye ba'i zhing grong gzhung lam zhig gi nye 'dabs su/ tshang tshing gi nags tshal stug po'i khrod du thog so can gyi thog khang chung chung zhig 'dug thog khang chung chung de'i mdun ni sngo ljang gi spang thang yin zhing ra ba'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du me tog sna tshogs rnam par bkra/ gnas de mdzes shing sdug la ha cang snying 'jags yin pas mi rnams la mi lam lta bu'i spro skyid kyi tshor snang zhig bcos min du ster/ mi rnams kyis thog khang chung chung der 66zho lags kyi bzhugs shag mi sa 'bod cing / khang pa de ni dbyin ji'i rtsom rig mkhan po zho po nā yi bzhugs gnas red/ zho po nā dang lcam mo gnyis 1906lor lon ton grong khyer nas de ru gnas spar ba nas khong sku gshegs pa'i bar la lo ngo zhe bzhi'i ring thog khang chung chung de ru 'tsho gzhes gnang /zho po nā sku gshegs nas cang ma 'gor bar/ dbyin ji'i rig dngos srung skyob do dam u yon lhan khang gis kho'i sngon chad kyi brtsams chos dang shul rdzas rnams gcig tu bsdus te khang pa der nyar tshags byas pa dang / mang tshogs kyi spyan sngar bshams/ lo rer rgyal khab rang gi ltad mo ba mang po yod pa las gzhan/ 'dzam gling gi sa cha so so'i mi mi nyung ba zhig kyang rtsom rig mkhan po der mya ngan rjes dran du yong dang yong bzhin yod/zho po nā'i bzhugs shag gi gzhung sgrub khang dang za khang / 'grul khang ba/sdu sna khong gi sku par dang snum tshon ri mo/ 'jim sku sogs mthong thub

cing / de dag ni zho po nā'i grogs po dang sgyu rtsal pa skor zhig gis zho po nā la bzhengs pa red/ de dag gis zho po nā yi u tshugs dang nga rgyal/ gzhung drang /rtsed rgod che ba/ de min dus nam yang spyi tshogs khrod 'dra mnyam min pa'i snang tshul la 'gran rtsod byed spobs pa'i gshes ka ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon yod/zho po nā yi sku tshe gang bo ni kyag kyog dang 'bad 'thab hur len gyi tshe gang yin/ khong 1856lo'i dbyar khar ar lan ḍi 0 lho ma'i dha ste lin rjogrongakhyer gyi khyim tshang dbul bo zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ khong gi ma yum ni rol dbyangs dge rgan zhig yin pa dang / yab ni spyi zhabs pa dkyus ma zhig yin la chang 'thung rgyur dga' bo yod/ zho po nā ha cang chung ba'i skabs su pha ma gnyis kha bral nas bsdad pa dang / khong thag ring gi gnyen nye zhig gis bskyangs/ lo na chung ba'i zho po nā la na mnyam gyi byis pa gzhan dag gis myong ba'i pha ma'i byams brtse dang thugs khur 'thob ma myong zhing / phye thang gi rtswa phran zhig dang 'dra bar bdag skyong byed mkhan med pa'i khor yug khrod rim gyis nar son/ khong chung dus nas rtsom rig dang rol dbyangs/ ri mo bcas la dga' zhen che ba dang / phyin chad ri mo ba grags can zhig tu 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa'ang ha cang che/ yin na yang / khong rang lo bcu bzhi'i steng slob 'bring mthar phyin skabs/ khyim tshang dbul rkyen kung zi zhig gi las bzo ba byas te khang gla bsdu ba dang / rtsis tho 'god pa/ 'phrin yig 'bri ba bcas kyi bya ba mi sgrub thabs med byung / bya ba de lo lnga drug tsam la rgyun bskyangs pa red/dus skabs der zho po nā yis mi yul gyi 'dra mnyam min pa'i gnas tshul dang ma rtsa can gyis dbul bor bshu gzhog byed pa'i ya nga ba'i lag thabs la ngos 'dzin zab mo rnyed/ thog mar khong don de dag la yi mi rangs pa'i bsam ཿ pa sna pa/ ḍi/ba/di/ sduḥnāshā 319

tshul skyes mod/ 'on kyang de'i rjes su khong gis shes byar re snyeg byas te dpe deb dang rol dbyangs/ ri mo bcas kyi khrod dris lan 'tshol 'ib byas stabs khong la bsam blo'i khyer so yod par gyur/ khong gis phyis su bshad rgyur/kho'i dbul phongs dang skyo sdug gi na gzhon dus skabs su/ rtsom rig dang rol dbyangs/ ri mo bcas kyis khong la 'od snang dang drod khol sbyin zhing khong gis ma 'ongs par 'bad brtson byed par skul lcag thebs song zer/1876lor/ lo nyi shur son pa'i zho po nā yis rang nyid kyi 'dod blo dang 'tsham pa'i bya ba zhig 'tshol ched sngon chad kyi bya ba bskyur zhing / pha yul dang gyes nas rang nyid gcig pu lon ton grong khyer du thon/ lon ton sa rgya che yang gnas der gtan sdod byed pa las sla mo zhig min/ khyad par du khyim tshang dbul bo nas skyes pa'i na gzhon zhig la mtshon nas bshad na de bas kyang khag por 'dug zhi po nā lon ton grong khyer la 'byor ba'i ches thog ma'i zla drug phal cher ltogs skom gyis bskyal ba dang / de'i rjes kyi lo gnyis ring /khong gis sngar bzhin tshong khang nas rtsis tho dang zong tho 'god dgos byung /dmigs 'dun chen po yod pa'i na gzhon zhig la mtshon nas bshad na/ de ltar 'tsho ba bskyal bas yid gtan nas tshim mi srid/ zho po nā la thog mar 'bad brtson gyis rang sbyong byas te rang nyid kyi rig stobs 'phel bar byed 'dod pa'i blo skyes shing / bya ba'i khom gseng du khong gis dbyin ji'i dngos mang bshams ston khang nas dpe cha mang por gzigs pa dang / rtsom rig dang ri mo/ rol dbyangs bcas la sbyangs te dus tshod mang shos slob sbyong gi khrod nas 'da' bar byas/ dus tshod nges can zhig la 'bad brtson byas thogartsom rig sgyu rtsal thad kyi sbyang 'bras yar thon gang legs byung bas/ khong phyis su zlos gar mkhan por 'gyur ba la rmang gzhi brtan po bting /32byin na'ang / dang thog khong gis rang nyid brtsams sgrung pa zhig tu

'gyur ba'i 'dun pa bcangs/ 1879lor/ khong dgung lo nyer gsum steng spobs pa cher bskyed kyis brtsams sgrung thog ma〈〈nar ma son〉〉zhes pa gsar rtsom gnang / sgrung de legs grub byung rjes re ba chen po dang bcas ma yig par skrun khang du bskur/ yin na yang / cang ma 'gor bar ma yig de phyir bskur nas yong / de'i rjes su khong gis mu mthud du bcoms chos re 'ga' bris kyang par bskrun byed ma thub/ de nas khong mi gzhan gyis mtshams sbyor byas pa brgyud rol dbyangs kyi dpyad brjod gsar 'god pa dang zlos gar gyi dpyad brjod gsar 'god pa byas te/ tshags par dang dus deb la rig rtsal gyi dpyad brjod rtsom yig sna tshogs bris gnang mdzad/ 'on kyang des khong gi 'tsho ba la legs bcos chen po ma byung bas sngar bzhin nyam thag tu 'dugadus rabs bcu dgu ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu bar/ a me ri ku'i dpal 'byor rig pa ba hin ros jor ḍi yi〈〈gong 'phel dang dbul phongs〉〉zhes pa'i dpe cha de dar byin shin tu che/ 1882lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 2nyin/ zho po nā yis hin ros jor ḍi yi snyan zhu gsan rjes su/ 6 spyi tshogs dpal 'byor la slob sbyong byed pa'i gal chen rang bzhin gyis nga rang la blo sgo ches cher 'byed ’ ces brjod pa dang / de nas bzung khong gis spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gnad don la zhib 'jug byas par ma zad/ mar khe si yi〈〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad〉〉nan tan gyis klog 'don mdzad/ khong gis gsungs don/ 6 mar khe si yi gsung rtsom gyis nga rang la mig rgya bskyed cing / lo rgyus dang dpal yon gyi gnas tshul ngo ma mthong du bcug pa dang / des nga rang la 'tsho ba'i dmigs 'ben dang don snying rjen par rtogs su bcug zer/ mar khe si yi gsung rtsom gyis khong gi bsam blor shan shugs chen po thebs rung / khong sngar bzhin 'byor ldan gral rim gyi legs bcos ring lugs pa zhig las ma 'das/ khong gis hphe 321

pen lhan tshogs 0kyis bsgrigs pa'i〈〈mi mang shos ci'i phyir dbul phongs yin〉〉zhes pa'i deb chung de bklags rjes/ hphe pen lhan tshogs su zhugs rgyu'i blo thag bcad par ma zad/ lo nyer bdun ring tshogs khag de'i 'go khrid pa'i las 'gan 'khur/ zho po nā spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi phyogs su gzhol te dbul bor snying rje sgom na yang / khong gis dbul phongs de nag nyes shig tu brtsis yod/ khong gis rjes su bris gnang mdzad pa'i〈(hra'o 'a'o dmag dpon bhar bha la〉〉zhes pa'i zlos gar khrod/ khong gi dbul phongs nag nyes su rlom pa'i 'dod blo de gsal bor mngon yod/ khong gis gsungs rgyur/ 6 dbul phongs kyis grong khyer tshang ma rul sungs su 'gyur bar byed cing / 'jigs su /dri hāX /sna drimazlokta spya sdo ra hā/ padhi/sa /dīkā sdidīkā / / shā lhasasu zlo/ ṭā / nag nyes de bzo mkhan nyes can ngo ma su sdun pa rtogs dka' bar bzhed/khong ma rtsa ring lugs kyi nyes spyod sna tshogs la sdang sem sa skye zhing spyi tshogs ring lugs la dung sems bcangs mod/ 'on kyang / khong mar khe si ring lugs pa 'ig tu 'gyur ma thub par dbyin ji'i legs bsgyur ring lugs kyi rtsa 'dzugs te 6 hphe pen lhan tshogs kyi khongs mi zhig las ma 'das/1888lor/ mar khe si yi bu mo e lin na yis gdan 'dren zhus par brten/ zho po nā e pi sen 0gyi ming du grags pa'i zlos gar〈〈rtsed brnyan gyi khyim tshang〉〉zhes pa'i las zhor 'khrab ston la zhugs pa dang de las khong la blo bskyed chen po byung / e pi sen gyis zlos gar gyi rnam par brten nas spyi lugasahā'i 〉mikhang cirdo slo/ shā/ste/gan/ ༷dzra (sdo rnyi tna tā 3 1 blo dru /rnyi rnyi spyamarmisdirātsasdus/ sdu snri sduga~Xng ba/snro2 /nākāsna' mi/ ༵༵bsdu/snaX spya ༵/

tshogs kyi gnad don ther 'don byas par khong gis gzengs bstod byas/ de nas bzung khong gis blo rtse gcig sgrim sgos e pi sen gyi zlos gar brtsams chos klog 'don byas par ma zad/ 〈〈ye pi sen ring lugs kyi snying bo〉〉zhes pa'i ming du grags pa'i dpyad rtsom bris gnang mdzad/ thengs shig la e pi sen gyi〈〈gdon tshogs〉〉zhes pa'i zlos gar de lon ton grong khyer nas 'khrab ston byas rjes/ dbyin ji'i sku drag tsho'i tshig rtsub mo'i dmod mo thebs/ yin na yang / zho po nā yis bltas na zlos gar ni spyi tshogs kyi nag nyes ther 'don byed pa'i yo byad gal chen zhig tu brtsis chog par 'dod/ de nas bzung khong gis dpa' spobs cher bskyed sgos e pi sen mig dper byas te mtha' gcig tu zlos gar gsar rtsom gyi las la gzhol/1889lo'i bar/ zho po nā yis〈〈yugs pho'i khang khyim〉〉dang〈〈yugs mo'i khyim〉〉 〈〈mdza' sems ston mkhan〉〉 〈〈hā lung rmu yi las ga〉〉 〈〈drag chas dang mi〉〉 〈〈ca te ta〉〉 〈〈mi'i las dbang〉〉 〈2khyod kyis brjod mi rung〉〉zhes pa sogs zlos gar gsar rtsom byas nas par du bskrun pas/ snyan grags 'bar ba'i zlos gar gsar rtsom pa zhig tu gyur/ zlos gar bcoms chos de dag las khong gis tshor sgo rnon pos snying rje spu tsam yang med pa'i sgo nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi rul sungs ther 'don byas pa dang /dgod bro dang zur za'i nyams kyis sku drag dang mdzangs mar rlom pa'i bud med rnams kyi rang gi ngo so kho na bsam pa'i ngang tshul la 'phya smod byas/ khong gi zlos gar brtsams chos las skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don ther 'don byed pa gtsigs su bzung ba zhing sngon thon gyi bsam blo dang ldan pas/ khong gi zlos gar bcoms chos re 'gar 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dbang 'dzin las khungs kyis 'khyab ston byas mi chog pa'i bkag rgya spel ba dang / khong rang nyid la yang mtho rim spyi tshogs kyis 6 gdon 'dre ru dmod na yang /32/na

dam du khong la gus mthong ched po byed pa'i mi phyi phyir je mang du gyur/1925lor/ khong gi brtsams chos la no pel rtsom rig bya dga' thob/zho po nā rang nyid spyi tshogs ring lugs pa zhig min yang / khong gis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam du bskyod pa'i su'u len rgyal khab la brtse sems zab mo bcangs yod pas/ 1933lor khong gis su'u len rgyal khab la 'tshams 'dri mdzad/ phyir dbyin ji ru 'byor rjes/ gsar 'god pas sku zhabs zho po nā yi mtha' bskor zhing lha su'u len rgyal khab ji 'dra'i nyam thag gi gnas su lhung yod ’ pa'i tshul 'dri skabs/ khong gis lan du 6 ngas mthong ba ni bzang phyogs tag tag yin la/ ngan phyogs ngas kyang ma btsal/ su'u len rgyal khab la da dung zhan cha mi nyung ba zhig mchis srid kyang / nga rang rgyal khab der song ba ni zhan cha dang mi 'dang sa 'tshol du song ba min par legs cha 'tshol du song ba yin/ gal te ngas zhan cha 'tshol dgos na/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab 'dir rang khyim gyi sgor bud ma thag mthong tshad tshang ma yin pas/ rgyang ring gi su'u len rgyal khab tu 'tshol bar 'gro ba'i dgos pa ci zhig yod ces bshad/khong gi lan des gsar 'god pa de dag kha grags rgyu med par btang /zho po nā ni rtsed mtshar che ba'i mi zhig kyang yin te/ thengs shig la mdzes sdug gi snyan grags yo rab gling dang me gling gi khyon na ldir ba'i bud med mdzangs ma zhig gis khong la 66sku zha4bas zho po nā lags/ gal te khyod bdag dang gnyen sgrig byas na/ skyes pa'i byis pa de'i 'al bzhin bdag dang 'dra zhing blo shes rgya khyod dang mtshungs na/ byis pa de rig stobs dang yag bzhin gang gi cha nas kyang 'dzam gling na 'gran zla bral ba zhig tu 'gyur nges red ces brjod pa la/ khong gis 66gal te de ltar ma yin par zhal bzhin bdag dang mtshungs shing blo rig khyod dang 'dra na/ byis pa de ji 'dra zhig yi/ 14 bsam yang phod dam ’ zhes lan btab/ zho po nā yi sku tshe gang bor de

'dra'i dgod bro zhing ha las par byed pa'i mtshar gtam bgrang gis mi langs pa zhig mchis/1933lor/ zho po nā dgung lo don bdun steng khong gi lcam mo dang mnyam du 'dzam gling gi yul gru mang por gnas skor byas rjes krung gor 'tshams 'drir phebs/ khong gis khyer yong ba ni nga tshor gnod pa'i nyal tha dang drag chas min par/ krung go'i mi dmangs la bcangs pa'i brtse sems rnal ma dang nag nyes la ngo rgol byed pa'i mtshar gtam sna tshogs red/ sung chin lin dang tshe yon phe/ lu'u zhun sogs krung go'i phul du byung ba'i mi sna 'gas dga' bsu chen po byas/1950lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 12nyin/ zho po nā dgung lo go bzhi'i steng sku gshegs/ yin na yang / khong gi sna mang phun sum tshogs pa'i brtsams chos dag ni mi'i rigs kyi sgyu rtsal bang mdzod khrod kyi dgos 'dod nor bu zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/ khong gi sku tshe gang bor zlos gar gsar rtsom gyi las la rtse gcig tu gzhol/ 1892lor zlos gar brtsams chos thog ma〈〈yugs po'i khang khyim〉〉brtsams pa nas 1950lor ches mtha' mjug gi zlos gar bcoms chos〈〈mos ci'i phyir mi 'dod〉〉ces pa brtsams pa'i bar gyi lo ngo nga brgyad ring /bsdoms pas zlos gar brtsams chos lnga bcu gsar rtsom gnang ba dang / ha lam lo rer bcoms chos gsar pa re gsar rtsom gnang yod/ de'i nang gi bcoms chos mi nyung ba zhig ni 'dzam gling gi sgyu rtsal gar stegs stong snyan grags ches cher rgyas pa'i phul byung brtsams chos red/325

rlabs cheri'i glogabarnyan 'khrab ston la bra gi yin/thra phi lin ni dbyin ji'i rlabs che ba'i dgod bro'i zlos gar pa 'ig yin la/ 'dzam gling glog brnyan gar stegs kyi 'khrab ston pa skad grags chod pa zhig kyang yin/ khong gis tshe gang bor glog brnyan brgyad cu lhag par rgyag byas par ma zad/ 'khrab gzhung rtsom sgrig dang / 'khrab khrid/ dbyangs rtsom pa/'khyab ston mkhan sogs kyi las su'ang zhugs myong ba red/ mi rnams kyis gson nyams ldan pa'i glog brnyan gyi gtam rgyud 'di 'dra mang po zhig ci ltar grub pa yin nam zhes dris tshe/ khong gis 6 mi'i bsam blo ni gang nas byung ba red dam zhe na/ de ni rgyun chad med par bsam gzhigs shugs drag tu byas pa las byung ba yin/ de la nges par du yun ring po'i dka' ba bzod dgo sa shing / nyams pa med pa'i spro ba zhig cis kyang yod dgos zhes bshad/khong gi bshad stangs 'di las nga tshos khong gi grub 'bras thob pa'i man ngag ni gting zab pa'i bsam blo'i rmang gzhi zhig dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'tsho ba'i brgyud lam zhig yod pas yin tshul de rtogs par 'gyur ro//khrar le si mi pan ser bra phi lin 0ni spyi lo 1889lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 16nyin dbyin ji'i lon ton khor si ( ṣṭhapo 67)sa khul gyi khyim tshang dkyus ma zhig tu skyes/ khong gi pha ma gnyis ni zlos gar mkhan yin pas khong gis chung dus nas glu dbyangs dang bro gar sogs la sbyangs/ a mas 'khrab ༷ khrara' si sa pan ser thra pi lin/ 0541—34700 (6 91 ba po morsā sgosgro /cho188/bye/977

stonakhyed dus rgyun par khong zlos gar khang du 'khrid kyin yod/ thengs shig khong gi a mas gar stegs su glu dbyangs len skabs glo bur mgrin pa 'gags pas ltad mo ba rnams kyis 'ur brgyab la/ gar stegs bkod 'doms pa'ang ci bya gtol med du gyur pa'i tshe na/ lo lnga can gyi thra phi lin gar stegs su bud de a ma'i tshab tu glu dbyangs blangs la/ blangs pa'ang shin tu bzang bas/ltad mo ba rnams kyi bsngags brjod chen po thob/ de ni thra phi lin gyi 'khrab ston ches thog ma yin la khong gi a ma'i 'khrab ston ches mtha' ma yang red/skabs der thra phi lin gyi a mas mu mthud du 'khrab ston byed thabs bral bar gyur pa'i khar/ pha ma gnyis bza' thor byung ba dang / dang thog khong ma bu gnyis la dus ltar 'tsho dngul ster mkhan gyi a phas kyang chang bag med du btung drags pas las shor byung ste/ khyim gyi 'tsho ba nyin re las nyin rer je sdug tu gyur/ de lta bu'i dka' khag la 'phrad rkyen a mas khong dang khong gi phu bo khrid de dbul bo bdag skyong khang du mi 'gro ga med byung / thra phi len gyi a mar sems khams dang dpal 'byor gang thad nas rten so med pa'i rkyen gyis smyos shing smyo nad khang du bskyal/ de nas bzung / lo na chung ba'i thra phi lin gyis mi tshe'i dka' sdug nyams su myangs mgo brtsams/thra phi lin gyis snga rjes su sgo bston sman khang gi nad g.yog dang /dpar khang gi dpar rgyag mkhan/ dpe khang dang tshong khang gi gla ba sogs byed myong / khong gi phu bo hphe gling lho ma nas phyir log rag bar gnas nges med nyul nas ltogs skom myangs shing / thabs zad dus gad snyigs khrod kyi tshal shun dang sil tog sogs btsal te 'tsho ba bskyal dgos pa byung /phu bo phyir log rjes khong rgyun du 'khrab ston pa mtshams sbyor khang du song nas 'os 'tshams kyi las gnas shig la 'phrad re byas/ 1901lo'i zla 11pa'i nang 'khrab ston ru khag cig gi 'go pa'i blor babs te khong ru khag de'i 3༷/ba

ston la zhugs su bcug phyis su/ lo ngo lnga lhag gi 'bad brtson la brten nas khong gi 'tsho ba yang rim bzhin je legs su 'gro mgo brtsams/1907lo'i rjes su khong gi dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen rim bzhin je legs su song yod na'ang / 'tsho ba sngar bzhin bab chags yin la/ chang thigs pa tsam yang mi 'thung / khong gi dga' phyogs gtso bo ni rang dga' sa'i dpe cha dag klog rgyu de red/ khong gis nam rgyun dus tshod dam 'dzin byas nas khom long cung tsam re yod tshe dang / tha na mdzes spras khang du'ang dpe cha klog pa red/ khong gis rgyun par hra khe phe ir ①dang / ti khen si/duzo phen hwa/༷nyi tshe 0sogs kyi bcoms chos klog pa ma zad/ sman gzhung dang dpal 'byor rig pa'i phyogs kyi bcoms chos kyang bklags myong ba red/lo ngo du ma rim bzhin 'das rjes/ khong dgod bro ba'i lkugs brda'i zlos gar ched du 'khrab ston byed mkhan khar 'o zlos gar tshogs pa zhes pa de'i 'khyab ston pa gtso bor gyur/ 1909lo'i rjes su khong zlos gar tshogs pa dang lhan du a ri dang hpha ran si sogs su 'khrab ston byed du song zhing / ltad mo ba rnams kyi dga' mgu chen po thob/1912lor khos a rir thengs gnyis par 'khyab ston byed dus/ ho le wu 0yi glog brnyan phab skrun pas khong gi 'jon thang la rtsis mthong byas shing /1913lo'i zla 12nang khong gis chi si tung(ṭha46lko)phab skrun kung si la lo /shā/ ring gi gan rgya ba'ag ste a rir glog brnyan 'khyab ston gyi mgo brtsams 'i sbyo tsā/ ཿra khu/ sngi 3 sdu bye/ /sa〉〉 67 66༅stuḥdzhai lju/ kā/nga:khyiX ༵ ṭī kāshā

thra phi lin gyis 1914lo'i lo hril bo'i nang glog brnyan thung gras khag so lnga lhag gi 'khrab ston pa gtso bo byas shing / de las khag nyer gcig ni khong rang nyid kyis 'khrab gzhung rtsom sgrig dang 'khrab khrid byas pa red/ glog brnyan khag gnyis pa〈〈le ni se'i durlangs 'khor 'gran bsdur〉〉bya ba'i khrod/khong gis thengs dang por yul rgyar ba zhir ro(2lo7)yi bzo lta spras te ltad mo ba rnams kyi spyan lam du byon/ zher ro ni ngang rgyud 'jam zhing gshis rgyud bzang la/ nam rgyun sku drag gi bzo lta dod rgyur shin tu dga' ba'i yul byar pa zhig yin/ kho ni btsan rgyal ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod kyi mnar gcod dang brnyas bcos myong mkhan zhig dang / mi rnams kyis snying rje la dga' zhen yang byed pa'i mi sna chung chung zhig red/ thra phi lin gyis 6 zher ro la rang gshes mi 'dra ba mang du yod de/ yul gyar pa zhig dang / sku drag cig snyan ngag pa zhig 'tshol snyeg mkhan zhig sogs yin mod/ 'on kyang khos dud sne 'thu ba dang byis pa'i lag nas ka ra sil tog 'phrog pa las gzhan gang yang mi shes/ yin na'ang stabs legs dus a phyi dang bud med rnams kyi yong dor rdog gzhus re gtong yang srid do ’ zhes bshad/1914lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po langs shing / 'dzam gling gi mi khri phrag mang por mnar gcod tshabs chen thebs pa'i dus su/ thra phi lin sgyu rtsal pa zhig yin pa'i ngos nas rang nyid kyi drag chas te glog brnyan la brten nas ya nga snga na med pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi g.yul 'khrug der sun 'byin dang rgol rdung gtong rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ snga rjes su spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la zur za byed pa'i glog brnyan〈〈dga' skyid srang lam〉〉dang〈〈ga'is 'khyar ba〉〉 〈〈khyi'i 'tsho thabs〉〉 〈〈zher ro dmag la zhugs pa'i () we ni se/ sa ba su (5khuskosko329

zin tho〉〉sogs par du brgyab pa red/ grogs po tshang mas sems khur byed kyin yod na'ang khong la dngangs dogs spu tsam yang med par rang nyid kyi 'jon thang bed spyad de mi'i rigs la drang bden 'tshol rgyu'i blo thag bcad/dus rabs 20pa'i lo rabs 20pa'i mjug dang 30pa'i dus mgor/a ri'i dpal 'byor nyams nyes kyis ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs hril bor shugs rkyen bzos te rgya che ba'i bzo ba las shor dang / zhing ba khyim 'thor byung yod na'ang / ma rtsa can gyis bshu gzhog byed ched 'o ma mtsho la blug dgos rung rin gong smad nas 'tshong 'dod med pa'i tshad la slebs pa red/skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos mtshon par byed ched/ thra phi len gyis 'byor ldan gral rim gyi skyug bro ba'i ngang tshul dang / ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod kyi mi sna chung gras kyi skyo gar mtshon pa'i glog brnyan khag gnyis ste/〈〈grong khyer gyi 'od mdangs〉〉(1931lor)dang〈〈dpe gsar gyi dus rabs〉〉(1936lor)gnyis par brgyab la/ lo rabs 30pa'i nang gi a ri'i rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba mngon par mtshon/ 〈〈grong khyer gyi 'od mdangs〉〉su〈〈dpe gsar gyi dus rabs〉〉las kyang lhag pa'i sgo nas ma rtsa can gyis khe spogs len ched bzo ba'i ngal gso'i dus tshod kyang bed spyad nas/ 'chi gson la mi blta bar khe spogs gnyer la/ tha na 6 za 'khor ’ zhes pa zhig gsaragatod byas te bzo ba'i gung ja 'thung ba'i dus tshod thung thung de tsam yang mi gtong ba'i ngang tshul skyug bro ba de dmar rjen du bstan yod/ zher ro yis nyin gang bor 'phrul chas kyi ldir sgra'i khrod nas las ka byed dgos pa dang / mtha' mjug kho rang smyos pas smyo nad khang du bskyal/ smyo nad sangs rjes khos las ka shor/ nyin zhig kho rang srang lam du 'gro skabs/ mdun du rgyu ba'i zong 'dren rlangs 'khor las ras dmar yug cig lhung yod pa de rnyed/ma~X spyar rngam ston khrom skor tshogs pa zhig der brgyud nas song yod pas/

nyen rtog pas kho'i lag gi ras dmar de dar cha yin par 'dod de kho rang khrom skor gyi mgo gtso yin par snyam nas btson du bcug btson khang du sdod sa dang bza' chas sogs la khag theg yod rkyen zher ro de dang 'bral 'dod ma byung / rjes su kho rang dgod bro la ngu yang bro ba'i bya ba mang po zhig la 'phrad/〈〈dpe gsar gyi dus rabs〉〉'grem spel byas rjes log spyod pas glog brnyan khrod zher ro yis ras dmar g.yob pa de ni 6 gung khran ring lugs dril bsgrags byas pa red ’ zer nas ngo rgol drag po byas na'ang / zhing ba dkyus ma rnams kyi sems khongs su thra phi lin gyis go gnas gal chen zhig zin yod ༵/ khong la gzangs bstod kyi yi ge ni kha ba'i 'dab ma bzhin springs 'ongs lo rabs sum cu ba'i smad du/ 'jar man dang dbyi tha li hpha shi si yis drag chas la brten nas si pan la the gtogs byas shing / 'jar pan btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis krung gor btsan 'dzul byas la/ she thi ler gyis o si 'o ri ya btsan bzung byas pa sogs rgyal spyi'i gnas babs phyi phyir bde 'jags min par gyur/ de dag gis thra phi lin la khro ba chen po skye ru bcug pas/ khong gis skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi don chen dag rang gi gsar rtsom las mngon par mtshon rgyu'i chod sems bcad/1939lo'i dpyid kur/ khong gis〈〈ger gcod pa chen po〉〉zhes pa gsar rtsom byas pa dang / gsar rtsom de'i nang du dngangs skrag med pa'i sgo nas hpha shi si'i 'go gtso she thi ler dang mu so li nyi gnyis kyi snang brnyan bskrun yod/ khong gis bshad rgyur 6 ngas〈〈sgor gcod pa chen po〉〉par du rgyag pa ni nga rang sger gcod mkhan la sdang ba'i sems pa mtshon pa dang / mi rnams la de tshor 'phya dmod byed du 'jug ched yin ’ zer/ thra phi lin ni yongs kyi bde sdug rang khur du len zhing btsan gtum la zhum 'dud mi byed mkha/ sag

yin la/ glog brnyan khrod g.yul la mos pa'i smyo ham dag la zur za dang 'phya dmodabyas te/ sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas hpha shi si la rdung deg byas/ der brten〈〈sgor gcod pa chen po〉〉zhes pa 'di la hpha shi si ring lugs pas ngan smras shugs chen byed pa ma zad/ thra phi len gsod dgos pa'i skor gyi yi ge skur mkhan gyi ming ma bkod pa yang gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'byor/ 'on kyang /khong zhum pa spu tsam yang med par sger srung dmag gi srung skyob 'og 〈〈lhar gcod pa chen po〉〉zhes pa 1939lo'i zla 9pa'i nang dngos su par rgyag mgo bcoms la/ 1940lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 15nyin thengs dang por nye'u yog grong khyer nas dngos su ston mgo brtsams/1941lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin hpha shi si 'jar man gyis su'u len la phar rgol byas/ thra phi lin a ri'i dmangs gtso ba'i phyogs su langs te gtam bshad gang mang spel nas/ a ri'i srid gzhung la mgyogs myur ngang byed thabs don smin can spyod pa dang / gung rgol gyi dril bsgrags bya ba mtshams bzhag nas/ 'jar man hpha shi si las rgyal bar bya dgos pa'i re ba bton/thra phi lin gyis dmangs gtso ring lugs kyi phyogs su langs te hpha shi si la ngo rgol byed pa'i langs phyogs de'i rkyen gyis/ dgra bo mang shos shig gis gnod pa gsar pa brtsams mod/ 'on kyang khong gis dgra bo'i 'jigs zil gyi mdun du rang lag gi mtshon cha de nam yang 'dor ma myong / 1949lor rang rnam la gzhol che ba'i glog brnyan 'khrab gzhung〈〈gar stegs stong gi mi tshe〉〉zhes pa brtsams/ glon brnyan de ru khong rang nyid kyi ngo bo rnal ma de glog brnyan gyi ras yol steng thog dang por bkod pa dang / khong gis sgyu rtsal pa rgan pa kha hphi ro( rdo77)zhes pa'i snang brnyan der brten nas/ mi dmangs dang khong rang nyid la mnar gcod gtong ba'i spyi tshogs de'i nag nyepa 12 sun 'byin drag po byas/

1952lo'i rjes su thra phi lin yo rob rgyal khab khag gis〈〈gar stegs steng gi mi tshe〉〉thog dang por ston pa'i mdzad sgor zhugs pa nas bzung / khong phyir a rir ma log par je nee wa 0yi mtsho 'gram gyi byang rgyud du khor yug ha cang mdzes pa'i be wa grong brdal du gtan gzhi tshugs/ de nas bzung khong phyir dran gyi zin tho 'bri ba'i las la gzhol/ lo rabs 50pa'i mjug tu yi ge khri phrag 40yod pa'i〈〈rang rnam〉〉bris te mjug rdzogs/ gsung rtsom de 194lor dngos su par bskrun byas pa dang / yig rigs du mar bsgyur te 'dzam gling yongs la khyab tu bcug1977lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 25nyin 8 glog brnyan las rigs khrod kyi med du mi rung ba'i shes ldan pa ’ ste skyes stobs kyi rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa'i sgyu rtsal pa 'di dgung lo 88bzhes thog sku gshegs pa red/khong gis rul sungs su gyur pa'i ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs la skyon brjod mdzad cing / dngos yod ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom lag thabs spyad pa dang / khong gis dgod gtam sgyu rtsal gyi 'thab 'dzing dpung rtsal de ches phul du phyin la 'thus tshang ba/ khong gis gsar gtod byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi dngos pos mi rnams kyi sem sa khong du spro dga'i sa bon btab ste/ mi rnams la dgod sgra'i khrod mdzes sdug dang ya rabs la dga' mgu yi rangs dang / log spyod dang ma rabs la sdang sems skye ru 'jug pas/ khong gi skad sgra dang 'dzum zhal de dang / khong gi rlabs che ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi dngos po de dag la'ang 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi sems khams su nyams pa med pa'i bkrag mdangs gtan du 'tsher bzhin yod do// du je nee wa/ 'u brngu brame7 333

'dzom gling gi' mobasngags can bste so/1981lo'i ston kha'i nyin zhig la/ nyen rtog pa'i srung skyob khrod me 'khor zhig si pan gyi phu la to pho brang du slebs/ me 'khor du 'dzam gling gi ri mo ba grags can phi khā so yis bris pa'i ri mo ches che shos te〈〈per ni kha〉〉yod pa red/ ri mo de ni 1937lo'i zla 4pa'i nang hpha shi si 'jar man gyis si pan byangaphyogs kyi grong khyer ker ni kha brlags pa la rgol gtam gtong phyir bris pa'i ri mo zhig red/ 1939lor si pan du hpho lang gi(snyoXste5stso1)srid gzhung btsugs rjes/ phi khā so yis ri mo de nyar tshags yong ched du nye'u yog grong gi deng rabs sgyu rtsal dngos mang bshams ston khang la g.yar ba dang / lo ngo zhe gnyis ring a rir nyar tshags byas rjes phi khā so 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi re 'dun ltar bde blag ngang phyir si pan du 'dren thub pa byung /pha pu lo ra e si 'i khā so ① ni 1881lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 25nyin si pan lho phyogs kyi ma la ka 0 ru 'khrungs/ khong gi a pha ni par si lo na du yi bzo bkod mdzes rtsal slob grwa'i ri mo'i dge rgan zhig yin zhing / khong gis chung dus nas a pha'i drung du ri mor sbyangs te ri mo mi nyung ba zhig bris/ de kās khong sdi skye stobs kyi yon tan mngon pas mi tshang mas khong la do snang chen byas py-i khā ṭā /ni chung dus nas spyang grung ldan pas/ khong gis bris pa'i ri mo ཿ swānāshā ro hā/ pi /gā/sdu 1055 2721047377 776 4meXtshesdu par 4lo na/ 〉sgoge ༷ 3 zazas

la a pha'ang ha las shing rang gi ri mo 'bri byed kyi lag cha tshang ma phi khā so la gnangs pa dang / de nas bzung rang nyid kyis ri mo mi 'bri ba'i dam bcas/phi khā so yis 6 nga'i ri mo 'bri shes pa 'di ni ngas skad cha bshad shes pa las kyang snga/ ngas ri mo la brten nas yod tshad mtshon par byed thub ’ ces bshad/phi khā so rang lo 14stong du si pan gyi par si lo na grong khyer gyi par si lo na sgyu rtsal slob gling du rgyugs sprad pa red/ slob gling de'i rgyugs ga'i'i re ba ha cang mtho bas rgyun ldan gyi rgyugs sprod mkhan zhig yin tshe zla gcig gi ring la gtan 'khel byas pa'i bslab bya tshang ma rgyugs sprod pa yin mod/ 'on kyang phi khā so yis nyin gcig gi dus tshod spyad de sgyu rtsal slob gling du rgyugs 'phrod pa byung / rang lo 16steng du khong gi ngo mtshar ba'i bris rtsal la si pan gyi hrin hpher nan to sku drag slob gling gis gtsigs chen byas te slob gling der blangs mod/ mi ring bar khong la nad tshabs chen zhig phogs te slob gling de dang mi 'bral ga med byung / de'i phyir pha yul du log ste nad bcos khang du nad gso byas/ zhing ba mang tshogs kyi dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba la khong ha las par gyur pas/ snying rje dang drang bden gyi rkyen gyis/ khong gis ri mo brten nas zhing ba mang tshogs kyi dka' sdug mngon par mtshon rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ dus skabs der bris pa'i ri mo mang shos la tshon mdog sngon po spyad pas 6 sngon po'i dus skabs )zer/ (19)tshe 194lo'i bar)1899lor phi khā so pha ri si la song ste ri mo grags can la lad 'bri byas pa red/ 190)gro'i zla 8par yang bskyar pha ri si la slebs pa dang / khong gis tshon mdog sngon po la brten nas gdong mdog rid pa'i mi sna mang po zhig gi snang brnyan bris yod pa dang / 6 sngon po'i dus skabs ’ su khong gis bris pa'i ri mo'i snying don ni sdug bsngal dang skyo gdung zab mos khengs pa'i 'jig rten zhig yin la/ de ru ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyis mthar skyod 3)snang

ba'i mi rkyang mang po zhig rgya lam gyi g.yas g.yon gyang rtsar khums 'dug pa rnams la/ thugs khur dang dbyugs dbyung gnang mkhan med par ma zad/spyi tshogs yongs kyis 'phya smod dang sdang mig mchil zhags kyi 'ben du byed/khong gis dbul po'i nyam chag la byams sems mtshon pa'i 'bus tshab rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos ni〈〈mi tshe〉〉dang〈〈sngo chang btung mkhan〉〉 〈〈'tham 'khyud〉〉 〈〈bu mo spun gnyis〉〉sogs yod/194lo'i dpyid khar/ phi khā so pha ri si yi men mur(06lo)khul du gzhis sdod byas/ byams brtse chos khang mdun du yod pa'i sdod khang rnying gog cig tu bsdad/ de ru khong gi 6 sngon po'i dus skabs mjug rdzogs la/6 glo skya'i dus skabs ’ kyi mgo bcoms/(1904wa 1906) zhi 'jam glo skya ni dus skabs der bris pa'i ri mo'i tshon mdog gtso bor gyur/1906lor/ phi khā so yis a ri'i phyug po skor zhig ngo shes pa dang /de'i khrod kyi gcig ni ha hpho slob grwa chen mo ru gso rig la slob gnyer byed bzhin pa'i ki khri nyi si than(lkoṣṭhaṣṭha lo7)zhes pa'i bud med de red/ring po ma 'gyangs par/ sras mo si than gyis gso rig dor te rtsom rig la sbyang zhing / hpha ran si 'ong / nyin zhig phi khā so yis sras mo si than la bris brnyan zhig bzhengs rgyu'i re ba bton pa na/ kho mo dga' spro'i ngang 'thad mos byung ste/ khong gi ri mo'i khang du thengs 80lhag la bris shing / bris thengs re rer ras yol steng du bzo bcos gang mang byas rjes/ mgo brnyan bsubs par byed de/ khong gi 'dod blo tshim pa zhig mi 'ong bas so/skabs der/ ri mo 'tshong mkhan zhig gis phi khā so'i lag nas snum tshon ri mo nyos te 'grem ston byed par re sgug byas yod/ de bas phi khā so gnas skabs sras mo si than dang gyes te/ yul gzhan du ri mo 'bri ru phebs/thershaswā byer phyir song nas ri mo 'bri ba'i lag len khrod/ khong la ji ltar bde

lcag 'khyug cing spobs pa che ba'i sprug rtse spyad de ri mo la mtshon thabs gsar pa zhig rnyed thabs byed 'os pa'i nges rtogs skyes pas/ khong gis nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi srol rgyun 'bri thabs dang hphe gling gi 'bur bskos sgyu rtsal khrod kyi 'bur brnyan bzhengs thabs zung sbrel byas te 'bur gzugs rang bzhin gyi ri mo 'bri ba'i mgo brtsams la/ gsar rtsom byed thabs de dang spyir btang gi ri mo 'bri thabs dang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/ spyir btang gi ri mo las dngos po de'i ngos dang zur/ steng 'og ma gtogs rgyab ngos sogs mthong mi thub na'ang / 'bur gzugs rang lugs pas dngos po la ngos shin tu mang zhing /mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon steng 'og mi 'dra ba nas bltas na de'i rnam pa'ang mi 'dra bar 'dod pas/ dus dang yul gyi bkag rgya gtor dgos pa dang /snyoms ngos kyi steng nas dngos gzugs kyi ring thung dang zheng tshad/ mtho tshad/zab tshad sogs mtshon te/ dngos po'i nang rol dang mig gis mthong mi thub pa'i sgrig gzhi dag kyang ston dgos pa'i lta ba bton/ de las/ ri mo bas thog mar rang rtos kyi sgo nas dngos po'i rang byung gi rnam pa las brgal te/dngos gzugs de gzugs su ma grub pa'i sul bu mang por phye la/ de nas sil bu de dag che chung mi mnyam pa'i ris dbyibs su bsgyur ba dang / de nas ri mo ba'i dgongs blo ltar du de dag 'bur gzugs ring lugs su ri mo ru sdeb sgrig byed dgos pa'i don bstan/phi khā so phyir pha ri si la log rjes/ 'bur gzugs rang bzhin gyi lag thabs spyad de rang gyi dran sgo la gzhir byas nas sras mo si than gyi brnyan ris bris shing / de sras mo si than la legs skyes su byin te/ phi khā so yis dga' spro'i ngang kho mor 8 khyod nam zhig ri mo'i steng gi kho mo dang 'dra bo 'ong bar nges ’ zhes bshad/1907lor/ phi khā so yis lag thabs de la brten nas〈〈a be nee sdushā gyi

gzhon nu ma tsho〉〉zhes pa'i gsar rtsom mdzad/ khong gis ri mo'i steng gi mi sna'i rang byung gi rnam pa de gtor nas/ mi sna rnams gseg zur gyi sgrig gzhi zhig ltar slar yang bkod sgrig byas shing / mi sna dang dngos po/ lwa ba sogs phung bo re re bzhin bsdabs nas srol rgyun gyi ri mo 'bri thabs de rtsa nas dkrugs/ri mo de 1937lor bslebs pa na da gzod dngos su bkram ston byas/ bkram ston byas rjes mang tshogs kyis gdeng 'jog tshad mthon por gnangs/ ming grags can gyi ri mo de ni phi khā so srol rgyun 'bri thabs nas 'bur gzugs kyi 'bri thabs la phyogs pa mtshon byed gal chen zhig yin/1937lo'i dpyid khar/ si pan rgyal nang gi 'khrug rtsod dza drag tu gyur pa dang / hpho lang gi la rgyab skyor byed mkhan gyi 'jar man bya glag dmag tshogs kyis si pan gyi ker ni kha(7lo7rdo)grong la 'jab rgol byas te mi 1600lhag gi srog 'phrog pa red/ drang bden don gnyer lhag bsam las phi khā so la mes rgyal gyi ched du 'bad 'thab bya rgyu'i 'dun pa byung zhing / khong gis rang nyid kyis gces nyar byas yod pa'i brtsams chos rnams btsong ste ma dngul bsdus pa dang / khong khro'i ngang nas rang nyid kyi drag chas te ri mo'i mtshon cha bsnams te/ 'bad brtson chen po la brten nas〈〈ger ni khu〉〉zhes pa'i ri mo chen po de legs grub mdzad/ 〈〈ker ni kha〉〉zhes pa'i ri mo der/phi khā so yis rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin sgyu rtsal gyi rang gshes bed spyod dang 'phel rgyas su btang yod la/ sa khug rgya mtsho'i khul gyi lha sgrung dang gtam rgyud kyi snang brnyan bed spyad de/ rta dang glang gi 'thab 'dzing gis si pan mi dmangs dang hpha shi si'i dpung shugs bar gyi 'thab 'dzing mtshon yod pa dang /ri mo'i steng mi tshogs kyis/ skyo ba'i smre ngag 'don zhing / srog bsdos kyis 'phag 'tshag rgyag la/ re thag chad pa'i mchi ma 'don pa/ khong khro'i 'o dod kyipa sngi cigatug byed/ ri mo'i khrod/ khong gis 'thab 'khrug dang / 'jigs

skul/ gcan gzan bcas lhan du sbyar yod la/ bud med rnams bgegs dang bar chad kyis gtses pa'i mtshon byed du bzhengs yod la/ mdzes sdug dang stobs shugs kyi dpal yang sbyin yod de/ ri mo'i steng du bud med bzhi yod pa las/ gcig ni sa la 'gyel te ngu 'bod byed pa dang / gcig gis shi zin pa'i byis pa zhig pang du nyar yod la/ gcig ni rang dbang gi lha mo dang mtshungs par mi rnams la 'thab 'dzing gi 'bod skul gtong ba dang / yang gcig gis mgo btegs nas a sngon la dmigs te brjod mi tshar ba'i god chag gtug bsher bgyid do// phi khā so yis mi sems 'gug pa'i ri mo'i skad cha la brten nas ma nyes mnar gcod thebs pa'i mi dmangs la snying rje zol med bstan yod/194lo'i zla 9pa'i nang pha ri si grong khyer la bcings grol thob pa dang /phi khā so hpha ran si gung khran tang nang du zhugs/ 1949lor pha ri si grong khyer du bsdus pa'i 'dzam gling zhi bde srung skyob tshogs chen gyi re ba ltar khong gis phug ron bris yod pa'i rdo brkos ri mo zhig tshogs chen la phul/ de ni 'dzam gling na skad du grags pa'i〈〈zhi bde'i phug ron〉〉zhes pa de red/lo na bgres pa'i phi khā so yis brkos ris mang du bris pa ma zad/ khong gung khran tang yon zhig yin pa'i cha nas spyi tshogs kyi bya 'gul gang mang zhig la'ang zhugs myong yod/phi khā so yi sku tshe gang bor mdzad pa'i gsar rtsom la snam tshon ri mo dang /brkos ris/ skya bris sogs brtsams chos sum khri bdun stong lhag yod/ khong gar phebs sa na ri mos gang yod de/ tha na grogs po'i khyim gyi gyang ngos su'ang khong gi phyag rjes bzhag yod/ khong ni shes yon dang sgyu rtsal sna mang la nang byan chud cing / rtsed mtshar la 'jon sgo che ba zhig kyang yin te/ khyim mi dang grogs po lhan 'dzoms byung dus khong gis ras yol zhig blangs te ༵ snan

ya'i glang 'thab pa 'khrab ston byed la/ dgod bro'i mi sna'i chas su spras te grogs po la par rgyag tu 'jug gal te ri mo khong gi dga' phyogs gtso bo ma yin pa'i dbang du btang na/ khong phul du byung ba'i 'khrab ston pa zhig tu 'gyur yang srid do//1973lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 8nyin hpha ran si'i rlabs che ba'i ri mo mkhan po phi khā so dgung grangs 92bzhes thog pha ri si nas sku gshegs/ khong 'tsho bzhugs skabs su mi rnams kyis bstod smad gang rung gi rnam 'gyur bzung yod na'ang / khong gis khengs skyung gis rgan rabs sgyu rtsal par slob sbyong byed pa dang / si pan ya mi rigs kyi srol rgyun sgyu rtsal la brtsi 'jog dang / ri mo'i phyogs khag so sor slob sbyong / ri mo'i thabs rtsal la rgyun chad med par 'tshol zhib dang tshod lta byas pa sogs ni nga tshos khas len dgos pa zhig red/khong gi thun min gyi khyad chos shig ni 'du shugs che ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi skad cha spyad nas ches gting zab pa'i bsam blo dang / ches sne 'dzing che ba'i brtse sems mngon par mtshon nus pa de yin la/ des nub phyogs deng rabs sgyu rtsal phyogs khag la shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod/ khong gi sgyu rtsal brtsams chos skor zhig la mi rnams kyis go ba len dka' na'ang / khong gi sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa 'tshol rtog dang mi'i rigs kyi yar thon las don thad rang lus 'bul spobs pa'i snying stobs de ni nor bu bzhin gzi mdangs 'od du 'tsher ro//340
